A film about a political radio show host and the strange unconscious degrees of separation between himself and the people that call his show.

synopsis: A picture you'll be proud to tell your friends to see.

In the depths of the city of Buenos Aires there is a strange house where ceremonies and rituals full of occult elements are performed.
A magical tree has a 7 dwarves taking care of it. The tree is bearing money and only good people can take it and prove that the tree has money on it.

The kids at Jefferson Middle School are sick of having it rain their entire summer vacation, all because of June Jackson. You see, June's moods actually control the weather - and June is always in a foul mood.

Based on the Christa Worthington case. An out of work fisherman has an affair with a fashion writer wintering on the Cape. She returns two years later with his child, and when she is murdered, the fisherman is the prime suspect.

When the Coleman's inherit a run down Beach House on a tropical island, sixteen year old Lucy convinces her dad, Charlie, to fix the place up and in the process discover a part of their late Mother's life they knew nothing about.

The young teacher Li Mingguang is to be murdered in the north of China because of having taken the virginity from the young girl Li Pingwa. The whole family wants to take revenge on him for that, even the whole village.
This four story anthology offers a voyeuristic window into the lives of ten gay youths. Follow as they enter a world of the odd, the erotic and the supernatural.
A killer reclining chair becomes enchanted by a girl and starts committing crimes of passion.
Pregnant Reshmi decides not to have the baby after she wins a beauty pageant. But her husband Rohit doesn't agree, so she walks out of the marriage. Now, Rohit must try to win her back.
A group of divers find themselves in deep trouble with a drug lord after they come upon the illicit cargo of a sunken airplane.
When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.
A young rock band visits a deserted house to record their new album but things take a nightmarish turn when their Satanist manager attempts to open the gates of Hell.
A blind man tries to protect a girl from a psycho killer.
When teenage rebel nicknamed "Zero" tries to turn his life around, the events on one early summer's night turn for the worse.
A group of 5 people trying to hide from a terrible threat hanging over them. But they can not hide themselves.

December 2001, a circus bear escapes from his cage and disappears in the mountain. All the same time, a trooper recruit, Arthur, accused of the murder of his friend, escapes in a dark and cold forest.

movie_name: Tuo gu gui jian lang yan
synopsis: A wizard vampire haunts a number of warriors. He has several zombie servants. The warriors must defeat both threats.

When his little brother gets lured into working for a drug dealer boss, a mechanic is forced to join him and winds up torn between both worlds until a female undercover FBI agent proposes a plan to take the dealer down.
The story revolves around Ramesh and his family which dissolves due to a spate of ill-fated events. His sudden imprisonment leads to a drastic situation.
Anand, a wealthy man, spends his time in drinking, gambling and entertaining his friends. When he meets Geetha, a young woman, he is smitten by her and decides to mend his ways.
A Producer's struggle to write a film about being stranded in the Himalayas with a film crew, following a helicopter crash.

Shopping Mall is an edge-of-the-seat crime, suspense thriller that follows three characters just days before a mass shooting in a shopping mall. Who would do this, and why? This film takes a journey into the broken mind of a mass shooter.
A boy trains mutated animals to engage in sexual combat.
This film shows village beauty and culture the giving the younger generation exposure to Konkani culture.
Bandit leader El Diablo who controls the country with his gang plans to achieve gold destined for Mexico but he is not the only one.
An eye for an eye, a life for a life. Vulpes is taking revenge on behalf of those who are defenseless: animals.
A boxer is killed in the ring, and the only clue is a tune that a man was whistling.
Two mothers/wives devise a solution to the downsides of marriage.
Humiliated and down on his luck, a superintendent turns his life around when he decides to write a book.
Japan is plunged into chaos upon the appearance of a giant monster.

Secret agent Devi Titov discovers a syndicate of arms dealers simply called SYNDICATE who orchestrate and perpetuate war and terrorism around the world in order to profit from selling the participants weapons.
A couple living in Victorian London endures an unusual series of psychological and supernatural happenings following the birth of their child.

movie_name: The Revenge of the Defective Pearl
synopsis: This is a story about a young man name Luke Hunter who was thrown off the fishing pier at Hunting Island State Park in South Carolina by his RED-WHITE-BLUE STRIPES FRATERNITY BROTHERS OF THE CAROLINA CLANS in a hazing attempt.
A rebellious teenager, a hardcore gang member, and an idealistic cop risk everything to find their place in the crumbling fabric of modern America.
A British-Chinese takeaway girl discovers artistic bravery and the freedom in forging her own path when a circus comes to her small English town.

A family possessing unique powers after being augmented with by an special DNA creation by NASA. Through an major effect during Earth's aftermath, each family member is given specific super powers, and thus they form a superhero team.

French customs seize seven tonnes of cannabis in the heart of the capital. A former narcotics infiltrator claims to be able to demonstrate the existence of state trafficking led by Jacques Billard, a high-ranking French police officer.
A series of seemingly unconnected events across the world leads to Agent Vinod undertaking a globe-trotting mission to discover why his colleague was murdered.
Mr Tomasz and his friends are looking treasures hidden by the Count on the Island near Vistula.

An adventure movie about a king (Bhosle) who is overthrown by the perfidy of his villainous Commander (Pendharkar). The young prince (Vinayak) defeats the villain, reclaims the throne and restores his father's honour.
When a young woman ends up dead in an LA hotel, her twin sister follows to find out what happened - and discovers the hotel has many more secrets to hide.
Commissaire Letellier and Inspector Moissac are tracking Minos, a serial killer whose victims are women.
The life Of Sheriff Damon Huskey and his manhunt for the man who killed his brother.
A man is tormented by an ex-lover, Lorna, who posseses a strange power over a women, including the man's daughter.

movie_name: The Case of the Scorpion's Tail
synopsis: An insurance investigator tries to determine any irregularities in the policy of a heiress' dead husband, but soon finds himself suspected of her murder.
When the Choi family lose their dry cleaning business, they learn to love each other to survive the crisis and heartaches that they cause each other.
Plagued by a series of apocalyptic visions, a young husband and father questions whether to shelter his family from a coming storm, or from himself.

It's 1906, San Francisco: An unlikely, immigrant couple (she is Chinese, he is Irish) face tremendous social and racial barriers. And then the devastating Earthquake strikes, forcing people of all society to revisit their discriminations.
Jore and Kotze hit the road in search of a buried treasure through the intimate secrets of post communist Bulgaria.
A tale of two different musicians, dramatically different but united in their passion for music, set against the backdrop of the international music industry.
The Earth is being swept by a toad plague. Enter, the lone Samurai, Max Hell (Scott Shaw), the Earth's last hope to save the planet from the mad clutches of Mickey O'Malley (Joe Estevez).
Follows a man who is dropped off, naked, at the Dodger Stadium parking lot and must make it to Long Beach on foot by dawn, otherwise his family will be killed.
Inspector "Dirty" Harry Callahan must stop a sick secret contest to murder local celebrities, which includes himself as a target.
A gang of wealthy ne'er do wells rape and terrorize women for fun and force their husbands to watch. A police detective tries to catch them, but can he break their twisted loyalty to one another?
Leslie, a tightly-wound corporate lawyer, finds the love of her life right under her upturned nose -- and it's her temporary secretary, Fred, which causes her all sorts of embarrassment.

A small group of young misfits with supernatural abilities must band together against an evil tyrant who seeks to capture them for his own selfish gain. Will the help of two former heroes be enough to survive and put a stop to Him?
A story about how synthetic humans can feel and even love and how the people they are involved with react to this concept.
A demonic nun unleashes holy hell when she summons the devil to possess a great white shark.
A couple decides to wed in a historic haunted house where a woman was murdered 30 years before.
A man with a painful secret is caught up by his own past in the Norwegian mountains, when his attempt to escape himself leads to an escape from the law.
The Wiggles throw a surprise party for Dorothy the Dinosaur, while she goes after a magician who takes Greg's magic wand to become popular.

In north-western Canada,in the 1870s,American schooner captain Peter Keith hopes to return to America with a cargo of furs before winter but two local crooks plan to steal Keith's cargo,boat and wife.

In the 1950s, a poor Georgia cotton farmer and his sons search for the gold presumably buried on the farm by their great-grandfather, but problems related to poverty, infidelity, unemployment, and booze threaten to destroy their family.

A story about a night in Ginza where a woman who became a hostess by the hand of a pull-out shop called a woman's police escapes the crisis of being sold abroad and is connected with a person in love for the first time.
The adventure of a rebellious child, running away from his house to an island called Madol Duwa.
After being attacked, an introverted young man must follow clues left by his dead parents in order to figure out who is after him - and who he really is.

When David, in a wheelchair with muscular dystrophy, accurately foretells the death of their fourth grade teacher, a doubtful Lyle decides to test the existence of God by attempting to get David to run again.
When a sole survivor of a fateful hiking trip to the mysterious Dark Peak was taken into police custody, nothing could have prepared them for the horrors they were about to uncover.

The main character of the film-16-year-old Daniyar goes to a new school, where he makes new friends and becomes a member of a hand lead by a feisty guy Vanchopa. They faces serious problems, because they crossed the road of the real mafia.
After a family tragedy and the police unable to help, Emanuelle takes matters into her own hands and unleashes justice on the bad element in a troubled city.
During the Johnson County War in 1890 Wyoming, a sheriff born into wealth does his best to protect immigrant farmers from rich cattle interests.

The landlord of a boarding house in 1923 Tokyo, is keen on spying on the bizarre close encounters taking place beneath his roof. One day he sees a prostitute killing a customer, and decides he's found his soulmate.
A millionaire has his life turned upside down after firing his I.T. consultant.

A pizza delivery boy receives superhuman strength upon ingesting a genetically altered tomato. He must battle a corporation that is trying to steal his powers in order to save both the world and the girl of his dreams.
A Christmastime drama centered around the Whitfield family's first holiday together in four years.
The students are sure their teachers have a fixed mindset, they set out to prove them wrong by documenting how important a growth mindset is. Once the cameras roll, all kind of truths come to light.
After the partners in the LaFontaine Chemical Co. sign a legal agreement leaving their share to the surviving partner(s), two of them are murdered.
After a peace-loving Japanese immigrant and his family become victims of a crime syndicate, a master ninja emerges.
The untimely murder of a New York glamor-girl sparks an investigation with an emotionally driven detective at the helm.
Two children, brother and sister, grow up in a family of alcoholics.

movie_name: Kafir: A Deal with the Devil
synopsis: A family is being haunted by some strange happenings after the death of the father.
A psychic doctor and a paranormal serial killer, both born during a meteor shower, seem destined as arch-adversaries.
The wickedness of Detroit can break a man to the point of no return.

A corrupt D.A. (Thurston Hall) with political ambitions is angered by news stories implicating him in criminal activity and decides to frame the reporter (James Cagney) for manslaughter in order to silence him.

movie_name: The Stalker of Lady Bird Lake Part IV: A Location Scouting Film
synopsis: Kevin Neece shoots a Zombie Life TV location scouting video around Lady Bird Lake in Austin, TX. Unfortunately, Kevin is also out of shape, so his heavy breathing shows up on camera making it look like a first person POV horror film.
Drake gets into a betting game with his best friend, which involves courting the unsuspecting Sophia. When Sophia finally falls for him, Drake must tell her that everything was just a game. A bet.

movie_name: Battle of the Bands: Rock-a-bye Road II
synopsis: Continuing story of Billy & Cricket, 1960s newlyweds, experiencing music career fame and further dangers from the Summer of '59 mystery.

movie_name: Doraemon: Nobita and the Animal Planet
synopsis: What comes to the end of war, unlimited development and environmental destruction.
When a fellow student casts a dark spell using black magic, he unleashes something evil that goes on to terrorize the city's residents.
A couple retreat to Venice to work on their relationship, but an encounter with a stranger leads them into a world of intrigue - where their darkest desires are in reach.
A cowboy doll is profoundly threatened and jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as top toy in a boy's bedroom.
A professional assassin accidentally injures a girl on a hit job. Out of a deep sense of guilt and a need for redemption, he takes on one last job to make things right.

The Eagle uses sky writing to make threats against a corporation. Nathan Gregory owns a traveling fairground and is thought to be the Eagle. Craig McCoy is a pilot who goes looking for the Eagle when Gregory turns up missing.

The story is set in Asura, the dimension of pure desire according to ancient Buddhist mythology. The mythical realm is threatened by a coup from a lower heavenly kingdom and the story follows from there.
An arrogant criminal offers to seduce a woman for his dim, sexually inexperienced partner.
An actor in Hollywood is accused of murder and tries to figure his way out of it.

Tween Mads is having trouble fitting in: he's got a crush on a female classmate--and his clumsy father is a teacher at his school. By an unforeseen chance of events, Mads becomes somewhat of a hero, but will he win the girl?

A young woman who oozes sensuality arrives in a small town and marries the local mechanic. Was it love at first sight? What links her enigmatic presence to the family's piano? Is it curiosity or is it something far more sinister?
In 1877 Western Canada, a police inspector revolts against his inept commander, taking a safer route to the U.S. border in order to stop invading hostile Indians.

The Through Another's Series is a Collection of thrilling stories that expand the 7 deadly Sins of the flesh. Each features a complex psychological element to get people to think about the consequences of their actions or lack thereof.

Dr. Ho the Chinese Consul in Vienna in 1938 issued Exit Visas to many Jews against the instruction of his superiors. Together with Fannia and Bruce they must leave Vienna as the Gestapo is chasing them to get the Jews and Hitler's painting.
Not related to the previous Leprechaun films. Two young couples backpacking through Ireland discover that one of Ireland's most famous legends is a terrifying reality.
After his neighbor's real life murder, an unemployed man goes down the rabbit hole investigating what he believes to be a conspiracy.
An "adults only" retelling of the legend of Zorro.

Chaos embodies the turbulent life of an assassin - from a murder-for-hire plot as a kid to an organizer in a deadly all-female martial arts tournament, all while fighting an all-female assassin squad and psychotic wife along the way.
El Santo is chased throughout 4 centuries by a mysterious masked man called El Encapuchado Negro.

When a group of young adults' random stop at a Texas back-road head shop turns into hell on earth - The five will have to fight to survive against a sadistic family who treasures their marijuana more than human life.

In the 1970s, Om, an aspiring actor, is murdered, but is immediately reincarnated into the present day. He attempts to discover the mystery of his demise and find Shanti, the love of his previous life.
After the cash from a vault is stolen from under their very noses, all hell breaks loose in a desperate fight to find the cash and who stole it.
The showdown of two friends who committed a robbery.
A faceless and ruthless killer struggles tirelessly to hunt and kill ten people over a twenty four-hour period in a setting where not everything is what it looks like.
Rosi is a disturbed teen, the night after her grandmother's burial, Rosi begins to kill her whole family.
A couple's honeymoon turns into a nightmare when an ex-girlfriend returns from the dead to fulfill a promise of undying love.
After awakening from a seemingly terrifying nightmare, Rachel Wilcox slowly begins to discover that she is imprisoned in a seamless virtual simulation designed to study human behavior.
Ben and Jen's relationship is put to test as they embark on a trip of a lifetime to Jen's lifelong dream destination - Iceland.
A young and talented man embarks on an arduous journey to save his family from financial debt.
Mad Villain chronicles the origin of the worlds first real life super-villain.
Teenager Dallas Edwards, and his derelict friends on a quest for the meaning behind a series of mysterious, paranormal events in Southern California.
In a near future world, your memories belong to the corporation that records them.
A group of cave explorers are menaced by giant centipedes.

A good girl is forced to join a dangerous all-girl high school gang, and only her waiter boyfriend and a caring female teacher can possibly help her before it may become too late.

A teen angst thriller at a high school gripped by an apparent curse that claims the life of a senior every year. Story follows a senior, Chrissie, who is skeptical, and another, Tracy, who believes that she may be the next victim.

In an unstable African country, US psychiatrist Martin Cypher teams up with a street-smart poacher to save his patient and her uncle Kingsley, who runs a diamond mine, from some rebels led by white mercenaries, who took them for ransom.

In New York, Donte Toscano is shielded from his mob boss uncle by his Italian parents. His parents die suddenly and his mafioso uncle is his only family. Donte commits a daring heist and becomes an important mafia figure - Joey Roman.
Herbert Von Krantz does whatever it takes to keep the wrong people from finding out about his groundbreaking invention that can incapacitate nuclear bombs.
A rock chick pursues a crime-fighting record mogul and is framed for the mob's bungled hit on his life. Let's rock.
A circus becomes the location for stolen loot and murder.
Silverhide is a horror/thriller film exploring Government conspiracy and secrets too horrifying to imagine.

In order to keep their band together, Ozzie Nelson and his orchestra have been flunking their college final examinations for years. Bob Saunders, the new pianist in the band, agrees to fail...                See full synopsis »

movie_name: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Rodrick Rules
synopsis: A new school year, his brother Rodrick teases him over and over and over and over again. Will Greg manage to get along with him? Or will a secret ruin everything?
A bloody war breaks out on the sea following the abduction of the governor's son by a band of pirates.

Wanting revenge on a street gang for a rape attack, four young girls get together, take kung-fu lessons, learn how to shoot, form a gang called the Black Alley Cats and search out the gang that attacked them.

Alone with her thoughts of the Throne and how the Empire has changed over the years, Milcentia knew that the war had just begun. She had to now live up to her name, The Relentless One, as she mercilessly Defended the Throne.
Set in early 1980s. A murder case happens in a borderland village. Police captain Zhao believes that the case is connected to the former administrator's murder case.
Having lost their MARBLES!, a group of Greeks plan a heist to get them back.
A "support" group of vigilantes band together to seek revenge on those who murdered their loved ones.
A down on his luck Irish immigrant is drawn into the Toronto underworld when he does a favour for the owner of the bar where he works.

Akey, the Christian and Muslim grandfather saves his family feud this winter by transforming into Santa Claus and the Imam on both Cultural holidays so all his grandchildren can celebrate "Christmas Eid" in peace.

OREN a skateboarder in a Dystopia future, comes into self discovery that he is the descendant of a Greek God and is plunged into a battle with a Gothicized Fallen society that wants to turn the outside world into hell on earth.
An engaged attorney and a divorcee fall for each other in 1870s Manhattan.

The families of Raj and Nikita have always maintained a hatred for each other. However, this hatred has not passed on to Raj and Nikita who meet, fall in love and cannot imagine the consequences to come.

Jack Knight deals with the death of his father by looking through his old possessions. While saying one last goodbye to his father Jack starts gaining mysterious powers. Meanwhile, an evil scientist wants to destroy the city.

movie_name: Gekijouban Toaru majutsu no indekkusu: Endyumion no kiseki
synopsis: In a futuristic metropolis full of super-powered students, Kamijo, Index and their allies use sorcery and science to keep Arisa, a level 0 girl, safe.

After receiving word of his estranged mother's untimely passing, a reluctant former army lieutenant must travel to a secluded town in the Pacific Northwest to unlock the mystery surrounding her suspicious death.
A desperate neuroscientist races to save his dying wife by using his groundbreaking neuro-technology, Synapse, to enter her dreams.
A squad of young American soldiers stationed on a distant planet encounter an alien attack.

A psychiatrist, living in Vienna, enters a torrid relationship with a married woman. When she ends up in the hospital from an overdose, an inspector becomes set on discovering the demise of their affair.
Clare is exploring current discoveries of dinosaur blood when an old friend turned journalist suggests she take a field trip to track down and find evidence of some dinosaurs allegedly still alive.
When a shopping mall is taken over by a gang of organized crooks, it's up to a mild-mannered security guard to save the day.
A Nazi spy passes himself off as an optometrist in San Francisco's waterfront district. Someone robs him of his codebook, and he must get it back.

A 20 year old, runs away from his conservative father to the remote town where his mother died two years ago. He meets an alluring young woman. They search for answers about his mother's death and discover a terrifying entity in the woods.

An unassuming karate instructor, with the help of his movie star sister, accept the challenge to meet a really bad villain in the fighting ring and attempt to stop him and his unscrupulous crime bosses in their tracks.
Roland has made decisions with a die since his 8th birthday. Now an insurance investigator, he uses it at work.
A young woman goes on a quest to collect people's emotions in hopes it will allow her to feel something for the first time in her life.
A husband-and-wife pair of retired cult deprogrammers experience marital strife when their past catches up with them.
A phobic man's dreams begin to come true.
A banker and his housekeeper are brutally assassinated by a gangster. The murders are arranged so that they may look like a showdown between two victims.
A newlywed couple is terrorized by a consumer drone that has become sentient with the consciousness of a deranged serial killer.

When 14-y.o. Kamaria Cassiopeia "KC" Cannon discovers her grandmothers ancient Sapphire pendant and the family secret it holds, she uses its magical powers to travel through time with her best friend to save those once lost to history.
A political satire of Bangladesh under the rule of Pakistan metaphorically, where an autocratic woman in one family symbolizes the political dictatorship of Ayub Khan in East Pakistan.

Locked in her flat for several years, a reclusive young woman stumbles upon a mysterious web community. According to an urban myth, the Suicide Club grants death to those wishing for it. Unless these "cyber suicides" are actually murders.

At the start of the 20th century, a man lives in solitude on an island. One day on the mainland, he saves a young woman from some nasty folk and takes her with him to his island. Her former captors soon find the island as well.
A detective is tasked to capture an elusive thief called Arsene Lupin.
Jed gets two of his girlfriends to set up some of their old boyfriends to be robbed. He robs them and all of the money he gets ends up being Snu-Tilly's. Snu-Tilly goes after revenge
When humanity had not yet developed elaborate languages, there were already love and jealousy, and rivalry and war.
A lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

Voyeurs is an Norwegian drama thriller about psychic men. It is an independent production and shot on DV. The story is about a psychic man, Samuel who falls in love, but his ability gets in the way of an ordinary life.
Ready to catch a train to his hometown, a washed-up boxer tells us about the strange and twisty events that happened to him the past couple of days.

movie_name: Wraith of the Umbra and Eidolon
synopsis: For endeavors long ago, two friends travel to an island resort that specializes in rebirth, overseen by a lonely spirit who divide their stay into three stages.

Claudia and Georg Rattey have everything they might wish for. But their contentedness does not turn into happiness but into an inner void, when they discover a ten-year old burglar in their half-finished vacation home.
A kind-hearted street clown tries to charm his childhood sweetheart.
An unborn baby teams up with a group of angels to meet her future parents.

To kill was the only choice K-7 could make to save his brother, but when his reason for living is shattered by the act of betrayal, his only choice is to face the organization with the one skill they ever taught him.

movie_name: Guardians of Night: The Demon Hunting Academy
synopsis: "DAGENGREN" named Ye Yan loves performance art, he attended Xia Hou College where he met a "LINGQIZHE" and a "SANXIAN" . However zombies suddenly attacked school, "a battle for the crystal" to recover the world peace started.
During World War II, a mail clerk turned code breaker is thrust into the C.I.A. to stop a squad of Nazi saboteurs from destroying the U.S on its own soil.

movie_name: Oops, Ups & Downs: The Murder Mystery of Humpty Dumpty
synopsis: An elite member of society's egg-shaped body was found on the west side of town. The mystery of his death investigated by a fantasy township in 1945.

Juki is a popular celebrity until one mistake turns him into number one public enemy. But then, a fallen meteor is threatening to destroy Indonesia and a talented young scientist asks Juki's help to stop the meteor together.
Three very powerful brother witches fight to restore the balance of power in the world while dealing with a mired of everyday teenage issues.
Romeo and Juliet story set amidst horse racing in Kentucky. The family feud of lovers Jack and Sally goes back to the Civil War and is kept alive by her Uncle Peter.
A nightclub performer whose act incorporates bizarre sadomasochistic elements begins to lose her grip on reality, and is plunged into a nightmarish mental landscape.

movie_name: Aleya's Tango: Dreams of a Vampyre
synopsis: Getting leads from strangers and dreams, a P.I. searches San Francisco and Buenos Aires, Argentina, for an exotic and mysterious Tango dancer with a second but hidden identity potentially linked to her disappearance.
Gandharva Kumar reveals a long-forgotten secret wherein he claims to be heir to the family property to Ratanlal Babu.

This retelling of the Hans Christian Andersen classic fairy tale has the digit-sized heroine evading the clutches of various toads, moles, and beetles before she can proceed with her courtship with her dream lover, Prince Cornelius.
A young woman who cannot be alluded to.
In a village where the sea and the moon are near, there was a monster, three witches, many ghosts and a shipwrecked man.

Local L.A. homeless man, Oscar, has an uncanny ability to predict Oscar winners. Young U.S. studio exec, Rosemary (Anne Hathaway type) must find out how he does it at any cost, leading to a buddy travel adventure in a 1955 Crown Vic.
A successful fishing businessman, fakes his own death, in order to give his arrogant and proud children a life lesson.

One evening, a guy sees a girl in a café for the first time, straightaway he is drawn into her. And when a mysterious man who seems to be stalking the girl shows up, he becomes a protector of the girl. But it turns into a real nightmare for him.
Dixon patrols the US/Mexican border. He's recognized from years ago in an LA gang. The gang needs his help smuggling drugs across the border and holds his wife and daughter hostage.
Embarrassed about his identity and culture, a meek Indian high-schooler decides to attend an American university. But in doing so, he causes a rift in his fundamentalist family.
A thriller by film director-writer Miguel Cohan. A deadly duel within a family where there can be no winners.

Trespassing gang of boys encounter a ghost in the ruins of a castle. When they rescue the ghost who is caught in a trapset, they become allies in a fight to prevent ruins from being turned into mushroom farm by the city authorities.

In the mid-nineties, a young writer, victim of AIDS, wants to ensure from the beyond that his lover receives a camera with supernatural powers, hoping that this will revive his lover's will to live and connect with him.
Random Snippets of people going through their daily routines, the eternal story.
Jerry Mason, a young Texan, and Jake Benson, an old rancher, become partners and strike it rich with a gold mine. They then find their lives complicated by bad guys and a woman.

In a blackly satirical near future, a thriving industry sells celebrity illnesses to their obsessed fans. Employee Syd March's attempts to exploit the system backfire when they involve him in a potentially deadly mystery.

A married man in his fifties who has lost all interest in his wife suddenly meets Juliette, a young woman. She reignites love in his life but triggers violent arguments with his wife. Their indifference soon turns into chaos.
After his family is killed by a terrorist act, a firefighter goes in search of the one responsible.
Four friends whilst on a weekend break in the Scottish Highlands unearth such evil proceedings, that their faith in humanity will be transformed for life... however short that may be.
Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe, and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.
Plot currently under wraps.
A Mother loses her job before Christmas and, in an effort to get the gift her son always wanted, she makes questionable decisions that she will have to make right.
Timo leaves the busy citylife on a search for his mother in the dutch countryside, after his father told him (on his deathbed) that he has another mother .
Who made them sinners - war or society? there are thirteen answers in 13 Hudas.
Millionaire JOHN, takes his wife BETH on vacation. Assassin is on their trail, and BETH has been shot. Later, only to find out it's not all that it seems!.
Dynamic duo, Jess and Lauren, embark on a late night robbery. Upon arrival, The lovers receive more attention then they bargained for - What could possibly go wrong? Apparently, everything.
A horror-mystery-thriller exploring the unknown, the unexplained, and the unimaginable, with eight intertwined stories on life, death, regret, and atonement.
While running for her life, a witness with fragmented memories of a brutal murder crosses paths with a reluctant criminal in the midst of a heist gone wrong.
A young woman meets and falls in love with a young man who is part of a family of immortals.

Annie who accidentally takes her mom's laptop instead of her own to visit her father in New Jersey. Annie soon realizes the laptop is everything she needs to pose as her mom for the day, repairing her parents' marriage.

movie_name: Those Who Kill: Shadow of the Past
synopsis: A forensic psychiatrist decides to change work. Days before leaving, a case of 5 shot on a Copenhagen city bus might involve an old patient of his. Other murders follow. He can't stop before the case is solved.
John Jack, an American agent working for the French Foreign Legion during World War II, is sent on a dangerous mission to stop Adolf Hitler from stealing the White Stone of Mecca.
After their satellite crash lands on Alpha Centauri, Two astronauts brave the cosmos to retrieve their data, only to be met by a tribal race of aliens on a planet that's running out of time
How the lives of the residents of a bungalow court intertwine with each other and the court's mean, nasty owner.
A wannabe superhero struggles to help his village fight back against the evil corporation behind his father's death.

Marcus awakens to find his apartment under quarantine and completely isolated from the outside world. He tries to navigate the way through the indefinite wait - staving off hunger, boredom, and paranoia.

movie_name: Macross Frontier: The Wings of Goodbye
synopsis: A young stunt pilot named Alto Saotome's life is changed after he joins SMS, a military company on the Frontier. By some fate, Alto begins to fall for the galactic idol, Sheryl Nome, along with his friend and rising pop star, Ranka Lee.

Terrified and bloody, Oscar Svendsen awakes clinched to a shotgun in a strippers joint. Around him 8 dead men, and police aiming at him. To Oscar it's clear that he is innocent. It all started when four chaps won 1,7 million on the pools...
After years of being tread upon and cheated on, a man awakens to find his face has a been replaced by a blank, white mask.
Eco-Thriller - plot being kept under wraps.

After Wu Hao dies from a brain tumor, Professor Pang transplants the brain of Wang Jiapei, an ordinary farmer, into Wu's body. Therefore, Wang resurrects with a new identity and lives a life that does not belong to him.
During one of Oregon's most violent storms, a young cellist seeks solitude and comfort in the safety of her large apartment, but soon realizes she might not be home alone.
A young man is hired to drive a truckful of crates into a remote area and is told that once there he only has to do one thing, wait until daybreak.
After stumbling on a unique opportunity a group of nerdy sorority girls, with the help of their slutty friend, find out how the men of their college measure up.
A mystery about three friends who get caught up in a series of bizarre events.

movie_name: The Island at the Top of the World
synopsis: In 1907, four explorers discover a lost colony of Vikings in the Arctic.

movie_name: Shao Lin san shi liu ban deng
synopsis: 37 children of Shao Lin Temple are descendants of the glorious Ming Clan and are under threat from a notorious and ambitious Ching Clan leader. They must learn the ways of the Buddha and battle the Ching Clan to a standstill.
An Iraq war veteran robs a drug deal only to find he has accidentally injured a young girl who was part of the deal.
A science professor travels to another dimension in search of his daughter who's been missing for 3 years.
The story of a woman who lost her heart to someone else after the loss of her husband.
After a series of gruesome attacks on local livestock, and the ritualistic killing of the county sheriff, a cadre of Texas Rangers are dispatched to restore law and order to the territory.
The Universe has been "watching" longer than we can possibly imagine.
In a post-apocalyptic world, six soldiers on a covert mission must transport a mysterious package across a frozen archipelago. Noomi Rapace stars.
Plot kept under wraps.
An invisible scientist escapes from an asylum and teaches high-school physics to nubile teens.

Following the murder of his father, little Bruno is raised by his Uncle Nick, a crime boss. Growing up with the mob, Bruno joins the family business and finds himself tangled up in a web of murder and more murder.
Politicians Bikash and Nagen are at loggerheads due to their contradicting personalities. Nagen's man attack Bikash in the presence of the media, which ultimately leads to a bitter scandal.

LA PI Marco Defalco takes one last case against his wife's ultimatum, the hell she was afraid of quickly becomes her reality and is unleashed on the criminals that crossed paths with the right PI on the wrong day.
A young couple's first road trip together takes a disastrous turn when they follow a GPS into Death Valley.
The greatest love story ever told...with fingers.
Two different people - the son of a prostitute, and the son of a professional musician - develop a bond of friendship through their love of playing the piano.
A young lady cop tries to solve a murder mystery and why it is happening.
A gang of criminals and corrupt cops plan the murder of a police officer in order to pull off their biggest heist yet across town.
With no response from Alpha team, a second unit is sent to investigate. Upon discovering a huge mansion in the middle of the vast wooded island, their mission only gets more bizarre.
After killing his employer when said employer tries to cheat him out of his payment, a man becomes an outlaw and starts following a self-proclaimed saint.
When Belo Monte dam displaces an indigenous girl, she must rely on a white man to save her people - although he is the key to their destruction.
Black Aura on an Angel is a romance thriller that depicts the devastating effects of a woman's mental illness on a blossoming love affair.
In addition to his passion for red roses, Count Henri de Verlaine adores wooing all the women he meets.
A British Army Captain serving in 19th century Ireland must save his kidnapped daughter.
A Coast Guard mate (Victor McLaughlin) wants his daughter (Ida Lupino) to marry a crewman (Donald Woods), but she loves someone else (Preston Foster).
A boy and his dog with bionic powers save a small town from two bumbling crooks.

The wife of a galactic dictator makes the decision to leave her husband and take her three kids: Aine, Adam, and Puck, to her home world. But the dictator husband, with armies at his disposal, isn't going to let her go without a fight.

After Carlos - a 12-year-old whose father has died in the Spanish Civil War - arrives at an ominous boys' orphanage, he discovers the school is haunted and has many dark secrets which he must uncover.

In a future world of scientific advances, humans share every aspects of their lives with their machines. But when a leading scientist and his team build an advanced prototype cyborg, the scientists aren't prepared for the consequences.
An art teacher is hired as nanny for 2 orphans, a boy and girl, at a huge, isolated country estate. The nanny starts seeing dead, former employees. Is she mad or is the estate haunted?
A group of adventurers are gathered together to retrieve some mystical gems which are in the possession of a deadly cult.
A young man falls in with a society whose principle is a complete disregard for work, and chaos ensues when the society decides to help run the hotel of his father.
Anna, a young 8-year-old girl, begins to have unexplained nightmares; as they intensify, the family turns to their local priest for help.
It follows Kara Zor-El's story and her darker origin before she finally made her way to Earth.
Look at dark dirty seedy world of prostitutes in brothel and high society rich feeding off them. A struggle of a prostitute trying to raise her illegal child with dignity.
The Straw Hat Pirates come to Gran Tesoro, the richest ship in the world.

movie_name: Fairy Tales Can Come True: The Beginning
synopsis: Fairy Tales Can Come True: The Beginning is Linda S. Gunn's poignant novel about growing up, sibling love, and discovery.

Dad is to take the 5 kids to Egypt but the plane leaves without him. They can't enter Egypt without an adult supervisor; their neighbor agrees to take them but she wants to visit museums and the kids want to swim and see the camel race.
"Left to the Imagination" is a sexy new film which features hot models from all around the world acting out various fantasies and erotic scenarios.

movie_name: Mermaid: The Lake of the Dead
synopsis: An aquatic nymph falls obsessively in love with a man and wants to have him with her forever in her underwater kingdom, where she is doomed to spend eternity.

After Wonderland, Alice dreams of going to Paris. A mouse named Francois, the grandson of Anatole, agrees to take her there if she will tell him her favorite cheese. Along the way they share several stories.
In the devastated urban landscape of Mexico City, in the course of a day, the lives of a handful of characters intertwine.

An action crime comedy set in the last days of communism in Poland, a story of folk-hero thief, who escaped 29 times from cops. Naymro was living on his own terms against the system. But love and collapsing Berlin Wall changed everything.
A woman battling addiction is given a chance at redemption if she accepts Death's offer.
A group of friends navigate the seven spiritual plains between heaven and hell.
Aqua, a young woman who aspires to be a performance artist, drifts through the sun drenched milieu Santa Monica, CA, finding love, loss and herself along the way.
Shivarudraiah is haunted by a series of nightmares in which he sees his daughter Namana, a daring journalist die of an accident.
Giaccomo is a forty-year-old who works at a company in Milan. To avoid working on weekends, he lies about having girlfriend whose character he creates based upon a girl he sees every morning.
AN 11 YEAR OLD GIRL FINDS HERSELF IN THE MIDDLE OF A ZOMBIE INVASION AND SHE MUST BATTLE TO SURVIVE THE ONSLAGHT OF THE UNDEAD
A police officer gets embroiled in a deadly game with drug mafia, while searching for his long lost friend from London.

Bug wants to be a Starship Ranger, but there's one thing they are he's not... human! On a far off world, one small alien bug sets out to find love and save the universe! So get ready because the Future is Now!
"A promise to her dead mother is all that 10 year old Crystal has left. Will she break it to save herself, or keep it and be sold again?"
Four kids find a WWII battle tank on one of the historic battle sites. They start playing and - find themselves back in the time of war in the middle of a battle.

movie_name: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
synopsis: The fragile peace between apes and humans is threatened as mistrust and betrayal threaten to plunge both tribes into a war for dominance over the Earth.
A goblin helps a miller's daughter spin straw into gold, asking in return for her first child, in this amusing 'teaching play' about greed, envy and helpfulness.

Emiliano Saudado is a writer who goes to a small village in the Italian to collect information about some popular legends. Saudato looks for some details about the legend of the "Seeds of God". He will discover a terrible truth.
The effete son of a cantankerous riverboat captain comes to join his father's crew.
A young singer's chance at fame is threatened by his hoodlum pals.
After a comet releases a mysterious virus that begins to kill all the women in the world, a young couple hides out in their over-sterilized apartment trying to fight for their lives.

Centers on Aydis, a young female viking, a warrior, an outcast, and a self-proclaimed "heathen". Born into a time of warfare, suffering, and subjugation of women, she is on a mission to end the oppressive reign of the god-king Odin.
A three-part anthology film exploring juju (magical) stories rooted in Nigerian folklore and urban legend, written and directed by the Nigerian new wave cinema collective known as Surreal16.
The son of a murderer is entangled in his father's crimes and is sentenced to a rehabilitive farm, where he learns a new way of life.
Jai, a police officer embarks on the mission to eliminate his enemies, who destroyed his life.

When Andres and his partner are hired to recover some valuables from an airplane that went down in the Bermuda Triangle, they face not only human treachery but also the mysterious powers of an underwater civilization.

Four young outsiders teleport to an alternate and dangerous universe which alters their physical form in shocking ways. The four must learn to harness their new abilities and work together to save Earth from a former friend turned enemy.
Two sworn motorcycle club rivals collide when a young leader breaches forbidden love crossing long feuding ties between the two clubs.
An introspective young girl falls for the new boy in class, an outcast who is also a hemophiliac.
A solitary man struggles when trying to discern reality, dream, and memory. The path to clarity lies in discovering his past.
A newly minted detective is forced to endure hopeless odds when pit against the works of a brutal and merciless visionary killer. What gruesome horrors await inside of Unit 312?
Desperate for money to save his sick Grandfather, a South Texas farmhand resorts to the extreme: He breaks his own arm to smuggle a cast made of cocaine across the Mexican border.

An adventurer who dreams of becoming a circus performer encounters a group of unusual creatures that he previously considered only heroes of myths and legends. He creates a circus troupe from them to put on the most incredible show.
A college freshman becomes obsessed with the previous owner of his school issued laptop.
Plot kept under wraps. Described as an action comedy.
A shy withdrawn country lad is watching Global Citizens music video Broken Doll over and over and he becomes fixated on the girl starring in the video.
A chemist (Garcia) loses his job to outsourcing. Two years later and still jobless, he hits on a solution: to genuinely eliminate his competition.
A secret society kidnaps a man to force his sister to steal plans.
Promising to make a delivery for a dying man, the blind swordsman Zatoichi comes across the usual crime gangs but also meets a blind monk who brings into question his use of violence.
A prank goes terribly wrong and a demon is unleashed upon an all-girls school.
A story between a mole in the police department and an undercover cop. Their objectives are the same: to find out who is the mole, and who is the cop.
Jefri's wife, Dilaila, goes missing on their vacation and when she is found, he discovers the woman is not her even though she insists that she is.
A team of gifted teens control biological nanobot robots warriors and they battle another group that is controlled by conjoined twins whose nanobots are brainwashing world leaders.
A drifting gunslinger-for-hire finds himself in the middle of an ongoing war between the Irish and Italian mafia in a Prohibition era ghost town.
An erotic love triangle revolving around a writer adrift in the icy slopes of Kashmir where he discovers a woman with a strange, silent past.
In a post-nuclear holocaust world, a three nomadic men are accosted by a group of five murderous women living in a secluded farmhouse.
A group of researchers from Earth travel in a spaceship to Mars, where, to big surprise, they find a peaceful vegetarian and pacifist civilization.

movie_name: Raiga: The Monster from the Deep Sea
synopsis: When the Earth's ecosystem is disrupted due to global warming, a plethora of prehistoric sea monsters wage war on Japan. Led by the powerful Raiga, the monsters ravage the city of Asakusa.

In 1985 where former superheroes exist, the murder of a colleague sends active vigilante Rorschach into his own sprawling investigation, uncovering something that could completely change the course of history as we know it.
An heir, framed by his cousin for killing his father, breaks jail and saves his wife from a fire.

A federal agent is assigned to get the inside scoop on a dangerous terrorist group. In order to blend into their ranks, he's forced to fake his own death and make friends with the group's deadly but charismatic leader.
The movie is based on the comic book character of the same name.
A Finnish midwife falls in love with a German-Finnish SS-officer during the Lapland War, in the middle of WWII.
Henry Aldrich becomes the most sought after guy in town when he wins a date with a movie star.
After her grandmother dies, a young woman decides to find her mother who abandoned her when she was a baby.
The son of a Viking king forms a company to save the woman he loves from a sisters betrayal and a ravenous evil no man has ever encountered before.
A teacher helps a boy become better behaved.

Thirty years after a boy's disappearance, a journalist revives interest in the case, which in turn compels the victim's brother to look for this woman's daughter in the snowy hinterlands of northern Japan.

Trapped in a vicious cycle, three drug pushers who want out, find themselves forever indebted to a hardened drug kingpin, who, in turn, is dependent on the protection of a corrupt police officer. Can they escape from the inevitable?
A lifeboat crew discovers millions of euros worth of drugs on a fishing boat off the coast of Ireland.
A mad scientist changes his simple-minded handyman into a werewolf in order to prove his supposedly crazy scientific theories - and exact revenge.

1960 Lacedon Jungle in Mexico. Coatis Manu and Sacha are best friends. However, mischievous Manu is exiled from the empire for breaking a statue ordered to be made by the king, then girlfriend Sacha is captured by hunters.
Revolves around how the journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step and explores love and life.
An unspeakable traumatic incident from the past and subsequent cover-up, send young star-crossed lovers, Pax and Gianna, down a dark and precarious path fraught with insecurity and self-destruction.
Prequal to Cotton Candy Girl

In this darkly comedic and uniquely angsty journey, twelve vignettes chronicle a young woman's inner monologue as she visits various NYC beaches in hopes of fulfilling her dream of being eaten by a shark.
A newly-possessed high-school cheerleader turns into a succubus who specializes in killing her male classmates. Can her best friend put an end to the horror?

When their home is haunted by a dream spirit, it's up to Whiskers to figure out what is haunting them and how to send the ghost to the other side. She'll use ghost hunting, the Nekkomeownicon, and Wally's credit card to get the job done.
A mother struggles to keep things under control as her daughter dies of cancer, her estranged father suddenly returns, and her faith in God is put to the test.
A couple is abducted by aliens. After they are released, they are hounded by both the media and government agents trying to discover what they might have learned about the aliens.

Drones are used in agriculture to optimize production and as sentinels. An employee discovers a connection between his job assisting in suicides and his employers' ownership of the drone manufacturing.

movie_name: Night of the Day of the Dawn of the Son of the Bride of the Return of the Terror
synopsis: The makers of this parody of "Night of the Living Dead" took George Romero's classic and wiped the soundtrack clean, then redubbed it with comedic dialogue.

Deeply affected by the death of a schoolmate, Emilia, a senior student with the ability to see people close to death glowing, begins a romantic relationship with Renata, a laid back girl who will make her question the way she lives.
Sami goes back in time to try and fix the mistake that resulted in his mother's death.
After running away fails, a terrified woman empowers herself in order to battle her abusive husband.
A troubled teen joins a gang to seek vengeance for the death of his brother.
Young museum curator, Isabelle, is sent to inspect a part of what seems to be a strange crucible buried near an eerie old manor.

movie_name: Kiss Me at the Stroke of Midnight
synopsis: A stern young girl who yearns for romance, finds herself involved with a celebrity whose image reveals a hidden persona.
When moral standings are laying down, saints and sinners are one in the same.
A group of bank robbers find their multi-million dollar plan interrupted by a hard-boiled detective.

movie_name: Once Upon a One More Time
synopsis: Cinderella, Snow White and other fairy tale princesses form a book club when a rogue fairy godmother drops Betty Friedan's landmark feminist novel "The Feminine Mystique".
As a rage inducing zombie like virus sweeps Britain, a small group must find answers in order to survive. But the truth may be more than any of them can handle.
An acerbic, scooter-bound mother in small town America discovers her estranged son has died while climbing Mount Everest and decides to honor his memory by training to summit the mountain herself.
Shiva meets Parvatha and the couple falls in love. However, misunderstandings weaken their bond and forces Parvatha to rethink about their relationship.
Wrongfully accused of murder in Mexico, a Florida blogger relies on his camcorder footage to prove his innocence.

Several tourists get lost and decide to seek help in an old basement, they don't know but they are invading the place of a hermit murderer, who has the power to turn its victims into guts and bloodthirsty monsters.
A couple of dimwitted criminals rob a bank, and a murder is left without a trace as detectives try to investigate the case.

A Bosnian girl Mother dies of Cancer. She must move on and help her Dad take care of her Sister with the help of her Aunt. She must also accepting her Dad moving on. The hardest lesson is letting go of her mother.
A young Celtic warrior and a hermit wizard must unite to defeat an evil druid.
Garth, the legendary Starfleet captain, and his crew during the Four Years War with the Klingon Empire.

movie_name: San Martín: El cruce de Los Andes
synopsis: The story follows a 15-year-old Manuel Corvalán, who decides to leave his upper-class family and be disinherited by his father to join the newly formed Army of the Andes, commanded by the General José de San Martín.
Five high school friends are about to graduate from the human race.

Set in the year 2340, the film follows Katherine McDonald, journalist and the only person to survive the destruction of a mining colony. Convinced the government was behind the disaster, she embarks on a mission to uncover the conspiracy.
When a talented actress fails to land the role of her dreams, she becomes obsessed with the up-and-comer who gets the part.
The love between a father and son is pushed to the limits.
A feature film inspired by Alex Panagopoulos' drawing of a teddy bear defending a young, sleeping child from an approaching monster.
A burglar falls for an heiress as she dies in his arms. When he learns that he has the gift of reincarnation, he sets out to save her.
First Czech movie made in 3D is a political mysterious thriller without suspense, in which organ transplantation serve as allegory of political manipulation.
A team of paranormal investigators return to the Steelmanville Road property to make a documentary about what happened there.
A Polish rabbi wanders through the Old West on his way to lead a synagogue in San Francisco. On the way, he is nearly burned at the stake by Native Americans and almost killed by outlaws.
After a tragedy, John Ingram and his wife Rae are spending some time isolated at sea, when they come across a stranger who has abandoned a sinking ship.

A 24 y.o. wrestler/McJobroni man meets a mom 20+ years older at group therapy for family of murder victims (sister and husband). He helps her deaf teenage son. She invites him to weddings. They await convictions on the murder trials.

movie_name: Santi Clo... La vaina de la Navidad
synopsis: Unemployed and abandoned by his wife and daughter because of poverty, Nicolás luckily gets a part-time job dressing up as Santa Claus in a mall. But his life takes a complicated turn when mistakenly he finds a bag full of money.

A covert military airstrike against rebels in the tiny Mideastern nation of El Alahaim goes wrong, leaving one pilot dead and another in enemy hands. A second, more dangerous mission is planned to rescue the captive pilot.

movie_name: Sala sa init, sala sa lamig
synopsis: A suave ex-cop and a sassy pickpocket are finding it difficult to co-exist as neighbors. Although they may have to team up to take down an assassin who's on a killing spree.
Thomas and Stéphane are happy as lovers but feel that they need to adopt a child to make their lives more complete.

Deals with beautiful girl who, through no fault of her own, leads a double life. Her inherited love for pearls brings her in conflict with great detective. He effects her reform and wins her love. Mystery melodrama.

The battle-scarred hero of the Greek Revolution, Giannos "Astrapogiannos", returns home after the end of the blood-soaked War of Independence, only to find himself in a new conflict, as he locks horns with a ruthless local Kodjabashis.
A 16-year-old girl travels to the human world in the form of a dolphin and forms a connection with a human boy.
Welcome to the world of Dangar Doctor Jelly where chaos reigns when Ravinder Grewal's in-laws pay him a visit at his house. What follows next is utter confusion and a laugh riot.
An aspiring politician uses her brother's murder as the turning point in her campaign, in order to win a State's election.
Tori stalls adulthood out of fear of leaving her single mother in their small town.

Ji Mo is regarded as an outlier because she can see monsters. One day, she sees a monster in the supermarket and meets a monster hunter, Meng. She discovers that there really are monsters in the world, and she is involved in a new storm.
A young couple try to free an imprisoned child with catastrophic results.
If all machines were annihilated we should become extinct in six weeks.
A family traveling from Kolhapur to Mumbai will face many ups and down before they reach their destination.
In this family classic, two orphans cross the Rocky Mountains in search of their heritage. The couple forms an uncertain alliance with a drifter and embarks on the adventure of a lifetime together.
A young boy just short of a monster is adopted by a loving man and his wacky wife. The laughs keep coming as the boy pushes them to the limits.
An alien from another dimension lands on earth to fight the "Great Evil" that has been unleashed on it.
Plot kept under wraps.
The adventurous journey of the prince Yashodhavardhana to save Padmavathi from a wicked wizard and also to bring back his father's vision.
The fairy tale in which the hero finds out once that his personal shadow has begun to live own life.

movie_name: The Girl in the Red Velvet Swing
synopsis: The Girl in the Red Velvet Swing is the true story of Evelyn Nesbit (Dame Joan Collins), a beautiful showgirl caught in a love triangle with elderly architect Stanford White (Ray Milland) and eccentric young millionaire Harry K. Thaw (Farley Granger).
Four ladies end up taking on a cleaning job in a building that is haunted. The night gets more interesting as it gets later on and things start to happen, will any of them survive?
Three girlfriends on a weekend getaway get trapped in an abandoned amusement park with sinister plans.
The most spectacular motion picture your eyes will ever see.
A manager tells to a fictitious assembly a story that arrived to him during his last business trip in the Dead Sea with the aim of lay the employees who listen to him off.

When the hero wakes up, he learns that he has spent 60 years in a deep sleep and has not aged. Fragments of memories lead him along the path of the expedition of the 1960s, where he went with the team.

movie_name: Lone Wolf and Cub: Baby Cart in the Land of Demons
synopsis: Five warriors challenge Ogami to duels. Each holds a part of information needed to complete the assassination of a mad clan leader.
A biopic based on the life of one of the pioneer argentine rock stars 'Tanguito'. The movie tells the story of his rise and fall from grace, encompassed in violent times of a military regime.
The lives of a hoodlum, businessman, a law student and a woman are deeply affected by the greed for power.

In Russia, vigilante groups lure gay men and abduct them in order to "out" them, humiliate them, often torture them. And these gangs capture the encounters on video to post on social media. In LURED, one group decides to turn the tables.

To prove his brother's innocence, undercover officer Nick enrolls in high school again, dealing with crushes, bullies, humiliations, popularity swings, and quirky teachers and staff to find the real murderer.

Two young girls used to play Serpents and Ladders. One of them always won, but they are very close friends. When they grow up, the winner is still the lucky one in the game of life, but life can be treacherous...
Follows the story of several characters whose life constantly interact and in their very own way mutually influence each other.
Convict Kramer manages to escape from prison. Before leaving for Switzerland, he wants to take revenge on Kwinto, the man who sent him to jail.
From the moment the new Reverend climbs the pulpit, Liz knows that she and her family are in great danger.

Bai Yu Lung's father mysteriously disappears one night, and for 10 years Bai searches for him in vain. Finally, he decides to head to the far northern part of the country with the hope that he can find a clue in that region.
It tells the story of Dilara and Yusuf, who went to look for treasure in a plateau.

This near-silent black and white film from Argentina tells the story of a city that has lost its voice, stolen by Mr. TV, and the attempts of a small family to win the voice back. Similar in design to early German expressionist films.
The Moldovan commissioner has to solve the case of a robbery of the central bank, with the help of Petrescu, a novice partner.
Rodney is a mouse who's always dreamed of dancing. Now, he's about to make his dream come true. He's gonna dance in front of the entire world of mice so he must prepare.
Updated version of a 19th century romance set on an island in the Finland archipelago sea.

movie_name: Anubis en de wraak van Arghus
synopsis: To celebrate Appie's birthday, the Anubis residents rent an old haunted house. However, strange things start to happen here when the friends disappear one at a time..
A female vampire must bathe in the blood of virgins in order to stay alive. The trouble is that virgins are in short supply nowadays, and she is running into major problems in finding one.

movie_name: Raggedy Ann & Andy: A Musical Adventure
synopsis: Raggedy Ann and Andy leave their playroom to rescue Babette, a beautiful French doll kidnapped by pirates.
A group of friends set out for a weekend road trip. They believe to be astonishingly lucky to find a bag full of money on an abandoned car, but the truth will prove to be quite different.
Set in New York City's Chinatown, an ornery, chain-smoking Chinese grandma goes all in at the casino, landing herself on the wrong side of luck - and in the middle of a gang war.
After a fellow Officer's funeral, 4 Cops decide that the only way to get rid of the criminal element is to stop arresting the criminals, and start burying them.
In a future France with many unemployed, big companies run the country. Ares is a loser boxer. When his sister's arrested, he agrees to a new drug, that'll help him win.
The clues to a young woman's death come together as the lives of seemingly unrelated people begin to intersect.
Candy Christian, an innocent high-schooler, encounters numerous colorful characters and humorous sexual situations while attempting to find meaning in life.
A American man's plane crashes in a small town in Mexico in where a clumsy woman finds him and must go to the US in order to help him.
A man emerges with his autistic daughter and three others from a hospital elevator to find themselves trapped in the building with devilish monsters.
A gifted female warrior is destined to marry the emperor and bring prosperity to the dynasty.
After a freak accident, a disturbed priest is transformed into a mutated killing machine on a mission to wipe out the godless fans of heavy metal music.

Ten stories are woven together by their shared theme of Halloween night in an American suburb, where ghouls, imps, aliens and axe murderers appear for one night only to terrorize unsuspecting residents.
Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson look into reports that a huge, vicious hound has killed Lord Charles Baskerville and that Lord Henry Baskerville is the next to be killed.

It follows Franky, a woman who suffers from multiple-personality disorder. She's having a hard time managing the four other characters living inside her. They seem to dwell in an old-fashioned hotel in the middle of nowhere.
In Moscow, five young people lead the charge against an alien race who have attacked Earth via our power supply.
A scientist becomes obsessed with bringing back his family members who died in a traffic accident.

Two estranged Sisters Amanda and Tamara will have to find a unifying force if they have to survive their common enemy Ik who murdered their father Dr Robert in his quest to get revenge for the murder of his brother and nephew.
A struggling actress and her novelist lover each illustrate the struggle and deconstruction of their love affair.
A family comedy set over a summer, where a coach of a neighborhood swim team experiences some funny times with his athletes.
On the trail of a woman, Vares finds himself caught up with underworld characters who are on the trail of hidden millions.
A coming-of-age story set in the suburbs of Houston, Texas in the summer of 1969, centered around the historic Apollo 11 moon landing.
An orphaned teenager and her oddball aunt must learn to live together and become family.
When a wrongfully imprisoned First Nations boxer returns home to lead a quiet life, his courage is tested when he learns his once peaceful town is now overrun by a corrupt and brutal police force.
1945. Former Allied war prisoners are dispatched to sabotage a top secret Nazi underground facility, whose otherworldly secrets could turn the tide of a lost war for Adolf Hitler.
The lives of two hit men, associated with a powerful mob family, are thrown into peril when their true profession is discovered by an emotionally disturbed teenager driven by unjust revenge.
In the wake of 5 other High Schoolers disappearing from their hometown, Harris, Will and Norman must work together to find their friend and bring him back home.

movie_name: Capture Anthologies: The Dimensions of Self
synopsis: The best UK Sci-Fi short films that look at the theme of identity through the lens of cloning, time travel and space flight. Are we who we think we are, were and will be when our DNA, past and very existence are all up for grabs?
A young surfer rallies his friends to stop a billionaire from rewriting history as a way to hoard Helium 3, the clean energy of the future.
A man plays a game of life and death with the Grim Reaper.
