El ranchero Juan 'El Coyote' y Trinidad tienen una familia ejemplar de cual son muy orgullosos. Un dia, los hijos de Juan se meten en grandes problemas provocando un terrible acontecimiento en el pueblo y dañando el nombre de la familia.
Claudia, 22, gets busted for credit card fraud and deported from USA to Mexico. She returns to her estranged dad's ranch. She's a pocha - can't speak Spanish. She gets involved with a drug smuggler.
One of the most talked-about trials in 1930s Polish press. Housekeeper Rita Gorgon, who has an affair with her employer, is accused of murdering his teenage daughter.

The story revolves around a 'reunion' of 5 college friends. Shrouded in mystery, this reunion starts with a cry for help. As expected, the college buddies jump in to help their dear friend in trouble.
After being framed for a murder in childhood, a young man returns to his former neighbourhood and resolves to rid it of crime.
Sherlock Holmes comes to the aid of his friend Henry Baskerville, who is under a family curse and menaced by a demonic dog that prowls the bogs near his estate and murders people.

Two friends discuss whether life is chosen on a free will basis or is ruled by Destiny. They agree the one who dies first will return to warn the other about his Fate, allowing him to change it for better -as long as he wants to listen.

movie_name: Doraemon: Nobita and the Knights on Dinosaurs
synopsis: Origin of species that have evolved differently from human beings.
Based on Russian folk tales.
A funeral director tells four strange tales of horror with an African American focus to three drug dealers he traps in his place of business.

Four young boys tragically separated from their parents and each other grow up to become four different men with divergent values and conflicting methods. Fate eventually sets their paths for a head on collision.
Amar, Akbar, and Anthony are close friends enjoying a carefree life in Kochi. Their perceptions and beliefs are shattered by an unexpected event; the resulting story forms the plot of the movie.
A drug lord under arrested threatens the judges and the police. Meanwhile an undercover cop approaches the drug lord's girl to collect evidences.
A Polish countess becomes Napoleon Bonaparte's mistress at the urging of Polish leaders who feel she could influence him to make Poland independent.
When Anna awakes one morning at this place without time, nothing was as before. She found herself being controlled by a strange force. Controlling her body, her mind and her soul.
One of a gang of karaoke loving middle aged women is murdered by a young man. Her friends track him down and kill him. His friends track them down and kill the killer ..... and it escalates!
A new set of adventures revolving around Pinocchio's efforts to put on a puppet show for Maestro Eisenbeiss who is sick with a cold.
A man tortured by guilt meets a psychopathic killer who forces him to revisit and conquer his personal demons in order to save his only daughter and survive the day.
During a band contest, the leader of a dance band falls in love with his competition--the leader of an all-girl's orchestra.
Lucinda Regis, Director of Development at MALCO Oceanic Research, becomes the target of a dangerous killer after unraveling a sinister plot to inject sharks with human DNA.
A man has an ulterior motive for enduring acupuncture - to get revenge on a voodoo doll.

Animated version of Jules Verne's classic. Teacher and sailor, hired by US Government to destroy a submarine monster, are captured by Captain Nemo and taken to a fantastic adventure underseas on Nautilus submarine.
A single father sets out to avenge the murder of his only son.
A private detective Hassan Dynamite and his assistant are informed about a murder case. They go to discover the truce and face the challenges to reveal the secret behind this case.
Set during a crazy afternoon in the lives of a dozen college students at a co-ed dorm that starts with the arrival of two very different women with the same name of Dominique.
In search of a kangaroo, a little girl receives help from Santa Claus.

A naïve young pilot crashes his plane and is thrown into a thrilling and terrible adventure in a fantastical world where robotic men, feral children, a talking bear, and a beautiful singer struggle to survive a maniacal despot.
Two brothers dig up a solitary grave late at night, causing the corpse to transform.
Jewel thieves become interested in an invisibility formula invented by Professor Nakazato and want to use his invention to acquire a diamond necklace called the "Tears of Amour"..
A young man must live a life of crime in order to save the girl of his dreams.

When a ship sinks during a storm, a slave from the industrial island of Plutonia is washed up on the beaches of paradise island Melonia, where the "all-powerful" wizard Prospero and his strange friends reside.

A Russian producer Alexander happened to see an old magazine photo from Cambodia; to his surprise he looks at his grandfather, who had been considered dead during The Great Patriotic War. ...                See full synopsis »

Balu, on a visit to his friend's hometown, falls for the latter's sister, Hema. When he learns that this area is ruled by a local goon, Kaasi, Balu teaches him a lesson. Now, Kaasi is seeking revenge.

movie_name: The Legend of the Christmas Witch
synopsis: During the day Paola is an ordinary primary school teacher, but at night, she turns into The Christmas Witch, a magical creature who brings gifts to the good kids.
A lost orphan boy and a giant elephant team up to take down an elephant poaching syndicate.

1988. It's the thinning days of summer and for the tight-knit group of teenagers spending their last night together in the foreclosed arcade, what starts as a bittersweet farewell becomes an emotional journey of self-discovery.
It tells the story of Allan, who moves with his father to an apartment block on Amager after his parents get divorced.

Two women - a struggling actress and a brilliant homicide detective - spiral into a midlife crisis. Trapped in a web of violence, they face a decision: flee, or confront the powerful forces of their world.
A woman falls in love with a police officer but faces heartbreak when he marries another.

A hermit farmer discovers his late father's secret journal containing plans to a magnetic powered machine that could change the world, while unexpectedly becoming custodian of his gifted 6 year old nephew, after his mom's untimely death.

A skillful fighter who works as a mechanic goes with his friend to a rich guy's villa where illegal fighting is being organizes. It should be easy money, but the friend gets killed and now the mechanic wants revenge on the people involved.
The now-adult Ricky talks to a psychiatrist about how he became a murderer after his brother, Billy, died, which leads back to Mother Superior.
Taking place 1 year after the events of 3rd Generation, Aaron finds himself fighting to keep his family and the United States together.

After his wife is murdered and his son kidnapped, a gangster is forced to betray his best friend who is also a deadly killer, in this raucous, off-the-wall satire that is to action films what Scream (1996) is to horror movies.
An inexperienced yet naturally gifted ice skater makes a spectacular debut in the skating world before encountering an event that could possibly derail her hopes and dreams.

Rene Del Toro a young naive boy in a border town of Mexico confronts bullies and evil parents. Thru a toxic pond accident he is transformed into Xenobot a DNA altered Superhéroe with frog-like superpowers.
A young detective is investigating a series of murders by the serial killer named Dancing with Death. Everything is not what it seems.Is there a way to right the wrongs of a past injustice.

8/85 Eldon Sys. served a fatal execution order directing sentinel AI's to eliminate all human inhabitants in Arcadia. The cause of the attack is unknown. But when Eldon Sys. mysteriously comes back online, all secrets will be revealed.

A man awakens stripped of all of his possessions and trapped in a bare room. Aided by a primitive computer, he must learn to survive in his new isolated existence where entertainment is the only currency.
A family adventure set in modern day Prague.

Nahuel is looking for his mother. She's also looking for him but he doesn't know that. Togheter with his friend, a stray cat and dancer, an a large dose of imagination, they set out on a big adventure.
A thriller/drama about a young female lawyer, playing mysterious game of catch and release.
An illusion, or reality? The future, or the past? One girl, or two? Human, or something else? Nothing is what it seems in this post apocalyptic world.
A woman gets kidnapped in the middle of the day and is tortured in a psychiatric hospital. A Journalist gets on the trace of the case and tries to find out the truth.
A mother and father run three businesses and a chain of restaurants while raising their young 8-year-old daughter.
Jewel thieves attempt to recover treasure from piranha infested waters. Mistrust and betrayals happen amongst the gang in the quest for gold.
A couple in crisis cannot solve their sexual problems. After resorting to medicine and spells, the woman unsuccessfully seeks a clumsy inventor who promises to recover her husband's sexual desire.

In Sofia, Bulgaria in 1992, an American doctor takes a detour in life when he helps a mysterious woman escape from her would-be assailant and becomes a victim of mistaken identity, as seen in the Alfred Hitchcock classic North by Northwest.
An account of five couples, five stories of different overlapping life events told through the story of a young writer and a girl he meets.
UNLIKELY JUNGLE FIGHTERS ARE PURSUED AND CAPTURED BY A BAND OF TERRORIST IN HILARIOUS CIRCUMSTANCES.
A roadtrip to meet an alien
Two loving middle aged couples get caught in a series of marital misadventures over reasons of fidelity.
Anthological film consisting of ten spooky stories spanning the horror, sci-fi and fantasy genres, intended for young audiences, and hosted by legendary creature and film actor, Doug Jones.
INFECTION takes place in a dark, isolated hospital, where one doctors mistake has led to dire consequences for a patient.
In 19th-century San Francisco's Chinatown, American adventurer Gilbert De Quincey saves slave girls owned by the Chinese Tong factions.

Sigmund Freud style psychological, drama, thriller movie about a woman and two men getting stuck on a island in a ship crash, telling the two men falling over each other and the two men falling on the cliff during a fight.
In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a plan to assassinate Nazi leaders by a group of Jewish U.S. soldiers coincides with a theatre owner's vengeful plans for the same.
Uganda's president gives Captain Alex the mission to defeat the Tiger Maffia, but Alex gets killed in the process. Upon hearing the tragic news, his brother investigates to avenge Alex.
Multi talented Cho wants to learn from the God of Gamblers and contacts his disciple. They are attacked by a crime boss with a plan to misuse GoG's good name to make millions.

movie_name: Heaven's Lost Property Final: Eternal My Master
synopsis: Wraps up the story of Tomoki Sakurai and his relationship with the Angeloid who fell from the sky, Ikaros.
Plot kept under wraps. An adaptation of the comic book, Red Sonja, a vengeful warrior known as a "She-Devil with a sword".
An absent minded professor invents a pen that will explode on the sound of bells, then leaves it in a taxi.
Wanted by the Chinese mafia, a New York City bike messenger escapes into the world of parkour after meeting a beautiful stranger.
Desperate to avoid his family's judgment about his perpetual single status, Peter convinces his best friend Nick to join him for the holidays and pretend that they're now in a relationship.

Reporter Annika is at the Nobel prize awards, when shooting kills a woman and wounds an Israeli stem cell scientist. Annika is silenced as witness, so she investigates the killed woman while the press writes about the Israeli.
Saravanan, a lackadaisical man, finds his life turned upside down when he is accidentally made the local head of a political party. Later, he shamelessly uses his status to woo the girl he loves.
After his wife/model dies of starvation with her portrait unfinished, an impoverished artist meets another woman with a striking resemblance to her.
A girl decides to leave her boyfriend and run away to an unknown place. Before she leaves, she decides to meet up with him, but they have only one hour to reflect on their time together.

Charles "The Butcher" Benton, a brutal death row inmate gets double-crossed by his crooked lawyer. He gets his chance for revenge when, after he's been executed, a bizarre experiment brings him back to life and more deadly than ever.

Lena is the daughter of an Aboriginal mother and Irish father and Vaughn is a Murri boy doing time in a minimum security prison in North West NSW. Dramatic events throw them together on a journey with no money and no transport.
Scotland Yard sends a handwriting expert to a country house full of people with guilty secrets in order to solve a murder.
In pre-World War II England, an injured snow goose brings together an emotionally and physically scarred man and a young woman.

A deformed hunchback kidnaps a bride on the day of her marriage and holds her hostage while his connection to her and his targets is revealed in a series of flashbacks that unfold as he starts seeking revenge.
A young journalist turns to an assassin for help when a team of hired killers comes gunning for her.
A modern retelling of the classic tale. A return to the big screen after 50 years of one of literature's classic heroes.
Inter High is over and the third years will be graduating soon. But Team Sohoku receives an invitation to one last race, the Kumamoto Fire Country Race.
Tangled lives of three young people who struggle to change their lives but end up failing.
The class arrives in another world and they encounter a desolate environment dominated by a rampaging magical automaton.
The sister of a dead car thief wants to avenge her brother.

Harry Jevans has not so much as an inkling of his Jewishness, until one day he discovers his Jewish half-brother. My Jewish Auntie, is a story of family, and of identity. It is rich in wonderful Jewish humour .
A courier for a local crime lord must deliver a mysterious package while being chased by a horde of unusual gangsters.
When an alcohol fueled hook up takes a violent and horrifying turn, three college athletes find themselves haunted by the very girl they left for dead.
After saving an infant of royal blood, knight Brancaleone forms a new army and sets out to return the baby to his father: a prince fighting in the Crusades.
A Man saves a backpacker from a snowstorm in Lapland.

A young man who survives a disaster at sea is hurtled into an epic journey of adventure and discovery. While cast away, he forms an unexpected connection with another survivor: a fearsome Bengal tiger.

movie_name: Thunder and the House of Magic
synopsis: Thunder, an abandoned young cat seeking shelter from a storm, stumbles into the strangest house imaginable, owned by an old magician and inhabited by a dazzling array of automatons and gizmos.
When Gina's tampering with dark magic releases something evil, Father Donnely must re-examine his faith to determine if he has what it takes to Vanquish the dark entity once and for all.
Two friendly thugs take a job of a robbery and the murder of a girl and they find themselves in love with the girl and face many obstacles to keep their promise.
Manny, a rebellious biker, must fight for justice when his younger brother is killed in a senseless police shooting.
Scientists working at a secret government research facility use prehistoric DNA to resurrect a T-Rex. But it escapes and terrorizes the residents of a nearby town.
In old New Orleans, a beautiful adventuress juggles the attentions of a rich banker and a dashing sea captain.
A man raised in the jungle by apes falls in love with a wealthy American heiress.
A TV news crew investigates a mountainous area where people are disappearing, and they soon find themselves fighting for their lives to escape the feral experiments of a madman's lunacy.
A rookie cop teams up with a former detective with a supernatural gift to hunt down a serial killer.
A woman blessed with magical powers by the gods and living in a place where you are forbidden to use them, teams up with a princess to summon the gods and bring down the oppressive regime.
Storyline kept under wraps. Described as a family-adventure film with a sci-fi element.
At the stroke of midnight, pirate radio host Devlin Deeds taunts the airwaves with tethering stories of murder, madness, and the macabre in small town New England.
All she ever wanted was a quiet life..
After the passing of her parents, a young heiress suffers abuse at the hands of her relatives.

Julian West is recovering from the tragic loss of his wife in a car accident, in his return to work he finds that he is unknowingly apart of a sinister plot of shady boss Daniel Franks that could change the face of human science.

When the fabled Star of Rhodesia diamond is stolen on a London to Edinburgh train and the son of its owner is murdered, Sherlock Holmes must discover which of his suspicious fellow passengers is responsible.
Abandoned by her fiancé, an educated black woman with a shocking past dedicates herself to helping a near bankrupt school for impoverished black youths.

On Halloween night, a charming and seductive witch introduces 3 macabre stories based upon pre-code horror comics of the 1950s ala Tales from the Crypt. This is the Spanish language version of Witch Tales.
When the heavy storm hits, it wasn't the storm that a family should fear but the people and non-human entities who are out for them
At an all-girls boarding school, Manuela falls in love with a teacher, to terrific consequences.
In New York, a small-time hood, who took the rap for a murder committed by his crime-boss in exchange for 50 G's, faces deportation because he doesn't hold American citizenship.

movie_name: Green Ghost and the Masters of the Stone
synopsis: In a Texas border town, car salesman Charlie moonlights as masked Lucha libre wrestler "Green Ghost." When assailants arrive seeking an otherworldly emerald, Charlie discovers that he has super powers that he must harness to save humanity.
Two friends driven by a perverse hacker are guided in the search of a missing friend from a few years ago.
The film is a historical drama speculating on the fate of the missing Kruger millions. Could love and intrigue have played a role?
A married couple purchases an abandoned house in the countryside. Soon they witness strange apparitions and events. Their son and their prepubescent daughter are haunted by a poltergeist.
Ishihama is planning a casino robbery with his wife and mother-in-law. They meet a man named Tsuneda who was aiming to do the same thing so they decide to work together.
Five famous literary detective characters and their sidekicks are invited to a bizarre mansion to solve an even stranger mystery.

Rolando, a millionaire, travels to a remote island and meets the tough Tania, a local woman with great dancing skills. He falls in love with her and takes the girl to Mexico but he soon discovers that Tania cheats on him with another man.
The Shickles is an edgy comedy which explores the life and loves of an eccentric Jewish family following the death of their dearly beloved grandparents, Elroy and Nanna Shickles.
A quadriplegic man has a trained monkey help him with his paralysis, until the little monkey begins to develop feelings, and rage, against its new master.

An Extraction Specialist and his team will go to extreme lengths to protect hard working American's against the unknown enemies that live within it's borders, but while maintaining the highest level of security to protect their families who are unaware of their true identities.
A mysterious call summons Joe Newman to Bavaria in search of the father he believed dead for 20 years.

Godspeed" is an intense, dramatic thriller set in the lingering light of the Alaskan midnight sun. Charlie Shepard is a modern day faith healer, a man who claims that if you let go and believe, then his power to heal is very real indeed.
A young woman becomes involved with a man who not only may be an art thief, but a murderer.

John Byrne ran away from home to join a Scottish Regiment fighting in India. After harrowing world travels in the British Navy he settled in NYC to be a missionary at "The Floating Church" in NYC, where his song and verse became legend.
Anna and Ira prank a local woman by writing her letters from a secret admirer. The prank takes a more serious turn when the local women goes missing,
Delshawn, "The Chosen One", is back in action, but this time, it's not for destiny. Not for revenge. Not for justice. ...For answers.
In the near future, the President of the New United States of America hires a team of military veterans to retrieve an alien bio-weapon from a top secret research facility orbiting the Earth.
A trio of World War 2 vets band together to search for a lost Nazi fortune.
After a rape at a girl's gymnastics school, questions arise and bring to light ancient Cretan rituals.
A financial reporter travels to Rio de Janeiro to visit a wealthy friend, only to get sucked into a plot to fake his friend's death.
Contemporary Russia. Two girls begin to receive messages from their recently deceased lover. The two former rivals in love team up to solve this mystery.

The story of Athiratha revolves around an aspiring journalist who helps the innocent and talented young students get a fair chance by uncovering the huge racket of question paper leaks and fake certification prevalent in the country.

Filmed in Welsh, the picture follows a young woman serving privileged guests at a dinner party in a remote house in rural Wales. The assembled guests do not realize they are about to eat their last supper.
In a world drowning in disease and disaster, a grief-stricken scientist sets out with his ailing teenage daughter on a perilous journey that could save the world's energy crisis.
A recently released ex-felon living in India struggles to adjust to a world of corporate greed and eroding spiritual values.

USD400,000,000 is stolen and a drug lord wants it back. The killed thief's brother is broken out of prison by a DEA bounty hunter to help find the money boat. The body count continues in Latin America.
Yuan leads a double life: spoiled rich girl by day and skilled swordfighter by night.
In a near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.
Opstandelsen brings the zombie apocalypse into the house of God.
Fascinated by gorgeous Mrs. Bannister, seaman Michael O'Hara joins a bizarre yachting cruise, and ends up mired in a complex murder plot.
Orphaned as kids, Radha and her brother Ramu make their living by dancing and singing in small functions. Ramu makes it big in the music world.

A young tomcat named Tailchaser leaves the comfort of our world for a mysterious forest when the cat he cares for most goes missing. Soon he discovers the secret world of cats, learns of his special heritage, and confronts an evil cat god.

Andhadhi revolves around two main characters Guna a Police Officer and Rajesh a Solar Plant Engineer, how both fight for their goals and achieve their perspective dreams with a message that every achievement has its struggle of its own.
A story based on the actual case of Fatima Buen.
Two undercover cops blow their cover while investigating a heroin ring.

movie_name: The Earth is not our Home
synopsis: Exploring mental health issues set on a dusty volcanic island off the coast of Africa.

Inside a remote rehab sanatorium, four newly arrived patients, each one with a specific emotional damage, go through hell by discovering and enduring the vicious methods of the sinister doctor's treatments, attempting to stay alive.
In 1942 submarine commander Jeff Conway secretly photographs Japanese aircraft carriers in the Coral Sea but his submarine is damaged and he's forced to surrender.
A man is framed for being a spy. After he is released, he sets out to find who the real spies are.

EJ has a crush on Hsin-Hsin. He decides to train as a boxer in order to show his braveness and prove his love, but Hsin-Hsin is already in love with a superhero. When Hsin-Hsin gets kidnapped, EJ must risk his life to save his dream girl.
A Muslim police lieutenant takes on a criminal syndicate behind the kidnapping of a Muslim princess.
Sexy young nurses apply special therapy in their daily rounds, as they work against a drug ring operating out of the hospital.

Eight entry in the series of animated films about a little Australian girl called Dot and her animal friends. Dot competes to become a film star in 1930s Hollywood in order to pay for the operation that could save her sick koala friend.
Priya is gifted a defective car by her scheming uncle and runs over Arjun subsequently. He loses his memory and becomes delusional. In that condition, he falls in love with Priya.
The adventures of a female reporter in the 1890s.
A ring of devil worshipers bring forth a demon and let it loose at a campus Halloween spook show.
Doctor Gia searches for the meaning in life through extraordinary events in the ER where he works.
An unwanted teacher is assigned a class of rejects and helps them and others to see their worth.
The ancient Kingdom where Magical beings live, love, and fight alongside real people.
A man wrongly convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage against the U.S. is offered his freedom if he can rescue the President's daughter from an outer-space prison taken over by violent inmates.

A young woman has inherrited an old house on the island of Sct. Thomas but is threatened on her life by unknown criminals. When she meets two Danish private detectives on a ferry, she asks them to help her.
A Cat from outer-space comes to earth and befriends a Miller's Son and together they set out to defeat an evil wizard.
Best friends, Lucas and Ethan, set out on a journey to find a missing treasure only to discover some treasures are not made of gold.
Dusty Rhodes (Bailee Madison) & her grandfather (Pat Boone) rely on their faith & each other while her parents serve in the Afghanistan War.
As an 11-year-old boy struggles to cope with a disability, he finds a pony who gives birth to a unicorn which he takes care of.
Poker professionals gamble to win 10 millions. When one of them falls dead all become suspects.

After high school is over, three friends have to choose their paths. Pastor dreams of flying and winning Flor´s love, while her jealous brother Nacho gets seduced by the local gang, and falls in to crime.

When a reconstructed family moves to a converted church in the country, 14-year-old Molly, must save her new troubled step-sister from a dangerous relationship with the desperate ghost of a young girl.
In a series of long held shots, men are observed performing simple tasks in real time, while on the soundtrack we hear excerpts from opera.
A reclusive man conducts a series of interviews with human souls for a chance to be born.
A con-artist hires two low-lifes to cover him during a deal, ending with three criminals, two dueling pistols, and one night they'll never forget.

An American brings his daughter from the bright lights of the USA to the mystical landscapes of Cornwall, with the intention of reviving the tin mining tradition. But the ghosts of the mines have other ideas.
A young black man in Brooklyn must prove his new white neighbors are emissaries from the Satanic cult they both survived as children.

Suzu is a shy high school student living in a rural village. For years, she has only been a shadow of herself. But when she enters "U", a massive virtual world, she escapes into her online persona as Belle, a globally-beloved singer.
A young boy-genius befriends his grandfather's robot, designed as a test pilot for space travel and coveted by foreign spies.

A humanoid robot is asked to replace Hal, who was killed in a terrible accident, in order help Hal's girlfriend move on in life, but struggles to understand the real Hal's past and the meaning of being alive.
Agnes goes undercover as a teacher. Partnered with Meg, they must take down a drug kingpin who uses their school as their operation base and win the inter-class soccer competition.

movie_name: Sid the Science Kid: The Movie
synopsis: Four kids travel through the amazing wonders of a science museum with their advanced robot tour guide.
At the end of WW2, a Japanese freighter sails with Allied prisoners as cargo but, sensing doom, the prisoners plan to overpower their guards and capture the prison-ship.

Forced to relocate to the mountains of Pennsylvania, Emma struggles to adjust to her new setting. Her fortune changes when she meets Will, an older man riddled with secrets. The two form a bond that leads them both down a dark path.
Sam and her friends are terrorised during a party by a group of young men on a desperate hunt for something in her house.

9 years old Hugo spends the summer holidays with his cousins and his grandma Sara. When they learn that the wolf is coming to pick her up, the children are mobilizing to save their grandmother and embark on an unforgettable adventure.
A poor man wants his daughter to be happy, no matter what comes through.
An escaped convict and an east-coast academic encounter two mysterious sisters living alone in the forest while investigating a series of unexplained deaths on the American frontier.

A young man returns from the city to his village in the remote mountains of Mustang, in the Nepal Himalaya, with ideas to improve the lives of his people, but struggles to reconcile these with the existing realities.
Teng Piao went to jail for fifteen years on a frame up for drug smuggling. Now that he's out, along with his iron chain and hungry for revenge.

Members of a poor family living in a shantytown aspire to a better life by owning an apartment within the economic housing, a dream that will only be fulfilled by breaking into a bank agency to pressure its manager to obtain a loan.
A man with stalking habit meets a girl with a strange atmosphere and they fall in love, but with what they are holding inside, lives of them and people around them shift to unexpected directions.

Science Madman has privately developed a highly developed humanoid robot with sympathetic nerves to satisfy his own desires. Unexpectedly, the robot developed its autonomous consciousness. It exchanged the skin of the beautiful woman
When three young women are implicated in a crime, a retired lawyer steps forward to help them clear their names.
A young boy tries to rescue a girl in danger with the aid of a magic umbrella.
NOORIE tells a simple and touching story of Noorie and Yusuf's fearless love and dream at all cost.
A tribute to classic Hong Kong horror-comedies in which four aspiring filmmakers have to deal with the ghosts that haunt an old film studio.

Nese and her friends are preparing for a big party. While they are decorating the house, an intruder knocks on their door. However, no one knows the incoming child is a prince from the land of fairy tales.

movie_name: Kamen Rider Zi-O Next Time: Geiz, Majesty
synopsis: In an alternative timeline of 2018, a group of high school students is pursuing their dreams. Sougo Tokiwa wants to become a king, and Keito Myokoin wants to become the judo champion while trying to impress his crush, Alpina Tsukuyomi.

movie_name: Circle of Fire: The Dark Lord Kylnor
synopsis: The land is being taken over by the Dark Lord Kylnor. The people need help of the elves to save them. The Circle of Power is a necklace of power and only one can retrieve it.
A voyeuristic hotel clerk becomes the subject of a murder investigation.

Champion gamer Max Troy discovers events in a new video game are being mirrored in the real world, and must join forces with the game's protagonist, Orson Creed, to unravel the conspiracy before the game's sinister plot overwhelms the city.
After his brother is gunned down and robbed, Tom Carter searches for his killer.
In colonial Nigeria, an English documentary photographer in search of a story falls in love with an accused witch living under subhuman conditions.

movie_name: Di na natuto (Sorry na, puede ba?)
synopsis: Ysmael is the rich family's black sheep, unlike his older brother Bongbong. They both want to win the heart of their female worker, Carlotta. When Ysmael discovers that Bongbong is using dirty tricks, conflicts arise.
A rookie cop falls for a "taxi dancer" in a dance hall, but his father has strong objections to the relationship.
A young girl with a special gift comes of age during one of the most desolate periods in American history in this dark Dust Bowl fantasy inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's "The Little Mermaid."
Detective Cormac Reilly is thrown back into a case from 20 years before involving two children whose mother died of an overdose.
A desperate group of refugees attempts to recolonize Earth 20,000 years after Godzilla took over, but one young man wants revenge above all else.
A 17th century Hungarian countess embarks on a murderous undertaking, with the belief that bathing in the blood of virgins will preserve her beauty.
This year, Santa has competition.
In 2085 A.D., global governing forces host a martial arts tournament. The last fighter standing wins Absolute Dominion for one faith.
After their cattle are stolen and their brother murdered, the Earp brothers have a score to settle with the Clanton family.

Our innate fear of the dark is validated by the fact that there has been something evil living in the dark since the dawn of time. A police detective and his friends come face to face with this evil thing.
Mistaken for a detective, Slip takes on the case of a missing woman, which turns out to be bogus.

Your family is in for a flurry of fun with Snow Day, a musical reimagining of the beloved classic comedy film that follows a group of kids who discover that anything is possible when you break routines and take giant risks.

Reluctantly designated as the heir to the land of Far, Far Away, Shrek hatches a plan to install the rebellious Artie as the new king while Princess Fiona tries to fend off a coup d'état by the jilted Prince Charming.
