Government creates an artificial intelligence robot child built of audio and video surveillance that's required in every home. One robot child can obtain feelings and memory. It tries to stop the government of its real intentions.
An escaped convict plays the occupants of a remote home against one another for his own sadistic pleasure while searching for the loot he buried there following a previous robbery.
Diana and her mother Brenda travel from their home in New York City to Argentina. Once there they will seek out Diana's dad who's an archaeologist looking for a legendary cache of gold.

Six people find themselves on a shipwreck and assume they washed up on a Caribbean Island beach as survivors, but they did not make it, instead they drowned and found themselves in a place called Purgatory, their own purging from sin.
A desperate man ventures into a dangerous and sordid underworld of crime and pornography in search of his severed genitalia which is held for ransom by his disgruntled former girlfriend.
Alex and Joe are two best friends who fight with mutants, energy drinks, and Jehovah's Witnesses.
A group of wild punks touring on a bus survive an alien invasion.
The mountain resort of one the European countries is blocked by the group of terrorists. They threaten to cause the descent of avalanches by directional explosion.

movie_name: Fica Mais Escuro Antes do Amanhecer
synopsis: After the tragic loss of their child, a couple must prepare to witness their last day of light before the world fades into ever winter and darkness.
A young Detroit hustler falls in love with the woman of his dreams but she wants him out of the game. Now Terris must choose between love and money.
A young woman who has faded to the point of becoming invisible must find her way back with the help of the one man who can see her.

movie_name: The Manson Brothers Satanic Vampire Death Match
synopsis: Two professional wrestlers, who end up fighting a horde of zombies after a midnight cage match on Halloween.
Based on the tales of Cinderella, Rapunzel and Sleeping Beauty,- BUT- told from the Princes' point of view.
After the death of her mother and grandmother, Inti inherits a country house, where she goes to party with her friends. Unknown to her is that someone's been watching them

movie_name: The Gathering Storm: A Marauders Fan Film
synopsis: The year is 1977, and You-Know-Who's forces are growing stronger. With the the end of the Marauders' time at school drawing closer, everyone is forced to choose a side. Based on the stories and events of J.K. Rowling's Harry Potter series.
An Ancient Evil Unleashed. A supernatural thriller based on the terrifying legend of The Mothman. Rachel and Katy work together in a large, empty museum.
Brad Angel, a man for hire, finds a woman on an island who claims she's being held prisoner.

When a Halloween store opens in a deserted strip-mall, three friends, thinking they've outgrown trick or treating, decide to spend the night locked inside. But their night of spook-filled fun soon turns to outlandish survival.
A gang of crooks has kidnapped a rich heiress come up against a beautiful, but lethal alien who has crash-landed her spaceship on Earth.
Cali's stuffed animal comes to life and their magical journey together begins.

Years it has waited, now someone's moved in. Through the eyes of the evil within we witness a broken family desperately seeking a new beginning, in a new home, but this house lives, watches and wants them to stay-FOREVER.

movie_name: The Killer Robots! Crash and Burn
synopsis: Four fallen robot gladiators are rescued from the scrap pile, turned into an elite group of mercenaries and sent on a mission to bring about a new age of enlightenment in a post-apocalyptic universe.

Raafat works on one of the ships and meets with his ex-girlfriend Madiha, who refuses to marry him because she wants to marry a wealthy person. They plot to make millionaire Azzouz falls in love with Madiha so that she can have his money.
A pair of young lovers flee their New England town, which causes a local search party to fan out to find them.
A single mother entertains a dangerous fantasy after she's recruited to live in an unsold property in an empty development.

A young woman returns home to Zimbabwe to visit her ill father. With her mother's recent disappearance still grieving the family, she discovers shocking lies and secrets hidden within in the place she once called home.
Milton and Kendra fall for each other. The problem is that they are half-brother and half-sister.
Once left without his protective father, a child embarks on a quest for answers and love in a dangerous, dystopian world.
Students try to convince their parents that their sixth-grade class' new substitute teacher is an evil alien from another planet.
After some hesitation, 10-year-old Bobby accepts the gift of a magnificent black foal from his severe, thoughtless and overprotective father.
Genevieve and Adrian, two young friends, are individually seduced by the same young man. As the love triangle develops, the boundaries of their friendship come into question.
A frustrated man decides to take justice into his own hands after a plea bargain sets one of his family's killers free.
The story follows a dedicated actor as he prepares for a frightening task. He becomes trapped in both dimensions as the line between truth and imagination blurs.
A young teacher who arrives at a village school, who tries to make a definite change in student attitude.
An indestructible gangster living in an alternate version of the 1940s sacrifices a major U.S. city in exchange for killing Adolph Hitler.
In a war for gang supremacy, two beautiful female assassins are given the ultimate target - each other.

movie_name: Captain Video: Master of the Stratosphere
synopsis: Space hero Captain Video battles the evil Vultura on the planet Atoma.
Truckers form a mile-long "convoy" in support of a trucker's vendetta with an abusive sheriff - Based on the country song of the same title by C.W. McCall.
In New Guinea a man escapes from natives and saves a girl from marrying her crooked partner.
Children's story about an always-unlucky Highwayman of of the southern-German forests in the late-19th century, featuring witty grammification by the author in, of course, German language.
Three friends Syahmi, Asif and Yoe are stuck in several different eras after buying an antique camera.
While travelling the countryside to locate his nephew, a small town doctor finds himself interacting with people from his past and future.

In the Médoc, a young woman is found drowned. An accident, her influential family of winegrowers maintains. Or rather murder, as the American inspector Morrison suspects. If so, why? What secrets this family keeps?
Tamura is an average divorced salary-man in Japan - and also a man-sized, suit-and-tie wearing, bipedal koala bear.
Logline kept under wraps.
A film-tale about the Iris flower and the love of young Lan Xiao and Lan Ma.
Ive is a man on the edge whose traumatic childhood causes him to develop a thing for sex, perversion, violence and murder.

movie_name: The Island of Wonder and Despair
synopsis: A fusty, narcissistic head teacher experiences karma from a mysterious entity, while on holiday with his wife and estranged kids.
A pair of outlaw brothers seek temporary refuge in a desolate town.
A young actor falls in love with a mysterious being encountered in a dream.
A horror/thriller set in a world where people lock themselves indoors one night a year for fear of random attacks from creatures known as the "Grims".

movie_name: Blue Skies, Green Waters, Red Earth
synopsis: Kasi and Suni go for the ride from Kerala to Nagaland in search of Kasi's girlfriend. En route, they encounter different people who change their lives forever.
A split feature film that follows the story of two separate individuals whose lives are turned upside down by an ominous sound from the sky.

What happens when a man gains all that his heart desires just to watch it all slip through his hands? When he is brought to his knees, will he ever again stand? "Provision" is a faith-based story about one man's journey.
The plot is unknown.

Every day with Barney is fun--but today is stuuu-PENDously special: it's Barney's birthday! His friends decide to throw a party and BJ and Baby Bop arrive with party supplies to help prepare for the festivities.

After losing his job for nearly losing a cargo of gold bars in a holdup, Gatdula finds himself working as a nightclub bouncer. There he meets and is smitten by Varga, a college coed forced by poverty to work as a ramp model.

Some games are played for fun, some are played for power, but this game is played for ultimate stakes. In the underground world of ultimate poker, only one person walks out a winner, but win or lose, sometimes winning just isn't enough.
After his girlfriend's pregnancy forces him to marry her, a young man must adjust to his new life and contend with his domineering mother-in-law.
Based on actual events, "Avenue M" relives the chilling events witnessed by friends stranded in an isolated California dessert.

A surreal, isolated village sees its inhabitants gradually leave behind their mutual traditions and superstitions as they leave for the city. Among them are two cousins who love each other and who get into a quarrel with other villagers.
A curious daughter asks her filmmaker father "What is cinema?" With a camera in hand and friends from school to help her, she sets out to make an incredible movie.
A young woman just released from a mental institution returns home to her mansion and faces a new set of horrors.
Two boys try to send their strict father back to the city with the help of the forest witch, but instead get taken for a merry ride by her granddaughter.

It tells the story of the lives of two boxers. One is an underrated boxer, Flash Gonzaga, and the other, a promising talent, Kid Alaminos. In their first fight, the latter wins, which causes two stories to form about them.
Jack Lowman sees murder victims in his camcorder 24 hours before they die and soon becomes the lead suspect as a serial killer.
Taking place almost entirely over the course of one stormy night, a woman is terrified when an accused murderer escapes from a mental hospital and seeks refuge in her home.
Justino, a 45-year-old Desana native, is a security guard at the Manaus harbor. As his daughter prepares to study medicine in Brasilia, Justino is taken over by a mysterious fever.
Joe is assigned to protect the wife of a millionaire but his mission gets complicated when he discovers the true intentions of the person who hired him.
It's story of a happy family ,the parents get trapped inside a flat and kid outside and the kid got missed the movie is the parents are fighting for getting outside so watch the movie.
At age four-and-a-half the Dionne quintuplets in their third movie - singing, dancing, playing with puppies, being charming.
The story of Manô, a Portuguese silent movie star from the 20s that happens to appear in modern day Lisbon, and caught the attention of a female photographer. A very original fish-out-of-water story.
A father and son try to save a small town and its newly-built tunnel that is threatened by natural disasters.
The story of an unlikely friendship between a bear, Ernest, and a young mouse named Celestine.
The more a family seems perfect, the more secrets it is hiding.
Plane crashes in Caucasus mountains and the rescue-workers search for the passengers stuck in inaccessible glaciers of a Caucasus peak.
A cute dancer sees her womanizer boyfriend/can-can dance instructor with another woman and shoots at him but misses. A young, single painter lets her stay the night in his home to avoid the police.
Villagers of towns affected during the Cristero War in 1926-29, in Mexico.
On the final day of his life, a cynical patriarch lapses into an intermittent coma where his granddaughter, appears in the internal landscape of his dreams as a guide to the great beyond.
A composer named Hans List fought on the barricades of the Paris Commune in 1871. He now wakes up to a new life in the present, moving through Berlin-Mitte without identification.

For generations, the people of the City of Ember have flourished in an amazing world of glittering lights. But Ember's once powerful generator is failing and the great lamps that illuminate the city are starting to flicker.
The Secret Service sets out to break up a smuggling ring.
In a devastated post apocalyptic world, some begin to worship the ancient gods.

movie_name: Bad Vegan and the Teleportation Machine
synopsis: Lily, a dismal stand-up comedian, falls for Spike, a handsome physicist who enlists her to work on his teleportation machine, changing her life for ever.
Prem, the younger prince of the Kingdom of Khazaag, born in an auspicious astrological time to be the future King goes through his biggest obstacle in life, Geet, his only love.

A young human being parses through his thoughts and the environment around him as a hybrid of synchronous visual and auditory imagery, twisting a lifetime unfolding before his eyes into a brief linger in nature.

It's another ordinary night out for Amir and Sophie. Clubbing, partying, drinking, dancing - You know the drill. But little did they know that at 6 a.m. the next morning is when all the fun stops. What happened? Shh - It's a secret.

As Mika returns to the farm for the summer, she finds a wild white horse in the forest. When one day, she spots a mysterious young man trying to tame the animal, that Mika believes to be a unicorn, Mika and the stranger strike a deal.

Max and Ronny don't know each other but both have special abilities. She can Teleport short distances. He can go back in time by 5 minutes. Fate will bring them together, when a threat from the future reveals the truth about their origins.

The relative coexistence of the human world, demon world and beast world is soon to be disrupted by The Overfiend, an immensely powerful demon who'll be reborn after 3000 years to remake the world to his own liking.

Two teenage girls on a mission to find drugs at a rave get more than they bargained for. One is sexually assaulted and they are both tortured in horrific ways. The attackers seek refuge in the parents' of one of the victims' homes.

movie_name: The Golden Claws of the Cat Girl
synopsis: Françoise looks like a sexy kitten by day, but is a silent she-wolf by night, making very clever robberies of gold jewels. Despite the interest, and competition, from Bruno, she ends a lonely she-wolf.

movie_name: Virginia Rose and the Lost City of Gold
synopsis: In 1925, archaeologist and adventurer Virginia Rose searches for the Lost City of Gold before a rival can obtain its treasure and awesome powers.
Doug and his pal Skeeter set out to find the monster of Lucky Duck Lake.
a family film about brakers.

Young Swedish woman Alice travels with her abusive American boyfriend in the Balkans. As their relationship goes from bad to worse, Alice drifts more and more into an emotional void, which leads to violent repercussions.
Black Guards Taki and Makie must protect the enigmatic Mr. Mayart in a city teeming with demonic creatures.
Misunderstandings arises in a joint family for certain reasons. But they gets succeeded in overcoming all those misunderstandings to live happily together again.
A misunderstood boy takes on ghosts, zombies and grown-ups to save his town from a centuries-old curse.
A cop goes undercover in a ruthless underworld organization to stop a gang leader, only to put himself in great danger after being exposed by his former protégé and best friend.
On the Friday night before Christmas, a sleepy beach town is shaken by a series of events that will lead a group of friends to a party to remember.

A young girl discovers a secret map to the dreamworld of Slumberland, and with the help of an eccentric outlaw, she traverses dreams and flees nightmares, with the hope that she will be able to see her late father again.
When a rare Lakota Ghost Shirt falls onto the black market in a small town in South Dakota, the lives of local outsiders and outcasts violently intertwine.

During the rebirth of society, two low-level workers unearth a mysterious device that traps them in a reality where their deepest fears and desires come to life, forcing them to confront the true nature of their existence.
Two officers find the body of a young woman in the water of the Copenhagen Christianhavn district.

movie_name: Det er så yndigt at følges ad
synopsis: Remover Lasse (Frits Helmuth) accidentally runs over Lone (Ulla Lock), soon to be hospitalized with a broken leg. Lasse pays her a visit and falls head over heels in love. As feelings grow between them, so does resistance from her parents.
In the 1970s, a gangster goes undercover as a slave to assassinate the owner of a notorious gold mine.
Two cab drivers search San Francisco's Chinatown for the mysterious Chan, who disappeared with their $4000.
Louis made his fortune selling candy, but no one buys them anymore. He steals grandpa's love serum to put in his candy which can turn people into devoted slaves. Mega Mindy has to stop him.
The ultimate legal high 'Portal' part drug, part social network, just got banned - what happens when the 'lost generation' loses its means to escape.
5 friends who have fun together face several twists and turns due to their rebellious deeds. Together they end up learning important life lessons.

Set on a remote Pacific island, covered in rain forest and dominated by an active volcano, this heartfelt story, enacted by the Yakel tribe, tells of a sister's loyalty, a forbidden love affair and the pact between the old ways and the new.
He's trying to make a killing, but Death's cleaning up.

A beautiful young woman starts receiving messages through a ouija board, claiming to be from the former occupant of her apartment. The former tenant claims she's been murdered, but there's no record of a murder or even her death.

In 1803 France, Napoleon Bonaparte (Robert Cornthwaite) orders the capture of notorious highwayman "Purple Mask" (Tony Curtis), who routinely rescues imprisoned nobles and harasses the Revolutionary officials.
Seattle call girl Gracie Blake wakes up in a cage, in a warehouse - somewhere in America.

Robot Taekwon is a Robot that was built by a super-heroic team so it could help them fight monsters that have been destroying the world. So it's up to Robot Taekwon and some heroes to become saviours of the world.
A socially obsessed teenager will do anything to save her reputation after she downloads a new phone app to increase her popularity status.
Savitri, a vet and Satyaprakash, an electrical engineer are forced into marriage by their parents.
A newspaper editor in a small agricultural town finds himself going against the people in the town when he gets involved in the plight of the area's fruit pickers, who are mostly Mexican.
An American in Japan recruits the help of a ranger to guide him through a forested area where the spirits of suicide victims haunt the living.
A Mexican comedy of a caveman that wakes up after a beautiful 1,000 year slumber.
Let the Christmas spirit whisk you away on an incredible sing and dance-along journey you won't soon forget, It's Christmas Sing-Along 2.
A group of barbarians travel through time to modern day Eastern Finland.
After copper miners discover part of the frozen tail of a prehistoric monster in Lapland, scientists inadvertently bring it back to life.
Set against the backdrop of a decaying Midwestern town, a murder becomes the focal point of three people who work in a doll factory.
A girl becomes homeless as a result of a fire and then comes to Tehran by a truck driver and becomes a famous singer.
Journeyman takes you on a journey of 2 MMA fighters and their relationship during triumphs and failures in and out of the cage
Daryl wants to go straight after years in prison. He meets a cute girl who helps him find an honest job driving. He wants to save up and open a nightclub. But then gems and mayhem pop up.

A suicidal stockbroker convinces a Black gang and a Latin gang to join forces and use street moves to sway a hedge fund. A vicious fast moving Action Comedy from the writer / director of The Weathered Underground.
A jockey has been shot dead at the race track. Famous detective Nick Charles and his wife Nora happen to be on the scene and Lt. Abrahams asks for Nick's expert help.
The first of three battles between Identity and Survival.
A struggling auto mechanic with a criminal past agrees to one last heist to pay off his debts.
When life turns unbearably miserable, a lonely old man takes part in a medical experiment, reviving a long-forgotten story of his love.
GPK: A company which offers applicants the opportunity to enter one of their studios in order to murder a person of their choice. The rules? Killer and victim must wear Go-Pro cameras at all times.
A Witches' Ball is about a young witch who is ready to jump in feet first into the witching world but not before leaping over some magical hurdles along the way.
Murder mystery involving a man and his relationship with twin sisters.
AirBoss does cool stuff (Again)
Two LAPD homicide detectives face the case of their careers chasing a legendary, allegedly cursed painting responsible for a century of mysterious deaths.
A S.W.A.T. team becomes trapped in a tenement run by a ruthless mobster and his army of killers and thugs.

A young man has the gift to manifest the thoughts and fears of others as tangible shadows. But when the Nazi's invade Poland, he must choose to remain committed to his life of peace or protect those in his care with his gift of shadow.
A jungle boy gets involved with a genie.
Welcome to Atlantis, where royal guardsmen wear uniforms that could easily be from the wardrobe of Ming the Merciless and some unfortunate slaves are turned into bovine-headed beasts.

Eric Hayes is a video vulture preying on human violence and suffrage, selling his footage to the highest bidder. Eric's about to discover something beneath the streets even hungrier for blood than he is. He's about to discover the ghouls.
Follows the missions of a special operative spy.
About how spies made their way to the plant where Geum Sam works and how they, using some facts from his biography, want to force this person to help them in their criminal activities.
Ray Garrison, a slain soldier, is re-animated with superpowers.
An outwardly normal teenage girl faces overwhelming body transformations that put the very nature of her existence into question.
Lured by gold, two greedy peasants unknowingly escort a princess and her general across enemy lines.

A fertilizer used in a rich gated community becomes the source of a genetic mutation that transforms its residents into zombies. Can a teenager and his baby sister break free from the quarantined island before turning into grass?

Having fallen in love eight years ago, a young couple finds their engagement on the rocks. As they desperately cling to the foundations of their relationship, one man knows exactly how to start the fire to burn it down.
After 8-year-old Mia loses her mother, her family moves to Grandma's Montana ranch. In the woods, Mia discovers a unicorn colt: a magical creature that brings luck to anyone who believes in it.
The life of Cuban poet and novelist, Reinaldo Arenas.
A lifestyle photographer, a student activist, and a relationship that developed amidst contrasting ideals and principles.
A charming restaurant. A book and its mysterious author. A little secret. A romantic meeting. Paris and all its magic . . .

movie_name: Visceral: Entre las cuerdas de la locura
synopsis: A washed-up boxer, who finally gets his big break to prove he is worthy of the champion's gloves, becomes a vessel of pure evil and a relentless instrument of destruction of the human flesh. Is he hell's next champion?

Shinichi is a good guy serving three years and approaching the end of his time. He escapes handcuffed to dangerous Gunda, who instigated the escape. Thus tethered, they start out on a journey across the desolate snow country of Hokkaido.
A Kung Fu master battles Bruka the evil snake queen with her army of snakes and savage little people.
An investigative team are on the hunt for supernatural claims of Witchcraft. They try to falsify the claims but soon realize they just entered the world of the unholy.

movie_name: Fist of the North Star: The Toki Saga
synopsis: Kenshiro must stop two martial arts masters who are brothers, Toki and Raul, from destroying each other.
A forged 500-franc note is passed from person to person until carelessness leads to tragedy.
A stolen heiress is secretly wed to a man framed for killing her miserly guardian.
Four friends are stuck in a school building, while something evil surrounds them.

When a woman on an interstellar voyage falls in love with someone during a cryosleep simulation, she attempts to discern whether the man is a real passenger on the ship or just a figment of her imagination.
The story is centered around a five year old girl whose innocence is caught in the world of hatred.

movie_name: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
synopsis: Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson must protect a Swiss inventor of an advanced bomb sight from falling into German hands.

movie_name: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Miss Osbourne
synopsis: In 19th century London, a sex maniac sneaks into the engagement party of Dr. Henry Jekyll and Miss Fanny Osbourne, turning the event into a nightmarish whirlpool of murder and debauchery.
Zombies are on a rampage around the world, Joseph Kales begins a quest to find his girlfriend. Combat operations and zombie attacks, complicate his effort, making it unlikely he'll succeed.
A young man comes to the rescue of his girlfriend abducted by thieves and brought to Rio. An extravagant adventure ensues.
A Texas high school baseball coach inspired his team of poor, Mexican-American players and led them to the state championship.
Aliff, who can see ghost and hate them. Find a really big problem to protect his friend who is so interested in finding ghost.

A team of space scavengers discovers superior alien technology that threatens the balance of the known universe. Hotly pursued by a rival crew of intergalactic mercenaries, the Revelator crew must fight through the deepest reaches of space to locate and protect the life-altering device.

Balthazar Blake, an apprentice of the legendary magician Merlin, must train his old teacher's successor - an introverted but resourceful physics prodigy - in the art of sorcery to prevent the return of Morgana le Fay.
A French corporation goes head-to-head with an American web media company for the rights to a 3-D manga pornography studio, resulting in a power struggle that culminates in violence and espionage.

UN's secretary general uses covert operations to help diplomacy along. Shaw's called back 6 months after one such operation. He witnesses the murder of Chinese UN ambassador at UN, NYC, chases the assassin and ends up a suspect.

movie_name: The Adventures of the Adventures 2: Denver Rocks
synopsis: The Adventure Family finds themselves on a quest for lost documents that takes them to the city of Denver. But they quickly find themselves on a perilous new treasure hunt in the mountains of Colorado, from which they may never return.
Three directors, three group of students, three stories, all aiming at the upcoming National Students' Talent Competition, where all the students training hard to perform on stage to win the game.
When a little girl begins to see the ghost of another girl her age shortly after finding a necklace at a landfill, she embarks on a journey to help the ghost discover the mystery behind her death.
The story of the first person born on the moon coming down to earth to play basketball.
An unlikely hero's quest to return to the younger brother he was stripped from years earlier, only to discover a far greater mission to save the city he left behind.
Two stories and two protagonists with mirrored narration and motivation.

A hero's journey with a most unlikely hero. Yellowbird is a teeny tiny orphaned bird that has never left the nest, has no family, yet desperately wants one - That is, until he finds himself leading a flock on their migration to Africa.
The hyperactive red-headed bird enters a turf war with a big city lawyer wanting to tear down his home in an effort to build a house to flip.
A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi.

An adaptation of the legendary 17th Century, Battle of Kata Cove in Jamaica, where a warrior king must valiantly fight against marauding Pirates and ferocious Duppies to defend and protect his people and his land.
Someone is viciously murdering people, people with criminal pasts. It appears that the murders may be linked to the disappearance of a young girl 15 years previously.
In Bermuda, two amateur treasure-hunting divers have a run-in with local criminals when they inadvertently discover the secret cargo of a World War II shipwreck.
When a U.S. Intelligence Agent is unable to bring a ruthless drug baron to justice, he resorts to hiring a contract killer. But the man with whom he is put in contact turns out to be an old friend.
The story of one lonely puppy searching for a family of his own. As chance may have it, he is adopted by a picky, wealthy woman who desperately wants to win a prestigious dog show.
Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists the help of his new-found ally, Diana Prince, to face an even greater enemy.

A Western noir about a freelance journalist who rolls into a small Mexican town to cover the cartel battles--but instead falls for the ex-wife of the town's mayor and gets drawn into her own private war.

Geeta, a criminal lawyer, has to defend a man who is allegedly mentally unstable and has killed three men. As she delves deeper into his case she realizes that things aren't what they seem and another murder might be impending.

Paloma decides to access a dating website for people of the same sex (female). She is surprised when she finds an profile for a girl who looks exactly like her. He doppelgänger threatens to impersonate her, and to erase her identity forever.
When a single mom and her two kids arrive in a small town, they begin to discover their connection to the original Ghostbusters and the secret legacy their grandfather left behind.

After his son witnesses a brutal murder by a notorious crime boss, a deaf Indonesian gangster is thrust into the fight of his life when he takes on his dangerous former allies, including a sociopath assassin, in order to protect his child.
A police officer attempts to change a dacoit into a good person and also gets him married to a beautiful village girl. However, circumstances do not let the changed man live happily.
Two stories about the greatest seducer of all time, Giacomo Casanova.
A campy pulp-noir following two estranged twin brothers, a cosplaying femme fatale, and a sexually-charged phone caller linked to a mischievous set of pookas.
Steamboat inventor Robert Fulton shows up in New York in 1807. Tavern keeper believes in him, but her boyfriend doesn't. All seems lost when sailors afraid of losing their jobs burn his boat.

Secret agent Perry Grant is called in via encoded radio message to investigate a strange case which involves counterfeit money industrial espionage and a fashion company that may be functioning as a front for a secret criminal organization

movie_name: The Thousand and One Lives of Doctor Mabuse
synopsis: One more tale in the Doctor Mabuse trilogy. Inspector Carl Lohemann killed Dr. Mabuse, heroically putting an end to the criminal mastermind's reign. But the nightmare has only just begun.
An old friend of a novelist eagerly reads each of his new books, waiting to find a character based on her.
Three women in three different situations report for induction at the Great Lakes Naval Training Station and end up roommates. What follows is a frothy and fun musical.
A retired cage fighter must embrace the monster he once was, to rescue his daughter from persecution in a small country town.
After discovering a magical mask, an 11-year-old aspiring wrestler enters a competition to become the next WWE superstar.

When a highly trained bodyguard is hired to protect a wealthy businessman's pampered daughter, he will have his work cut out for him. The beautiful young woman doesn't want or believe she needs protection.
A disfigured but compassionate and dedicated Jailor's life undergoes changes after his wife leaves with another male.

A struggling doctor and his ward are called to England to perform a unique form of mesmerism on an enigmatic and dying old man. Things take a haunting turn when his ward discovers the old mans sinister past.
To rid the world of evil, two human spirit-hosts and their spirit-protectors have to overcome countless adversity on a mystical journey through spirit worlds and requiem streets.
An unhappy businessman finds a new sense of purpose after he's tasked with helping a quartet of ghosts fulfill their last wishes before moving on to the afterlife.
Stuck in a time loop, two wedding guests develop a budding romance while living the same day over and over again.
When a young man accidentally kills someone, he is plunged into a rich man's world of blackmail, betrayal, adultery and ...murder.
When scientists use eco-terrorism to impose their will on the world by affecting extremes in the weather, Intelligence Chief Cramden calls in top agent Derek Flint.
The British intelligence agency plants spies in the Irish Republican Army to monitor terrorist activities. Based on an "Atlantic Monthly" article written by Matthew Teague.

A thriller involving an ongoing unsolved mystery in Alaska, where one town has seen an extraordinary number of unexplained disappearances during the past 40 years and there are accusations of a federal cover up.
15 years after a mysterious virus that causes humans to attack others spreads across the country, Zidik is forced to confront his fears again when another outbreak occurs.
A group of friends attempt to escape their daily grind at a lake house but find themselves influenced by a diabolical force that preys upon their worst impulses and desires.

movie_name: The Curious Case of Dolphin Bay
synopsis: It follows 15-year old Quinn Perkins, who will be spending the summer working as an intern with her best friend Daniela. Mysterious events start to occur, and they assume that they are being haunted by local legend Everly Fallow.
A foster family rescues a greyhound dog and when things go financially bad for the family the greyhound rescues them.
Paul Bommel loses a reasonable sum of money betting at pig races. However it all was meant as a donation for building a local hospital.
A cleric's son saves a maid from suicide and she saves him when he is framed for killing a crook's mistress.
A corrupt police officer faces challenges from his family, gangsters and politicians.

"A group of Celebrities and Internet Sensations get together at a Hollywood Hills Mansion for a star-studded New Year's Eve bash, when the night abruptly turns as a group of criminals crash the party with a deadly agenda."

movie_name: Die letzte Fahrt der Santa Margareta
synopsis: A captain from Hamburg takes over the command of a yacht, unaware that it's smuggling liquor. The action revolves around love, attacks on customs guards, a storm on the high seas, a capsized speedboat and a brave rescue operation.
A down-on-his-luck New Orleans private detective investigates the death of a voodoo charlatan, finding himself in the middle of a paranormal murder mystery.
A story of 7 prisoners who sentenced to death for kidnapping a rich businessman's daughter.
Based on a short story by Ken Liu, Arc is a story about a woman, Rina (Kyoko Yoshine), who has obtained immortality but struggles to find her place in the world and instead finds it crumbling.
A woman named Ruby has an anxiety attack and goes down the rabbit-hole of her mind, where she meets versions of herself who take over her life.
A groundbreaking popular science fiction film about the past and future of astronautics, from the first experiments by Konstantin Tsiolkovsky to the manned spaceflight and colonization of the Moon.
An up and coming young writer accidentally kills his ex-girlfriend then tries to cover it up but just tangles up a web of lies he weaves. The more he tries to hide, the deeper he digs the hole.

movie_name: Tumhare Hum Kaun Hai - A Lovearranged Story
synopsis: This is the story of a fatty-black boy. His wife was forced into an arranged marriage by her family. Love is not a matter of personality or appearance,but two words of affection. This is a story of acceptance of true love.
A gangster hires a mysterious rent-a-man for a subtle game of cat-and-mouse in the Las Vegas desert.
A man believes that his ex, shrink and colleagues are out to get him and that he's being followed by someone or something.
A NASA scientist is ordered to take a vacation due to showing signs of stress while working on his latest missile project.
WITH HER DEVIANT SEXUAL BEHAVIOR, OLIVIA, A NYMPHOMANIAC, COMPROMISES THE REPUTATION OF ALBINA WHO RESEMBLES HER.
White hunter Allan Quartermain and his enigmatic guide help a young Irish woman locate her missing father in unexplored Darkest Africa.
Two anti-terrorist agents are assigned to free a busload of American schoolchildren in the Philippines who are taken hostage by terrorists.
IS SOCIETY TO BLANE - for the bruised and twisted minds of a city's slums - snarling, growling, and grumbling as they are? "Barkada" awaits your verdict.

Vandiyathevan sets out to cross the Chola land to deliver a message from the Crown Prince Aditha Karikalan. Kundavai attempts to establish political peace as vassals and petty chieftains plot against the throne. Unrest grips the land as a long-tailed comet arrives, signalling a time of turmoil.
When the Prince of an empty kingdom embarks on a deadly quest to find an all-powerful stone, he discovers a secret, undeniable truth: real power lies within.
Five best friends who came from a foreign country studied in Netherlands. There they struggled with money and a lot of things but their friendship was a journey worth more than money.
A half-vampire, half-mortal man becomes a protector of the mortal race, while slaying evil vampires.
A woman lands a dream job at a powerful tech company called the Circle, only to uncover an agenda that will affect the lives of all of humanity.

What if you knew the world end before sunrise tomorrow? Heads of state, top scientists, and the UN leadership have all been informed a rogue asteroid will destroy the Earth in approximately 22 hours. How will they spend their final hours?
Three kids who travel back in time to 65 million years ago, where they are taken in by a dinosaur.
The lives of several couples and singles in New York City intertwine over the course of New Year's Eve.
Akari Inoue and other students are kidnapped and incarcerated. They are forced to participate in a game of kill and survive. The last survivor will receive one hundred million yen.
A group of young friends on a road trip decide to take a hiking trip into a remote forest and stumble upon the lair of a powerful vampire.

The Rapture has come and gone. In it's wake, a wasteland filled with desperate bandits. Josh McManus, a drifter with a knack for fighting, must find the mysterious "Shepherd" - a dangerous mission that will put his faith to the test.
Narco Soldiers is a timely, action-packed crime thriller that explores the resurgence of the Caribbean drug routes and one couple's violent, Bonnie and Clyde-style rise to power.
One of Marvel's most iconic families makes it to the big screen: the Fantastic Four.
The story of an uptown rat that gets flushed down the toilet from his penthouse apartment, ending in the sewers of London, where he has to learn a whole new and different way of life.
Two LAPD homicide detectives face the case of their careers chasing a legendary, allegedly cursed painting responsible for a century of mysterious deaths.

Before Tilda's parents can put her beloved grandfather in an old people's home due to his progressing Alzheimer disease, she takes him on one last adventure that subliminally threatens to tear her family apart.
Moto thwarts a ruthless band of international agents who try to foment an international incident by mining the entrance to the Suez Canal and blaming the British.
A hard-working mother inches towards disaster as she divorces her husband and starts a successful restaurant business to support her spoiled daughter.

Based on real events In a school in the northern suburbs, the arrival of the mysterious and charming Chris will upset Dorothea, which will fall in love. Soon the two of them will bring the rest of the gang in a dark new world.
Tom Sawyer and his pal Huckleberry Finn have great adventures on the Mississippi River, pretending to be pirates, attending their own funeral and witnessing a murder.
In a small quiet village a few of the locals begin to take on evil split personalities with horrific results , a psychologist is hired by the Police to get to the bottom of why this is happening.
After making a bet, Steve strands himself on uninhabited island.
Story of two starcrossed lovers who are not destined to be together; based upon the novel of the famous bengali novelist Humayun Ahmed.

Amid the Civil War in 17th-century England, a group of deserters flee from battle through an overgrown field. Captured by an alchemist, the men are forced to help him search to find a hidden treasure that he believes is buried in the field.
Boonie bears and Bald Qiang work together with secret primitive girl to smash a conspiracy to destroy old-growth forest.

movie_name: Innocence in a Garden of Lies
synopsis: In the not to distant future two young man leave home in search of personal freedom.
A challenged man is stalked by tall phantoms in business suits after he buys the car of his dreams with a mysterious black credit card.
Jaden marries his perfect mate only to learn they have a battle between them with personality challenges unexplained.

Waking up in a room, while all alone, a glimpse of a familiar around, with some shading lights coming in. A dream and reality as one, while getting out of a place that keeps one trapped of going on and meeting her, his, one.
A young student discovers he has superhuman abilities of various beasts absorbed inside him. He must struggle to keep his hold on reality and not be taken over.
Unknown for copyright protection..
When a man inadvertently makes Santa fall off his roof on Christmas Eve, he finds himself magically recruited to take his place.
Reality and delusion meld as a female drug-addict runs for her life from an ominous pale man.
Macy Gray, the story of a rising female boxer must face a very important fight, but must first deal with her inner demons.
A young college student and a group of friends find themselves victims of demons unwillingly released during a mishap at a prestigious university.
A cursed girl gains weight and her mother seems to be an acolyte of the supernatural creature that causes her condition.
A psychologist, an Englishman, a bellboy and a wounded female assassin have their fates crossed at a sleazy Bangkok hotel.
Logan Burnhardt is the ego-king of the airwaves, but his unflappable persona is put to the test when a terrorist bio-attack unleashes a plague of flesh-ripping maniacs on Los Angeles.
Ma Liang's brush makes whatever he paints come alive, which makes him the target of a power-hungry general.

A teen with superhero powers leads an underground group formed to bring down the establishment after the mayor of New York City intensifies police brutality towards blacks and calls for a citywide purge.

Follows the journey of Clémence and her kitty, Rroû, as they leave Paris to spend the holidays in the countryside. While there, Rroû enjoys the wildlife and befriends Câline, a white kitten who prowls in the woods.
A virtuous Hong Kong Police Officer must clear his good name when the drug lord he is after frames him for the murder of a dirty cop.

When two troll siblings wake up all alone in their cave, they need to embark on an adventure to find out were the 100 troll family has gone to. New things come to light about their family and feared mother Grýla.
Spooky high jinks abound when Elvira finds herself spending the night in a mysterious castle en route to 1851 Paris.
A guy gets his hands on an experimental drug that allows people to travel at incredible speeds.
Four thieves attempt to make the richest score in history.
Relationships are not easy. A multi-story film with intersecting lives in which adult relationships are closely examined during challenges.
The last 24 hours of a man on death row.
The lives of two friends are turned upside-down when someone from their past returns.

Peter, a young aircraft engineer is deceived by his manager Jason into substituting faulty aircraft parts. When a part explodes killing a passenger, Air accident investigation find Peter responsible. Jason is found murdered.
A quirky twist on the vampire tale, set in modern day corporate America.
In the late 17th century, two Puritan witch hunters travel to a small Massachusetts town investigating rumors of devil worship, and are irrevocably transformed by the ungodly forces they encounter.
Upon reuniting with his friend Gage, a disengaged man named Owen is set on a deadly path to gain control of his own life. Can he survive?

The ghost of a woman who was murdered on her wedding night haunts anyone who comes into possession of the wedding ring that was on her ring finger on the night of the murder and vows to continue until justice is served.

After Sunday mass, a sadistic priest locks identical twin alter boys in the church basement claiming one to be the embodiment of good and the other of evil, leaving them with the choice to destroy them-self or the other.
In an apocalyptic future, a man with extra-human powers goes on the run.
A murdered man (Baxter) helps his widow (Leeds) bring his killer (Bari) to justice.
An inversion of the Bible into a dark parable where Jesus finds love in Mary Magdalene, a kindly evilness in the Devil, and comes to terms with the sins of God, a power-hungry autocrat.

A portrayal of a new world order's birth of fire. September 11, 2001 destabilized not just the entire western civilization, but also the very people who found themselves in the Twin Towers, when terror gripped the city that never sleeps.

Student Tomins finds a gold pocket watch. He hands it to the swindler who pretends to be the owner of the watch. After finding out the truth Tomins and all his classmates gets on chase to get back the lost watch.

After Carlos, an impoverished teen from a fractured home, receives a desperate note from Sarah, a pen pal he lost touch with a year ago, he uses her letters to solve the mystery of her disappearance and crimes she may have been a part of.
Autobiographical comedy about a recovering sex addict, about his obsession with prostitutes, and how that affected his relationships and his life altogether.

movie_name: The Enlightenment: Sons of the Silent Age
synopsis: THE ENLIGHTENMENT is a feature film that touches overall the global conspiracy of the Illuminati. In a unique way shows an esoteric ritual sacrifice with the use of blood as a divine medium to achieve power and money.
In the year 2050, super kids from different parts of Saudi Arabia band together racing against time to stop an evil hacker from erasing all human life, history and culture of their nation.
A maths teacher acquires the power to travel into movies to save the woman of his dreams and bring her back to her correct film.

Three different stories of three different people- an undercover cop on a hunt of an international criminal, a small time entrepreneur who accidentally witnesses a murder, and a criminal lawyer hated for defending rapists.
Using the interrogation of a US counterinsurgency agent as a backdrop, the film explores the consequences of the struggle between Uruguay's government and the leftist Tupamaro guerrillas.
A pair of intergalactic explorers in deep space make a startling discovery.
When the wind moves, rustling the leaves of two katsura trees, it is as if they speak.
17-year-old Zoe Hull uses her wits, survival skills, and compassion to fight for her life, and those of her fellow classmates, against a group of live-streaming school shooters.

While hanging out after school, Charlie and his friends discover the headquarters of the world's most powerful superhero hidden beneath his home. When villains attack, they must team up to defend the headquarters and save the world.
A prince kidnapped at infancy and his foster brother fight against an evil wizard and a conspiracy in the palace.

Two villains escape from jail in London. They are planning an attack on Agaton Sax. Inspector Lispington and Sax are chasing the two bad guys, but the hunt is hampered by the villains have lookalikes.

After a string of bad luck, a debt collector has no other choice than to spend the night in a haunted temple, where he encounters a ravishing female ghost and later battles to save her soul from the control of a wicked tree demon.
The God of Destruction Lord Beerus comes to Earth looking for a Saiyan God and threatens to destroy the Earth if there is none.

Maya wakes up alive after committing suicide and strangely finds herself caught up in surreal circumstances where she meets a man claiming to be dead who takes her on a journey crossing lines between illusions and reality.
Inspired by her grandfather's stories, young Shinko embarks on wild flights of fancy about the history of the little town she lives in. But dreams can't fend off the realities of growing up.
Detective Gore Stoecker embarks on a missing persons case and encounters bits of enlightenment as he gets closer to his goals.
A desperate man hires an advanced biotech firm to engineer a child while, in the distant future, a corrupt oligarch runs a dead earth awash in genetic inferiority
Seven characters are brought together under false pretence to a neglected and desolate care home only to find out that they're there to be avenged for their crimes of the past.
A 10-year-old boy's fondness for practical jokes gets him into trouble when a baby is accidentally kidnapped.
The Mafia tries to take revenge against a man who testified against them in court.
The shackles of destiny become broken.

Investigating off the Mediterranean, the ultra-deep drilling vessel Yavuz discovers an unknown object 9 kilometers deep in the sea. As the research deepens, the crew will soon have to make radical decisions in the game of survival.

movie_name: Deceit, a Lethal Ladies Noir Novella
synopsis: When online dating goes way, way wrong..

A close knit community of gifted earth worshippers use their strength of will and character to peacefully disrupt the distopian society that they have inherited. "There is a place at the table"...for us all.

movie_name: Tomorrow I'll Wake Up and Scald Myself with Tea
synopsis: Jan is a decent, boring man, living a decent, boring life as a rocket designer. When his adventurous twin brother dies in a breakfast accident, Jan decides to impersonate him, unwittingly becoming a part of a Nazi time travel conspiracy.
Richard Okezie decides to leave Sylvia, his lifelong imaginary friend and lover for Gbemi a flesh-and-blood real woman, but complications arise when Sylvia decides to destroy Richard's peaceful life.
Hidden with a mysterious agenda, a sniper holds a businessman hostage in a closed phone booth, where he is ordered to obey the sniper or he will be killed.

Carty has a new baby, a tense marriage, and four months of fragile sobriety. When he discovers a twenty dollar bill with a message written on it, an obsession begins. Will it free him? Or destroy him?
Four scientists craft a machine to reanimate deceased organisms.
A girl discovers that her cat has the abillity to influence the decisions of her struggling family members only during the holiday season.
A NYPD detective attempts to avenge her father's death but unwittingly becomes involved with one of his murderers.
A dark comedy about a family taking care of their vampire daughter.
A clever reporter gets involved with a bank embezzlement case.
A female hero who transforms her world without using violence or imitating her male counterparts.

Ascension Core is a cyberpunk tale, that follows a prominent security team who find out their next assignment could be their last. Betrayal and secrets follow the team as they try to uncover the truth behind their company.
WARRING POLITICAL WARLORDS IN CENTRAL LUZON SOW TERROR DURING THE LOCAL ELECTIONS OF 1971.

movie_name: The King Kong That Appeared in Edo
synopsis: In part one of this silent two-part film, an ape nicknamed King Kong by its master kidnaps the daughter of a wealthy man as part of a revenge plot by one of his lackeys. The story concludes in King Kong Appears in Edo: The Episode of Gold (1938).
Earth sends a five-man team to explore the frozen planet Uranus, only to find a temperate forest and sultry women from their past on it, courtesy of an alien brain with evil designs.
After witnessing a bungled heist, 3 Teenagers foolishly decide to take the abandoned Armored Car for themselves that instantly plunges them into danger.
A bold, amateur kidnapping goes wildly awry in this fictionalized account of beer magnate Alfred Heineken's 1983 abduction, which would go on to become one of The Netherlands' most infamous crimes.

movie_name: Tim Travers & the Time Travelers Paradox
synopsis: A scientist creates a time machine and kills their younger self to see what would happen. And that self-obsessed, misanthrope, mad genius of a scientist is Tim Travers. And the universe was bad enough with only one of him.
Two musicians are unknowingly drawn into a supernatural scheme.

Stacey and Lilian are unsuccessful you-tubers . One day, after drunkenly trespassing in a graveyard, the girls capture footage of a ghost. This is their ticket to fame and fortune, but their real problems have only begun.
A senator is forced to go on the run after killing a judge and fights to clear his name.
In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

A student travels with her boyfriend to Chiloé, remote Patagonia island in southern Chile, to investigate the link that exists between the high number of sexual related crimes and the myths 'n' legends that surround this mysterious place.

Hoping to cure his violent seizures, a man agrees to a series of experimental microcomputers inserted into his brain but inadvertently discovers that violence now triggers a pleasurable response to his brain.
A manufacturer of furniture sees his business go down and decides to rob banks to pay his staff. Het gets romantically involved with one of his victims.
The actual tape of a couple who travel to Poland but find themselves disturbed by an evil force when the girl returns to her home town where she once played a Ouija board.
A group of young people living a luxurious life in Istanbul go to a village for a rafting adventure on the Euphrates.

When an unknown disease slowly occurs and wipes out half of the population, A former ems chief name Walker tries to warn the remaining population including the president as the scientist and doctors try to find a cure for it.
A foreigner girl murder mystery.
This first person text by Michael Haussman examines gravity's effect on human emotion, told through five high definition video sequences filmed at 2,000 frames per second.
A gory & violent take on "Night of the Living Dead", only with vampires.

movie_name: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
synopsis: Detective Sherlock Holmes is on the trail of criminal mastermind Professor Moriarty, who is carrying out a string of random crimes across Europe.

A Sumatran elephant calf was being hunted for smuggling. This incident caught the attention of five children who were camping nearby. The five children had the courage to try saving the elephant calf.
A well-known writer becomes a recluse after her sister is murdered, and devises a plan to catch the killer after she thinks she sees him on television.

movie_name: Trailer Park Boys: Countdown to Liquor Day
synopsis: The boys return from jail to find the park has deteriorated, with a brand new park being created beside it. They attempt a series of get rich quick schemes and robberies, while a freshly drunk Lahey threatens to derail their plans.
A satire of the Giallo style spaghetti slashers, this film centers around a group of young men and women who meet violent ends at the eponymous Red Rabbit Lodge.
Even the Vatican has secrets. Islamic militants plot to overthrow the Vatican with inside help in a supreme attempt to subvert Christianity offering 2000 year old 'living proof'.
After Jane Hoyt's journalist husband disappears, she arrives in Hong Kong determined to find him but instead meets shady shipping magnate Hank Lee.
The spirit of a comatose teenage girl possesses the body of a newcomer to her girls boarding school to enact bloody revenge against the elitist, lingerie-clad coeds responsible for her condition.

movie_name: Alega Gang: Public Enemy No. 1 of Cebu
synopsis: BASED IN THE TRUE-TO-LIFE STORY OF ULYSSES 'BOBBY' ALEGA, THE FUGITIVE LEADER OF CEBU CITY'S MOST DREADED GANG.
After the police deliver him a piece of devastating news, a teenage boy and his girlfriend are taken on a trip through Rotterdam to find and inform his parents.

When Emily (Christina Slocum) goes missing in a rural town, Zack (Zack Gold) enlists the help of Detective Lark (David Hesseltine) to track her down. But the mystery soon deepens and takes stranger turns than anyone involved has ever seen.
Bryan must put a new team together. His last team died in action.
A scientist makes a last stand on Earth with the help of a ragtag team of soldiers against an invasion of alien phantoms.

Martin inherits a fishing boat and a house in a small town in Denmark. He employs the old employee Mikkel and nephew Anders who likes a girl at Møllegården. Martin likes another girl there. Smugglers are active in the area.
The film is a love story with elements of horror. The protagonist is a man who shows off his bravery and also manages to scare ghosts.
Late one night a shopping centre receives an unexpected visitor, what begins as an act of kindness turns into a night of horror.
A race of sexy women from Angvia, a planet in another dimension, comes to Earth to kidnap women to repopulate their planet.
Plot undisclosed. An action-thriller with sci-fi elements.
Kemal is forced to be divorced by his ex-lover. So, ex-lover pay the money needed for his wife's expansive medical treatment.
Two friends, fed up with their college lives, quit art school and escape to the woods of northern Wisconsin where the wilderness begins to close in and they drift into a state of surrealism.

movie_name: Long John Silver's Return to Treasure Island
synopsis: In this sequel to Treasure Island, Long John hopes to rescue his friend Jim from a rival pirate and return for more treasure.

Sharon is a fast-­rising PR executive from Singapore, searching for love in Hong Kong, who may have found her dream guy, but as she chases after him online and in person, Sharon quickly finds out the dangers of stalking a secret crush.

Reminiscent of Sunset Boulevard, Hustler White transposes the action from the silver screen's old movie backlots to contemporary male prostitution and the porn industry. Said to be an homage to classic Hollywood cinema.

A cold case is reopened when new evidence emerges drawing a tenacious detective into a decades-old murder investigation. As they dig deeper they uncover a web of secrets hidden motives and unexpected connections that lead them closer to the truth.

Full-time detectives Nick and Audrey are struggling to get their private eye agency off the ground. They find themselves at the center of international abduction when their friend Maharaja, is kidnapped at his own lavish wedding.

This story is about a part of an area in Delhi city where life is as a bullet. The whole administration fails to maintain peace in the city just because of the fight of supremacy between two gangsters.
A cop becomes obsessed over his new and mysterious neighbor who he believes to be someone from his past that was killed years ago.

Scientists create amphibious supersoldiers and detonate a nuclear bomb. In the midst of the fallout, a monster arrives, leaving Japan defenseless. Mankind's only hope is an irradiated water goblin with death on its mind.
When a mechanic in the future is accused of a crime he did not commit, he must use his knowledge of the stat-of-the-art maze like building in which he works to expose the real truth.
The story follows a young woman as she's put through a psychological journey under the thumb of a mysterious figure who suspects her husband of stealing millions from a crime syndicate.
A raped woman tries to prove her innocence and catch the criminals.
The story of a vampire who terrorized the inhabitants of a mountainous region.
A lawyer is caught in a conspiratorial web that he cannot even begin to imagine in scope.

After beheading her husband, Queen Titiana takes over the mystical woods where lost souls and ghouls wander about confused in this surrealist film inspired by William Shakespeare's 'A Midsummer Night's Dream'.
Two young women, on a quest to explore their sexuality in the decadent New York party scene - transform into monsters when they get aroused.
In a ski resort in the Apennines live Paolo Antonelli and his partner Daniela, a young heiress.
The encounter between Harper,mysterious getaway driver and Mary, a beautiful aspiring actress .

The true story of Lord Francis Hope, who inherits the Hope Diamond and marries showgirl May Yohe'. Lord Francis Hope gambles away the family fortune and May Yohe' leaves him--another suspected curse of owning the Hope Diamond.

George Ladima, a poet and renowned journalist, loves Emilia, an actress whom he helps in her career, but who takes advantage of him. He commits suicide and in his pocket is found a love note to a Mrs. T.
A British girl is trapped on the island of Crete when the Germans invade it.
A man's (Ajay Devgan) loyalty to his underworld friend (Rahul Bose) interferes with his relationship with a dancer (Tabu) who hates violence.
A reclusive Mink farmer reunites with her feuding siblings in order to investigate the death of their brother and an imminent land expropriation.
Set in a small town whose residents find themselves under attack after a spaceship carrying the universe's most wanted and dangerous criminals crash lands in their backyard.
An ex-prizefighter returns to the ring to help his father-in-law who has money problems. Based on Lucian Cary's novel "The Duke Comes Back."
A musical following Noah, a boy with a song in his heart and dreams to share messages of love with the vile Knawkemoutville, a city obsessed with violence and boxing.
A woman who lives forever is reluctantly connected to a clandestine group that she calls her family. Struggling with this alienating condition, she now faces the decisive days of her endless life.
Lonely, misanthropic small-time crook Enzo uses the superpowers he gained after falling into the Tiber River to chase down a crazy gangster called "The Gypsy."
A young punk teenager pulls a prank on the night of Halloween that will come back to haunt him a year later.
A new interpretation of the most known and beloved fairy tale of Hans Christian Andersen - "Snow Queen"
Toke N' Choke Dispensary begins to slowly spiral out of control with the threat of an asset forfeiture by a bully DEA agent Ronnie has a history with.

Modern Arcana is a psychedelic dance romance about two beings. Only one can live at a time, but in the afterlife they are together for eternity. When Estelle starts questioning, why not stay dead, who says love has to last a lifetime?

Tom's wife tells him that he needs to get more sleep or he's going to start seeing things that aren't there. After working the night shift Tom leaves for a camping trip. Tom probably should have listened to his wife.
Three men spend the night in a haunted house to face the malevolent ghost that drove their brothers to suicide...and they end up exploring the darkest corners of their own minds.
Clara Goldstein is a Jewish woman who, because of a visit from her brother, is forced to create a contrived relationship with a man of her own faith.

A con artist, Brian Torro, uses global environmental laws to make himself a multimillionaire. His arrogance sets him up for a race against time to avoid prison or from losing everything he has. Fortunately for Torro, B.S. is his business.
Deva (Sharwanand) is a powerful gangster from Visakhapatnam who moves to Spain to put his past behind him. But what happens when he realises he can't shake off his enemies no matter where he goes?

movie_name: Zu: Warriors from the Magic Mountain
synopsis: A Chinese soldier in an ancient civil war flees the battlefield and gets caught up in a fantastical quest to save the world from evil.

Krash wants to throw his best buddy Barry an unforgettable birthday party. He hires the DejaVu Agency, which organizes exciting time travel adventures. But the Kikoriki crew fail to follow the rules and the group is scattered across time.
When six best high school buddies are cross the forbidden forest and broken all the rules in there, something evil follow their back and causing death among themselves.

A suspenseful thriller pitting money greed and destruction from a Mexican drug cartel jihadist terrorist group using a new prototype drone from a US arms contractor and one man using all of his assets to stop them.

movie_name: 3 Tough Guys in a Girls' School
synopsis: Three friends disguise themselves as women in a desperate attempt to meet their sweethearts who attend a strict all-girls school.
Long-fiction film tracing the professional journey of Eliott, sent to Alaska for maintenance work on the Trans-Alaska Pipeline. A journey which will slowly change into a initiatory trip.
Two young people find love despite the violent landscape in which they live.
A two- front war between Indian intelligence agencies and the Pakistani establishment.
An Argentinian adaptation of the Justice League series.

Solar flares erupt from the sun, headed for earth, and giant meteors rain down on the planet. Meanwhile, a young girl is dreaming it all before it happens. Or is she? A sci-fi thriller shot in beautiful New Zealand.
A team of archaeologists are searching for clues to solve a unforeseen mystery, however they find something far worse than they expected.

Eight unsuspecting high school seniors at a posh boarding school, who delight themselves on playing games of lies, come face-to-face with terror and learn that nobody believes a liar - even when they're telling the truth.
An advance team from a dying, far-off civilization seeks a new world to conquer and inhabit -- Earth.
A group of dropouts find an old man (Sir Christopher Lee) in a castle. The old man subsequently turns into the Devil and seizes them.

For Victor, days go by and are all the same. But this dull life could be disrupted because, little by little, it is clear that something is going wrong - Vi is sure: somewhere in his flat, or perhaps hidden in himself, Hell is ready.
A football star jailed for assault leads a group of inmates in a match against prison guards.
A poor factory worker employed by a wealthy uncle falls in love with a beautiful heiress, but his happiness and promising future are jeopardized by a previous affair with a coworker he impregnated.
After the Republic's victory on Christophsis, Anakin and his new apprentice, Ahsoka Tano, must rescue the kidnapped son of Jabba the Hutt. Political intrigue complicates their mission.
When Jack, a vampire slayer, is bitten by his arch-nemesis, he will have but one day left to live, before becoming the very thing has been hunting his entire life.
The movie story deals with a CBI inspector who foils a diabolical plot of the uncle of a neighboring ruler from usurping the throne with the help of outside agents.
A spider escapes from an isolated Arizona desert laboratory experimenting in giantism and grows to tremendous size as it wreaks havoc on the local inhabitants.
A single father and two women venture from the safety of their homes to face monstrous creatures to save the life of a young boy.
Uprooted from her colorful and secure childhood, Soley wakes up one morning to a raging volcano that changes her lifer and that of her family forever.
When his only son dies in an accident, Balraaj urges his depressed daughter-in-law to marry a man who has long loved her in silence.
A near-death experience has a dedicated young astronaut questioning whether to follow her head or heart, once she is offered to go farther into space than any human in history.
Remnant. Action/Thriller/Adventure.
A tough, slobby, honest cop tries to simultaneously take down heroin dealers and a corrupt businessman who murdered a burglar, even if it costs him his life.
