A vengeful spirit has taken the form of the Tooth Fairy to exact vengeance on the town that lynched her 150 years earlier. Her only opposition is the only child, now grown up, who has survived her before.

A celebrity impulsively leaves fast-paced Tokyo to deliver a much-needed jeep to a remote village. When his controlling manager, the woman he loves, follows, the two must reconcile while dodging reporters.
Plot is being kept under wraps.
A man falls in love with a village belle who is destined for traditional prostitution.
It's a case of mistaken ethnicity, where two non-Italians pretend to be Italian to win each others hearts in Boston's North End.

movie_name: How Does David Lynch Do It?
synopsis: 6 people talk about the intimate life of David Lynch.
A female gunfighter returns to a frontier town where a dueling tournament is being held, which she enters in an effort to avenge her father's death.
Based on the short film "Silver Stiletto", written and produced by Craig Rossiter.
A man went back to Guizhou, found the tracks of a mysterious woman. He recalls the summer he spent with her twenty years ago.

An off duty police begins to suspect a local man for having had an affair with his recently dead wife. Gradually his obsession for finding out the truth accumulates and inevitably begins to endanger himself and his loved ones.
A brother and sister learn to use their martial arts to protect the ocean they love.
In a mysterious city, a young man's life begins to unravel when some extraterrestrial life form is discovered in space and connects with the questions he's always been asking himself.
A war veteran suffering from PTSD befriends a teenage girl.
An 11-year-old boy's amazing ability to break wind leads him first to fame and then to death row, before it helps him to fulfill his ambition of becoming an astronaut.
A kidnapping goes sour when the perpetrators cross paths with the unforeseen.
A father and son, with help from their dog and parrot, chase down thieves who stole their valuable paiting.
A woman struggles to protect her children from a dangerous fog as she fights through two converging timelines - one in an abandoned chapel, the other in a research facility.
Years after retiring from the world of free fighting martial arts, a man returns to the deadly world of fighting after his best student is killed in the tournament.

movie_name: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
synopsis: "Godfather of the kung-fu film", Chang Cheh, made this treasured and beloved adventure featuring a sword, training manual, treasure map and a secret message. The kung-fu which ensues is as impressive as it is glorious.

A timid, nearsighted chemistry teacher discovers a magical potion that can transform him into a suave and handsome Romeo. The Jekyll and Hyde game works well enough until the concoction starts to wear off at the most embarrassing times.

NOT FROM HUMAN HANDS Adventure of the Forest Five Family, Sci-Fi A young hiking enthusiast and his friends discover an alien substance that can change humanity in a hidden cave, and fight to keep it from falling into the wrong hands.
A scientist named Dr. Kevin Trench obtains a battle-suit with super powers, from someone he discovers is a future version of himself.

A storm rages. A young girl is kidnapped. Her mother teams up with the mysterious woman next door to pursue the kidnapper, a journey that tests their limits and exposes shocking secrets from their pasts.

The toys are mistakenly delivered to a day-care center instead of the attic right before Andy leaves for college, and it's up to Woody to convince the other toys that they weren't abandoned and to return home.

It's Valentine's Day and all the inhabitants of Sunnyville are celebrating. Besties Beezbee the bee, Peanut the giraffe and Brooklyn the lion are trying to figure out what Valentine's Day is all about.
A bat-wielding, masked killer in a rusted-out black Cadillac weaves in and out of three interlocking stories awash in sex, drugs, punk rock, black magic, and broken homes.

When the director of a successful racing car company is shot dead the other directors have reason to believe their lives are at risk too. Suspect number one is an ex-employee just released from gaol who went down on their evidence.
A cop, who sets out to solve the mysterious death of infants in Kumbakonam, realises that a few bigwigs are behind the crime.
An anthropologist and his family are shipwrecked on a South Seas island.
A former hit-man for a drug cartel becomes a vigilante to pay for his sins and find redemption.

movie_name: A Nymphoid Barbarian in Dinosaur Hell
synopsis: In a post-Armageddon world, a young woman finds herself in a fight for survival against mutant cavemen, dinosaurs and other prehistoric animals.
Tia, a 10 year-old Syrian refugee living in Montreal, finds a magic portal and travels to the Arctic where she befriends an Inuk girl with who she immerses herself in a world of Inuit myth and magic.
A corporate criminal plans to devalue property by fueling a devastating crime wave, but his plans are complicated by a cop who won't be bought and a vigilante killer who dresses like a circus clown.
A serial killing painter murders three women who are subjects of his latest masterpiece. In doing so he releases the evil they hold inside and they exact revenge on his party guests one by one.
A young man suddenly discovers that he has the gift of healing. As he tries to understand it and the new reality it offers, a teenage girl with terminal cancer unexpectedly shows him the way.
Four-part television mini-series: General Hannibal Barca invades Rome. After Rome's long war against Carthage, Barca rises from the ashes like a Phonex.
A dreamlike journey of Youssef, 30 years old sick with the amnesia. A girl lead him in front of the " House of the light" , that recalls something in him. He researches the missing piece of memory.
Notorious cult The Lords of Samhain resurrect long dead serial killer Halloween Jack and all hell breaks loose in the town of Dunwich.

movie_name: Tomica Hero: Rescue Force Explosive Movie: Rescue the Mach Train!
synopsis: Mad scientist Mataro Madano has hijacked the Mach Train, and the Rescue Force must use all the tools at their disposal to save the passengers.
A bounty hunter from New Mexico and a gang of horsemen called "Four of the Apocalypse" set their sights on the town of Dogma.

The United States is the only populated country left on Earth after a worldwide nuclear war (that it started). A vampire-like alien race comes to Earth to "save" them but instead turns the US into a nightmarish dystopian police state.

The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind
A sceptical American man is stranded in the middle of a zombie-infected Africa and must trust the help of three mysterious strangers in order to make it out alive.
Two children who have psychic powers use them to avenge the death of their father, who was murdered by a biker gang.
A troubled young women fights her urge for revenge with her need to survive, when her and her five friends are kidnapped by her sadistic childhood kidnapper.
MISTERIOS DEL PASADO straddling drama, fantasy and suspense, tells the story of a girl who tragically loses her brother.
The residents of a small town team up to kill a group of evolved sharks that can swim in sand, and are terrorizing local beaches.
A recap of the popular anime series Shingeki no Kyojin from seasons 1-3.
Nick tries to kill his wife to get her money, but when learning of this, she plans the same for him!
120 years in a cyberpunk future. An elite special forces team. Next level nanotechnology and the awakening of something even those in the know, knew nothing about.
A Gigolo and a Parrot Shop Keeper have to clear their names while on the run from the Santa Muerte Cartel.
Teenagers Ania and Tomek's relationship is put to test when not only do both of their families disapprove of it, but Ania is also introduced to all-night parties that soon turn disastrous.
It tells about the theft of a miraculous iconostasis from the city museum.
Swiss Professor Raimund Gregorius (Jeremy Irons) abandons his lectures and buttoned-down life to embark on a thrilling adventure that will take him on a journey to the very heart of himself.

A scheming raccoon fools a mismatched family of forest creatures into helping him repay a debt of food, by invading the new suburban sprawl that popped up while they were hibernating...and learns a lesson about family himself.
Titli, the youngest member of a car-jacking brotherhood wants to escape the family business. He and his wife form a pact to set free from their family roots. But is escape possible?
On the eve of their children's marriage, NYC in-laws Sheldon Kornpett and Vince Ricardo embark on a series of misadventures involving the CIA, the Treasury Department and Central American dictators.
An adaptation of the Robert Lewis Stevenson adventure classic, in which a young boy sets off on a voyage armed with a map to buried treasure.
A guilt-ridden man suffering demonic hallucinations from his traumatic past falls under the spell of a powerful witch doctor determined to kill him.
A young foster child finds temporary placement on a horse ranch before Christmas. Can she find the love she was missing with a busy young female rancher who has eyes for a handsome young vet?

Isaiah seems to have his life completely together only a couple years after college, but perfection comes at a cost and everything that he loves is put to the test. Will lust overpower and destroy this young couple or will love prevail?

movie_name: I Am the Pretty Thing That Lives in the House
synopsis: A young nurse takes care of an elderly author who lives in a haunted house.
Two strangers meet on the road and travel through Nevada on motorcycle to find an elusive spot where they can dump another man's ashes.
In the near future, where illegal body swapping is a premium service, a wheelchair-bound father must solve his own murder after a switch gone wrong leaves him on the run.

movie_name: Che fanno i nostri supermen tra le vergini della jungla?
synopsis: Three superheroes attempt to reclaim the stolen lease of a uranium mine.
An overbearing mother asks a witch doctor to help bring her dead son back to life, which leads to disastrous results.
The best men of France - a brave journalist and an extremely energetic commissioner - attack the trail of a mysterious criminal mastermind.
Vacationers are terrorized by an army of hungry reptiles.
A womanizing CIA agent and an insecure insurance agent are paired together to make sure a deal goes through with aliens for the future of mankind.

A boy happen to meet a girl by chance, and then come to know about the secret that she haunted around without any memory that she has been murdered. He helps her to go to heaven by revealing the details of her death...
A monstrous crime occurs in Arlettsville that shatters Sheriff Joe Haladin and his family. But then, on the very same day, another tsunami hits. Stars Jeff Weber as Sheriff Joe Haladin.
Doraemon and friends look for a famous thief after he stole Doraemon's bell.
Biopic of female Japanese murderer Takahashi Oden.
The special squad "Black Berets" does not accept compromises. Even if twice as many enemies, they will fight to victory.
A former aerobatic pilot must overcome fear and turn into a soldier in the times of war, to save his colleagues stranded behind the enemy line.
After being exiled from the most advanced town in post apocalyptic Australia, a drifter travels with a group of abandoned children to rebel against the town's queen.
Sometime Before Yesterday. Or After Tomorrow. Somewhere Out In The Yonder. There Was This Guy.
A young programmer is selected to participate in a ground-breaking experiment in synthetic intelligence by evaluating the human qualities of a highly advanced humanoid A.I.

movie_name: Confessions of a Teenage Drama Queen
synopsis: A teenage girl is convinced that her home city revolves around her until her family packs up and moves to the suburbs, where she finds herself competing for attention.

A biker returns from Thailand to set things straight with his girlfriend. One gang leader wants him for delivery of 2 motorbikes filled with crystal meth and another gang leader wants him for murdering his brother.
A young boy from Earth embarks on a mission with aliens from another world to save his parents. If he fails, an evil dark lord will takeover the universe, destroying it and his parents.
A woman down on her luck stumbles into a bar run my a local meth dealer and finds herself accepting an offer that will change her life for the worse.

Gloria finds a power she never knew she had when she is drawn into a dangerous world of cross-border crime. Surviving will require all of her cunning, inventiveness, and strength. Based on the Spanish-language film.

A homeless man is hired as a survival guide for a group of wealthy businessmen on a hunting trip in the mountains, unaware that they are killers who hunt humans for sport, and that he is their new prey.
A married film director falls for a young painter - twice.
A man is framed by two corrupt cops for drugs. After he gets out of prison, he comes after them.

UN's secretary general uses covert operations to help diplomacy along. Shaw's called back 6 months after one such operation. He witnesses the murder of Chinese UN ambassador at UN, NYC, chases the assassin and ends up a suspect.

movie_name: Bobby Jr and the Great Trip to Antlantis
synopsis: Bobby Jr is thirteen years old and ready for adventure. His father decides to let him join on their next escapade, though things quickly get out of control.
When a census taker mistakenly receives a snuff film on his doorstep, he must risk his life to uncover a network of political corruption.
Love's wires are crossed in this hilarious caper; strategems and misunderstandings abound as the young protagonists struggle to navigate their way through life, land jobs, and find a place to live.
A young boy is searching for meaning, but he cannot share his experiences. A man carries with him the lonely child in his memory. Life projected as a self-recycling dream.
What is that thing Jack is building in his cellar? How could such a device be used? Perhaps it has something to do with that creature out in the woods...
The Berenstain Bears are back to save their home and town from being bulldozed.

The Last Fiction" is the first animated feature film made entirely in Iran. This contemporary looking crowd-favorite film played in countless film festivals and received multiple awards. Based on classic Persian literature.
A handsome prince rides a flying horse to faraway lands and embarks on magical adventures, which include befriending a witch, meeting Aladdin, battling demons and falling in love with a princess.

John and Maria Wilde move to her native Sweden to save their marriage. Whilst on a break at a lakeside cabin dark forces threaten everything Maria holds dear. In order to survive, she must accept her true destiny, before it's too late.
When Katie, an ordinary woman, meets Paco, an ordinary man, something magical happens: a love story. From this union an extraordinary child is born: Ricky.

movie_name: Fullmetal Alchemist: The Revenge of Scar
synopsis: When a mysterious figure starts to target State Alchemists for their sins against God, Alchemist Edward Elric and his brother Alphonse are at their most vulnerable, meanwhile the homunculi begin to unveil themselves once again.
People from various walks of life find themselves held captive in a desolate area surrounding a secret government installation rumored to contain extraterrestrial life.
A Korean music group leads a secret life as demon hunters.
A group of friends go on a weekend get-a-way to remember a friend on the anniversary of her death, unfortunately they aren't as alone as they thought.
Women beaten by there husbands took matters into their own hands killing them and sentenced to the Arizona State Prison they knew the worst was too come.
Bagheera the Panther and Baloo the Bear have a difficult time trying to convince a boy to leave the jungle for human civilization.
In the midst of a tropical storm, the crew of an offshore oil rig must survive the rampage of a creature after invading its undersea habitat.
Set in a fictional world where Tim Burton was able to continue his DCU, Lex Luthor has drawn an alien force to Earth, and it is up to the newly formed Justice League to stop the threat to the planet.
Lina and Naga take opposing sides in a blood feud involving dragons.
Four folk tales from Assam re-imagined as a narrative about four mothers, each facing demons of her own.
Plot is kept under wraps.

On planet Earth, a galaxy alliance was formed. Together with the good planets of the solar system, they maintained peace throughout the universe. Until a new horrible menace threatened the galaxy and Voltron was needed once more.
A writer who begins to believe in his script is dragged into a great mental depression.
Satya, the leader of a party in his college, falls in love with Aditi, the niece of a politician. However, things turn complicated when Aditi stands against Satya in the elections of their college.
When an unhappy, overweight, older man is almost at his wit's end, a strange Voodoo witch comes into his life with a spell that unexpectedly changes his life forever.
Peanut butter is the secret ingredient for magic potions made by two friendly ghosts. Eleven-year-old Michael loses all of his hair when he gets a fright and uses the potion to get his hair back.

A white authoress, looking for a story in the outback, is kidnapped by an Afghan slaver, betrothed to a white jungle-man, and menaced by a jealous half-caste rival, a hostile witch-doctor, his crazed-killer son, and opium smugglers!

Economy has collapsed. Among the affected ones lives the rebel teenager Flavia, and her old and grumpy neighbor Martin. Both will learn to relate , not just to survive the crisis, but to find the sense of their lives.
When Chef finds out his family will be deported if he doesn't pay government imposed fees, he turns to his boss who offers him an opportunity as a black market driver to earn the money.
A private detective specializing in missing children is charged with the task of finding a special child whom dark forces want to eliminate.
A mysterious new shop opens in a small town which always seems to stock the deepest desires of each shopper, with a price far heavier than expected.

A naive college student, Evangeline, is brutalized by a gang of thrill seeking killers. Left to die in the forest, her corpse is revived by an ancient demon spirit that empowers her with a blood-lust for vengeance.
The story of piano student David, who hurls himself into the world of music and into his first love. Full of zest for life but with growing pressure, he soon begins to lose control.

A photographer travels to Jerusalem and register a terrorist attack, but receive negative critics for taking pictures instead of trying to avoid it. He falls into depression and stands on the border between reality, dream and delirium.
Will Meghna continue to love Sampath after he kills her brother?

Detective Damien Seryph investigates a string of murders that connects to a group trying to bring forth the 4 King Demons of Hell. Damien's past connects him to those involved and will force him to become "The Demonologist".

Eighteen year old Rosie goes to the magical world of her childhood story book, where she reunites with her old imaginary friends and learns of her true destiny, to find her grandmother who lost years ago and she is the Sky's Queen.

movie_name: Lone Wolf and Cub: Final Conflict
synopsis: A noble samurai becomes an assassin for hire. A live-action adaptation of the Japanese manga.
A cop must stop the killings of rap stars. But, he gets in too deep after his partner is killed.
A Manny Velazquez underground slasher tribute about a number of serial killers on the loose in Chicago and begins a murder spree.
A team of researchers discovers a strange mutation of man and octopus who proceeds to terrorize them.
A teenager is part of an interactive video game where he kills innocent victims. Later, the murders become real.
While being on the run for saving a mouse, the famous Puss in Boots, Pero, helps a young peasant boy win the heart of a lovely princess, while trying to rescue her from an evil wizard.
A slightly disturbed young amateur photographer finds that his father has been secretly having an affair with his co-worker. Thus begins a spiral into blackmail, stalking, and voyeurism.
A band of misfits go on an adventurous journey to bring back the cure for their dying world.

"Gerda Malaperis!" (Gerda Disappears!) is based on the Esperanto novel by Swiss writer Claude Piron, which has been used as a learners' reader for years. Gerda is an expert on obscure and cryptic languages. Then she is abducted.
As Brandon's bratty sister is sent to visit and stay for summer vacation, a mysterious journey awaits them in the illusive forest.
Junes and Bobby, who hang out with other second generation Muslim immigrants at Pizza King in Copenhagen, come across 50 lbs. hashish in a burglary. The Pakistani owner wants it back.
While leading a study of our galaxy, an astronomer deals with a series of startling revelations, about the universe, his family, and himself.
A horrible virus kills billions within minutes. The few survivors that are left have to deal with the shock of the apocalypse, and they have no idea that things are about to get much worse.
Two victims of traumatized childhoods become lovers and psychopathic serial murderers irresponsibly glorified by the mass media.
A boy attempts to realize his father's dream of climbing an alpine peak known as the Citadel.
Two people meet each other while they are in the hospital recuperating from an accident . They fall in love 'but their religion is an obstacle that must be deal with.
Follow the adventures of young Leroy Brown, who runs a detective agency out of his family's garage.
Mike Dreamer tries to sleep but when he realizes his dreams seem to all come true, he tries to do anything but sleep and to protect the one little girl he doesn't want harmed.
A fraternity house throws their big "Winter Luau" party but when fraternity brothers and coeds begin dying horrible deaths they discover an evil entity has taken over the house.
Enzo, Carmine and Bandula are laid off when their factory is modernized. They fear the worst until their boss rehires them to guard his new modern art collection.
GENNDY TARTAKOVSKY'S PRIMAL - TALES OF SAVAGERY features a caveman and a dinosaur on the brink of extinction. Bonded by tragedy, this unlikely friendship becomes the only hope of survival.
A loud-mouthed Texas cowpuncher tries his hand at polo finding himself at odds with high society and trying to save a floundering Wild West show.
In an ancient world, she put the hero into heroine and the men to shame.
In Paris a lawyer's clerk is the secret strangler who robs for an extravagant daughter's sake.
Sameer and Sheena's marriage was fixed when they were children, but now she has decided to marry him only on the condition that he will abduct her and take her to Mumbai.

Pippi is a little girl who lives alone in her house, while her father is sailing the seas. With Pippi we meet her horse, her monkey and her two friends Tommy and Anika. Together they go on many journeys through the neighborhood.

A jaded US mercenary thought to have slaughtered her unit is brutally interrogated by a CIA Agent with whom she shares a sordid past. Their dark history is revealed as a hacktivist navigates the conspiracy surrounding the mission.
A post-modern romantic comedy about luck and timing in relationships, missed opportunities, unrequited love and how the grass always appears to be greener on the other side.
The several misadventures and life-lessons learned by 8-year-old Theodore "Beaver" Cleaver in an entertaining and hilarious tale of a small-town Ohio family and the daily trials and tribunes of life.

While traveling, a crew of documentary makers met a horrible fate when their van fell off a cliff. Though only one of them really died, the rest were 'accidentally' dragged into hell where each were tortured according to their sins.
Two rival career-criminal brothers recollect their lives in a Courtroom in which one is about to be convicted for murder.
Deep in the woods of Maine, a broken promise made after the September 11th attacks forces two friends to confront the teenagers they were and the men they've become.
Two best friends must fight corruption in the Philippines to find a man called Ninong, who is responsible for the loss of their loved ones.
A man tries to stop a ruthless business tycoon from destroying a village's livelihood.
In 1946, an irishman joins a group of 'gancheros' (wood workers) while they drive wood thru the Tajo river, discovering human solidarity
The story of the prince Tamino and his zestful sidekick Papageno, who are sent on a mission to save a beautiful princess from the clutches of evil.

Mona picks up her first job tutoring two orphaned children living in a derelict house in the country. Her obsession with trying to educate these two nearly feral children blind her to the fact they have other plans for her.
Pylon is a political thriller based around modern British political events.
Three aspiring filmmakers document inexplicable events in a "haunted" abandoned mental institution.

Karen, Sarah, and Emma Tunney are all moving to a small town in Pennsylvania where, unknown to them, in 1913, a horrid mine accident trapped dozens of children alive, underground. But there's a problem. They're still alive.
Three childhood friends discover their worth and inner strengths, as they experience love and being loved.
During the British Raj, the orphan of a British soldier poses as a Hindu and is torn between his loyalty to a Buddhist mystic and aiding the English secret service.
When Geno decides to pursue his dream in modeling, his reality no longer seems clear as he struggles to awake from his premonition. Geno has to fight for his life, or does he?
The spirit of a long-dead prisoner returns for revenge, haunting the prison's new governor.
The story of a woman as she fights with the memory of her deceased husband, a week before his funeral.
A soon-to-be married couple gets caught up in the sinister plans of an alien race bent on the domination of planet earth.
Bill struggles to put together his shattered psyche, in this new feature film version of Don Hertzfeldt's animated short film trilogy.
A psychiatrist who can't help himself.
Criminals have chosen an ordinary man to carry drugs and jewels in his car across the border. The problem is that this man turned out too much ordinary.

movie_name: The Death Ray of Dr. Mabuse
synopsis: The evil Dr. Mabuse develops a death ray with which he threatens the world.

Jenny is a lonely girl. But is she alone? Dreams, nightmares and visions torment her until she does not know what is real anymore. The voices, the shadows, the spirits - is there a way out? Maybe her diary has the answer.

A Stockholm cop moves back home to his brother near Norway and Finland. He investigates out of control deer poaching. He confiscates rifles with no permits. Everybody, even his brother and local cops, are against him. Things escalate.
A down-on-his-luck sea captain goes treasure hunting for a wrecked Spanish galleon that is rumored to be cursed by God and protected by supernatural forces.
A hacker known as the Puppet Master is hunted by a female cyborg cop and her partner. This film is a revised version of Ghost in the Shell (1995).
Sergey Gromov is professional stuntman. While accepting easy-to-done job for good money, he finds himself involved in dangerous game of some mafiosi.
A teenage martial artist is thrown into a world of theft and risky behavior while investigating the death of his older brother.

Mario is a boy in his early teens who has been looking forward to spending the summer on a camping trip with his father. But when dad lands a new job just as school lets out in June, their plans are put on the back burner.

In the year 2.028, Natalia is a glum psychiatrist and the daughter of a scientist who invented a time machine. She will discover her darkest side after taste an experimental drug. Meanwhile, she has a strange dream about her own death.
Video footage is recovered revealing campers having a terrifying alien abduction experience.
Pulled back to a past Earth, Captain Trelane and his crew must escape a strange subterranean robot facility.

When a shy girl becomes entangled in her older sister's world of sex and murder in 1980s Los Angeles, she must decide how far she can go to preserve their sisterly bond. Subversive coming-of-age drama/stylish thriller.
An ensemble comedy about romance in the modern era.
A prison is about to be evacuated to make room for an airport expansion project. Major Jahed and his officers are busy transferring all inmates to the new facility, but one inmate is missing.

In order to cheer up recently divorced Chloe, her friend, Sam gives her a giant teddy bear, Bearry. As Chloe confides her wishes to Bearry, people close to her go missing or die. Is Chloe a murderer, is it her stalker? or is it Bearry?
A salesman who sells nothing but lies visits a town that produces all of the world's facts. A live-action feature based on Jason Carter Eaton children's book.
Miles Grissom offers $30,000 to the first person who can prove to him that we go on after death.
Jaumet is about lo live his most unforgettable adventure. Traveling by car, he arrives in a village whose inhabitants are quite outlandishly, as if they were plunged in a rare carnival behavior.

movie_name: Trevor Sawyer and the Lost Tachyon
synopsis: While drilling for oil in an Arabian desert, an African-American father and son accidentally discover an alien space ship, that begins a quest around the world in search of the Lost Tachyon.
Trio crew finds real ghosts when they shooting movie at a cemetery. They capture it and back to the city where they try to sell it to anybody who can pay highest.
A resourceful American orphan living in rural Australia finds himself caught up in the magic of a local Aboriginal myth that might be more real than anyone knows.
When a tragic accident befalls a group of lifelong friends, one becomes the sole survivor, now a quadriplegic, he must rely on family, faith and love to carry on.

Two men show up at Sardar's home claiming to be his son. As he tries to sort the mess out and identify the imposter so he can be married, the police figure out he is wanted for murdering his brother 20 years ago.

Much to his surprise, an utter misanthrope is transformed into a reluctant do-gooder, when a glorious pair of angelic snow-white wings sprouts up from his back. Now, everyone in town wants a piece of his feathered appendages.

movie_name: Doctor Imperfect and the Perfect Man
synopsis: A failing scientist, Azrael Thran, decides to clone himself as a last minute effort to achieve success and escape his controlling father.

movie_name: One Piece: Episode of Alabasta - The Desert Princess and the Pirates
synopsis: A re-telling of the Alabaster Arc from One Piece (TV). Luffy and his crew come to rescue a land in the midst of a civil war, due to a powerful devil fruit user.
With the world's end imminent, a dying mother sends her young son on a journey to the place which grants wishes. The film's inspired by the works of 13th century Sufi mystic and poet, Rumi.
Life changes for Malcolm, a geek who's surviving life in a tough neighborhood, after a chance invitation to an underground party leads him and his friends into a Los Angeles adventure.

movie_name: Nosferatu vs. Father Pipecock & Sister Funk
synopsis: A man goes to visit Count Orlock, a deviant, adulterous, shape-shifting Transylvanian vampire.
It is a 2021 Chinese animated fantasy adventure directed by Liu Zhijiang and Qiao Yu.

movie_name: If These Walls Could Talk - The Stage Play
synopsis: What happens when you bring together different life experiences, banana nut bread, warm tea, and prayer? A weekly gathering that is more than one can bear.
A film crew travels out to a village in Anatolia to shoot a movie. But after each were affected by a dream they saw, the remaining four team members decide to stay and investigate the incident.
A group of people brought together through a twist of fate hide out in a remote cabin, unaware that a ferocious monster roams the surrounding area.
On the run from his former employer, a reluctant hitman seeks refuge in an isolated village where he is faced with events that test the true nature of his conscience.

Gianni Alberti is a journalist who is sent to Palestine. He decides to fake a fatal accident so he can then return home as a hero. But things don't turn out as planned, Gianni end up coming back to Italy, but only as a ghost.
The final chapter in the Bloody Nun saga. There can be only one Bloody Nun!
A would-be playwright and a young woman escaping from a job at a gas station meet cute and fall in love.
After their boat mysteriously sinks, a group of friends, with no supplies and strange happenings, try to trust each other long enough to survive.
The Incredibles family takes on a new mission which involves a change in family roles: Bob Parr (Mr. Incredible) must manage the house while his wife Helen (Elastigirl) goes out to save the world.
An Italian waiter fights off a criminal mastermind with his inherited powers of disguise.

A frustrated city girl disguises herself as a youngster in order to get a cheaper train ticket home. But little "Sue Sue" finds herself in a whole heap of grown-up trouble when she hides out in a compartment with a handsome Major.
After witnessing her brothers die and her niece go missing, a guilt-ridden tomboy wakes up in a lion's den of human traffickers and must embark on a murderous mission of redemption before she's sold.

Ji Mo is regarded as an outlier because she can see monsters. One day, she sees a monster in the supermarket and meets a monster hunter, Meng. She discovers that there really are monsters in the world, and she is involved in a new storm.
A young girl from South Los Angeles tries to make it to the National Spelling Bee.

movie_name: Masked Ghost Lady presents Scary Stories

synopsis: The Pevensie siblings return to Narnia, where they are enlisted to once again help ward off an evil king and restore the rightful heir to the land's throne, Prince Caspian.
A sexually frustrated serial killer takes a liking to a woman he comes across.
The inventor Petr takes Vera to his laboratory. There he works on a machine to create perfect "golems" or "human doubles". Vera unwittingly creates her own golem.
A story set in the north English seaside town of Blackpool and centered on two kindred spirits who form an unlikely friendship.

After Carlos, an impoverished teen from a fractured home, receives a desperate note from Sarah, a pen pal he lost touch with a year ago, he uses her letters to solve the mystery of her disappearance and crimes she may have been a part of.
A troubled, drug addict man finds an opulent house, pretends to be the owner, and starts to live there while the family member welcomes him.

Gonzo journalist Jack gets involved with a new gang. Kat, his new female partner who is a fan of raw violence, gets dangerously close to Jack and he has to make a decision that might change his life for ever.

A girl named Clara lives in an amazing fairy world inhabited by dwarfs, dragons and sorcerers. Astonishing adventures await Clara and her friends and also the future of the whole world will fall into her hands.

A time traveling scientist goes back to prehistoric times and feeds dinosaurs a magic cereal that increases their intelligence - next they land in modern New York City for a series of comic adventures.

A deranged scientist escapes from prison and recruits Dracula, Frankenstein's monster and the Wolf Man to get revenge on his behalf.
A Creature terrorizes a small town and it is up to a small group of scientists to stop it.

A defense attorney wife and her prosecutor husband square off in court over a murder case in which four young boys are accused.

A young man is hunted by a darkness that fears he may be the catalyst that will bring about the destruction of the ethereal world and protected by those who believe he may be the key to unity among the two sides of the veil.
The film is set in a village in the Peruvian jungle and is about how missionaries to abduct children to give them a Christian upbringing.
When two bus crash survivors awake to discover that they are the only people left in their town, they work together to unravel the truth behind the strange events.
Mike Dreamer tries to sleep but when he realizes his dreams seem to all come true, he tries to do anything but sleep and to protect the one little girl he doesn't want harmed.
After a woman was possessed by an evil spirit, a group of suburban moms put their friendship to the ultimate test.

A young actress rehearsing for a play about human trafficking begins to relive terrifying scenes that may be dreams -- or an alternate reality.
When hikers trespass onto private land, an altercation with the landowner descends into violence.

Zany subversion of the 1001 Nights myth that skips all of the stories and simply focuses on the lovely Scheherazade's escape from the lustful king with the help of a magic lamp and a time traveling astrologist.
A down on his luck stupid nobody gets his world thrown in a loop thanks to his new room mate......a ninja!
In a peaceful town, a tragic death leads to two men's desperate crime race.
Karthikeya, who loves to solve mysteries, goes to Subramanyapuram to investigate where the villagers are frightened by a deadly snake in the temple.
A gritty, honest and beautiful tale of a working class family in South Texas caught up in a dysfunctional cycle of seedy traditions, and their search for a way out. Based on a true story.

An Oscar Winning Movie is a Queer Horror Comedy. Sometimes your past haunts your future in ways you would never believe.

Tales of the Night weaves together six exotic fables each unfolding in a unique locale, from Tibet, to medieval Europe, to the Land of the Dead. From the imagination of internationally renowned animator Michel Ocelot.
The prison of death, where only vicious criminals who don't have a sense of law or common sense are being kept. A new era of power opens when Lee Tae-sik, the nation's former boss entered the office.

In an undefined future, madness was defeated all over Planet Earth. Only 3 madmen survived. A team of scientists manage to catch them. The scientists begin an experiment: they want to isolate madness for understanding its mechanism.
The film is an emotional action thriller which is based on friendship between two boys who work in a wine shop.
In the early 20th century, two rivals, the heroic Leslie and the despicable Professor Fate, engage in an epic automobile race from New York to Paris.
The greatest heist in the history of motion pictures.

Santa has to get a job as Santa to earn money to pay his overdue rent bill

Young man gives up his dream of becoming an astronaut to go into business--and finds himself turned into a little old man.
Trapped within a distortion of time, unraveling his fragmented memory, a man comes into contact with a woman living in real-time who reveals the truth about him.

Rescued as a child by the legendary assassin Moody, Anna is the world's most skilled contract killer. However, when Moody is brutally killed, she vows revenge for the man who taught her everything she knows.
Based on The Tessera Project (2007).
To save the universe, and their friendship, Mordecai and Rigby must defeat an evil volleyball coach.
He came home to bury his brother. Now he must solve the murder to save his own life.
Exploitation anthology from the twisted minds of established and up and coming directors from across the globe.

The owner of a coal mining operation, falsely imprisoned for fratricide, takes a drug to make him invisible, despite its side effect: gradual madness.
Crew get stranded on a large, abandoned space ship while solving the mystery of what happened to the ship.
The scary story of a woman who died nearly 100 years ago.
For many years he was lonely and dreamed about love. Every night he escaped from reality, but once she came and everything changed
Compilation of clips and appearances by the 3 Stooges on '50s TV. Includes pilots for a proposed new Stooges TV show and a children's cartoon.
LIKE MANY LOCAL ACTION FILMS, THIS MOVIES CENTERS ON AVENGING AN INJUSTICE COMMITTED AGAINST PROTAGONIST'S FAMILY.

When a group of urban explorers venture beneath Berlin, their guide hurts himself and the group must struggle to escape the subterranean maze beneath the city.
Chelios faces a Chinese mobster who has stolen his nearly indestructible heart and replaced it with a battery-powered ticker which requires regular jolts of electricity to keep working.
Tae finds a box with letters and recipes written by her mother.
The parents have no time for little Mísa, so he befriends an old, lonely man, the owner of a mysterious shed, which hides many tempting and surprising attractions, treasures and trinkets.
Allied prisoners of war plan for several hundred of their number to escape from a German camp during World War II.

A murder story with a comedic twist. A famous photographer uses his models for more than taking pictures. He needs them as victims to satisfy his blood-lust. Each murder becomes more bizarre than the next.

Dika (Bioone) helps a woman (Clara Bernadeth) with a traumatic past. The struggle began when Dika fell in love with that woman.

One man, one wolf, many mysteries.
An ex-con and his devoted wife must flee from danger when a heist doesn't go as planned.
The story of Badul, a playboy who has managed to accompany 17 girls, but his attempt to seduce 2 new victims ends up trapping himself so he has to marry them.

Private investigator is lead on a horrific journey, of conspiracies and insanity, following the murder of his partner.

A mountain girl sets out to avenge her murdered father.

A modern take on Alexandre Dumas' classic tale of 'The Count Of Monte Cristo'.

Seven women are determined to exact revenge on the evil lord Akinari Katou and "The 7 Spears", the band of soldiers he commands.
A small, depressed Canadian town is about to relive its tragic past when a popular movie director comes back to town - but who is the killer?
La Martina arrives to a small conservative town, fascinating men and winding women up.
A group of dreamers is making an epic music video on a superyacht, but they're lost at sea, and something evil lurks beneath.
The story of Ed Gein, who dug up the corpses of over a dozen women and made things out of their remains before finally shooting two people to death and butchering their bodies like beef sides.

1873, Alice de Bussy, a French lady crosses alone on her horse the Rocky Mountains until the events go wrong. She will meet a desperado, bounty hunters and wild beast. Alice will be pushed to her limits to survive.
A married woman and a drifter fall in love, then plot to murder her husband.

Two brothers (one from the rural areas and the other from the city), after 20 years of being separated, meet again on a Christmas Eve in the city, but end up having various culture and tradition differences that causes a crazy Christmas.

Identical twin brothers become hybrid A.I (artificial intelligence) entities, yet torn in different directions to achieve justice for humanity.

High school students band together to dispense vigilante justice against a vicious gangland boss.
An undercover cop becomes embroiled in a battle with warring criminals who want to acquire a "black box," their ultimate key to a treasure.
A woman battling addiction is given a chance at redemption if she accepts Death's offer.
A captain with a month to live forces a usurer to join him in drinking poison.

movie_name: Holmes & Watson: The Adventure of the Lost Soul

Santos, a failed comic book artist, lives in a parallel universe where he's a superhero who has to save the world.

An ex-army scout is hired by ranchers to kill cattle rustlers but he gets into trouble with the corrupt local officials when he kills a boy.

A band of Mexican gun-runners employed by a revolutionary general accept an American into their gang, unaware of his intentions.
One of the gratest love stories ever told!!

A romantic comedy set in Bath, where our hero meticulously plans and executes a grandiose proposal. However, instead of sweeping his prospective fiancé off her feet, she has the worst day of her life.

Two kids experience an initiatory journey during their first day of summer holidays.

A convicted man embarks on a journey of violence and redemption to find out the truth about his sister's death.

An FBI agent consumed with tracking down an international terrorist group called the BoardRoom becomes distracted when a car crash tethers him to beautiful, mysterious interloper suspected of murdering his fiancee.

synopsis: A millionaire's ghost watches while his heirs murder each other over his fortune.

A mafia comedy where two hit men have to get along with eachother.
A sexist womanizer is killed by one of his former lovers and then reincarnated as a woman.
A young girl returns to her hometown of Yarmouth after the death of her Grampy and reconnects with her best friend.
When Marie moves into her boyfriend's apartment, she uncovers a disturbing mystery.
A masked, shadowy killer brutally murders the models of a scandalous fashion house in Rome.

A gang of black militants plots to rob a factory to finance their "revolutionary struggle".

Bécassine, a naive and clumsy farm girl, is hired as a nanny in a bourgeois family.

movie_name: To All the Boys I've Loved Before
synopsis: A teenage girl's secret love letters are exposed and wreak havoc on her love life.

synopsis: A pilot loses his memory after a plane crash. A good friend helps him to remember his past by talking about a transport plane they built together.

A transgender fashion model collides with a teenage victim of a mass shooting to track down a black market human organ.

An old Norse legend of revenge, power and human spirit, that subsequently inspired William Shakespeare on his tragedy - Hamlet.
A transcendent journey of a girl and her dead father.

A journey with complete stranger who share their experiences which lead to..
