In 1961, a divorced Catholic couple's life is turned upside-down when one of their two adolescent daughters is suspected of her younger sister's brutal murder during her First Holy Communion and a series of subsequent stabbings.
Scientific advancements are discovered in a massive alien starship that has crashed on planet Earth. These advancements help create new robotic technologies--adaptable-to-terrain mecha: Robotech.
Young adventurer Artyom meets the legendary art masterpiece thief Felix, who was nicknamed Number One. Together they decide on a large scam and steal one of the main paintings of our time.
A long time ago... in the summer of 1981, a tragedy of epic proportions (a broken plastic bat) sends five friends on an epic adventure to the mall. All they have to do is follow The Stream and back.
A life where reality and fantasy blurred into each other. What survives...?
A widowed father tries to support his children after he becomes a ghost in an accident.
It follows Li Xin and Wang Qi as they stand on the battlefield for the first time to fight off an invasion by Zhao, and it also follows Ying Zheng's unknown past.
Young martial artists face their grandfather's foes when they accompany him to Japan to deliver a priceless dagger.
In the 18th century France, Jean-Paul, who was cheated out of his inheritance, land and titles by his uncle, decides to go to Guatemala in search of a famed Mayan treasure.
A crime boss is assassinated and witnesses to the crime are subsequently killed. A no-nonsense policeman decides to take the law into his own hands in bringing these criminals to justice.
After being wounded in a fight, Zatoichi is nursed to health by a young woman and her father. Now indebted to the family, he works to protect their ferry business from local thugs.
Classic whodunit mystery film about a gold-digging variety show actress who has many enemies and is found dead in her private railroad car at Grand Central Station in New York.
Cesare is a ticket collector on a bus who is competing with the driver, Bruno, for the love of Rosella, a naïve waitress who's been mugged on the bus.
The classic gangster story of Bugsy Malone told with an all-child cast.
2 strangers, a man and a woman are trapped together underground when the building collapses around them, and are forced to create a new world.

A gun-for-hire known only as Agent 47 hired by a group known only as 'The Organization' is ensnared in a political conspiracy, which finds him pursued by both Interpol and the Russian military as he treks across Russia and Eastern Europe.
A young man still in love with his self-destructive ex agrees to join her on a trip to Cancun where he ends up meeting a local girl - forcing him question everything he wants in life.
In the midst of a tropical storm, the crew of an offshore oil rig must survive the rampage of a creature after invading its undersea habitat.
Set in a parallel universe entering a black hole, a woman reading the book of Revelation has visions of regeneration during Anthropocene.
An inebriated filmmaker finds himself in a shocking situation when he realises that the mysterious girl who accompanied him to her room has been killed.
Through Loki's treachery, two children in the Viking age find themselves spirited away into the world of Norse Mythology.
A secretary is sent on a business trip to inform a radio personality he's just inherited two million dollars. She falls for him instantly, but he's on his way to get married.

movie_name: Little Grey Fergie and His New Friend Clunky
synopsis: Fergie thrives at the farm, but sometimes he still feels alone as a living machine. He gets an idea of making and befriending an automatic scare crow. But then his new friend is kidnapped.

movie_name: Son of Adam Daughter of Eve
synopsis: Mina Bozorgmehr and Farhood Zandi are two young lawyers who start working at them same time. They share an apartment, but Mina thinks that Farhood is a author and Farhood thinks that Mina is a photographer.
A mysterious presence watches over a man tied to organized crime as he spirals into a final choice between love and vengeance, which will decide more than his mortal fate.
Nicolas Philibert goes to America after killing a French aristocrat. On his return he tries to divorce his wife, Charlotte, but when he sees others trying to woo her his own interest is rekindled.
A woman who travels around the USA to heal animals alternatively and naturally with oils, herbs, and clairvoyance to help heal them.
Mark struggles with drug addiction following the war. An Alien, that only Mark can see, manipulates his will and forces him to commit acts that he cannot recall.
An unquiet mind at an unquiet place.

A troubled teen uses tiny, hidden micro-cameras sharing 'in-your-face' encounter video of telepathic beings, human hybrids and the unusual MIB (Men In Black). Based on the real UFO phenomena, The Alien Report is part one of a trilogy.

In the small city of Morgantown, West Virginia, a high school installs a maximum security system in fear of recent school shootings across America, only to have a gang of crazies invade the campus and take over the facility.
Deeply ensconced in a top-secret military program, three pilots struggle to bring an artificial intelligence program under control before it initiates the next world war.
A young Brooklyn based real estate mogul in the making unwittingly gambles his success, sanity, and the safety of his young child, when he falls for the wrong woman

After the death of their friend, a group of eccentric young adults are whisked away to a villa on the outskirts of London, but a mysterious entity seems to have followed them to their luxurious getaway.

When a teenage boy's phenomenal life-changing secret come to light, he uncovers a sinister plot of "Eminent Domain" that threatens the very existence of a beloved Florida Seabird Sanctuary and takes him on a journey of a lifetime.
DEA agent battles Mexican drug cartel helped by a corrupt federal prosecutor operating through an Indian Reservation along the Arizona/Mexico border. Inspired by true events.
A look at the final moments in the life of Nicholas II, the last Russian tsar, as he lived in Siberia with his family.
Karan and his mother live a happy life and he is soon to be married to Kajal. But on the day of his engagement, he discovers his mother is not his biological mother.
A twisted web of lies, plagued by demons, kept locked in closets. What happens when mayhem strikes and the demons that don't choose to stay hidden decide to claw their way out?

An African American male is imprisoned and placed in solitary confinement after being found guilty of murdering his wife, as he's haunted by internal demons and his dead wife, and pushed to the breaking point by an abusive female guard.

One day, when four young men wakes up in the morning, they're all in a small room filled with the white powder, naked.Why they are gathered? What is this room mean to be? Who brought them into this room? How to escape from this room?

A young American girl has a chance of a lifetime to visit her ancestors castle in the south of France, only to find that her family is hiding deep, dark secrets about their nefarious past, far away from prying eyes.
2 FBI agents try to find an space alien who crash-landed on earth.
Mario Almada returns as "el fiscal de hierro"; in this entry his family is kidnapped by gang leader Ramona Pineda.
In the distant future, a space traveler from Earth breaks a special law and interferes with the history of another, Medieval-like, planet.

An ever evolving alien life-form from the Dark Gaseous Nebula arrives to consume rampant pollution. Spewing mists of sulfuric acid and corrosive sludge, neither humanity or Godzilla may be able to defeat this toxic menace.

After a sleigh crash in the blazing Australian Outback, Santa must get back to the North Pole. Can he outwit conspiratorial elves - and win back his rebellious rock star teenage daughter - in time to save Christmas?
The owner of a suburban art gallery searches for someone to perform an exorcism after a witch casts a spell on him.
An unhappily married woman saves the life of a young violinist and tries to resist falling in love.
To find her parents, Henrietta pursues her astral roots accompanied by a scatty invertebrate who impersonates a boy, and a schizoid trickster who serves the Black Cardinal who wants her dead.
A blind man's master told him that after he has broken 1000 strings on his Banjo, he can open the Banjo to get a script for his eyes. After 60 years he broke the 1000th string...
While trying to win over his beloved's parents, a young man is accused of arson, and his father soon realizes insanity may be his only defense.
An artist forms an attachment with a woman on holiday in the country. As the relationship develops, his behavior and information about his past cause her increasing concern.
A serial killer who drains his victims' blood is on the loose in London. The police follow him to a house owned by an eccentric scientist.
A group of actors perform in the heart of the Warsaw Ghetto, in a life or death context on a run-down stage.
Circuit crashes on a hostile planet with no memory. He must find his way back to the Orbitor Space Station to complete his mission. Will he make it or be deleted in the process?
An unassuming high schooler finds himself inexplicably drawn to the free-spirited new girl, whose unconventional ways change how they see themselves--and each other.
An auto driver, Manikam, desperately tries to hide his dark underworld side to keep his promise to his father.

A couple discover Kirlian Photography apparatus in their new house. Intrigued by the concept of photographing peoples' Auras they unwittingly release an ancient evil. Only the local psychic can help and she knows far more than she reveals.
A love story in which fragmented memories are brought back to mind by a song.
Strange things are happening in the Lincoln National Forest of the south western state of New Mexico. People are vanishing... It seems there has been a wrinkle in time. Or is it more than that?
A remake of the 1978 Shaw Brothers film, 'The Avenging Eagle, in which a rebellious warrior turns against his gang of outlaws known as The Thirteen Eagles.
Lethal virus transmitted by SMS predominant 'Pathogen' software company workers, specializing in Anti-Virus for humans.

In a remote, yet dazzling landscape, a temperamental hiker tormented by the past , has the perfect scheme set in place against his friend; until a mysterious stranger comes along with a plan of his own.
San Francisco, 1940, detectives, dames, documents, Nazis, and a treasure.
Saved from a war-torn land, he must find a way to fit into a world where he will always stand out.

movie_name: Baba Yaga: Terror of the Dark Forest
synopsis: When Egor's mom dies, he gets a stepmom and then a baby half sister. Things get seriously twisted when his dad gets a hot nanny, who's the witch, Baba Yaga.
Buffoonish Ernest and his dimwitted pal Abner unearth a huge cannon reputed to contain the crown jewels of England.
Nikki finds herself in tantric practice. Her marriage life with Calvin and the Asia root are those that question her. All questions keep going back to money.
The tale of a yakuza (Japanese gangster) who makes his way through the Japanese criminal underworld.
A single father and his three daughters are struggling to gain acceptance in their hostile community.
A kindhearted street urchin and a power-hungry Grand Vizier vie for a magic lamp that has the power to make their deepest wishes come true.

Derick Abraham, a fiery and dutiful police officer, continues to be the best officer until his brother Philip Abraham gets arrested for false murder charges. Will he be able to investigate the case and serve justice to his brother?

movie_name: Muumipapan urotyöt - erään nuoren muumin seikkailut
synopsis: As Moomintroll gets wasp-stung Moominpappa wants to cheer him up by telling about his own adventurous youth. Pappa tells about how he escapes from an orphanage and about his historic meeting with an inventor called Hodgkins.
A pair of twin brothers from East L.A. choose to live their lives differently and end up on opposite sides of the law.
A hard-nosed, spouseless cardiac surgeon finds herself reconsidering her career-driven life choices as she bonds with her lighthearted new artist neighbor.

A teenager wakes in the middle of the night when he hears a noise in his house. Upon exploration, he finds nothing. He returns to bed, where he is spooked by a vision of his doppelganger. The mood intensifies as he confronts the spectre.
Serge Osmeña and Geny Lopez are wrongly accused of plotting to assassinate President Ferdinand Marcos.

It is about two Atheists who run a video blog debunking Psychics, Mediums and religious beliefs. However, a death experiment goes totally wrong and as a result they attract evil entities that stalk and haunt them.

A young man dreams of making a fortune in Chennai. He owns a travel agency and is all set to marry his lover. After he crosses paths with a loan shark, The Latter is Murdered, the young man runs for cover and plans to find the murderer.
Doctor Stein's teleporter will cure your cancer, but will it kill your soul?

In the year 2961, the time is after humanity and nature has recovered the land. A hunter named Cygnus is called to protect his people. He travels across a desert valley to protect his tribe against a band of Heretics. Cygnus must find a way for his tribe to survive.
A journalist gets caught up in a terrorist plot in Moscow while investigating the Russian secret service.
In 1937, Japanese troops raid the Chinese city of Nanking to execute a planned massacre by subjecting over 300,000 helpless civilians to various tortures and atrocities before slaughtering them all.
A lonely career machinist falls for a troubled young artist and they are drawn together while being guided through a mysterious dimension to reconcile with their pasts.
The humorous adventures of an all-male team of cyclists training for an upcoming important bike race.
The lives of some different people get intertwined when a girl is in urgent need of a heart transplant with the only heart donor being many miles of traffic away.

Three castaways, Leone Devereaux, Jim Dorn and John Polack, all from differing levels of society, reach and board a deserted schooner in mid-ocean. There, a drama of conflicting wills and agendas ensues.

Pakistan police is working against a network of international terrorists in Lahore. Ahmed, a young unemployed man becomes a witness of suicide bombing incident and helps a Police officer Sonia to apprehend them.
A clown doll possessed by a demon goes on a bloody rampage of murder after being found and taken into a home.
The exploits of a noted band of criminals whose reputation for notorious crime equals that of the famous Camorra gang that for many years terrorized the cities of Europe. 15 episodes.
A young father has to fight the monster inside himself before he can protect his family from becoming prey to an ancient killer.
After taking a job at a prestigious VR company, a coder uncovers a secret project that hits close to home and questions the motives of its ambitious creator.
A guy - old enough to be her father - woos Tina away from her twenty-something boyfiend, who then starts acting even nuttier. Could it be, however, that they're BOTH whack jobs?
Shill sequel project based on a story by Paul Grimshaw.
A woman, who witnessed her father kill himself as a child, invites several friends to her husband's secluded castle. Unbeknownst to them, she has a sinister motive for the invitation.
Follow a ruthless romantic and her best friend to investigate her ex-boyfriend, only to discover lies, deception and danger.

An awkward teen and his rebellious crush search for the truth behind the accident that claimed his father's life and unleashed an army of the living dead, while those responsible take drastic measures to cover it up.
When a close friend of the Drew family is accused of murder in a rural community, Nancy, aided by boyfriend Ted, helps her lawyer father expose the real killers.
When an amnesiac wakes up in a post apocalyptic world ravaged by a rabies type virus, he must band together with a small group of survivors.
A dancer is invited to choreograph dancers for a wealthy family in Budapest. However, strange things start to happen...and the answers might lie in a nearby cemetery called the Butterfly Cemetery.
Couples today come from different backgrounds and have independent lifestyles. But their independence leads to friction between them, what will keep them together?

The Critic is a story of ambition, blackmail and desire with a dazzling anti-hero at its dark heart. A whodunnit wrapped in a Faustian pact which winds tighter and tighter. Patrick Marber adapted the script from Anthony Quinn's novel.
Plot kept under wraps.
What happens when a successful businessman is confronted by the toughest battle of his life in the form of his disgruntled long term ex - girlfriend, when she finds out that he has a pregnant fiance?
A family are visited by aliens who wish to abduct them and put them in their intergalactic zoo.
Young man and girl decide to marry despite opposition from their parents .
A young man tries to break away from his poverty-ridden life as a barber's son and hopes to study further. His father, however, refuses to send him away and threatens to commit suicide.

movie_name: Death Wish: The Face of Death
synopsis: Paul Kersey is back at working vigilante justice when his fiancée, Olivia, has her business threatened by mobsters.

Little Sunny Gill, coming from a family of pickle manufacturers, is a misfit as he cannot smell, but when a laboratory accident enhances his olfactory abilities, he transforms into one-of-a-kind super hero.
Two college students volunteer for pharmaceutical testing to make some extra cash.
When Sam Melody, a hardworking private detective, meets the beautiful Jasmine Pellitier, the consequences could be deadly.
A woman tasked with finding homes for 12 abandoned puppies before Christmas finds love with her co-worker just in time for the holidays.
Strange things start happening after a girl is found drowned in a lake.

The Masked Man is a vigilante who saves innocent lives, however he is about to meet his most difficult foe, Leonard Kauffman. A man so hell bent on getting what he wants, he will be willing to kill in numbers to get it.
An institutionalized woman claiming to be Blanche DuBois must unravel the tragic circumstances that brought her there.
24 year-old pessimist Cillia meets Tris, an aspiring singer who recently moved to Jakarta.
One man receives an unexpected visit from a second man, with whom he reminisces about a life and love they both shared with a third.
Two sisters of differing temperaments, the younger's milquetoast fiancé, and a free-spirited artist in an auto trailer are all experiencing romantic complications.

Dick Hallan, a journalist for the Herald-Tribune gets mixed up in international politics through a series of incredible coincidences and is finally coerced by the CIA (not really) to follow the intrigue to its unremarkable end.
A group of disaffected Roman Catholics are manipulated into planning a terrorist attack on the English Parliament.
The love story of Karthik and Anjali, whose paths cross at three different phases of their lives.

Bruce returns to Manila to investigate the murder of his sister, Susan Chang. On the night of her attack she was helped by an amateur-boxer, Ramon "Rocky" Roblado. Behind Susan's death is the 'Black Dragon Society'.
Soldiers on a mission from a fort on the Northwest Frontier of British-Raj India argue over tactics as they seek to deal with reports of a native uprising.
Based on the true events revolving around King James Strang and Beaver Island, Michigan.
The anthropologist Luce Sartor, following the clues left by her father and researcher Paolo Sartor, who mysteriously disappeared, discovers the truth thanks to an enigmatic painting.
A singing star is murdered, and a TV star tries to solve the mystery.
After mistakenly going to jail, Maria makes friends with a woman whose kids live in the streets and Maria gets the idea to help them.
Web loses his brother in an extreme sports accident. When he learns it may have been murder he searches, from America to his ancestral home in China, pursuing answers and vengeance.
In 2020 a pandemic of massive proportions spreads on Earth. This is the story of human isolation and deceit by government agencies.

movie_name: Als je begrijpt wat ik bedoel
synopsis: Bumble the Bear (Olivier Bommel) finds an egg that, it turns out, has a cute little dragon in it. However, this dinosaur grows huge every time it is upset. As this causes a lot of problems, Ollie Bommel has to face a difficult dilemma.
An action adventure drama with the mystic infusion of angelic and spiritual influences and transformation.
A college basketball star collaborates with organized crime and becomes involved in 'point shaving.' A sportswriter tries to get him back on the right track.
SOUL SEARCHING is a story of a psychic man who must battle fate and foul play to help an amnesiac ghost uncover the mystery behind her death or else he will be haunted forever.

The fate of the entire hotel industry is at stake. A group of evil black ninjas have threatened to insinuate themselves into the industry, take over, and transform the operation into something unspeakable.
A lawyer takes on a case of a prison guard in South Africa who is traumatized by the executions he's witnessed.
When a teenage girl with a mysterious pendant goes missing in the woods, a feral man-creature cares for her, and together they must escape a manhunt in order to fulfill a Native American prophecy.
After the events of the the first film Jon returns as a ghost to haunt Tom. Tom initially refuses to believe that ghosts exist but Jon eventually hypnotizes him into continuing his rein of terror.

movie_name: Joe Palooka in Humphrey Takes a Chance
synopsis: A crooked mayor and fight promoter conspire to sign slow-witted Humphrey to a contract. Their goal is to use Humphrey to get Joe Palooka to sign. As things develop, Humphrey becomes mayor.
A battle between good and evil.

Sgt James Tides flees the Vietnam War as a stowaway on a cargo ship headed for Tahiti. After being given a second chance he falls in love with a native woman, and becomes enmeshed in a deadly love triangle that could destroy them both.
A rotoscoped time travel western.
The Mystery Inc. gang must save Coolsville from an attack of their past monsters brought to life by an evil masked figure trying to take down the gang.
A horror tale centered on the friendship between a young girl and the ghost of her mother's twin.
A young mermaid gives up her life in the sea to love a human prince.

Homicide detective Steve Carella is trying to solve the brutal murder of 17-year-old Muriel Stark. Her younger cousin Patricia, who saw the killer and barely escaped with her life, helps him. However, the case soon takes a bizarre turn.
A friendship is put to the ultimate test when two best friends wind up in bed together.

East Germany, 1989. 12 year old Fritzi takes care of her best friend Sophie's dog Sputnik, while Sophie's family is on summer vacation in Hungary. When Sophie doesn't come back from vacation, Fritzi and Sputnik set out in search of her.
A small-town English widow, facing financial troubles after her husband's suicide, turns to agriculture of an illegal kind.

The titular river unites a farmer recently released from prison, his young son, and an ambitious saloon singer. In order to survive, each must be purged of anger, and each must learn to understand and care for the others.

A young woman is disabled in a horrific accident after a group of friends play a sick joke on her. Five years later they are invited to a reunion in the countryside where they are targeted by a masked killer hellbent on revenge.

After a string of tragic accidents on a distant planet, cosmonaut Chapayev is all alone. His life is in constant danger. Something inexplicable, with which he came into contact, will change his life forever.

Boston Metropolitan Police officer Joey Bangs orchestrated three spectacular crimes: the $30-million Depositors Trust Bank heist, Exam scam (the sale of stolen police exams), and the largest drug distribution ring in New England history.
Will and Jake Grimm are traveling con-artists who encounter a genuine fairy-tale curse which requires true courage instead of their usual bogus exorcisms.

Two girlfriends let themselves be locked in a department store for the sake of a school paper, but they look quite differently at this exciting undertaking. One takes everything seriously. The other wants to turn the night into a party.
In the near future, a drone pilot sent into a war zone finds himself paired with a top-secret android officer on a mission to stop a nuclear attack.

Strait-laced Rose breaks off relations with her party girl sister, Maggie, over an indiscretion involving Rose's boyfriend. The chilly atmosphere is broken with the arrival of Ella, the grandmother neither sister knew existed.
When his beloved boss is killed, a dangerous young gangster cuts a path of vengeance through the Japanese mafia.
A major car accident victim who returns home from hospital, experiences paranormal and strange happenings during his first night back in his apartment.
A crazed escaped mental patient holds 2 couples hostage and terrorizes them in a Malibu beach home during a stormy night.
A power-hungry sorcerer curses a princess to live as a swan by day in this tale of everlasting love.
Sandra meets a shrink on the way to picking up her sister at a desert town to continue to their mom. He decides by flipping a coin. The coin flipping gets psycho.
A man takes another man's girl as a hostage and goes to a deserted house outside of Tehran. But there another destiny is waiting him.
A genetically-enhanced boy runs away to a garbage planet where he will rescue a population of outcasts and find a meaning to his existence.
Christmas story about a teenage girl that finds hope in a magical nativity display at her church.

A forest ranger and an adventuress team up against a gang of bandits when all are cut off from the outside world by a blizzard. The gang is controlled by the mysterious Charles Redfield, whom none of the bandits have ever actually seen.

It's not about fame and fortune, - It's about the footprints we leave behind. An Egyptian travelogue starring Luc Verlinden, Patrick Knight and a special appearance by Ofra Haza. Original Soundtrack, Music by Gravity Noir.
Asko Mertanen is a waiter who is very interested in shooting. He gets fed up how the things are run in Finland, so he thinks that the best way to change them is to shoot the Finnish president.
A paranormal expert discovers a house that is at the intersection of so-called "highways" transporting souls in the afterlife.
A scientist who is working on a cure for influenza is victimized by his unscrupulous boss, who releases the vaccine before it's ready, resulting in tragedy.
Two cops on patrol have to team up with a war criminal to survive when two rival gangs has the city under total lockdown.
A young brotherhood of mystics set out to stop the an evil priest, with the help of a chosen warrior.
Robinson Crusoe is shipwrecked and he finds himself all alone on a tropical island. With a few tools he manages to rescue from the wreck he has to learn to support himself until help arrives.
A young stick-up kid turned hip hop artist ,who has muddled through a broken child hood, is offered the performance of a lifetime; but it may cost him his soul.
After a traumatic experience, Chris comes home to confront his past. but soon finds himself prey to a Demon who taunts him through sleep paralysis.
A movie about love, hope, and despair by Martin Beek and Karel Hamm. An unexpected love story, approached from an unexpected angle, with a terrified anti-hero, a milkmaid, and a dead comrade.
Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen) comes out of retirement to help Police Squad infiltrate a gang of terrorists planning to detonate a bomb at the Academy Awards.

International thief is sent to São Paulo, Brazil, and has to work with two women. But the three get emotionally involved, and this love triangle, with the ensuing jealousy and rivalry puts his mission to risk.
The members of a cursed mysterious clan look at daytime and regain their youthful looks after sundown.
In what seemed like the perfect marriage, everything comes crashing down for Dante and Kelis when grief tests their commitment to one another.
Manu, a bodybuilder from Chandigarh, India, falls in love with Maanvi, a Zumba teacher. All seems well until a revelation causes turmoil in their love story.
Viking fantasy action and adventure film.
Three boys challenged by pressures of drugs and gangs decide to fight back.
Santa's daughter must take over the family business when her father retires and her brother, who is supposed to inherit the Santa role, gets cold feet.
A hostage takeover brings a government scandal to the attention of a nation.

movie_name: Promenade: Volume 1 Love in the Elevator
synopsis: A man is hired by a high tech company and falls in love in the elevator with a woman that appears in his dreams.

An action movie about female detective who does everything she can to mop up the drug mess that was brought into Korea by Hong Kong drugs lords, that accidentally ends up in the hands of two men and a killer.
A fresh man came from outskirt to Cairo to look for work ; He meets a tycoon and creates a struggle between them .
People of Mangalpur die in a bizarre pattern. Inspector Vijay is appointed to reveal the truth behind the mystery.

On Halloween, a group of medical students steal the corpse a serial killer from a morgue and raise him from the dead, inadvertently putting themselves and a group of young neighborhood children in danger.
An innocent Satya is captured for a crime committed by his look-alike criminal Shiva. Will the cops believe his story and capture the real criminal.
Two impoverished males encounters goons and assorted characters as they attempt to procure a valuable coat.
Click: The Calendar Girl Killer is a thriller that probes the inner sanctum of the mind of a psychotic killer as he uses the world of big fashion photography for his sadistic playground.
Alby, who is a passionate and hardworking filmmaker, begins to face financial liabilities. Being stressed, he soon gets involved in a thoughtless act and finds himself in an unpredictable situation.
After obtaining a mystical power, Broski must travel back in time to save the world from becoming a post-apocalyptic wasteland; however, this adventure gets personal.
A girl is staying with her grandparents for the summer, where she meets a horse called Mississippi. Trouble begins when Mississippi is about to be sold, a fight for Mississippi begins.
A young boy donates his pet, a police dog, to the army to be trained as a war dog.
Planet Earth. USA. 2015. The natural oil resources are running out. The hatred between East and West has spread like a plague all over the world. The planet is on the brink of World War III.
While Charlie is distracted with the birth of his first grandchild, son Jimmy impersonates his father in order to investigate a murder aboard a freighter in the harbor.
A piano player pretending to be visually-impaired, unwittingly becomes entangled in a number of problems as he witnesses the murder of a former film actor.
A man who neglects his wife and is out of touch with their teenage daughter believes he is justified in having a gun available for the defense of person, family and property.
A story about coming of age, coming out and a gay marriage that is sprinkled with both love and comedy, at the centre of which is a teenager who doesn't yet know what he wants.
The Truffle Hunter is a comedic tale of friendship, deception, and the world's most mysterious and expensive food - The White Truffle.

One long night in 1933, a mysterious stranger and his companion Beata travel through the capital of the USSR, taking down crowds of Chekists and looking for the mysterious girl Eva, who can help stop the Holodomor..

A San Francisco cab driver finds himself in possession of a monkey that is carrying a formula for turning atomic waste into a plutonium bomb. He finds himself framed for a murder and chased all over town by people trying to get the formula.
It tells the story of a theater actor fighting with his own demons.
When a group of friends fail to lower the ladder of their boat, they find themselves stranded in the surrounding waters and struggle to survive.

A rational professor is sent to Africa to dispel the myth of an evil presence by a wealthy property mogul. After arriving at a large Victorian-built house, he is met by something he could never have expected.

movie_name: GoBots: Battle of the Rock Lords
synopsis: The Go-Bots fight to rescue the Rock People.
3 Sisters must survive in a futuristic world, where witches are hunted and no one can be trusted.

movie_name: The Biggest Toad in the Puddle
synopsis: When the unemployed miner Sheng digs out a hot spring in his barren land, he suddenly becomes so popular in the village that everyone wants to be friends with him, hoping to get a share of the treasure.
A recalcitrant thief vies with a duplicitous Mongol ruler for the hand of a beautiful princess.
While on a journey of physical and spiritual healing, a brilliant neurosurgeon is drawn into the world of the mystic arts.
A scientist tries to prove the existence of the Loch Ness monster.
Secret video files just discovered on an FBI server prove that the government has been hiding unexplained disappearances and a dangerous presence in the Pacific Northwest wilderness.

This short collection of strange, weird and fantastical monologue performances will take you on a journey of the bizarre. Thought provoking, captivating and heartwarming. Something Weird, Something Strange is a collection like no other.
Based on the Old Testament story of a young King David and his battle with the Philistine's Champion Goliath.
A young Greek photographer boards and an elevator of a very very very very tall building and goes up.
Based on the novel by Lono Waiwaiole.
Shing (Tony Leung Chiu Wai) is a artist draws his dream girl Ching Ching (Joey Wang) in a comic strip, When he gets into an accident she is thrown into the real world.
Renu and her husband, Anil, are devastated when she cannot bear children after a miscarriage. But soon, he visits a brothel and asks young Chanda to carry and give birth to a baby for his family.
A highway patrolman stops motorists on a highway after he hears news reports of a possible nuclear attack.

Deceived that he had won the Prize, Connor MacLeod awakens from a peaceful life when an entombed immortal magician comes seeking the Highlander.
The Falcon investigates the murder of an actor on a Hollywood backlot.
Scotland Yard is after a homicidal maniac called The Blue Hand, which is what he uses to kill his victims.
A man is on vacation and meets a married woman. She falls in love with him intensely while her husband begins to have suspicions.
A young woman with Asperger's syndrome tries to find her first boyfriend with a little help from her older sister.
A troubled cop becomes the reluctant protector of a small boy whose frightening visions of the future make him a target for the government and the agency that orphaned him.
A giant stone statue comes to life to protect the residents of a small town against the depradations of an evil warlord.
The true story of the infamous prison break of Gary Tison and Randy Greenwalt from the Arizona State prison in Florence, AZ, in the summer of 1978.

Three jailed convicts, Himmat, his brother Ajit, and Dilawar Khan break out of prison and take over the household of Editor Ashok Rai. The convicts will continue to hold the family hostage until their associate, Kamini contacts them in person.
Judge Hardy, trying to find a relative of an aged couple to prevent them from losing their home, enlists the aid of his son Andy.

Tells of Caleb Plummer, his son Edward and blind daughter Bertha, and rivalry over neighbor May Fielding. May's friend Dot weds John Peerybingle; they find a lucky cricket in their cottage. A mortgage and house on fire figure in the story.

Sonic Villains follows Eggman after the events of Sonic Forces as he uses the last of the mysterious Phantom Ruby to gather villains across EVERY SONIC UNIVERSE to regain control, and destroy Sonic in the craziest battle he's faced yet.
Based on actual events, a fisherman tries to survive in the freezing ocean after his boat capsizes off the south coast of Iceland.
A baseball player whose professional career was cut short due to his personal problems is suddenly awakened and invigorated by a young-man with Down syndrome who works at the local grocery store.

Unconditionally Us (previous title Devastation) Skylar and Trace discovers the strength of their love through a tragedy changing their world inside out that only the realness of their love can hold them together beyond death do us part.

movie_name: The Lady Shogun and Her Men
synopsis: In an alternate history of the Edo period, disease greatly reduces the male population. Women rise to positions of authority, while men are prized for their ability to provide children. At the castle, Lady Shogun keeps a harem of men.

After portals start popping up all over the Mushroom Kingdom and the Mario Brothers go missing, Princess Peach sends Fawful and his brothers to go and find them and stop whatever or whoever is creating the portals.

A vagabond swordsman is aided by a beautiful ninja girl and a crafty spy in confronting a demonic clan of killers - with a ghost from his past as their leader - who are bent on overthrowing the Tokugawa Shogunate.
Three vignettes, each set in room 719 of New York's Plaza Hotel, make up this comedy.

Fighting disabilities and cancer with their chins up, mother and son meander through the city against a tide of indifferent faces and distant eyes and arrive in a park, where blissful tranquility and a ray of sunshine await them.
From the order of the Weeping Thorn, Meliisa and her team are sent out to hunt down the killer of innocent colonists on an off-world planet, only their prey has other ideas.

FBI agent Brad joins Tony and Nick, the self styled Supermen who battle crime wearing bullet-proof super-suits. They are on a case involving radioactive counterfeit money and people who can be broken down into precious jewels.
An aspiring sculptor falls in love with a talking hole in the wall when it starts to produce award winning art.
This story follows a young and misunderstood princess who escapes her stressful life by confiding in her own imagination.
Six friends decide to camp out on Halloween night after a party. Little do they know, someone or something has taken the "fright night" a little too far.

Katniss Everdeen is in District 13 after she shatters the games forever. Under the leadership of President Coin and the advice of her trusted friends, Katniss spreads her wings as she fights to save Peeta and a nation moved by her courage.

When outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent, frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.
A mysterious doomsday UFO cult and it's connection to a series of disappearances in the woods near Eugene.
A newsman discovers he's been rigged with a bomb after he has an exclusive interview with a terrorist who blew up a bridge.
Twin brothers realize that the older sister they thought dead is in fact alive, whereupon they embark on a quest to save her from the lecher who has her in his thrall.
A group of childhood friends return to their former hometown to revisit the horrors that happened there 15 years ago.
Two FBI Agents learn about a very unique psychotic serial killer. Investigating together they find gruesome victims, shocking surprises, and evil in an unexpected way.
Philo Vance comes to England to investigate the murder of a millionaire.
Story of the famous Malkocoglu family who served Ottoman Empire in various military ranks.
Twenty years after the accident that claimed his son's life and permanently injured his wife, a man returns to his home in search of redemption.
The British monarch's (Dame Julie Walters') favorite dog gets lost from the palace and finds himself at a dog fight club. He then begins his long journey to find his way back home.
A US Army colonel in France tries to track down an escaped sex maniac.
A young woman returns to the family orchard bent on punishing her kin for past hurt. The secrets she unearths ignite an inferno beyond anyone's control.
Captain Drummond travels to Switzerland in order to marry his girlfriend but the disappearance of a dangerous cargo of explosives makes him delay his plans.

An MMA fighter wakes up one morning after several nights of strange nightmares and learns that he is a Special Agent undercover for an experiment in which his conscience is cast in Android fighters during his sleep.
A grisly unsolved murder links three seemingly unrelated stories in three different Japanese cities.

Life at the Magic Roundabout is disrupted when a blue cat called Buxton finds his way into town. Everyone loves Buxton except for Dougal, who discovers the cat's mad plan to become the king of blue army and destroy all who are not blue.

Farid and Leila are classmates and in love with each other. Farid is poor and works as a servant in a restaurant but has hidden this from Leila. When a woman Ayda intervenes in between everything changes for this couple.
Fifteen years after their time at camp was cut short, a group of adults tries to recreate the summer they missed, only to find the past always has a way of catching up with them.
A hard-living bounty hunter finds and captures a dangerous yet wise-ass criminal, but then the two must work together to evade the crooked cops and heavily armed mercenaries trying to kill them both.
An incompetent time traveler must team up with his unpredictable alternate self, to fix a paradox which is now slowly destroying the universe.
Going back millions of years to seek the own roots. Traveling through the time back millions of years, to discover their own original provenience, to explain and answer to many queries awaken.
When Mandarin Wu's unmarried daughter becomes pregnant by a young Englishman, he seeks vengeance.

movie_name: Kamen Rider Decade: All Riders vs. Dai-Shocker
synopsis: Nobuhiko Tsukikage, the caretaker of Tsukasa's sister, warns him that Dai Shocker plans to invade the Earth. He suggests that he should battle all of the Riders to see which one is the stronger to battle against the evil organization.

The adventure comedy tells about the story of the heroes of "Bozbash Pictures". So, the desperate heroes abduct a $ 2 million cash in one of the local banks. The police in the country are taking every opportunity to find criminals.
A New Zealand based crime comedy about three friends who stumble across three cases of premium grade heroin. Each one tells their side of the story in separate grueling police interrogations.
Like her grandmother and her mother Jane before her, Wendy must escape Pan's hold on her and the promise he wants her to keep.
A girl courting a young man over the phone which makes him want to know her .
A fantasy, soft-horror adventure in which ancient myths and legends revive thanks to a group of children who play detectives in the ancient land of Sardinia.
An orphaned teenager forms an unlikely friendship with a detective. Together they investigate her mother's murder, and uncover the supernatural force that proves to be a threat to her family.
Special agent Ace is called out of retirement and teams up with Scarlett to take down the Clown and his gang.

movie_name: Fountaine and the Vengeful Nun Who Wouldn't Die
synopsis: Mary, The Maniac Nun must battle through gangs of thugs, a corrupt Church and even a few Nazis to bring her sister's killer to light and make them pay for her overdose.

After being exiled from her clan for killing the son of a powerful clan's chieftain, a young woman battles against nature, fierce warriors, brutal bounty hunters, and a savage beast all while learning to embrace her own ominous destiny.
A wealthy businessman tries to take down a drug kingpin that he used to work with, while a policeman tries to find justice without breaking the law.
To escape a gender war, a girl flees to a remote farmhouse and becomes part of an extensive family's unusual, perhaps even supernatural, lifestyle.
The spirit of a recently deceased expert pilot mentors a newer pilot while watching him fall in love with the girlfriend that he left behind.
A dystopic, corporate government pursuits a couple of lovers with different social-political statuses.
Henrik and Frank, two computer nerds, get more than they bargain for when they must travel through time and defeat possessed Nazi-soldiers to impress the girls living in the cabin next door.
Bank teller Till Reiners' life is torn out of a rut by a series of offbeat coincidences that ultimately lead him to find himself and realize his life isn't so bad after all.
The film portrays the unexpected incidents happening over two days in the life of an oversees returned, middle class family man Jitya Bhau in a the small town city of Maharashtra.
In a future where disease has been conquered but economic disparity has grown, a young biker discovers that he has superhuman powers.
FOR ADULTS ONLY.

In 1975, a group of robbers stole seven million dollars from the Hang Sang Bank. The film is shot on the basis of description by one of the robbers. It aims to portrait those involved and reveal the plot as true as possible to the facts.
When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the shocking truth--the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence.
In 1690, pardoned pirate Captain Blood's quiet existence is shaken when the Crown re-arrests him on fresh piracy charges but the captain suspects he's being set up.
Demented mutants return with one objective in mind: Kill, kill, kill.
Two corporate spies with a $5 million haul for selling secrets are held hostage by a thief, triggering a game of cat and mouse to gain the upper hand.
A young couple awakens a terrible force when they attempt to socialize their reclusive neighbor.
A college student undergoing experimental treatment for schizophrenia must solve the murder of her best friend.
Two longtime friends, Antonello and Daniele, are spending the New Year's Eve night together, in a mix of comic adventures and eccentric situations.
A contemporary thriller set in Hamburg, based on and inspired by true events which began one day in June in 1942.

Wafaa (Hanan Turk) is in love with Khalid(mustafa amar), her class-mate at University, but Khalid seems to like her cousin Rania (Mona Zaki) When Wafa finds out about this, she tries to lead Rania towards him
Two men prepare to compete in a legendary bare-knuckle fight where the winner gets a $100,000 prize.
In St. Tropez, French gendarme Cruchot and his men battle petroleum-drinking, human-looking, metallic aliens.
A stormy relationship, complicated by the strictures of 1950s social class and gender roles, ends in death. Based on the life of Ruth Ellis, the last woman hanged in Britain.

movie_name: The Toxic Avenger Part III: The Last Temptation of Toxie
synopsis: Toxie finds he has nothing to do as a superhero, as he has ridden his city of evil. He decides to go to work for a major corporation, which he discovers may be the evilest of all his adversaries.
An addict joins a new age drug program.
When a time traveler starts meddling with the past just as Miles finally meets the love of his life, he must battle ever shifting timelines to find her again.
A canoe trip down the river Kolpa becomes a journey of discovery for three female students.
Five friends take a boat out on the lake, black out simultaneously, and wake up on the shore with no sign of the boat and no memory of how they got there.
The line between truth and fiction is blurred when we find Cryptic Ryan lost within the shadows of his own film.
Following the events of Superman: American Alien, Max Landis details the darkest night in Superman and Robin's life as they attempt to defend Gotham City under orders of a preoccupied Batman.
The plot is unknown.
Four different Thai directors offer their takes on love.
A broken heart. A stolen car. An unexpected romance.
In 1907, an actor is invited to perform in an isolated country house, and becomes involved in mysterious and dangerous events.
Un pobre obrero esta profundamente enamorado de una mujer rica, pero ella no le pertenece. Mientras lucha por conquistarla, aprende una valiosa lección.
A successful business woman takes her boyfriend home for Thanksgiving only to find her family is scheming to reunite her with her lost love.
Bungo becomes a single parent when his wife leaves him because of his drinking and gambling. Deciding to quit his vices, he works menial jobs, drifting from city to city.

Rochelle travels to the Philippines to introduce her boyfriend, Andy, to her Filipino relatives. But as the introductions and celebrations begin, Rochelle discovers that she is facing an ominous force that she never believed in.

Zack and Sham, two youngsters who love drift racing. Even though drift racing is much for men Zack's girlfriend enters in drift racing and becomes competitive in drifting. How their lives roll with racing, love and competition.

Luther Meek, a young, goofy citizen of a small town, foils the manager of a stranded theatrical troupe from robbing the local bank and escaping with the loot, and wins the hand of the troupe's fair leading-lady in the process.
Two soul mates, who have only met in their dreams, must find each other on in order to defeat dark forces.
In San Francisco, detective partners Jack Packard and Doc Long are hired by socialite Jefferson Monk who believes someone is following him with the aim to kill him.
Romeo and Juliet a-la Romani style.

The Exchange is a sci-fi story about a hybrid human-alien mercenary wants to return to his home planet but is stopped by his commanding officer. When he falls in love with a woman he must decide whether to stay a mercenary or become free.
Friends hiking the Appalachian Trail are confronted by 'The Foundation', a community of people who have lived in the mountains for hundreds of years.

movie_name: Hot Bath an' a Stiff Drink 2
synopsis: Twin brothers - one a Marshal, one an Outlaw - join forces against a hardened killer bent on revenge in the old west.
1941. The young maiden Liv and the German officer Franz meets in a military camp, and starts a friendship, something her father won't accept, and a flight to neutral Sweden is the solution.
In the sleepy town of Paintsville, USA, several young women will be terrorized by a maniac, and his paint brush.
Post-structuralist satire of a woman's journey into the male dominated culture of Uther Pendragon's Camelot.
The life story of Italian sports car entrepreneur Enzo Ferrari.
Telling a story about the world through music in this silent drama, experience a film like never before of Drugs, Emotion, Love and Hate, Life and Death, Surviving and Running.
The nightmare of the unsolved, random murder is brought to life: A faceless killer wreaks havoc on the lives of average people in a small Massachusetts town.
This martial arts/sci-fi film has plenty of action, intrigue and suspense. The story revolves around opposing forces in the world of military espionage.
Plot is unknown at this time
The monstrous Ro-Man attempts to annihilate the last family alive on Earth, but finds himself falling for their beautiful daughter.
An undercover cop infiltrates a gang of thieves who plan to rob a jewelry store.
A misogynist and shabby farmer, brother of other three goofy hillbillies leaves to the big city searching for a wife and wins the heart of a hot tempered woman.

Some have described love as a spell. Others have described it as a sickness. What they have in common is the idea that love, in its many forms, has the power to overwhelm the senses and control behavior.
Guilt drives a medical scientist to try cutting edge theta brain wave therapy to help her paraplegic husband, except the healing he needs is not her science but her love.
An intelligent forensic officer starts investigating a murder, but he faces a slew of challenges as he suffers from nyctophobia. Will he be able to solve the case?

A lonely nurse working the night shift on Christmas Eve befriends an elderly patient who weaves a wicked set of tales about the most wonderful time of the year. This Christmas, evil comes home for the holidays!
A gorilla named Ivan tries to piece together his past with the help of an elephant named Ruby as they hatch a plan to escape from captivity.
The Thottathil family set out on a journey to find extreme fun and enjoyment. Accidentally, two girls join their journey. The rest of the journey unfolds with lots of twists and turns.
Nkem's inability to change risks costing him more than he can imagine.
Little girl finds a teddy bear from the seashore. Reeta and Teddy Uppo form a deep friendship with each other, but what happens when Uppo meets an old hermit?

A woman takes the law into her own hands after police ignore her pleas to arrest the man responsible for her husband's death, and finds herself not only under arrest for murder but falling in love with an officer.

Cherry drifts from college dropout to army medic in Iraq - anchored only by his true love, Emily. But after returning from the war with PTSD, his life spirals into drugs and crime as he struggles to find his place in the world.

movie_name: The Island at the Top of the World
synopsis: In 1907, four explorers discover a lost colony of Vikings in the Arctic.
The story about the businessmen who are competing for international building contracts.

Young, pleasant Nikki Collins (Deanna Durbin) witnesses a brutal murder while riding on a train on her way to New York City. Though she desperately tries to inform others of what she saw, no one believes her.

Due to conflicts with her mother, Fiona has not visited Grandma for long. The constant nightmare forced her to go there with her two friends, Luna and Jeff. However, mysterious things end in a threat to their lives.
A NASA team gets more than they bargained for as the U.S. prepares for war against Alien invaders.
A woman and a man she claims to be her brother convince a naive employee of a prosperous company to help them steal the company funds, promising to divide the money three ways.
Narumi is set up by a mysterious woman. Abducted and tortured, Narumi is forced to take on a new job - the target is a veteran killer as good as he is.

Frank Gannon, a veteran cop, is being hunted by his fellow police officers after they learned he has betrayed the brotherhood and exposed to the feds wide scale corruption of the LAPD. He has one day left to prove his case and survive.
Young, wild poet Arthur Rimbaud and his mentor Paul Verlaine engage in a fierce, forbidden romance while feeling the effects of a hellish artistic lifestyle.
After a tragic accident, professional dancer, Rachael, tries desperately to recover her memory, but with every piece she recovers, she is losing more of her sanity.
Bizzare, often perverse yarn about nurses in a metropolitan hospital who seduce then murder male patients.
After twelve years of absence, Martina meets with her cousins, whom she has not seen since childhood.
In a magical community where girls are born to be witches and boys grow into shapeshifters, Aster discovers he has emerging witch powers.

Unaware of her reality, Shyam falls in love with Aathira, a ghost who wants to avenge her and her lover's deaths by killing a minister. However, when Shyam discovers the truth, he decides to help her.

A depressed insurance salesman meets and falls for a jewelry maker with a mysterious past. As their relationship heats up, he starts encountering strange phenomena and believes he is going insane while her past finally catches up with her.
A little boy lost in the woods is found and raised by Old John, a hermit, who teaches the boy about life in general and nature in particular.
Back in Prague after 15 years, writer Paul Herzog begins an investigation about a woman he loved at that time, who dead mysteriously.
Environmental activists encounter a mysterious and deadly presence.
Second contest edition in which 9 short movies are written, shot and edited within 72 hours. Primary goal, besides promoting the city of The Hague, was to use 'western' as the main genre.
After his daughter is raped, a father gets a gory revenge.
Dante travels across a desolate, futuristic Spain in search of his girlfriend, Ula. He is pursued by a bloodthirsty, cybernetic Rottweiler.
Three veterans are given magic artifacts by elves that can magically create gold, servants and any other object. They encounter greedy characters and one of them falls in love with a princess.

movie_name: Haven Lost: The Dragon's Brood Cycle
synopsis: When a teenage girl is transported into a mysterious world, she goes to war with the despotic sorceress that has turned The Haven into a nightmare using dark magic.

movie_name: Hua gui you xian gong si
synopsis: Two salesmen once worked in the countryside and came across a female ghost and a sissy ghost, and their driver was killed by the ghosts. They were so scared that they had to find a new job.
When Tim's girlfriend tragically dies, he calls on a kooky pair of 'Paranormal Investigators' to contact her. However, not all is as it seems.

Five people receive an anonymous letter revealing a secret of theirs and inviting them to come stay at a mansion that houses a clinic run by a corrupt doctor who experiments on the brain of his comatose son.
The wealthy hotel owner Scherzinger has to fight love and other catastrophes.

A meteor crash in upstate NY. A purple corn craze on the food truck scene. An undercover maid and a rogue FDA agent partnering over purple poops. An otherworldly mystery is unfolding - but If aliens invaded Brooklyn, who could tell?

The year is 3000. Geppetto, with the help of his faithful assistant, Spencer the cyber penguin, and by the holographic fairy Cyberina, creates Pinocchio, a prototype super-robot equipped for emotions.
Film set sometime in the Later Tang Dynasty, in the Five Dynasty Period.

Danish film from 1957. The son Jens runs Seat from Home and returns after 20 years. Reunits with old friends. Not all finds themselves happy about Jens's return, that brings new things and changes to the villiage.
BAD LUCK is a lovingly made, tragic-comic film about wrong decisions, chance and the search for happiness.
Two bored children have their lives turned upside down when a talking cat comes to visit them.
After a one-night stand with a mysterious and beautiful woman, Jonathan falls ill and starts to believe that he's the victim of a sinister supernatural plot.
After escaping a Russian labor camp, three men must overcome the treacherous wilderness and each other, as their journey home turns into a brutal fight for survival.

Princess Barbara is secretly in love with Prince Edward. When the sneaky post clerk Weasel demands the king to marry him to Barbara, she flees. Sweet monster Boogey does everything in his might to help Barbara save the kingdom.
FBI Agent Will Brody helps Claire McCoy solve his murder in the afterlife and fall in love.

movie_name: Simba, the King Lion: The Final Battle
synopsis: Simba and Buckshot discover that the King of Eagles has been seen flying around the peak of the mountain. They journey up the mountain to meet the king, facing many obstacles along the way.
On Gary's first day of being homeless, he encounters an intriguing stranger with a demonic destiny and realizes sometimes you've gotta go down in order to rise up.
Caroline's mother Isabelle is dead. While she stays at her mother's house, her body disappears.
A woman who lives in her darkened old family house with her two photosensitive children becomes convinced that the home is haunted.

This love-triangle story is about love, music, and drugs. Jessica (Vina Morales) is an up-and-coming singer who meets Gary (Keempee de Leon), lead singer of a band, and Karlo (Christopher de Leon), his ex-convict older brother.

Eloïse is sitting alone on a bench in Paris. She can't remember who she is, where she comes from or how did she get here. So, she begins a funny investigation on her life. This amnesia might help her finding love and reinventing her life.
A middle aged housewife takes the initiative to complete the bucket list of her deceased teenage heart donor.
A mother searches for her youngest daughter after she's abducted by an unearthly force.

A young woman tries to find her origins after having been abandoned as an infant at a cemetery wrapped in a cloth with satanic symbols, but as she gets closer to answers a malevolent spirit is telling her to leave.

Osman is a jealous and proud gentleman. Zala, who must have married him at a young age is unhappy. Avci, caught in a storm and had to take refuge in his hut, is an attractive young man who knows how to take advantage of his environment.

A futuristic Philippines with specific sections of the country under individual bio-domes. The OFWs are actually Outerspace Filipino Workers and the song Bahay-Kubo is a distant memory that makes a young boy ask: "Ano ang singkamas?"

movie_name: In the Kingdom of the Blind, the Man with One Eye Is King
synopsis: Al is hired by an acquaintance who happens to be the local mob boss to track down his own brother who's wanted by the mafia for the murder of an important gangster figure. Is blood thicker than water?
Strange happenings occur on a WW II submarine.
Four robbers attempt, between several misfortunes, to steal a famous statue from the museum of Delfi under the orders of a blackmailer.

When the second coming of Christ is discovered to be in a nymphomaniac's womb, the Virgin Mary enlists the Moirai, the three disgruntled sisters of Fate, to help protect the new mother and child from the most unlikely assailant: God.
A woman with a dark past returns to her long-abandoned childhood home to confront a fictitious ecology of strange creatures she invented during her youth.
Exzurians invade the Philippine Islands.
After ascending to the throne, King Shamsher Singh begins a reign of terror and oppression. A young commoner named Jai then decides to challenge the king and kidnaps his sister.

Ek Kassh (2018) is a Hindi Short Film written & Directed by Anugrah Agnihotri. This film is about how drugs is harmful for our health and society. Film Casting is Anugrah Agnihotri, Sunny Pal, Shiv Kumar, Vijendra Gotshe, etc.

"Ark" is a story of loss, identity and A.I. After losing everything in the year 2041 Siru takes an ark-device developed by her husband and makes contact with her younger self to change the course of history.

Two men and a woman, each of whom is trying to get their hands on a trove of precious jewels. Lots of misunderstandings arise, forcing the three hapless jewel hunters to co-operate. Despite internal rivalries an unexpected harmony arises.
Jack, a social outcast, is thrust out of his comfort zone when the outside world bangs on his door and he can't contain his violent past.
Kazuo Murata is a detective who has lost his wife and eventually the meaning of his existence.
Story of the friendship between a kid and his horse.
A detective investigating his best friend uncovers an assassin hunting through Las Vegas's power elite.
A broken family, recently restored by Christ, follow God's will to a remote lake with a dark secret.
Four Female Super Heroes, each with supernatural powers, are created to combat evil forces, to ensure Planet Aswan's protection, and to restore the peace and harmony of this planet in our universe.
1955. Drama. Directed by Charles De la Tour & Cy Endfield. Stars Arthur Kennedy, Constance Smith & Joy Shelton. A Night club singer tricks an estate agent into thinking he killed a jewel thief.
An old lady is far from suspecting everything that is going on behind her back, in particular what her servants are up to.
Batman and Robin struggling to survive in a apocalyptic third world.
Revenge is a dish served very cold as enemies of the Vector mission team's past seek deadly retribution for defeat suffered some five years prior.
A disgraced, condemned mech-pilot war hero, trapped in an electromagnetic superstorm, is pursued by a mysterious and relentless enemy.
A suspenseful and mysterious journey of 8 people where secrets and crimes get dirtier. FOUR is an anthology of different stories with extraordinary and unique concepts.

Bagawat is a story of Rebellion by lower class against the atrocities of Upper Caste and acquiring the most powerful weapon of "Divide and Rule" used to achieve and sustain the dominion, which was invented long time ago.
A nuclear powered bus driving cross-country, from New York City to Colorado, is destined for disaster due to the machinations of a mysterious group allied with the oil lobby.
The grandmother we all crave.
On a post-apocalyptic Earth, an angel descends to help the survivors.

movie_name: The Boy who Belonged to the Sea
synopsis: When a tragic accident puts his mother into a coma, a 12-year-old boy must enter a frightening dreamscape on a mission to wake her.
Peter Lu's Freshman Mushroom Project plunges attendees into the heart of a discomforting, autobiograpical live performance that examines sexuality.
Story of a mentally disturbed playboy serial killer who hunts kills many women.
An estranged father and son are brought together by a young crane named Karl as they trace a family of the birds on their migratory journey from Russia to Africa.
A detached university student faces the consequences of astral projection when he uses it to reconnect with his dead mother.
Some youngsters kill their teacher; but they won't tell their motivation. The police detective on the case feels some sinister influence behind the young murderers.
Years after moving to a remote town, ex-cop Pipa is pulled back into the dark world she thought she'd left behind when a corpse appears on her property.
Alli and Jane had their neighborhood under control until their new principal moved in next door and changed everything.
After being snubbed by the royal family, a malevolent fairy places a curse on a princess which only a prince can break, along with the help of three good fairies.
With the aid of his companions, a man seeks to defeat his evil brother who has taken a nun hostage.
A young man from a respectable family is forced to become an underworld don through circumstances out of his control and ends up wreaking havoc in gang torn Bangalore.
The end of our world is the beginning of another.
Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.
Princess Zeila must choose a prince from among all the princes in Baghdad, despite the evil plotting of Jafar to thwart her hopes.

When we think about life after death we often think of the state between the two as a nightmare; a purgatory where sins are revisited or unfinished business haunts the living. GLORY EVERLASTING tests this notion.

Comedy about a woman suffering from low self esteem who gets breast enhancement surgery, unaware that her surgeon worships H.P. Lovecraft's elder gods, and the surgery is part of a diabolical plot to rule the world.
comedy, thriller, scary movie
A Kung Fu master battles Bruka the evil snake queen with her army of snakes and savage little people.
A Coptic leper and his orphaned apprentice leave the confines of the leper colony for the first time and embark on a journey across Egypt to search for what is left of their families.

movie_name: Alexis Brimstone and the Riding Hood Academy
synopsis: Magic, mystery, and mayhem ensue when Alexis Brimstone, a witty and ambitious kid with a knack for getting into trouble, unearths a dangerous conspiracy after enrolling at the celebrated Riding Hood Academy.
A mythical princess searches for her father in a perilous labyrinth.
A dancer is invited to choreograph dancers for a wealthy family in Budapest. However, strange things start to happen...and the answers might lie in a nearby cemetery called the Butterfly Cemetery.

movie_name: San da ming bu hui jing shi
synopsis: The pursuit of the Devil Clan, a gang of very efficient robbers who have never been caught.
Cruel, horrible and insatiable the one-eyed creature with extraordinary features, becomes a nuisance and turns the life of a community hell. The curse of the community comes with terrify trouble.
Two lesbians commit murder and robbery and escape to an island.

Anna, Linda and Roxy are three girls living together in a flat in a big city. It's three months that Roxy is missing and police investigations come to nothing.

Dave and Joe, evicted from their apartment, turn to stealing cars and dealing Fluoride to make their financial ends meet. One night they find Summer Hayes in the trunk of a stolen automobile and nothing is what it at first appears to be.
A man and a neighbor share a strange bond, connected by surveillance.
Outcast scientist Dr Jon Thorson is chosen by his former employer, SIGMA, to lead an elite team of Soldiers and Scientists into a portal leading to the Realm of the Norse Gods.
A Kosovo-Albanian motorbike courier in London escapes the law after killing a Serb and goes on a road trip to Africa with his girlfriend in search of his missing brother.

A family struggles for survival in the face of a cataclysmic natural disaster.
In New York City, a young Classics prodigy descends into the city's underworld with the help of his new friend, an attempt to catch a glimpse of his late mother in the secret world.

Alan Armstrong, aka Spy Smasher, battles a Nazi villain known as The Mask, who heads a gang of saboteurs determined to spread destruction across America.
A forest by the sea. Three friends. A girl. Friendship, love. Can they overcome prejudices and go back to being friends again?
To the naked eye, they are the perfect family. But behind closed doors, a great secret is kept.

Cheerful, festive and glowing Yolki will give you all the festive moments. With a smile we will watch the adventures of the heroes and together with them we will look forward to our New Year's miracle, which will soon come to our house.
A horror hosted TV special (one off) on Channel 3 Los Angeles, California in 1990 with Dr. Acula.

The frustrated husband of a stripteaser takes revenge for suffered humiliation by haunting the nightclub milieu as a mass murderer.
A FORMER SEMINARIAN RETALIATES AGAINST THE SYNDICATE THAT KILLED HIS LOVED ONES.
Off the Spanish coast, two tug-boat captains are caught in a violent feud over a woman but their rivalry is set aside when a sinking freighter carrying explosives must be salvaged and towed to port.
Rural drug lord who bails out beleagurerd farmers with loans in exchange for harvesting marijuana on their land.
Ten short films made over a decade. They have comedy, mystery, romance, action, and international scenes.

Heroic war adventures of an orphan shepherd boy, who saved two Red Army scout soldiers from the pursuit by White Army and as a reward was admitted into the squadron.

German artist meets Han goatherd...perhaps.

Travelling by trains from Cape Town to Cairo.

The life of Kübra and Ahmet, who love each other and have a happy marriage, turn into a nightmare because of the events they cannot understand.

movie_name: Once Upon a Time in Indonesia
synopsis: Story of Max who haunted by the deeds of his criminal father, his family, and his closest friends, as they battle a local loan shark who wants revenge against Max and his father.
A couple on the verge of divorce have to stay together during lockdown as a nasty surprise awaits them.
Terror strikes in the backwoods of Tennessee when an age-old curse resurfaces and takes revenge on a group of friends on a weekend getaway at a family cabin.

Shy girl Molly is having a party. She is inviting her school bullies and has planned one hell of a night. After a party trick goes horribly wrong, each guest is forced into a macabre game of life and death by an ancient demon who forces them to tell horrifying stories.

In a future where procreation is policed by the government, one man throws caution to the wind and lives the way he wants to live. That man is Danny Stewart and he'll screw anyone who will let him. This is the story of that man.
A psychopathic killer murders three girls before police catch him.
A young boy has to make a voyage to a distant lake to save his mother, who has been turned into a dragon.
A psychic's investigation into the disappearance of a Senator's daughter leads her to a dangerous cult and the truth about her mysterious past.

movie_name: Christopher Hope and the Secret of Napoleon
synopsis: Christopher Hope, a student working toward his degree in history who is determined to uncover the secret behind the legendary lost treasure of Napoleon, supposedly hidden by Freemasons somewhere in Paris.

Angel is a shy, clumsy girl who can't say no to anything. When she finds a beautiful special watch, which can make all her wishes come true, she suddenly is incredibly popular but will her new life truly make her happy?
When the thugs who killed his father come looking for him, a young Latino man and his mother flee from their home.

movie_name: Stella und der Stern des Orients
synopsis: On New Year's Eve 2005, little Stella visits her grandma in the family home. Unknowingly she activates a time-travel machine and is transported back to the year 1905, where she meets some long-gone relatives when they were her age.

Young L.A. artist, Chloe, hires prostitutes to pose nude and talk openly about their lives while she films them for her new art project. She falls for one of them, the elegant 40-something Kat. The two begin a tragic passionate affair.

Copenhagen in the good old days, when the bourgeoisie swarmed and danced in the newly opened amusement park, Tivoli.

A skeptical professor visits a remote British estate to debunk allegations of psychic phenomena, but soon finds himself haunted by a ghost from his own past.
A psychological thriller about a couple caught in a bizarre realm in an old bed and breakfast.

When slaughterhouse workers Endre and Mária discover they share the same dreams, where they meet in a forest as deer and fall in love, they decide to make their dreams come true, but it's difficult in real life.

A young boy accidentally loses his sister's school shoes. To avoid trouble at school and with their parents, they decide to secretly share his shoes.

7 women find themselves dealing with a mystery killing. Who's the killer and what are the motives of the murder?
A former Special Operations Vietnam vet works as a Chicago cop, and uncovers C.I.A. wrongdoing.
After being conned by the woman he loves, a finance agent arrives in India from USA to retrieve his money from the woman's father, a powerful MP and an industrialist.
In the roaring 20's a secret organization made-up of eclectic team members from around the world will fight against dark paranormal forces to save humanity.
Two powerful female warriors must journey across a post-apocalyptic land to fight a ritual duel, and fulfill an ancient prophecy.
The owner of a plantation in the jungle marries a beautiful woman. Shortly afterward, he is plagued by a strange voodoo curse which transforms him into a gorilla.
A man is on the run from the law for committing a murder. He is solaced by a retired army major who is unaware that the fugitive has killed his own son.
An Englishman in Holland gets involved in a murder case. It looks bad for him, but the wily Inspector Van Der Valk isn't convinced of his guilt.
Vain Emperor is shown up by a trick; he realises his folly and reforms.
A mischievous kid and his friends torment their school teachers.
Boy Akmal and senior police lieutenant Nuriyev go to a fairyland to restore order there.

Teen Josie tries to make sense of a frightening world in which a sleep condition blurs her dreams into waking life, and comes under the sway of her sister Samantha, whose dark web of secrets she must unravel.
An ancient alien forced out of hiding is mankind's only hope for survival after a biological weapon brings humanity to the brink of extinction.

Romance blossoms between single seamstress Puck and the engaged art critic Roger.
After suffering a head injury during the Blitz, an actor comes to believe himself to be the Brighton Strangler, the murderer he was playing onstage.

movie_name: The Wacky World of Mother Goose
synopsis: Animated feature film based on Charles Perrault's stories and nursery rhymes. It features Humpty Dumpty, The Old Woman Who Lives in a Shoe, and the Crooked Man.
A bouncer is called in to help fight off a mob boss who is trying to take over local night clubs.
A story about choices to be made between relationships - relationships with one's mentor, one's love and family.
April 2019, Grenoble, France. Three friends are victims of paranormal phenomena following the viewing of several "videos" within a mysterious website. This band will try to escape from these events.
The first Darna epic in full color.

When forces within and beyond this world conspire to snatch his son away, a father resolves to do whatever it takes to protect him.

During World War II, Germany aims to conquer Turkey with an operation which is Ankara Express. German spy Hilda and Turkish major Seyfi engage in a dangerous relationship while they work for Ankara Express operation.

2142: Pollution and climate change wiped out most of Earth's population. Ecoban city is built to withstand this. Suppression results in revolt. A childhood couple find each other as adults on opposing sides.
A top Federal Agent's investigation begins to cast light on a conspiracy within government to assassinate the President - and now he must expose the conspiracy and stop it cold.
Alexis is a boxer, training for the Olympic Trials. As she is leaving the gym she is attacked and infected with a blood disease that makes her need human blood.

Ten-year-old Arthur, in a bid to save his grandfather's house from being demolished, goes looking for some much-fabled hidden treasure in the land of the Minimoys, tiny people living in harmony with nature.
A young girl's Christmas wish for her divorced parents to get back together becomes a reality with a twist of holiday joy, comedy, and laughter.
9 college students on road trip get waylaid and wind up in deep trouble.
Time Travel Action/Adventure that will change the history of the world forever.
Horrid Henry finds himself doing things he never ever thought he'd do, and then some.
Three film students from California travel to Utah to seek out the phenomenal forest creature known as Bigfoot.
A Private Detective is hired by a rich oil baron to find his kidnapped Daughter. After many encounters with local gangsters, Jeff Merlin finds the girl strapped to a bomb.Larry Anderson
