An ad exec quits her job, moves to Buenos Aires and rediscovers herself through tango dancing.
A mysterious fair that comes to a small community in the countryside could make real the illusions of two teenagers.
Two opposing characters are hidden in the person of the inconspicuous London gentleman.Dr.Warren and Janus
Fall, 1968. After many years Barbara visits her long time crush from high school, Howard. Bad timing, a serial killer is going around town.

Keith is a Japanese twenty-something who is followed by Death in various disguises. When he finally faces her, Death tells him that he has only 12 hours to live and he needs to make the most of it.

After an act of euthanasia, a college bound girl finds herself in the middle of a serial killer investigation. The catch is that her father, a leading FBI agent, is in charge of it.

movie_name: Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves
synopsis: Ali Baba unknowingly finds himself in a jungle of magic and strange creatures that hold several surprises for him.

Adaptation of cowboy comic-book El Payo, #2 in a series.

synopsis: The Knight Arn is sent on a last mission against Saladin. He has to win this battle, before he can go home to Sweden, and finally marry his Cecilia and start a family. But the peace back home is threatened by the Danes.

Sudhanshu (Prosenjit) cheats her wife and falls in love with Joysree(Rituparna Sengupta).

movie_name: Princess and Seven Kung Fu Masters

One man's journey to dominate the 1980s Gigolo scene.

French Secret Service agent and boxer Henri D'Alour uncovers a plot to con the government out of millions of francs in its purchase of machinery.

A young orphan is sent to the village of Moonfleet in Dorset, England to stay with his mother's former lover, who has the facade of a gentleman but leads a gang of swashbuckling bootleggers; the duo go on a treasure hunt.

Stagnant since 1903, at an elevation of 2,744 m, a volcano erupts on the mythical and majestic Baekdu Mountain.

A little girl's letter to two Christmas elves brings unexpected chaos to her small town.
An artist aids the wife of the MP who shot her blackmailer.

movie_name: Easter Dance: The Best Party in Town

Five friends, up north for three days, one creature ... NO CHANCE !

Plot kept under wraps.

A family is relocated by FBI after the twin sisters stop a diamond thief with ketchup. They are blabbermouths so, as last chance, they end up in in Sydney, Australia. 2 mobsters are sent there for them and the hidden diamond.

synopsis: A team of investigators search for clues about the legend of Sasquatch.
A misunderstanding between some orphans and a noble family leads to tragic consequences when some local gangsters get involved.
A loveable small man is a big spender.
While Judge Hardy handles a couple's divorce, Andy takes a shine to their shy daughter.

When Lucy, a young grieving woman who's lost the will to live, is in danger of going back to jail, a mysterious man with psionic powers helps her out, only to realize that he has a dark reason to keep her alive.

synopsis: The Knight Arn is sent on a last mission against Saladin. He has to win this battle, before he can go home to Sweden, and finally marry his Cecilia and start a family. But the peace back home is threatened by the Danes.

A young cop, Tina, meets a gambler, Lee, at a casino in Las Vegas and things started to happen. With an Indian rock, they are brought back to the past to change history, which includes changing the relationship between them.

movie_name: Padre no hay más que uno 2: La llegada de la suegra
synopsis: Javier's life turns in a hell twice: not only Marisa announces that she's pregnant, but she calls the most feared people by him to help them.
Animated feature film based on the popular comic strip about a sarcastic, lasagna-loving cat.

movie_name: Last American Horror Show: Volume II
synopsis: This is the sequel to Last American Horror Show.
A police crime scene photographer's camera begins to show him photos of murders before they happen.
After an invasion by blind baby snatchers which hunt by sound, a surviving mother and her kids pursue one badly hurt creature, hoping to track down her taken newborn.
A talented but indigent poet Vijay struggles for love and recognition in this selfish world.
A family in Africa finds itself under attack by a pride of lions.

Assassin John Brown, a heroin-addicted, recent war veteran, is hired to take out a local nightclub owner. When Brown slips, he finds himself on the run from both police and the shadowy corporation that hired him.
When a young caterer realizes guests are mysteriously being murdered during a lavish wedding at an isolated estate, she must figure out who the killer is before everyone is dead.
Henry is resurrected from death with no memory, and he must save his wife from a telekinetic warlord with a plan to bio-engineer soldiers.
It's another battle of the wits for the brilliant but eccentric physicist, Yukawa, and detective, Kaoru.
A team of international scientists and engineers attempts to build a tunnel under the ocean.
The story of Michael Moore, Shot, Hooker, Joey and Dennis: five gangsters who work for a man named Leo.

movie_name: Tri bogatyrya i Kon' na trone
synopsis: As always, Kon Yuliy got into history. And at the same time he helped the Prince - they accidentally exchanged bodies, of course, not without the help of an old acquaintance - Baba Yaga and a little witchcraft.
After his release from prison, Danny has to fight to get his respect back from the new breed of street racers now ruling the roads.
The son of a billionaire decides to take an extreme step by leaving behind his riches and swapping his life with a depressed techie look-alike who wants to be a billionaire.
After building an experimental machine, an out of work computer engineer must choose to live in a loveless marriage or risk everything by using a machine to spend time with ghosts from the past.

movie_name: Kamen Rider Zi-O Next Time: Geiz, Majesty
synopsis: In an alternative timeline of 2018, a group of high school students is pursuing their dreams. Sougo Tokiwa wants to become a king, and Keito Myokoin wants to become the judo champion while trying to impress his crush, Alpina Tsukuyomi.
A comedy set in a world where no one has ever lied, until a writer seizes the opportunity for personal gain.
She's depressed and could use a good laugh, he's a comedian without an audience. Together their co-dependency unravels to discover they don't need each other at all - Or do they?
Two teen-aged boys from completely different worlds wake up to discover that time has stopped, except for them.

After two warring aliens crash in a New Zealand town, an American teen enlists the help of a group of Kiwi misfits to decide which of the alien shape-shifters is the galactic policeman and which is the renegade intent on invading Earth.
I'll be there with you' explores the complexities of love in both its brightest and darkest corners as an unusual group of characters face tragic consequences.

Fifteen years ago evil creatures from the underworld plagued the Earth with the intent of eliminating mankind. Dubbed the Day of Reckoning by survivors of the hellish holocaust, warriors of mankind again must battle the forces of darkness.

Purity Archer, daughter of a cult leader, is sent to start a holy-war in metropolis. As she executes those deemed unworthy by her family's values, the death toll piles and she begins to explore her sexuality and questions her beliefs.
A tough criminal is arrested after hiding the loot from a Paris armored truck robbery. A talkative dimwit befriends him in prison and escapes with him - chased by police and his evil crime boss.
A CID Inspector infiltrates a gang of smugglers to uncover their operation but finds that his ex-girlfriend is now a member of the gang.
A prince kidnapped at infancy and his foster brother fight against an evil wizard and a conspiracy in the palace.
A musical movie based on the neverending story book by michael Ende.

After taking a wrong turn, a young man somehow falls into a mysterious cave and becomes hopelessly lost. As he searches for a way out, the journey he experiences forces him to confront the deepest parts of himself.
A conman's crimes are blamed on a good-natured fast-drawing cowboy he meets and decides to use as decoy.
A troubled assassin, who works by orchestrating "accidents", suspects that an accident that happens to his team is not an accident at all.
As a lawyer investigates the murder of a colleague, he finds himself more connected to the crime than anyone else.
Horrific murders which once lived only in a young man's nightmares suddenly begin occurring in chilling reality in his hometown.
A famous artist strives to find the secret to eternal life through the beautiful mannequins he creates.
In 1948, at the U.S. embassy in Zadestan, a young diplomat is ordered to find the missing daughter of an influential U.S. Senator.
A group of military prisoners must fight off a terrorist attack on their prison which, unbeknownst to them, is a cover for a secret drone control facility.

movie_name: Superzan y el niño del espacio
synopsis: En esta historia de Superzan, un joven extraterrestre viene a nuestro planeta para enseñarle a los terrestres como vivir en armonia.

Karo runs away from home because her quarreling parents want to divorce. She travels with her circus friends Victor and Tonie of Circus Noël, who can participate unexpectedly in Cultura Nova, an important circus festival.
A teenager is left invisible to the living after an attack.
Affected by the war and even his own family, a lonely veteran finds solace in a free spirited woman.
The film tells about the life of four sisters which are working on the milk farm and living in one of the Soviet villages in the mid-1970s.
An elderly man, returning to Yugoslavia after 20 years in America, is saddled with the upbringing of his two grandchildren in a small farming village. In HD.
A stark look at one of Hollywood's darkest mysteries, The Black Dalia (Elizabeth Short) Murder.

Ten-year-old Adas, beginning his education at the Academy, finds the hideout of Bird Matt, who used to be a prince. Touched by his fate, he promises to find the magic button which has the power to restore him to human shape.
The story focuses on the issue of ragging carried out by seniors during college life and the after-effects of ragging.
A Gothic thriller and love story.
A series of apparently coincidental events makes Silvia begin to suspect that there was something else behind the death of her ex-husband.

movie_name: How to Defeat Your Own Clone
synopsis: A guy tries to save mankind from a world populated with clones.
Having suffered sexual abuse as a child, Veera grows into a Psycho obsessed with sex and kills for pleasure.

10 years after their fathers' deaths, two teenagers' tragic common bond leads to friendship and adventure. Determined to uncover what really happened to their fathers, Matt and Tarra must take on two officials who know the shocking truth.
Actors audition for a film project, out of which infinite narratives emerge.
To stop an elusive criminal, a maverick detective enlists the aid of a police dog who's an unusually intelligent smart alec.
Driver 113 liked his job for Mappr360 - mapping America's forgotten roads - until his cameras captured something he wasn't meant to see.
A young photojournalist survives the horrors of war only to begin her descent into madness after discovering her father's murderous past while taking care of her dying mother.
A returning war hero who looks like a forger gets mixed up with gangsters and the Secret Service.
3 Friends from the favelas of Rio de Janeiro, find a camera and start making a movie.
A young woman is haunted by visions of a faceless man after she is awoken from the dead in a body that is not her own.
An aspiring writer is hired as a croupier at a casino, where he realizes that his life as a croupier would make a great novel.
Four teenagers are sucked into a magical video game, and the only way they can escape is to work together to finish the game.
Also known as 'The Fabulous Journey to the Centre of the Earth'. Partially dubbed to english, but good cinematography.
The year is 2033, three years prior an infection, a virus, or a bacteriological attack wiped out almost 90% of the global population
A group of catholic students traveling abroad unlock a curse after descending into the catacomb ruins of an old Roman church and awaking it's demons.
Owning an evil purse brings out the psycho twisted personality of Ella. Will the past come home to her or will murder bring her soul peace?
The lady editor of a crime magazine hires Phillip Marlowe to find the wife of her boss. The private detective soon finds himself involved in murder.
A heavy metal band are on tour when their bus breaks down in a remote area. They encounter a God worshiping family who fund their church by selling meat for profit - human meat.

Air pollution has reached critical levels. A lot of time has passed since the disaster. The heroine is engaged in illegal activities, a doctor by profession. She enters the academy, where she tries to get to the truth.
I hate Tommy Finch" is a 2 woman show that follows the friendship/relationship of best friends from the age of 8 to 35.
A waitress, desperate to fulfill her dreams as a restaurant owner, is set on a journey to turn a frog prince back into a human being, but she has to face the same problem after she kisses him.
100 people, who have betrayed The Syndicate, are gathered in a prison opening the next day. They are given weapons and 6 hours to kill each other. The 3 remaining share $10,000,000.
A grieving woman and her son move back to the unoccupied house of her ex husband, recently found dead, but discover they are not alone inside.

movie_name: Lucky Streak and the Crime Fighters
synopsis: Lucky Streak and the Crimefighters battle villains like Dr. Dragon and the huge hammer-wielding muscle-man Goliath to save the planet.
Feature film adaptation of the short film "A Crimson Man" (2017).

The impossible comes to reality, after two years of experimentation. Now comes - THE UNUSUAL - THE FANTASTIC - THE EXTRAORDINARY - THE EXCEPTIONAL - THE EXPLOSIVE - ADVENTRURES OF THE HEADLESS BANDIT.

Marooned by design in a strange asteroid inhabited by bizarre creatures, a left-for-dead astronaut miraculously heads back to Earth with a band of abominable mutant aliens to tie up some loose ends, after twenty long years in oblivion.
LOGLINE: Run A scientist stumbles on a dark secret and is running for her life.

The Clyde Beatty Circus seems jinxed, falling victim again and again to apparent accidents which are actually the acts of a murderous saboteur. Mystery writer Mickey Spillane comes on the scene to solve the case.
An anthology compiled from short horror films involving the internet.
A Hard Look at the current Education System of India and its treatment towards Teachers!
Cali's stuffed animal comes to life and their magical journey together begins.
A hideously ugly witch casts spells on her victims which turns their insides into snakes and worms.
A retired cop's life on his farm is interrupted when a girl show up, on the run from sex-traffickers.
Italian-American New York cop Joe Fortunato lost his father to the mob seven years ago. While his mother and uncle want him to seek revenge, he is unsure if he should break his oath as a policeman.

2038: George Almore is working on a true human-equivalent AI. His latest prototype is almost ready. This sensitive phase is also the riskiest. Especially as he has a goal that must be hidden at all costs.
An intellectually nonconformist friar investigates a series of mysterious deaths in an isolated abbey.
A "National Geographic" film crew is taken hostage by an insane hunter, who forces them along on his quest to capture the world's largest - and deadliest - snake.

Fast-paced and fiery, this action drama delves into the fluctuating fortunes in the life of an undercover operative, under orders to join a college on a mission to catch a terrorist, who has targeted a specific student.
A journey to hell.
A pair of slackers get in way over their heads when they try to dump the body of a dead girlfriend in the basement of a drive-in movie theater where a satanic cult performs ritual sacrifices.
The story of 13 Real deaf children and their heroism, passion and humanity.
A man wanders into a seemingly deserted town with his young son in search of work. But after a bit of bad luck, he joins the town's population of lost souls.
The film is a story which begins after a break up. A romantic thriller it shows the craze of a lover to get back his love and to what extent will he go for it.

After losing his parents, a priest travels to China, where he inherits a mysterious ability that allows him to turn into a dinosaur. At first horrified by this new power, a hooker convinces him to use it to fight crime. And ninjas.
A young priest is sent to Rome to investigate the troubling death of the head of his order.
The story of two immigrants, political prisoners in a penal colony, after a failed attempt to escape they are hired to eliminate three dangerous criminals.
A young man sworn to an oath of non-violence works with his cousins in an ice factory where they mysteriously begin to disappear.
A secluded farm is struck by a strange meteorite which has apocalyptic consequences for the family living there and possibly the world.
Two episodes of the TV series "Wild Bill Hickok" edited together and released as a feature film.
A salaryman, a drug addict and a yakuza go on a breathless three man chase through the streets of Tokyo, each for a different reason and fighting demons.
A U.S. Navy Seal Team is tasked with eliminating a high value target in Afghanistan. What they find, will change their lives forever. Duty. Training. Brotherhood. The Six.
An American girl, sent to the English countryside to stay with relatives, finds love and purpose while fighting for her survival as war envelops the world around her.
Framed for assassinating the Grandmaster, the Lost Ninja Clan must fight their way up an underground nuclear bunker filled with hordes of supernatural enemies, mutants, and flesh-eating zombies.
A cab driver takes in a young woman who claims to be a reluctant bride, and becomes involved in the search for a stolen necklace.
In 35 A.D., a Roman tribune is sent to Palestine to investigate the death and possible resurrection of a certain Jesus from Nasareth.

When a woman, able to read the thoughts of others, comes to help survivors of the 1995 Kobe earthquake, she encounters a girl with Multiple Personality Disorder whose dangerous 13th personality, Isola, must be stopped.

The story of youth. Kakeru, a 15 year old boy, and Mii (Little My) , a female transfer student. They are two lonely teens who cannot find their place in life, but who gradually learn to relate to each other through the power of music.
A crew of astronauts on a multi-generational mission descend into paranoia and madness, not knowing what is real or not.

A famous conductor divides his obsession for music with the sickly love for his muse. A strange love triangle is formed among conductor, wife, and muse; the wife ends up accepting the situation rather than lose her husband.
Gordon Finn is a fugitive on the run. Authorities believe that his lover Ally Henderson is a hostage. Find out who gets away and who takes the fall in this sequel to the award winning original.
Two men, lost in the desert, meet Queen Antinea, ruler of Atlantis.
Two crime syndicates lead by Blackbeard and White Tiger fight over a shipment of heroin. Junior, one of Blackbeard's hitmen is sent to retrieve the stolen heroin.
A young drug dealer watches as his high-rolling life is dismantled in the wake of his cousin's murder, which sees his best friend arrested for the crime.

Set against an iconic late 1940s Los Angeles, Call of the Void is a black and white psychological thriller about an eccentric young man struggling to win back the love of his life from the cop who stole her.
Ray Garrison, a slain soldier, is re-animated with superpowers.
The Thomas family goes out to their cabin in the woods to celebrate Christimas together with their daughter and her boyfriend, but their first Christmas together may be their last.
Mothers, Fathers, Here's a picture you must not fail to see - and learn how to solve the present teen-age problem.
A child is killed in a hit and run. The mother plots her revenge by posing as a maid in the house of the murderer.
After an outbreak of rioting in a small town, a professor and an industrial spy admit to a conspiracy to make a snack food irresistible.
A hitman in Koreatown meets a Karaoke hostess only to find out she is his next target.

movie_name: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Movie
synopsis: When a mysterious stranger arrives from the future with a dire warning, Leo is forced to rise and lead his brothers, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey in a fight to save the world from a terrifying alien species.
With Merlin's aid, Santa Claus must defeat the evil machinations of the devil Pitch to ruin Christmas.
4 college students dig up an ancient Aztec relic in their own backyard, only to discover a dark force that is attached to it.

Bill is a pizza delivery driver who is drugged and shanghaied into the Space Troopers. Bill initially works as a fuse tender but when his ship is struck by enemy fire he finds himself the only remaining soldier capable of firing back.
In 1899, Mandie's life changes when her Cherokee friends help her escape to a mansion that holds the hidden secrets of her past and the key to her future.
During the night of his 18th birthday, Jan-wen commits a random shooting in a crowded night market.
Angel works in an ambulance service. After a tragic accident, his personal life begins to deteriorate as he becomes more and more suspicious of his partner Vane.
Five friends go on a vacation to a cabin in the woods, but find that leaving isn't as simple as just walking away.

Explores a documentary about a radio show that takes calls from people claiming supernatural experiences. Soon a caller claims that as a schoolboy, he encountered a huge-headed infant. Both the TV and radio crews investigate.
The fates of horses, and the people who own and command them, are revealed as Black Beauty narrates the circle of his life.
Young Pinocchio runs away from his genius creator Jepetto accompanied by the horse Tibalt to see the world and joins the traveling circus run by hustler Modjafocco.
A ventriloquist is murdered, leaving a show to be done. So, a midget goes undercover as the dummy. But, he always needs to find the criminal!

Ramar of the Jungle encounters a holy man who warns him of great danger. His friend Professor Howard is near death, cursed by the Mark of Shitan. A sacred golden tablet and a woman ready for sacrifice holds the key to Howard's survival.

Anastasiya, a refugee mother from NY, must find her son while being hunted through the wilds of Scotland. Chasing her are AI-controlled, technologically enhanced humans wanting the key to humanity's salvation, which Anastasiya holding.
The fine line between fact and fiction is blurred as Kiren, a young writer attempts to spin a yarn out of a true story. He soon realises that, sometimes the truth deserves to be left untouched.

Two cousins haven't spoken for almost twenty years, thanks to the enmity that their fathers feel toward one another. But an accident suddenly brings the cousins back together and thrusts them deep into the heart of the mafia.

Vikings bonded by blood defend their homeland and go on a rescue mission, but their bond is ripped apart by the greed for power, a war with the Wends, and the red-faced warriors of a savage new world.
In 1985, during the Iran-Iraq War, 215 passengers were brought to Turkey from Iran in a major operation.
Monica, a witch vampire, has the power to invade with vampires. They can destroy everything that exists on earth. The situation worsens when Monica is working with Cooper, the master of the seas.
A young married couple tell their two children a "once upon a time" story, realizing that belief in a myth can become into reality.
A young alien and a teenage earthling fall in love, and plot to stop the alien's race from using Earth as a food-breeding ground for giant lobsters from their planet.
A naive princess, her beloved cat and a poor mining boy team up to save their kingdom from a nasty underground realm of bad-mannered goblins.
After the kidnapping of his younger brother, a black hat programmer and amateur sleuth discovers that he and his family may be living in a computer simulation.
A monster on a motorcycle is causing unrest among the population, and when the hairy creature manages to get hold of a young girl, panic sets in.

The story follows a young man (Bobby Deol) who flees India and arrives in Australia seeking vengence for something that started in India. In Australia he meets and falls in love with the daughter of a rich and powerful man(Suresh Oberoi). The story keeps the covers on Bobby Deols plan until the end when everything is revealed as to why he is a SOLDIER.

As his kingdom is being threatened by the Turks, young prince Vlad Tepes must become a monster feared by his own people in order to obtain the power needed to protect his own family, and the families of his kingdom.
A London based criminal sets out to eliminate his rivals and any witnesses that get in the way.
Four teenagers kidnap their friend to take him to the very dangerous place where he is the most afraid of to plan his birthday party there.

His friends are there when Olsen is released from prison. He's resocialized. The trio work at a toy factory, then cleaning at Denmark's central bank. When a US gang robs the bank, the trio must clear their names.

Juggling angry Russians, the British Mi5, and an international terrorist, debonair art dealer and part-time rogue Charlie Mortdecai races to recover a stolen painting rumored to contain a code that leads to lost gold.
Two Italian-immigrant couples are part of a game that leads to treason and brings serious consequences to those who lose.
Twelve strangers wake up in a clearing. They don't know where they are, or how they got there. They don't know they've been chosen - for a very specific purpose - The Hunt.

A marketing consultant, who has a psychological sensitivity to corporate symbols, is hired to seek the creators of film clips anonymously posted to the internet - before uncovering a larger conspiracy.
Commissioner Kapoor makes Dadu Kaliya take the place of his lookalike inspector Vinod who was killed by Devi Dutt but how long will he hide the secret of Vinod's death from his family.

On loan to the Tate Gallery in London, Da Vinci's 'Madonna and Child' is stolen and replaced with a fake but the American security expert working for Tate aims to recover the original painting and catch the culprits.
A thriller centered on a man who is accidentally sent one hour backwards in time, only to discover he now has the opportunity to prevent a serious crime.
Aliens equipped with venomous claws invade a small town but the town's teenage population is mobilized to fight the menace.
The Siu family move into a a new flat. There are disturbing signs, for instance the cemetery next door.
Christian kidnaps Hector's son, unleashing a chain of events that will be tragic for everyone involved.

movie_name: The Incredible Adventures of Marco Polo
synopsis: The Incredible Adventures of Marco Polo on His Journeys to the Ends of the Earth
A former boxing champ must fight again to win the prize money to save his daughter. His main opponent is the son of the man he hurt that caused him to retire at his prime.

As summer winds down in the Northern Minnesota town of Beckon, odd events begin happening, and quickly turn sinister. After decades of lying dormant, the Beckon Woods have awoken, and they are determined to add truth to the legend.
A thief pretends to be a cop in order to recover his diamond from a site that has been converted into the police headquarters. Although he becomes a favourite of the ACP, a colleague gets suspicious.
Teenager Earl has a vivid imagination fueled by movies like Frankenstein and Night of the Living Dead (1968).
Bahman and Ahad are bankrupted and escaping from their debts all the time. But when a fire in Plasco building happens it is their chance to take advantages.
Terrorists steal nuclear warheads from the U.S. military but don't count on a pilot and park ranger spoiling their plans.

Everyone's favorite couch potato pets, Bella the cat, Bagel the dog, and Alvin the mouthy parrot break it down yet again from the comfort of their own cushions, with holiday-themed pets, pets, and more pets in Christmas Furballs.
Hunting Souls is the story of an American couple who are dealing with the hardships of caring for their sick child. They discover that they are being hunted by a demon.
In the Oregon wilderness, a real-estate developer's new housing subdivision faces a unique group of protestors: local woodland creatures who don't want their homes disturbed.
The movie is set during the 1984 riots in Punjab.
After thirty years in hiding a notorious Outlaw is discovered by his long time bounty hunters, before his execution he recounts his experiences with crime, loss and love.
Liu Liang-Liang is a little girl born in an Army dependents' community in Taipei City.
A dramatic mystery where a haunted teen endures a terrifying exorcism in the hopes of unlocking shocking secrets about the church and his family.

On a Caribbean cruise, Jenny is marooned on a beach with her rock and roll idol. Deliriously in love with the idea of time alone with him, she manages to hide the fact that they're a stone's throw away from their resort.
A couple wake up one morning to find they have now switched bodies.

Widowed Amrit and Kamala are ill-treated by their respective children and find solace in each other's company. As their bond strengthens, the two decide to separate from their families and spend their lives together.
When there is nothing, there is revenge.
This is an adaptation of Jules Verne's novel Dick Sand, A Captain at Fifteen. The fifteen-year-old sailor Dick Sand have to take command of the ship.

Raised by the same woman, the dark-complexioned, Asmar, and the flaxen-haired, Azur, set out on a quest to a strange and magical land to liberate the enchanting Djinn-fairy; but, only one can save her. Will the brothers be triumphant?

After watching their small business go up in flames, three lifelong friends need money fast. Opportunity knocks when a local drug lord offers them a small fortune to smuggle 25 million dollars worth of Ecstasy from Amsterdam to Barcelona.
Detectives Rita and J.D. investigate the murder on a stripper in Vegas. Ex cop Sam is a suspect that Rita had an affair with.

movie_name: Mobile Suit Gundam 00: A Wakening of the Trailblazer
synopsis: Humanity battles aliens to stop the destruction of Earth and to achieve an everlasting peace.
A young gymnast immigrates from the Iron Curtain of Bulgaria finding liberation to the Land of the Free through an International psychedelic Traveling Circus.
As Bidin tries to convince his Thai girlfriend's family to let him marry her, he also has to settle an issue between him and an old enemy of his.
A man living in a Basque town falls for a woman who is being sexually abused by her father. Tragedy soon follows when he tries to stop the abuse.

A group of privileged students spends a night patrolling the prestigious Dhoultham school that turns into the worst night of their lives as they face off against burglars, supernatural spirits, and a deeper, darker evil.
A look at the creepy world of scary creatures conjured up from the imaginations of children.
The Candyman arrives in New Orleans and sets his sights on a young woman whose family was ruined by the immortal killer years before.
"survival is a matter of interdependence, it's not possible alone..." - Edith Eger, The Choice.

movie_name: Wu shi, hua dan, da liu mang
synopsis: Bruce is an action director at a famous Hong Kong TV station, the lead actress falls in love with him much to the disgust of a Triad big boss, who then hatches a plot to bring the lovers back down to earth.
A young boy attempts to convince a woman that he is her dead husband reborn.
After Tom's and Jack's death, Becky and Jill continue their journey in the zombie apocalypse. Their goal is only to survive, until they see the mysterious signs for a sanctuary.

Stuck in rural Idaho, a soccer-obsessed 13-year-old boy convinced he's going to be an international star, bets the school board he can win a California tournament with a club team of rejects, so his high school will offer the sport.
Under the control of a pill that eradicates human emotion, a young couple skip doses and discover new feelings, but realize that comes with emotional baggage to deal with.
D'Artagnan and his musketeer comrades must thwart the plans of Cardinal Richelieu to usurp King Louis XIII's power.
The third installment of the Power Rangers franchise.
A physically challenged girl fantasizes about walking when a bizarre clown named Mini continues to appear to her on her magic Yamaha motorscooter.
Neel falls in love with a gangster's niece and things go bizarre when he finds himself getting involved with the underworld.
A group of friends out on a trip are trapped by a cannibal family that are trying to make sausages out of them
Rocky, Colt and Tum Tum are back in an all new adventure everyone will fall for.
Marina passes from a dysfunctional family to love with an unsuccessful artist. But he is going blind due to a brain tumor.
A convict is released from state prison and tries to resume his life again.

Detective Hazel Micallef hasn't had much to worry about in the sleepy town of Fort Dundas until a string of gruesome murders in the surrounding countryside brings her face to face with a serial killer driven by a higher calling.
Misunderstandings arise between Akbar and his son Salim when he disapproves his son's love.

Master explorer Dirk Pitt goes on the adventure of a lifetime of seeking out a lost Civil War battleship known as the "Ship of Death" in the deserts of West Africa while helping a WHO doctor being hounded by a ruthless dictator.
A reality show team encounters a group of deranged killer clowns.
A teenage boy must fight in an interplanetary war as the only available pilot to a revolutionary new giant battle robot.
When DEA agents are taken captive by a ruthless South American kingpin, the Delta Force is reunited to rescue them in this sequel to the 1986 film.

The cult of Ubasti, headquartered on the isle of Lemuria, believes that Princess Nadji of Egypt is a reincarnation of their long-dead goddess, Ossana, and intend to sacrifice her so that Ossana may be resurrected.
A spoof of low budget 1950s science-fiction movies, interspersed with various comedy sketches and fake commercials making fun of late-night television.
A future reliant on solar energy falls into chaos after the sun disappears, forcing a reclusive astronomer and his bubbly neighbor out of the city in search of light in the perpetual darkness.
A man offers people who have been wronged an unexpected form of vengeance.

Wizarding criminal Rumburak, exiled to the Mortal Realm, uses a supercomputer to recreate his lost spell formulas. His software falls into the hands of humans, chaos ensues, and Rumburak suddenly finds himself on the side of good.
A rebel leader returns to his city for a final confrontation with the evil king he is fighting. However, he finds himself attracted to the king's beautiful niece.
Rock'n'Roll and bananas has arrived the country, and Egon has found out about sabotage plans about a circus, in order to take it over.
Ethan Hunt and his IMF team, along with some familiar allies, race against time after a mission gone wrong.
A disgraced member of the Russian military police investigates a series of child murders during the Stalin-era Soviet Union.
A pair of literary sleuths unearth the amorous secret of two Victorian poets only to find themselves falling under a passionate spell.
Down-on-his-luck Mike Cormack is hired to fly to a Caribbean island to retrieve a missing ruby. On the island, possibly involved with the ruby's disappearance, is his ex-girlfriend.
A streetwise New York police officer transforms into the world's most unusual superhuman hero.

movie_name: Shin Abashiri Bangaichi: Runin-masaki no ketto
synopsis: After causing problems, Ken Takahara is transferred from Abashiri to the honor factory at Tanigawa Prison. When the local yakuza gang is hired to destroy the factory, Takahara has to take violent action to save it.
A detective whose own son was abducted struggles with weird experiences and missing kids in NW Montana.
Sheriff Buford Pusser continues his one-man war against moonshiners and a ruthless crime syndicate after the murder of his wife in late-1960s Tennessee.
How far may you go to prove your thesis?
Welcome to Monsterland! A terrifying place where savage beasts, carnivorous creatures, and grotesque abominations are the new normal; and the human race is now at the bottom of the food chain.

Using an incredible musical soundtrack composed by Beethoven, Strauss, Chopin and the wonderful Brazilian folk songs that tell stories of animals, Bebê Mais Bichos entertains intelligently.

Describing the life of a man named Nordin who had a problem with low self-esteem or 'inferiority complex' due to his physical form.

Follow up to "Get Claused"

Digest of 3 "Northwest Passage" (1958) 30-minute episodes: 2 by director George Waggner, and the central episode, 'The Break-Out' (first aired 19 October 1958), by Jacques Tourneur.

A great example of this series at its best.
Hero by certain magnificent camouflaged calculations, crushes the chances of Villain who is Sci-Fi species, an alien monster, representing dark energy, to rule over world.

The Flaming Story of a Women Possessed and Obssessed.

Based on 1980's animated series of clumsy detective Gadget.

Arattupuzha Velayudha Panicker, a 19th century fiery social reformer and his unswerving fight against the dominant caste oppressions by the upper classes.

A woman becomes very curious about one of her psychiatrist husband's inmates, a man who was found guilty in the murder and disfigurement of his former wife.

Plot Unknown.

A naval officer inherits an island and helps a girl thwart a doctor's search for diamonds.
Four Indonesian kids with different cultural backgrounds defines the concept of 'unity of diversity' with their own way.

Adaptation of Indian mythology that depicts the triumph of good over evil.
SpongeBob lives above ground like all Hollywood superstars. Afraid that ,SpongeBob is becoming old news.

Four mathematicians are hired by the US government to solve the most powerful problem in computer science history.

A country boy leaves his family's apple farm and heads to the city to become a famous musician.
After starting a job at an eerie hardware store, an anxious young man uncovers a shocking mystery that leads to a fight against terrifying forces that lurk just behind the walls.

Charlie investigates murders connected with insurance fraud. This one is set in San Francisco's Chinatown.

synopsis: A man searches for meaning after losing his girlfriend and job.

synopsis: A black Philadelphia police detective is mistakenly suspected of a local murder while passing through a racially hostile Mississippi town, and after being cleared is reluctantly asked by the police chief to investigate the case.
When an ESL teacher and a Chinese student are framed for murder, they're forced to work together to clear their name.

A "Double Feature" of adventures, fantasy and humor. In "Troubled Rivers," Candolini and Largo must survive in a post-apocalyptic Spain. In "Sandra Munt", an adventuress will try to recover a mysterious book from the hands of the Nazis.
A fun-filled romantic movie in which two strangers from diverse backgrounds meet on a journey from Ooty to Kerala. The journey advances through different circumstances and coming across new people.
Three soldiers descend into the caves beneath their city to find a fabled stone with powers.
After ruining his reputation with the town, a courageous chicken must come to the rescue of his fellow citizens when aliens start an invasion.

The film is search of your own nature, your fears and dreams, accepting your inner features and befriending them like real people. It's about a journey into your depths and the encounter with the Wolf, who will guide you.
The loudest laugh of the season is coming.
About the infamous murder of investment banker Thomas Gilbert Sr., whose death was originally believed to be a suicide until an investigation proved otherwise.
Dr Wilson is well respected person in a small Goan village, soon one of his experiments will turn him into a monster.
Torben is 14 year old teen, whose imagination often gets him in trouble. His father sends him away to a farm during a summer break, and it doesn't take long for him to get in trouble again.
In the 90s, a young reporter investigates. And in this isolated region, a tale is told by the moon. And this story - about a poor melancholy man - plunges the region into turmoil and violence.

movie_name: Macross FB 7: Ore no Uta o Kike!
synopsis: Macross Frontier characters receive vintage VHS tapes delivered by a strange bird with the original Macross 7 episodes and watch them together, discovering the story behind the Sound Force and Nekki Basara.
Exhausting and mind-blowing.

When New York actor Paul Cole is beaten and left for dead in 1950s Ohio, he loses his memory and finds himself stranded in a mysterious small town where he struggles to get back home and reclaim what he's lost.
A sports journalist is assigned to discover the truth behind the mask of "El Angel Enmascarado" (The Masked Angel), a very popular and recently deceased wrestler.

The trials and tribulations of a cab driver working the night shift, who must put with an assortment of crazies, hardcases and sob stories during work and then has to come home to a loud, argumentative, shrewish wife.
Plot under wraps.
Five substance-abusing friends decide to fake a kidnapping in order to bribe a police constable for covering-up a hit-and-run accident.
Two survivors, who appear unwilling to answer questions, are the only links authorities have to a spate of attacks that have hit rural South Africa.
Zahra buys a little chicken and befriend it but when one day by accident it's leg is injured Zahra decides to take care of it and cure it. Her parents disagree with her which makes Zahra very sad.
Trapped in a bunker during World War I, a group of soldiers are faced with an ungodly presence that slowly turns them against each other.
The police commissioner of Hyderabad confronts an anonymous caller who has planted bombs in the city and will let them explode if four terrorists are not freed from the police custody.
It is the Chinese Hungry Ghost Festival and our intrepid documentarian Laurence Lovejoy is eager to report. But things don't go as planned.
A has-been aimless man and a carefree drifter girl run across a military conspiracy to seize the "Space Mind", a mysterious ball.
A young Filipina searches for the missing links between her strange bleeding condition and her faraway mother's healing powers.

An invitation to an isolated mansion leads a young man to a surprise family reunion. As the hours tick on, the weekend spirals into all-consuming paranoia with the temptation of luxury and sexuality intermingling with treachery and taboo.
Feature film based on the Starz TV series,"Magic City."
An uprooted young boy, on a quest to locate his family, finds himself destined to safeguard Santas from a vengeful villain.

A young art student suffers from a lack of confidence and her troubled lecturer struggles with dark visions. Unexpectedly, their fates begin to intertwine on a strange and hazardous journey into the unknown.
A young woman on the run is determined to make the world a better place - even if it kills her.

A brilliant plastic surgeon, haunted by past tragedies, creates a type of synthetic skin that withstands any kind of damage. His guinea pig: a mysterious and volatile woman who holds the key to his obsession.
In Victorian England a bored young girl dreams that she has entered a fantasy world called Wonderland populated by even more fantastic characters.

In a cafe someone has been murdered in the bathroom. An FBI agent Elliott and his best friend Gary discover the murdered victim, and the FBI suspects that a Russian cyber terrorist named Viktor had something to do with the homicide.
A man and his girlfriend plan to rob the mansion of the man's eccentric but wealthy aunt. However, the aunt keeps dozens of cats in her home, and the man is deathly afraid of cats.
They came from a doomed world to save us from the same fate.
At the request of factory owners and union leaders, a tough ex-con infiltrates a gang of loan sharks who are preying on financially desperate factory workers.

Gwen, a musician with a growing paranoia disorder, returns to her hometown after a traumatic event. Diverting their emotional issues with a strange and unholy discovery, she and her friends begin to deteriorate the fabric of the universe.
Police detective Dick Tracy must identify and apprehend a serial killer known as Splitface.

movie_name: Bullitt and the Curse of the Blood Ring
synopsis: In order to stop a Vampire's murderous rampage; Bullitt, a paranormal investigator must find and return the blood ring to its rightful owner before everyone he knows and loves is killed.
Crook Bennett Barton uses pretty Joan Granger as bait to blackmail millionaire John Warren.
Convicts escaping from Devil's Island come under the influence of a strange Christ-like figure (Ian Hunter).

movie_name: Saikyô heiki joshikôsei: Rika - zonbi hantâ vs saikyô zonbi Gurorian
synopsis: Rika never expected to encounter the living dead as she skipped school to visit her grandfather. She is forced to survive and discovers incredible zombie fighting skills.

Tao, a young Navajo herdsman, brought up in the 'old way' in Canyon de Chelly, Arizona, travels 350 miles to Tuscon on horseback to see a girl, Meiying. His trek puts him in conflict with neighboring Apaches, old enemies in a new world.
A cabbie and a businessman, both in need of big money, partake in a two-hour adventure together.

Faith finds her first honest love and the detectives become overwhelmed in a desperate struggle to track down three serial killers, while a shift of events leaves Faith devastated and drives her brother to become her fragile rock.
A scientist in a surrealist society kidnaps children to steal their dreams, hoping that they slow his aging process.
A killer is cleaning up the streets of Milan by murdering those considered as deviant. An ornamental dragonfly, soaked in the blood of the victim, is left on each body.

In the early 1800s, Prussian geographer Alexander Von Humboldt and French botanist Aimé Bonpland launch an expedition to explore the Amazon region, including the Orinoco River, from Venezuela to the border of Portuguese Brazil.

movie_name: El Encanto de la Oscuridad: Parte 1
synopsis: After a terrible incident, Annie Collingwood will lose her boyfriend and to get it back she will have to deliver 3 objects of great value to a strange entity called the illusionist.
A team of skilled criminals meticulously plans and executes a high-stakes heist on a heavily fortified bank facing numerous obstacles and unexpected twists along the way.
A scientist invents a television device called the Iconoscope. Foreign agents hear about it and try to steal it.

David Van Owen moves into a mysterious house and discovers a box buried in his backyard, filled with 3 million dollars and a fresh corpse. David hides the money in the house, only to be stalked by the buried body.
A mild-mannered police detective freshly stationed in tumultuous 1980 Amsterdam enters a race against time when he encounters a violent plot against the Dutch royal family.
A story about love and hatred, about those who cheat and who are cheated, about violence and sex and surprising secrets which we learn within these strange twenty four hours.

movie_name: The Bizarre Murder of Mr Tusker
synopsis: A celebrated author's story about a genetic experiment morphs into reality, when it is read by three strangers. Trapped in a room, the four discover that one of them must be killed to save the rest from an escaped undercover recruit.

Recovered footage documenting a UFO sighting and possible abduction. This found footage film will test even those with the most open-minded beliefs. Is "The Rejected" actual proof of aliens on Earth or is this an elaborate hoax?
A male prison escapee heads for his hidden loot electronically attached to a female prisoner.
A New York psychiatrist finds that a brujería-inspired cult, which believes in child sacrifice, has a keen interest in his own son.

When a troubled queer teenage misfit gets transported into the fantasy world of her beloved tabletop role-playing game, she must slay her inner demons in order to return home to her loving friends and family.
A small shop owner catches a little mutant Octopus and accidentally becomes involved in a conspiracy involving genetic mutation experiments and a giant kaiju Octopus.

Adriana finds out the son she's expecting suffers a brain malformation that won't allow him to live outside her womb. As therapeutic abortion is illegal in Chile, she must wait until her baby is naturally born.

movie_name: Beaster Day: Here Comes Peter Cottonhell
synopsis: A giant bloodthirsty Easter bunny starts viciously killing the local townsfolk. When the Mayor refuses to act and the attacks grow more gruesome, the town finds its very survival in the hands of a wannabe actress and a crazy dog-catcher.

While Arjun doesn't want to get married, his parents set up a blind date for him at his place. The story revolves around Arjun, how he falls for the girl he's about to meet, why and how he changed his decision to get married.
TV's greatest comedy duo, Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz, star in this madcap comedy about a research chemist whose dedicated pursuit of a new pesticide wreaks havoc on his marriage.
After meeting an mysterious girl on an dark stretch of road, a young salesman is invited to a beautiful house with bizarre secrets and no way to escape.
It's the end of the world--at least their world.

A demobilized centurion returns home to Pompeii to find his father murdered by a gang of black-hooded Christian robbers that terrorizes the city and he decides to investigate the matter while the nearby volcano threatens to erupt.

Three young people, tired of the restrictions placed upon them by adult society, run away to a deserted island to live as they see fit. Gangsters are also using the island, however, and the utopia the three had created is soon under attack.
When Miss Jane Marple reports witnessing a murder through the window of a passing train, the police dismiss her as a dotty spinster when no trace of the crime can be found.
A couple travels by accident to the Moon and have to deal with aliens lurking for the earth's destruction.
Stolen diamonds spark a deadly drama involving a group of strangers in the Philippine jungle.

A homeless man is murdered by a group of friends in early 2001. Five of the six friends are imprisoned. One receives probation in place of jail time. Five years later, it seems someone has come to hand down a much harsher sentence.
A Paris model must return to Madrid where her grandmother, who had brought her up, just had a stroke. But spending just a few days with this relative turns into an unexpected nightmare.
Set in a medieval village that is haunted by a werewolf, a young girl falls for an orphaned woodcutter, much to her family's displeasure.
Raised in Light while thrown into Darkness, a child finding its place through time and year, a better tomorrow on mind, while enough going on, a journey set to the Sky And Beyond.
A genetically re-engineered dog develops a psychic link with a monster created in a lab experiment which goes awry.
After We Leave is a sci-fi drama about a man struggling to find his wife, whom he abandoned six years ago, before their visa to immigrate to an off-world colony expires.

In Nazi-occupied Paris, the immoral art dealer, Robert Klein, leads a life of luxury, until a copy of a Jewish newspaper brings him to the attention of the police, linking him with a mysterious doppelgänger. Will Mr Klein clear his name?

Lionel, an ordinary 11-year-old boy, who, through a quirk of heritage, becomes the King of Great Britain. Lionel prepares himself for his new role...but finds the Palace is not what he expected it to be.

The son of a gang member struggles with an internal fight with right and wrong. He must decide whether he wants to end up like his father, a hardened prisoner serving a life sentence, or take a different path in life.

An exploration of how the actions of individual lives impact one another in the past, present and future, as one soul is shaped from a killer into a hero, and an act of kindness ripples across centuries to inspire a revolution.
The story of three young girls trying to stick together as they get trapped in a sea cave filled with crashing waves, hundreds of sea lions, and monstrous elephant seals.

Two Los Angeles detectives are assigned to track down and arrest a brutal rapist-murderer terrorizing the city. Their job is complicated by the fact that the killer is able to avoid capture because he can pose as a woman.
A professor and his daughter, Rekha, are led on a jungle safari by a guide named Shekhar who steals a priceless necklace off of a tribal idol.

A college girl who is plagued by night terrors and visions of a dark figure starts sessions with a psychologist in an attempt to overcome the childhood abuse she believes is behind these troubling experiences.

Lewis Clark is a brilliant author who stumbles upon a world of Magic after the disappearance of his two young children. He begins a quest to try to stop the insidious evil that threatens to destroy both his new world and his old one.
Two young couples in love, Bruno and Isabelle, and Alain and Lio face each other, love each other, hurt each other with passion, violence and pride.

movie_name: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet
synopsis: A ten-year-old scientist secretly leaves his family's ranch in Montana where he lives with his cowboy father and scientist mother, escapes home, and travels across the country aboard a freight train to receive an award at the Smithsonian Institute.

In a not so distant future, countries are recovering from World War III. Civilians from all over migrate to other countries to claim new land. 5 infants are born in one of the towns, that will forever change the course of time.
Triplets Prince - Bebo - Semsem (Ahmed Helmy) are taking advantage of similarities between them and outwitted the people, till meet a psychiatrist crook Suleiman al-Halabi.
Strange things start happening in space that will change life on earth forever.
A Victorian scientist tests a serum that transforms him into a sensuous murderess.
A group of friends venture deep into the streets of New York on a rescue mission during a rampaging monster attack.
Three college drop outs are recruited by an eccentric inventor in order to capture a horde of mischievous monsters he accidentally released from a parallel world.

After taking an innocent life, a hit-man's night takes a dangerous turn, facing violence and the supernatural. His only chance at redemption rests in the ghosts of a troubled young woman and a sadistic psychopath.
A police officer impersonates his murdered twin brother in order to bring his killers to justice.
A pious nurse becomes dangerously obsessed with saving the soul of her dying patient.
Newspaper reporters compete with London police to solve a murder.
A Chicago playwright uses self-hypnosis to travel back in time and meet the actress whose vintage portrait hangs in a grand hotel.

A land surveyor is sent to work on Romney Marsh, where her predecessor went missing months before. The new surveyor's strange experiences may either hold the key to the mystery, or simply deepen the frontier marshland's enigmas.
A movie maker experiences in real life the similar events he made a movie about.

A 26 year old girl life changes by the sudden death of her entire family. During which she started hallucinating about a 10 year old girl, But once what was only hallucinations ,came to be a much bigger part of her life.
Plot is being kept under wraps. In the vein and tone of "Training Day".
Indrajith heads to the forests of north eastern India in search of a precious stone.
FLUXX is mind-bending psychological thriller, about a Hollywood actress who is intent on finding her famous missing husband, despite the fact that she cannot willingly leave her Malibu home.

Felix has shrunk the hated school principal, Dr. Schmitt, to a height of six inches. Together with his friend Ella, Felix must get the principal back to her normal size while his rival Mario tries to stop him.
After the funeral of one of their own, a criminal family decides to embark on an emotionally unnerving journey in an attempt to exact bloody revenge.
Four local boys borrow a lot of money from the local mafia. Incompedent as they are, they loose the money. They have to think of infinite ways to earn and return the amount. In seven days...
An abused orphan sinks into a life of crime.
With the help of the police and a psychic, a husband attempts to try and locate his missing wife.
Smuggling Chinese into the United States from Mexico in car loads, with no regard for human life, smugglers resort to any means to accomplish their selfish ends
After being sentenced to a mental institution at 10 years old, Harlan Hatcher escapes 35 years later with revenge on his mind.
Story about the happy events of two village boys and their Soviet friend.

When four teenagers crash during a really bad thunderstorm they wake up on a yellow brick road in the middle of the woods. When they find out their not in Kansas anymore they find out the dark side of the wizard of oz.
A popular tenor finds himself broke and in a heap of trouble when who loses his voice through the machinations of his doctor and his secretary.
A small-town Southern beauty queen tries to skip town with stolen diamonds.
An evolved assassin helps a girl look for her missing brother in a post-apocalyptic world.
A girl is staying with her grandparents for the summer, where she meets a horse called Mississippi. Trouble begins when Mississippi is about to be sold, a fight for Mississippi begins.
The romantic and professional trials of Mary Henry - a cog in the machine of a London based crime syndicate, presided over by sinister pragmatist The Mademoiselle.
A family film about a teen who creates, with a group of other misfits and outcasts, a rogue hockey team in order to play against the high school team that cut him.
The story of Zagor taking revenge one by one from 4 men who oppressed his family.
An orphaned dinosaur raised by lemurs joins an arduous trek to a sanctuary after a meteorite shower destroys his family home.
Four soldiers and a beautiful Greek nurse, thrown together in North Africa during World War II, team up to pull off a heist of two-million pounds in boxes marked "plasma."
A convicted man embarks on a journey of violence and redemption to find out the truth about his sister's death.
After surviving a car wreck virtually unscathed, a young model compels her best friend to impregnate her at the salt flats in Utah.
A scientist must save the world after gravity has been mysteriously erased from the earth's atmosphere.
Betrayal and vengeance come crashing down when Frost is accidentally plunged into a secret organization. All within a game called: Rust.
A spiteful executive obstructs the efforts of a businessman, a filmmaker and his girlfriend by organizing shows in the country.

After a major bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists debate whether to save a suspected terrorist's life. However, assassins have infiltrated the building, and soon the scientists find themselves with time, and options, running out.
Two amateur pickpockets work together only to learn there's no such thing as easy money.
A series of animated shorts inspired by the 1981 cult-favorite film.
Two rival bounty hunters must team together to take down an old foe.
A washed up twenty something year old, who was once the hometown hero and track star, is convinced by a local sweetheart to run a marathon and get his life back on track.
A gang member back-stabs an entire team which pulls off successfully an ambitious heist done with all precautions. What is his motive and is it justified?

A sleeping pill thrusts Josh from his current banal existence to one that he had lost years earlier. As the walls of his own psychosis slowly start to close in around him, Josh must race to save the love he once had.
A mercenary is hired to protect an expedition group while they search for a Tangka, a Buddhist artifact worth millions of dollars.

movie_name: The Strange Case of the Man and the Beast
synopsis: Dr. Henry Jekyll experiments with scientific means of revealing the hidden, dark side of man and releases a murderer from within himself.

An independent TV reporter and her cameraman interview a man in regards to a serial killer the man knew by the name of Cyrus. The man traces back through the story of the serial killer and why he became the monster he is.
Struggling to survive with her father after the collapse of Earth's ecosystem, 13-year-old Vesper must use her wits, strength and bio-hacking abilities to fight for the future.
Four card players. Three $5 million dollar winners. One death sentence.
An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.
A young woman is kidnapped and sold to a villager in the mountains.
Red and Blue journey around the world to find The Great Sword of Destiny. Blue discovers that Red was never his friend at all, now they are enemies and are in worst situations imaginable.
A dreamlike journey of Youssef, 30 years old sick with the amnesia. A girl lead him in front of the " House of the light" , that recalls something in him. He researches the missing piece of memory.
When a premedical student is kidnapped in the Middle East and taken to Gaza to provide medical care for war-torn Hamas Soldiers, she's forced to find her way out.

movie_name: Xuxa and the Mystery of the Little Ugly Princess
synopsis: Princess Ugliness mysteriously disappeared. Because her story is not well known to children, she risks being forgotten forever. But to prevent this from happening, all enchanted princesses come together to save the little princess.
The leader of a biker gang tries to save his kidnapped friend from a powerful supernatural experiment.
A young nurse and three friends drive out to a remote warehouse identical to the one in her dreams, only to become caught up in a firefight between crashed aliens and an American military unit.
Diego is a doctor who is immune to the pain of others, but after being shot his reality changes.
Phil makes top 10 pop lists at work. His only "friend" is cellphone Siri. His new phone includes AI helper Jexi, who improves/controls his social life.

Koji Himuro is a make-out artist with unparalleled gambling skills. Shortly after his return to Tokyo, he is invited to attend a reception that is actually an undercover gambling operation run by an international gambling syndicate.
Workers employed at a French vineyard quietly follow old pagan rituals that call for the life of the marquis owner to save his crops during dry seasons.
The story of ordinary men during WWII as seen from three different points of View.

movie_name: Black Widow: Forever Red Part 1 and 2
synopsis: Black Widow is now a wanted criminal; with the help of Jessica Jones and Daredevil, they have to stop Taskmaster, an enemy who changed her life forever.

Mumble's son, Erik, is struggling to realize his talents in the Emperor Penguin world. Meanwhile, Mumble and his family and friends discover a new threat their home -- one that will take everyone working together to save them.
After learning about the dangers of time travel, a young scientist gets caught up in a dangerous mission to prevent it from ever being invented.
A fast-talking lawyer transforms his body and takes a vow of silence, not to be broken until he finds out who killed his wife and daughter and has his revenge.

Ivy is a serial killer who has evaded capture for 1 year, but Detective Trent stumbles upon 2 deaths, on the anniversary of the first confirmed Ivy murder, which will raise questions about what he thought he knew.
Ploddy the Police Car stumbles on environmental criminals threatening rare animals when he is to meet the Crown princess.
A not-too-bright cop searches for a serial bomber.
Scientists poison the water supply of a small town, turning the residents into homicidal maniacs who kill each other and anybody who passes through.
Feature film based on Tad Williams' futuristic stories of a group of renegades in a digital landscape.
Women have been victims of all types of violence. Now its time to take back their lives and put the cops to shame as they deal with crime on the streets their own way.
Balian of Ibelin travels to Jerusalem during the Crusades of the 12th century, and there he finds himself as the defender of the city and its people.
A young CIA agent is tasked with looking after a fugitive in a safe house. But when the safe house is attacked, he finds himself on the run with his charge.
The story of a gold smith who is so obsessed with his own craft that he murders his customers.

movie_name: The Grotesque World of Jimmy the Bean
synopsis: We spend our whole lives working for something, and the we die, it just ends, it's over.

Two sisters in their early thirties find themselves isolated in the Aegean summer cottage of their childhood, as they must deal with their uneasy sibling relationship and confront their devastating recent past past.

After the 'Greenwood Storytellers Festival and Bog-In' wraps, the storytellers meet at the farm of the event host for a night of drinking, smoking, and swapping their most treasured and darkest tales from the swamp.
A character study of a group of petty thieves who seem to have no specific direction or place in life.
An eccentric, unconventional woman whose naive aspirations to rise from her job as a security guard to full-fledged private eye lead her into a tangled PL: mess.
While Brandon and Julie are on a vacation, she goes missing. Local Deputy comes to their aid, but the matter is complicated by a brutal family murder.
Story follows life of a finnish marshal Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim.
A group of ghost hunters employed by the greatest supernatural crime fighting agency, The Corporation, go back to work to save the world from the evil Zero Group.

movie_name: The Sorrowful Song of the Sea
synopsis: This is a melodrama about the tragedy of two generations of father and son against the backdrop of Mount Hallasan on Jeju Island.
The Strange Events of the Life of Birdie.
The housekeeper, secretly in love with her master, guards a deep secret and does everything in her power to keep him to herself.
A group of teens are stalked and killed by a Shaman at a cursed camping site.
A private investigator is hired to find a missing dame and ends up finding a tangled conspiracy of lies, greed and murder.
A pair of art thieves go to Europe to track down a missing Leonardo da Vinci painting.
The Autobots must stop a colossal planet consuming robot who goes after the Autobot Matrix of Leadership. At the same time, they must defend themselves against an all-out attack from the Decepticons.
Two films that are spin-offs from the popular sixties Japanese TV show "The Guardsmen," about undercover security forces against organized crime.
An elite group of soldiers investigates the mysterious happenings on a remote island, only to discover vicious creatures who appear to be eerily too human.

Isabel is a feature romance/drama about a broken family. An ex-husband who's been unable to move on after his wife left him, a father who's lost touch with his daughter, a man who has one last chance to redeem himself.
Feature film based on the animated series, "Captain Planet", in which a superhero teams up with young environmentalists around the world to protect the planet.
Three teenagers leave Los Angeles and drive north to Alaska, wind up robbing a pipeline and taking one of the employees hostage.
Fred and Ethel Burns are taunted by an unwanted visitor on Halloween night while watching a cheap horror flick about the paranormal on an old TV. From a true ghost story.
A 20 year-old wimp that was raised in the U.S. will go on a journey in the Philippines after his Father died to search his mother only to discover a curse and evil forces destroying the town.

Every six years, an ancient order of jiu-jitsu fighters joins forces to battle a vicious race of alien invaders. But when a celebrated war hero goes down in defeat, the fate of the planet and mankind hangs in the balance.

Tung Yen goes into jail for her boyfriend, Walkie Pi, after they kill a gang boss together. On the other hand, Walkie Pi escapes to Holland. When Tung Yen gets out, she hooks up with club owner, Playboy Man, and runs the girls at his club.

A young filmmaker, John, finds himself in a very dark place after losing his eyes in a bizarre event. Suffering from brain damage, blindness, and psychosis, he struggles to find answers in an ever changing reality.
Plot under wraps. Adaptation of the Ubisoft game.
IN THIS SEQUEL, ZUMA, THE SERPENT-MAN-MONSTER COMES BACK WITH A VENGEANCE AND THIS TIME HE IS WITH HIS SON WHO IS JUST AS VICIOUS.
Journalist Naresh is hired to probe illegal activities on an island. When he's captured, a fellow prisoner gives him a ring with magic powers.

movie_name: Chuck Lawson and the Night of the Invaders
synopsis: In 2061, two ex agents and ex lovers reunite for one last mission: aliens landing on Earth. Haunted by a dark past, Chuck Lawson and Serena Fox are on it, discovering tech billionaire Dr. Tyrimpson is working on more than just computers.
A young crook meets a lady in the same business as himself, and finds she is more than a match for him.

movie_name: The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie
synopsis: An eccentric Scottish schoolteacher's extravagantly romantic ideas about life--and love--overly impress her young pupils and bring her into conflict with her school's conservative headmistress.
Three young musicians think they have luck on their side when they score the keys to a beautiful villa outside of Rome for the weekend. Unfortunately, they soon discover that they are not alone.
Conflicts between power-hungry triad gangsters in Macao leads to bloody battles.

Utena Tenjou disguises herself as a boy for the Ohtori Academy, however she encounters trouble due to a ring which shows she's skilled duelist. As well as this, the vice president of the school challenges her to a duel
A family moves into a secluded cabin only to be terrorized by a mysterious creature.
Sarah is a young woman with the gift of seeing and hearing things before they happen. As a child, she sees her father's death before it happens.
After nuclear warfare has decimated Earth, tyrants using service robots to enslave the population are met with a rebellion.
Gianni is a young criminal who is indebted to the nasty gang boss "Er Tajola". He must find a bunch of money by evening and he'll dive into absurd and dangerous situations.
A sci-fi comedy about the afterlife. Because we all know what happens after death.
A mobster's wife hates her lifestyle, but gets a chance to change it when her husband is killed - if the Long Island mob and the FBI let her.
Two cops and a news reporter find themselves caught in an elaborate game set up by an influential psychotic serial killing cult leader named "Father Paranoia".

Cosmos is a bus driver traveling to Spain. After the bus breaks down at a rest area. Passengers are picked up by another bus, but Cosmos is left alone with his coach. He has no light, no water, and no food.
Loise and Soyan embark upon an intense but dangerous romance. After being in a virtual world, will Soyan and Loise risk everything for true love?
After being dead and buried for years, Judas Gains, now a walking corpse and still very dangerous, returns from beyond the grave and immediately returns to Philadelphia to cause havoc.
When a horror obsessed teenager learns that her next door neighbours are vampires, no one will believe her.
Youth on the streets find not just the city but the planet must be reclaimed from a dark force in this eco urban fantasy.
Casey Wilde, a highly-trained professional thief, has left the crime life behind but is forced into doing one last job to save her father's life.

movie_name: Once a Year on Blackpool Sands
synopsis: A gritty Northern LGBTQ comedy drama. Blackpool 1953. Two young gay Yorkshire miners, Eddy and Tommy, on their annual holiday there, meet transvestite James Elbridge who is summoning up the courage to do the fabled walk from pier to pier.
Widowed, alcoholic cop teams up with an old private detective to catch a laughing serial killer who rides Harleys.
A group of lifelong best friends go to a remote cottage on Halloween Night.
Set in the years 2012 and 2018 in the Denver Music scene. A group of four friends meet up to talk their favorite dead musicians.

A character driven crime drama about what happens when an idealistic but guilt ridden detective helps a family take revenge on the man who murdered their daughter, exploring what happens when we cross that line can never be uncrossed.
A stubborn emperor plans to wage war against another who had humiliated him and his daughter.
While staying at a remote cabin for a week-long vacation, a group of five college friends succumb to an infectious, flesh-eating disease.
Ngozi and Kuji are mother and daughter, fun loving, carefree, artistic, inseparable, except when the insidious pressures of life weigh too heavily.
A sister and brother, the last heirs of a family of acrobats, are called upon by a Buddhist monk sect to retrieve an artifact that their ancestors have protected throughout the ages.

A young sailor saves a woman from drowning. The woman turns out to be a rich heiress; unfortunately for the sailor, she was only pretending to be drowning so that another young man she had her eye on would save her.

A girl teaches a cheeky collegian a lesson. In retaliation he decides to avenge himself. He endears himself to her family and extracts a promise to marry to her. However, he's in love with her sister.
Horrid Henry finds himself doing things he never ever thought he'd do, and then some.
Two car racing champions, an American and a German, face off on the world's hardest endurance course: Le Mans in France.

UK black-ops agent is sent to Argentina to find a kidnapped special-ops analyst and take out the terrorists who took him. When a pretty girl who might somehow be involved catches his eye, things get very complicated very quickly.

This is an edited version of the 1935 serial "The New Adventures of Tarzan."

A girl from a troubled family befriends two younger girls and begins to feel a sense of normalcy as they go adventuring at the seaside.

Shiro is an outlaw man who suffers from depression, his lover betrays him and everything heads down for ruin. After going through disastrous incidents that fell upon him like series of nightmares, he finds his true love.
The fugitive, the singer, and the song that brought them together: "Somewhere."
A recently released ex-con gets involved in a fake kidnapping scheme that turns very real.

Follows a writer seeking peace and solitude in the countryside to recover from tragedy and finish her book. However, as the welcoming country house turns into hell, she soon realizes that her inner demons are not the worst of her problems.
A magician attempts to use the power of the Millennium Comet to awaken the legendary Pokémon Groudon.
When a death row prisoner tells him he wouldn't have led a life of crime if only he had had one friend as a child, Father Edward Flanagan decides to start a home for young boys.

synopsis: As an asteroid nears Earth, a man finds himself alone after his wife leaves in a panic. He decides to take a road trip to reunite with his high school sweetheart. Accompanying him is a neighbor who inadvertently puts a wrench in his plan.

The story of Soviet cypher-clerk Igor Gouzenko who was posted to the Soviet Embassy in Ottawa,Canada in 1943 and defected in 1945 to reveal the extent of Soviet espionage activities directed against Canada.
A young woman attempts to escape her past by emigrating to the moon colony of Ganymede only to have her past catch up with her

The story surrounding the marriage of three high school girlfriends who are about to wed their rich boyfriends.

movie_name: Detective Conan: The Bride of Halloween
synopsis: During the wedding of Takagi and Sato, an assailant breaks and tries to attack Sato. But Takagi protects her while getting injured. The attacker escapes, but the situation is settled, although Sato is rightfully rattled by it all.

A valiant knight sets out on a perilous journey to rescue a captive princess from the clutches of a fearsome dragon testing his bravery and skill in a battle of wits and strength.

A veteran small-town police captain works to find a serial killer while experiencing marital problems, that bring past traumas. His structured world begins to collapse when his wife becomes a victim, and he is taken off the case.
A brain surgeon marries a femme fatale, causing his life to turn upside down. Things go more awry when he falls in love with a talking brain.

After inventing a drug that induces time-compressed virtual realities, young Ren grapples with partner Sam over how to use their powerful creation.
Centers on several alter egos within a dark landscape in a time not too far from our own.

Two reckless vloggers break into an abandoned insane asylum.

movie_name: Untitled Dragon Ball & Animes Mix Movie
synopsis: Sokuriel, a young new fighter unconscious of his alien origins, joins Goku Jr and Boruto to save the universes of all anime against his claimed brother.

The murder of a wealthy countess triggers a chain reaction of brutal killings in the surrounding bay area, as several unscrupulous characters try to seize her large estate.

A mysterious man arrives at the offices of an FBI agent and recounts his childhood: how his religious fanatic father received visions telling him to destroy people who were in fact "demons."
