Police procedural film about a police captain assigned to take over a demoralized police precinct and turn it around by solving all the unsolved cases as well as some new tough ones.
An officer of the 'Homicide Intervention Team' who frequently suffers from having his panic attacks does everything in his power to rescue a woman who went missing.
With a film festival deadline quickly approaching, two aspiring filmmakers attempt to pitch quality ideas to each other.

A boy obsessed with '50s sci-fi movies about aliens has a recurring dream about a blueprint of some kind, which he draws for his inventor friend. With the help of a third kid, they follow it and build themselves a spaceship. Now what?

Scientists attempt to send a historian back in time to Shakespeare's time, but instead bring him forward in time to present-day New York City. Will they find him and send him back to his own time or his works will disappear from history?

Two estranged half-brothers adventure together through Colombia to fulfill their dead father's will and connect with their family, their father's homeland, and - ultimately - each other.

Two North Carolina teens, Landon Carter and Jamie Sullivan, are thrown together after Landon gets into trouble and is sentenced to perform community service.
Crazy things happen after a release of something hidden.

Stay at home supermom of three re-enters the workforce, only to find herself in a suburban dystopia when she gets falsely accused of a crime by her own daughter.

movie_name: Roblox Five Nights at Freddy's: The Movie

Two mob money couriers, Frankie and Tony, have their latest package of $1 million stolen by two con women, Dana and Marcia, in which the men must find the women to recover the money before they become marked men.
Students encounter a haunted shark tooth.
Vampiro Nicolau procura através dos séculos: Nina, seu grande amor.
Terror grips West Chester University as a student undergoes a grotesque transformation into a werewolf.

Dark Matter, an alien organization, has been freed from captivity and comes to earth, and can only be stopped by Sun, who transforms into Fujiyama Ichiban, a hero that dons solar powered armor.

Sisters from the planet Vulkaria teleport themselves to Earth to investigate and report back in order to prove to their mother, the planet's ruler, that they are worth of becoming Queen.
Two newlyweds move to the outskirts of Yaktusk, unaware that they are not alone.
An alien ship crash lands onto a Russian city, many who saw it and the occupants start to question their own existence, while there are those who demand the aliens leave Earth.
You shall not commit adultery. Also known as Sins of Love.

A family moves into an old house. They start getting harassed by a gang, who eventually invade the house while the parents are away and start terrorizing the kids, but they didn't account for the deadly supernatural presence in the house.

Bundle of gaiety, Brawling action, Slashing fun,

Good old fashioned daft fun with the croc from Sompote Sands' classic Crocodile chowing down on Thai villagers and letting small children jump down his throat.

movie_name: Night of the Living Dead: Darkest Dawn
synopsis: A group of survivors trapped in a New York apartment fight to stay alive against legions of zombies.

Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to North London to help a single mother raising four children alone in a house plagued by a supernatural spirit.
Private eye Harry Wills investigates the theft of secret documents by a professional gang of thieves.

An original take on the legend of Atlantis, as seen through the eyes of a young woman who washes ashore in a Greek village, two weeks after Atlantis is disappeared.

The heartwarming tale of four lively Hamsters on a quest to find the Palace of Zhu, where they believe all their dreams will come true. They soon find themselves swept away to the other side of the Zhuniverse.

Three friends attempt to make a horror movie together, and complications arise when they find themselves within a horror movie.

It's 1985 and adventurer, Jonathan Danger, has crash landed onto an island in search of a temple that contains his ticket to travel back in time but he must reach it before the Soviets get their hands on the time machine and alter history.
Sometime in the near future, a renegade team of international truckers fight to haul the remaining supply of Earths fossil fuels.
Writer/Director Ryan Konig presents Andrew Vinogradsky as the legendary "Dark Knight" in an original take on the Batman mythology.

When an unconfident young woman is cursed with an old body by a spiteful witch, her only chance of breaking the spell lies with a self-indulgent yet insecure young wizard and his companions in his legged, walking castle.

In This Campy Christmas Slasher After Jack Frost (Played By Caleb Robbins) Is Kicked Out Of the North Pole By Santa Claus (Played By Layden Duncan) He Plots his Revenge Before Finally attacking, Trying To Steal Christmas For His Own.

movie_name: Star Wars: Episode VI - Return of the Jedi
synopsis: After rescuing Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt, the Rebels attempt to destroy the second Death Star, while Luke struggles to help Darth Vader back from the dark side.
The eight remaining survivors of a secret research facility barricade themselves away from a horde of ancient and deadly creatures.
An ex-convict trying to aid his brother must help him survive the night trapped inside a warehouse while danger looms both inside and out.

Two siblings begin to develop special talents after they find a mysterious box of toys. Soon the kids, their parents, and even their teacher are drawn into a strange new world and find a task ahead of them that is far more important than any of them could imagine!
A platoon of American and Finnish soldiers is driven deep into a Russian forest where its Captain discovers a terrifying secret.

movie_name: Dragon Hill. La colina del dragón
synopsis: Dragon Hill is a marvelous world where all dragons live and people from other times and places arrive from different reasons.
Upon the sudden death of his mother, a struggling young writer reluctantly returns home to care for his estranged, Alzheimer's-stricken father, an experience that transforms his life.
A hit man on the run and a woman with a secret try to evade teams of assassins headed by the lethal and relentless Mr. Gray.
A financial executive who can't stop his career downspiral is invited into his daughter's imaginary world, where solutions to his problems await.
When she's gone to Toulouse, Dolores has just left at home some Bristol papers

A young girl finds herself in a reform school after therapy since she was blamed for the death of a young boy. At the school she finds herself drawn to a fellow student, unaware that he is an angel, and has loved her for thousands of years.
An unexpected romance blooms after the the youngest daughter of a merchant who has fallen on hard times offers herself to the mysterious beast to which her father has become indebted.

In Paris, a demented surgeon's obsession with a British actress leads him to secretly replace her concert pianist husband's mangled hands with those of a guillotined murderer with a gift for knife-throwing.
An upper-class Manhattan divorcee comes to believe that her brother is possessed by the spirit of a serial killer who beheaded young women in Spanish Harlem.

Karla met Jonas during a summer vacation at the lake. After being unable to stop thinking about him and their kiss she phones him, making up a school assignment about children living in an orphanage, which is precisely where Jonas lives.
A father starts a motorcycle trip with his recently reunited son.
After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic incident involving a patient, a psychiatrist becomes increasingly convinced she is being threatened by an uncanny entity.
The film genre fiction is inspired by character fairy-tale NeZha.

During the reign of the Vikings, Kainan, a man from a far-off world, crash lands on Earth, bringing with him an alien predator known as the Moorwen. Though both man and monster are seeking revenge for violence committed against them, Kainan leads the alliance to kill the Moorwen by fusing his advanced technology with the Viking's Iron Age weaponry.
A well-intentioned novice priest tries to stay out of two older clerics' criminal scheme. Until money and a girl come into play.
An ocean liner is found at sea with everyone on board dead. An investigation is begun to find out what happened.

In New York's crime underworld, three hitmen for hire - Judo Green, Carl Murdock, and Johnny Devaney - are all assigned the same 'Mark.' Circumstances change when the crime bosses they're working for assign them to kill each other.
Washed up, has been, current B-list actors unite to save their failed careers.
A journey to hell.

Quirky kids led by shy detective AJ (12) an entrepreneur-at-heart find an abandoned cemetery and dug up grave. Who was Rose Lightener and where's her body? Follow the quick, scary-often-funny adventures of a girl who wants out of the dark.

After her son is fatally poisoned from tainted black market food, a woman falls deeply in love with the suave businessman who is secretly responsible for trafficking the poisoned food that killed her child.

Today is the Spy Ninjas Apocalypse. The evil PZ Leader will attempt to erase all existence of the Spy Ninjas; their merch, their books, their gadgets in stores, and their lives - They are not going down without a fight.
A small town is terrorized by "The Banana Killer", which turns out to be the missing link between man and ape.

When a family emergency brings Chef Sam Briggs back to her hometown, she has a chance encounter with her childhood sweetheart, Dr. Alicia Riviera. Will the connection rekindle old flames or remind them why things ended?

movie_name: Meitantei Conan: Seiki matsu no majutsushi
synopsis: Kaito Kid plotted to steal a rare Jeweled Easter Egg. Conan(together with his friends) is eager to stop the thief and uncover the mysteries surrounding the Jeweled Egg and the family who owns it.

An elderly couple lives in an abandoned farm. Every night they receive a visit from a young man who comes join them. The past comes to light when the memories of the couple seems to arise from dreams and nightmares.
A young vigilante finds love with a femme fatale, while being pursued by a serial killer task force.

movie_name: Zhu Zhu Xia: Jiong Jiong Wei Ji
synopsis: G.G. Bond and his friends have to use environmental protection to save the Fairy Tale planet. Their planet is actually an egg, and the greenhouse gasses from pollution are about to let it hatch. If the eggshell breaks, everyone will die.

Philandering actor Richard Hardell is murdered at a movie studio. His jealous wife Blanche, his director Rupert Borka, and a girl he mistreated, Helen MacDonald, all have substantial reasons for having wanted him dead.
An out-of-favor Scotland Yard inspector (Edmund Lowe) hunts a killer diamond fence--The Squeaker (Sebastian Shaw).

On the day of his mother's funeral, a homicide detective accidentally commits murder. When he gets a call from a mysterious man who claims to have witnessed the event, he must go to extreme lengths to cover up his crime.

Join the battle as Alex and Buck Canon fight their nemesis Malachi as he is back to take over earth. One year later and new evil in the world the brothers must once again use their skills to bring down Hell to save the world.
On a night before big competition, an ambitious and eager runner unpredictably snags with his peers and long-life sympathy.
A chimeric future on After Blue, a planet from another galaxy, a virgin planet where only women can survive in the midst of harmless flora and fauna. The story is of a punitive expedition.

Jack and William work for a secret government agency that keeps an eye on the foreign diplomatic community. When a foreign diplomat turns out to be a sexually deviant serial killer, it's up to Jack and William to bring him down.
A dangerous contract killer arrives in London to hunt down a weapons engineer, but discovers the deeper truth behind his mission.

Athens 1967. The political assassinations and the background between the government and foreign powers, on the occasion of the "Polk Case", where an innocent leftist was convicted for the murder of an American journalist in Greece.
A young couple, composed by a cheating wife and a retired car racer, arrive at a drive-in. A man with a gun arrives at the restaurant and takes hostages.
A sequel to the the classic film, "Casablanca" in which Ilsa and Victor Laszlo look for their old friend, Rick, an American expatriate who helped them flee war-torn Europe via Morrocco.

Set in the late 1940s, 'Three Knocks and a Ring' is a classic crime-Noir throwback. The story revolves around Connor Dolan (Nicholas Nazario) an Irish bare-knuckle boxer who gains fame, as well as enemies on his way to the top.
After a confrontation with an unstable man at an intersection, a woman becomes the target of his rage.

When reserved and lonely teenager Fenix (Chase Hudson) meets popular high school girl Scarlett (Sydney Sweeney), the two form a bond that shapes the rest of his life. A musical drama featuring the music of Machine Gun Kelly.

A dark night in war time, with several black-outs, it's just a night for murder. Susan Cooper, a fast-talking girl reporter, doubles as amateur sleuth solving yet another mystery among Hollywood's famous.
In 'Origins: Project Aliens', aliens from the depths of Outer space invades earth and the people have to stop them before Human Kind is wiped out.
Convicted felon, Nikita, isn't going to jail; she's given a new identity and trained, stylishly, as a top secret spy/assassin.
In a violent, futuristic city where the police have the authority to act as judge, jury and executioner, a cop teams with a trainee to take down a gang that deals the reality-altering drug, SLO-MO.
An anemic alien comes to Earth from a dying planet, in the remake of the Corman 50s classic.

A monkey trainer whose act goes wrong after an alien crash lands on Earth and injures his monkey. Desperate to perform the act, he attempts to train the alien instead, but is punished after the alien regains his powers.
The final part of Stockholm criminal world trilogy tells about the final struggles that await everyone to get out of their sins.
After the death of his father, a young field hockey trainer must take care of his eight year-old sister, whom he has never met before.
Tough Finnish detective Jussi Vares gets hired by a friend at a newspaper to investigate a 15 year old mystery regarding the disappearance of 3 girls.

Helinä is tired of her monotonous life revolving around her young children, while her husband is away on business. At the hair salon she meets other frustrated housewives. Together the find an attractive solution to the problem.
A group of fascists plan to finance their work by pulling off a bank robbery.
Hundreds of dinosaurs created by a biotech firm escape into Los Angeles, and wreak havoc on the city.

An ancient order of shape-shifting Gargoyles dating back to the 7th Century in Europe have been hunted to the brink of extinction by a Trinity of Warrior Priests. Today they reemerge in Asia to take their revenge.
In a world and in a time not so faraway lived a little girl who had the feeling to be invisible in her parents eyes. To be sure, she decided to disappear.

Ben fights to survive after his navigational error sends the Theseus into a dangerous spatial anomaly- a nebula unlike any ever encountered, causing everyone but the criminals to become mindless maniacs.
A beauty company run by Aliens abducts and harvest young women for life extension.
An 11 year old boy, an age old legend, a life long friendship.
A troubled girl befriends the daughter of the man responsible of her parents death to get revenge.

A nameless 'noir' detective, still mourning the loss of his wife, investigates a mysterious death in a Buddhist temple, but his logical, left-brained crime-solving skills are useless in the intuitive, non-linear world of Zen.
A group of men, heading to a remote village to help one of their friends get over his divorce, soon discover that all the women have been infected with a virus that makes them man-hating cannibals.
A king faces deception and challenges when he refuses to permit his daughter to get married to another king.
A group of four young friend addicted to drugs and aimless in life , embarks on an endless journey where they fight for their survival learning the lesson of real life.
Seven college students are forced to compete in children's games for survival. With their futures unclear, the secrets of their pasts are revealed.
To save his loved ones, Tony must use his motorcycle talents for drug deliveries.
Two childhood friends face obstacles and challenges after they confront gangsters and each other.
A kind-hearted street urchin and a power-hungry Grand Vizier vie for a magic lamp that has the power to make their deepest wishes come true.

Originally shot in 1984 and not finished until 2021, New York Ninja is about a sound technician for a news station (John Liu) who becomes a vigilante ninja in New York City after his pregnant wife is murdered.

When Terry's wife is senselessly murdered, the police are powerless to enforce justice, so he pursues his own solution. However, the one responsible for Terry's pain is on his own journey; his mission is to return home beyond the stars.

A 14-year-old girl tries to protect her best friend Matic from school bullies, finds herself in online abuse, unites her family after her parent's divorce, and shows us we should always stand up and fight for the right thing.
A family tries to save one of their own from the clutches of a doomsday suicide cult before it's too late.
A undiscovered, unknown, new-thought, psychic mind doctor who has rejected the established opinions and ideas on the mind treats 6 patients whose lives are changed unalterably.

movie_name: Winx Club: The Secret of the Lost Kingdom
synopsis: At Alfea College, Stella, Aisha, Flora, Musa, and Tecna all graduate and become fairy guardians of their home planets. But, Bloom must watch graduation from the sidelines. The Winx try to save Bloom's parents and the planet.
Feature-length, live-action musical version of the classic fairy tale by Charles Perrault.

movie_name: Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children
synopsis: When Jacob (Asa Butterfield) discovers clues to a mystery that stretches across time, he finds Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children. But the danger deepens after he gets to know the residents and learns about their special powers.
A reclusive neon sign repairman discovers a conspiracy in the futuristic city of Saibashikago.
Set in the future, the novel follows Henry Case, a washed-up hacker hired for one last job, which brings him in contact with a powerful artificial intelligence.
When a five-year-old girl is found wandering alone in the Arizona desert, an alcoholic cop must overcome her addiction to unearth the truth behind the girl's mysterious appearance.
In 2027, in a chaotic world in which women have somehow become infertile, a former activist agrees to help transport a miraculously pregnant woman to a sanctuary at sea.
Based on real incidents that happened in the life of 7 bachelors in Bangalore in 2007 after playing the Ouija board and events followed by it.
Criminals have chosen an ordinary man to carry drugs and jewels in his car across the border. The problem is that this man turned out too much ordinary.
Three teenagers blackmail a serial killer.
Impasse is the lyrical story of six souls who have withdrawn from life and the small but precious events that trigger their re-engagement with the world.

Jonna has lived at the orphanage all her life. One day a Gorilla comes and adopts her. It takes some time for Jonna to get used to her new mother, but just as everything starts becoming good, the local authorities threaten their existence.
Paranoia spreads like a virus when a crew of land surveyors encounter psychotic campers possibly infected with an unknown sickness.

A paroled convict who bears a striking resemblance to the local District Attorney is hired by the mob to impersonate him, while the real District Attorney is kidnapped and held captive at a secret location.
Anna, Elsa, Kristoff, Olaf and Sven leave Arendelle to travel to an ancient, autumn-bound forest of an enchanted land. They set out to find the origin of Elsa's powers in order to save their kingdom.
When Rodney Baze mysteriously disappears and law enforcement doesn't follow through fast enough, his older brother, Russell, takes matters into his own hands to find justice.

The accidental discovery of human bones during a road-widening project leads a local traffic cop into the mystery of a 40-year-old case. His investigation leads him across trails that will put his wit, resolve and morals to the test.
An English colonel's daughter meets the lord of the jungle who makes her his mate.
Kemal escapes from prison to prove his innocence and want to find his wife (Nevin) because can not receives any news from her.
Five stolen doves "monks" are helping to investigate a big diamonds theft.
Erika captured a photo of a handsome guy and told her friends that he is her boyfriend. Upon finding this out, the boy proposed to go with her pretense as long as she acts as his pet dog.
A pair of hired guns are hired to time travel back to 1927 to kill Hitler

A young man decides to leave his troubled farming village for the city. Desperate, the girl who loves him will do anything to solve the town's problems and convince him to stay, even give herself to another man.
A girl questions reality as the world around her changes.

A genetic scientist successfully clones the first human being, a baby girl named Elizabeth, but his work is soon threatened by a dark secret, a secret that threatens to destroy everything and everyone precious to him.
Three men attempt to seek vengeance against their oppressors.
Charlie and Itchy return to Earth to find Gabriel's Horn, but along the way meet up with a young boy named David, who ran away from home.
A robot searches for the truth behind his mysterious memories.
The mysterious death of an enigmatic young man newly arrived in the suburb of Wetherby releases the long-repressed, dark passions of some of its residents.
A rag-tag team of mercenaries seek to shelter a young girl while being pursued by a local warlord, the Cuban military and traffickers in 1980's Kenya.
An escaped prisoner abducts an accountant as he tracks a rodeo fair which is sheltering his wife.

In a dystopian near future, according to the laws of The City, single people are taken to The Hotel, where they are obliged to find a romantic partner in 45 days or they're transformed into beasts and sent off into The Woods.

When a wealthy heiresses' once believed dead ex-fiance turns up just after she falls in love with a servant at her sister's wedding, she must decide between the two; however, circumstances are not as simple as choosing one or the other.
After the tragic death of a young woman, 'Shades of Grace' follows the aftermath of her death from the perspective of her fiancé and the two criminals who took her life.
When a busy workaholic leaves town to meet friends, an unexpected delay leads him to the hut of an old man, whose haunting tale could change his life.

movie_name: Snake Club: Revenge of the Snake Woman
synopsis: A woman takes revenge with her pet snake.
A Pianist meets a singer at the Opera.
A military drama about the lengths a man will go to defend his country and his family honor, even if it cost him his soul.
The third and final installment in the Burnout trilogy. This time, the road leads trough Norway, to Sweden, Denmark and finally Germany to race on the famous racing track, Nürburgring.
Plot is unknown.

Discover a hidden kingdom inhabited by magical creatures and ruled by an ancient prophecy. Follow a group of unlikely heroes as they unravel the secrets of their own identities and strive to fulfill their destinies.
A successful male escort describes in a series of confessions his tangled romantic relationships with his two roommates and an older, enigmatic male client.

movie_name: Don't F*cking Tell Me to Calm Down
synopsis: When a woman is told repeatedly to "calm down," she instead embarks on a blood-soaked journey to save the person harmed by her boyfriend's double life.
Seduced by the haunting beauty of a remote marsh, a lone photographer finds himself at the center of a deadly mystery.

movie_name: 1,001 Ways to Enjoy the Missionary Position
synopsis: In the near future, where government regulations are so restrictive our most intimate acts are considered acts of rebellion, Nora tries to break out of a lifetime of strict thought and sexual repression before it's too late.

A disgraced Californian parapsychologist journeys to a cursed island to prove himself and resurrect the dead, only to conjure up newer spirits in the process in a swashbuckling supernatural journey of self discovery.
A story of Arthur, Lance and Gwen on a quest to save Camelot from the reign of the evil Morgana.
In a lost part of the world. A young girl with spiritual powers learns to control her abilities. But a threat is looming.
A criminal investigation uncovers the truth about the death of a schoolgirl.
Little Red Riding Hood lives in a forest with her mother, who is a meteorologist, and experiences unusual things.
In post-WWII America, a woman, rebuilding her life in the suburbs with her husband, kidnaps her neighbor and seeks vengeance for the heinous war crimes she believes he committed against her.

Ranger John Sloan gets a mysterious transfer to a National Park in Colorado, and he begins to uncover a plot between the U.S. Government and three Alien races living underground there, and used for the abduction and study of humans.
A young boy unwittingly releases an ancient evil on a small town.

Stompa starts a new school, Langåsen in Stakavik where he meets his new friends Bodo, Bergen, Nottero and Sorlandet, and finds tangled up in troubles with a spider, a fire drill and a swimming contest leading to detention.
A charming, suicidal druggie must obey his rehab clinic's demand to lead a seniors men's group, or face incarceration and lose the love of his psychiatrist's daughter.

Julia isn't a girl like the others but she might not be really aware of who she really is. The more she'll get to know herself, the more enemies she'll make. Her life is in danger and the countdown has begin.
Lau Ching-Wan is the "King of Pranks" with high moral standards who must square off in a battle against the "Emperor of Pranks", the leader of an opposing prank faction who has no pity.
Plot details to be revealed.
The survived Garrity family must leave the safety of the Greenland bunker and embark on a perilous journey across the decimated frozen wasteland of Europe to find a new home.
Jubei Yagyu tries to protect his clan from rival Kasumi spies.

After breaking up with her girlfriend, a Brooklyn musician moves back in with her mother. Playing for tip money in an old friend's bar, an unexpected relationship begins to take shape. Based on the life and times of Alyssa Robbins.
An executed samurai takes an existential journey throughout time, space and eternity in search of bloody vengeance.
A group of alpinists make a perilous journey up a mountain.

movie_name: P a r a m y t h í a!
synopsis: A little girl is sent off for the Easter week to her priest uncle in a rural Greek village, where she meets a dead young soldier who desperately asks her to contact his beloved ones, telling them what happened and where he is buried.

After the tragic death of his wife, a successful NYC business owner remarries and moves his troubled teen daughter and his new wife down south to start over, but the formidable powers of a dark witch prepare to deliver them more grief.
In an adventurous journey of spreading goodness on earth and by contributing to Tamil literature, Sage Agathiyar faces challenges at various phases of his journey.
A family whose suburban home is haunted by evil forces must come together to rescue their youngest daughter after the apparitions take her captive.

A retro-futuristic steam-punk adventure, led by a maimed and immortal Civil-War era attorney J.S. Edmonds. A battle between Victorian inventions ensues, as he seeks to prove his case. His godson's life hangs between life and the dead.
Manas, Mani and Mauni are at a critical stage in their lives wherein Manas is caught in a love triangle, Mani is on his way to become a crime boss and Mauni resorts to corruption for political gains.
Jimmy Dean's popular song (released in 1961) is translated into a feature length movie about a young couple who elopes to escape the girl's evil stepfather.

Narrates the story of an impossible love between Alice B. and Peter D. It's a path of innuendo through characters, poems, proverbs and events across the ages and dimensions. The film plays with logical rules, puns, physics and math.

Grieving his mother's death, Carlos moves into her home and becomes mysteriously ill himself with a slew of symptoms and horrific psychological distortions that appear to be in his head, until his nightmare meets reality.

A leader of New York society leaves her ship bound for Europe ,in disguise as a maid, to prevent her son's marrying into a lower class. Also converging on her home are a crook also disguised (as a deacon) several reporters and the police.
Chased by two androids programmed to kill him, Zerph puts down his flying saucer in Auvergne while waiting for help.
A secret teenage party turns deadly.
Ghouls, cannibals, Aliens and an evil robot in a giant maze like mansion, surrounded by eerie swamp land. Would you spend the night for $10,000?

An aspiring painter and a frustrated musician meet and become instant friends, but decide to end and leave everything as is, just like complete strangers. What will happen if they meet again as two completely different people?

movie_name: Skyjack: The Hunt for D.B. Cooper
synopsis: D.B. Cooper, makes off with $200,000 by jumping out of an airplane he hijacks.
The film follows a small town cop who is summoned to investigate the death of a politician which gets complicated by the victim's secretive family and his own conflicted heart.
1965, a train with a variety of passengers is heading north when it makes an unexpected stop. On the other track, heading south, a train passes with the same passengers 20 years later.

movie_name: O hamenos thisavros tou Hoursit Pasa
synopsis: A group of escapees goes to mountainous Peloponnese, looking for a buried treasure.
A down-on-his-luck ethics professor ends up on a completely unhinged run across the Mexican border with his teenage daughter in tow - and four undocumented immigrants in the trunk.
An strange meeting at night in a poultry store lost in Antarctica. A story full of lechery, sarcasm, extravagance, impossible geometries, discovery of existence's hidden sides and a pinch of Magick.

A teen's ability to surreally speak with cars sparks a revolution that could save his community. However, he soon finds himself in a fight for survival when his invention inadvertently accelerates the underlying problems.
A teenage boy named Max and his little sister move to Salem, where he struggles to fit in before awakening a trio of diabolical witches that were executed in the 17th century.
A real city boy has to move to the country with his family. He befriends a refugee girl, a dog and an ox in an adventuresome fight against some racist hillbilly thieves.
A family fights to survive as the streets of Paris fill with a deadly gas.
Having both lost their jobs, two strangers become unlikely friends after a run in with a would be robber, who is actually a hitman with a grudge against the two.
After receiving mysterious empty packages inside his apartment, a young computer-programmer begins a personal investigation into their origins.

movie_name: The Fall of the House of Usher
synopsis: Boston Lyric Opera gives an art house cinematic treatment to Philip Glass' opera The Fall of the House of Usher. This chilling film places Edgar Allan Poe's iconic gothic horror story.

Udo is invisible - no one ever seems to notice him. He makes the most of it, working as a department store detective and living off other people's lives as they never notice him tagging along. Until he meets the one woman who sees him.
Jacques, painter and great seducer, is about to receive for dinner the charming Claire, a young girl of 20. In his forties, penniless but astute, Jacques has prepared a sumptuous meal.
THE CURSE OF SIDONIA is the shocking true story of SIDONIA VON BORK, a 17th Century femme-fatale who allegedly brought down Pomerania's powerful family.
After a lab accident, a lethal virus destroys the entire planet, left alone eight human beings, among whom the "virus" creator, but also a photographer and six mentally handicapped persons.

Follows Mina, a 28-year-old artist, as she gets stranded in an extensive, immaculate forest in western Ireland. After finding shelter, she becomes trapped alongside three strangers, stalked by mysterious creatures each night.
A photographer on a trip to Japan meets a fellow American woman and they quickly fall in love. However, when he returns home to the US, he discovers that she is his girlfriend's older sister.

A stranger armed with a shotgun takes seven patrons hostage in a remote roadside diner. But as the body count increases, the desperate survivors discover that one of the hostages may be even more dangerous than their captor.
Three con artists dupe two Olympians into serving as editors of a new health and beauty magazine which is only a front for salacious stories and pictures.

Fresh out of a Danish prison, Harald bosses his old gang around, into visiting his hospitalized foster dad, who wants to see his bio son before dying. The son's in a Swedish prison. Then there's a money matter - robbing a bank.
Following a mysterious suicide at Niagara Falls, a low-rent detective unravels a conspiracy to build a revolutionary invention by enigmatic scientist, Nikola Tesla.
Nanda happiness is short lived as her fiance dies in an accident. However, a ray of hope strikes through the gloom as she meets the twin brother of him.

Heer, a small town girl faces taboos in her community to meet her man of dreams. she faces all odds to live a life of her choice and why can't a girl live with her parents like boys do and still be considered as a stranger in her own home.
Not a feature film but episodes of the TV series "Ramar of the Jungle" edited together and released as a feature.
In 1984 East Berlin, an agent of the secret police, conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover, finds himself becoming increasingly absorbed by their lives.
A man's daughter is taken a hostage by a group of men who want him to assassinate a minister in exchange for his daughter's life.

Pratiksha, 27, arrives in London three months after her marriage and shortly finds herself entrapped in a vortex of lies, deceit and danger. If she does not get out of the mess, everything in her life is at risk.
In 1947 three friends help each other overcome obstacles.
A young journalist receives three strange photos of his fiancée. He tries to find out who any why sent him these pictures.

movie_name: Untitled Romantic Hyper Violent Action Film
synopsis: Plot Under Wraps
Honey, a young entertainer on a carnival boat, is in love with Buck but Buck's father is against the romance.

In 2017 Anna continues to be persecuted by her look-a-like dead two hundred years before. In 1818 investigations into the death of Luigi Bacchi and the infanticide Emma Rigoni are assigned to a new detective.
A police detective investigates the truth behind his partner's death. The mysterious case reveals disturbing police corruption and a dangerous secret involving an unlikely young woman.

The year was 1973, Justin Thomas Wilson was hunting the fallen with an ax and a shotgun. Sam, his young disciple, documented their adventures with the first 8mm camera ever to record sound. The story begins but the battle rages on.
Two English kids meet their friend Anoop Singh and his baby elephant Ranee. The nasty circus owner wants the elephant for his circus and the children decide that they must prevent this.
Members of a Special Forces unit hunting a drug lord discover the man has switched to organ trafficking.
The movie revolves around Arunachalam (Rajini), who is the son of the VIP of a village who finds out about his past but destiny has its own play.
Journey with Pilgrim as John Bunyan's famous allegory leaps from its pages to a movie.
In 16th Century Spain, a revered sea captain resorts to piracy to find his lost son and exact revenge against those who murdered his family through the Inquisition.
Strange things happen in a village.
On the run from authorities, a sleazy courier poses as a Scout leader on a camping trip. But he has no idea what he's in for when he must actually take charge of a group of kids.
In a private academy, students are divided into two gangs and the dean tries to resolve the clashes between them.
In a coven of Parasitics, a secret is revealed and its truth is far more dangerous than they ever imagined.

Dorn is after the rancher's land and is trying to stop Banker Brady from helping them. When his man Hammond kills Brady, there is a run on the bank and Rocky volunteers to ride to the next town for money.
An angel cast out by Santa Claus must restore a young boy's faith in order to regain his wings.

After a tragic loss in the family. A college sister takes over parenthood of her little sister. What's supposed to be a fun weekend to try and forget about the past turns into a deadly night, as they must find a way to survive a night of horror or die.
Left for dead in an open grave, Emilia struggles to keep both her life and her sanity.

Yoogan is an upcoming Tamil horror, suspense thriller film directed by Kamal G. Starring Yashmith and Sakshi Agarwal in the lead roles. It is a horror story which revolves around the problems that happen in an IT company.
Detective Ellery Queen's vacation is interrupted when murder strikes next door to his oceanside cabin.
A French reporter travels to Iguazú Falls, where a local has found an object that may or may not be a fragment of a UFO.
Forced to retire because of shifting politics, Park Mun-su nevertheless finds himself called upon to root out a plot against the king

A CIA special forces team is betrayed and left for dead by their superiors, galvanizing them to mount an offensive on the CIA.
How do you track a killer whose victims have nothing in common?
A young cobra and his scorpion best friend go on a journey across the Sahara desert to save a new-found love.

The life of a young man and his struggles against the privatization of education.
A detective investigates the death of the wife of an emerging politician. The death was first ruled as suicide, but he realizes this is not a suicide but a well planned murder in cold blood.
THE NINTH PASSENGER - A group of salacious students party aboard a luxury yacht only to turn on each other as a 9th PASSENGER picks them off one by one.
The terrifying world of Social Media.

A man and his friend commit petty thefts to make a living. After they break into a woman's house one day, one man's life changes forever.
The young son of a test pilot, mourning his father's loss, inherits an advanced, sentient flying machine.

A Caucasian university student tries to win an affable South Asian girl's heart on a summer day at a beach-side park, but he's in for a big surprise.
Same Universe. New Threat. Less Experienced Heroes. Doesn't mean they can't hold their own.

A boy tries to stop aliens who have taken over his town and are attempting to brainwash its inhabitants.

A mad scientist teams with an evil, disfigured woman to kidnap and operate on young women to make her look beautiful again.
Special unit of police and border guards are fighting against foreign smugglers in Far East of Russia in early 90s.

An eccentric scientist helps a fugitive from the law become invisible, unwittingly giving him the power to exact revenge on his former friends.

An amnesiac Hindu man remembers his past as a Muslim sharpshooter and an assassin.
After losing his hearing in an accident, a musician triumphs in the musical world through the extraordinary bond he creates with an abused, deaf dog.
A young boy named Nicholas is about to become the next Santa Claus, but must first avoid a crisis that's threatening the magic of Christmas before he can succeed in his new role.

A man is sent on a clandestine business trip by a shadowy executive. The details of the journey withheld even from him, the man must follow a series of mysterious clues to uncover the true nature of his mission.
A lonely 8-year-old girl embarks on an odyssey from the Mojave to Australia to find her estranged Mama, but must fight off a zealous Social Services Agent or risk never seeing Mama again.

Roommates Emily and Sydney must do whatever it takes to survive when their car breaks down in the middle of nowhere.

An unexpected trip to the sun-kissed island of Corfu, combined with a harmless fabrication, will change forever the life of a live-in housekeeper who has a chance encounter with a handsome young stranger. Is he her Prince Charming?
In a fantasy world, Sisam and Helya discover they are soul mates who can merge their bodies into a single and legendary being : a Myrihande.

After ten years, Hella Mayer and her boyhood friend Andreas meet again in Berlin on the street. Both know each other from common dance lessons times.

movie_name: A Curry on an American Plate
synopsis: A dying Indian restaurant gets 30 days from its landlord to wake up or clear the space.

For some reason, forever young and always immaculately dressed, Koschey has been unable to find a bride for three hundred years.

An Argentinean couple living in Paris receive a letter from the man's mother, in which she gives them regards from his brother. Confusion arises, as the couple know the brother to have died from an illness.
A man with the ability to enter people's memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.

Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane traverses the world in a race against time to stop a zombie pandemic that is toppling armies and governments and threatens to destroy humanity itself.

A day trip for two hit-men soon turns into more than just sightseeing when all five spots on the tour are graves and clashes with a rival gang and a mysterious mob heiress prove that one of them may just have murder on the mind.

movie_name: The Hunters of the Golden Cobra

A young man from the suburbs with no mountaineering experience decides to climb Mt Everest to show a woman he'd do anything for her.
Three strangers arrive one by one at a mysterious cabin in the middle of nowhere only to learn they've been brought together for a reason.
A darkly-comic thriller about a lone tollbooth operator whose past is quickly catching up with him.
A group of students investigate the mysterious suicide case of an honor student. That leads them into the horrid situation.
"Ken and Hana" - About a lone-wolf type seeking love and defending the honor of an elderly widower.

An assassin on a final assignment in Fuerteventura, to kill a man he has never met. When his target is delayed, he finds himself drawn to the island, people and a ghostly shipwreck.

In the fall of 1986, six knuckleheads from Detroit travel north to partake in the annual tradition of deer hunting. But something horrific has been awakened and the hunters become the hunted.

movie_name: Hello Again - A Wedding a Day
synopsis: Zazie is invited to her best friend's wedding. She decides to do everything to prevent what is in her eyes the mistake of his life. But when she finds herself trapped in the time-line of the wedding, things get complicated.

An elderly woman decides to act on her own with a rifle as she gets fed up with injustice.

movie_name: Der Hund von Baskerville, 3. Teil - Das unheimliche Zimmer
synopsis: Sherlock Holmes' arch enemy Stapleton has escaped a watery death in the 1914 "Hound of the Baskervilles" and returns to torment Lord Henry and his fiancée. Subtitled "Das Unheimliche Zimmer"

Dark fairy-tale about a demonic doctor who abducts a beautiful opera singer with designs on transforming her into a mechanical nightingale.

Over night the world turned into chaos. No one knows what happened. The terrifying truth leads to Project:Eugenics.

A diverse group of heroes from different lands and backgrounds embark on an epic odyssey facing monstrous creatures overcoming personal conflicts and finding the strength to save their realms.

synopsis: A PERSONAL JOURNEY TO FIND REDEMPTION IN YOURSELF, THREE DAYS AND NIGHT FIGHTING THE DEMONS IN YOUR MIND PUSHING YOU INTO THE DARKNESS OF CRIME OR SELF DESTRUCTION. a FIGHT FOR YOUR LIFE TO CONTINUE.

The epic battle between the bloodiest Royals Vlad The Impaler and the Blood Countess Elizabeth Bathory will be fought.

On the Italian Riviera, an unlikely but strong friendship grows between a human being and a sea monster disguised as a human.
A rotoscope-animated modern-day Cinderella story set in the underbelly of New York's Chinatown.
A grieving defense attorney gets caught in a twisted game of who-done-it when he takes on the case of a beautiful socialite who is accused of murder.
A Russian fairy tale about a maiden named Snegurochka, who is made out of snow.

A woman faces with herself while staying in her remote family house deep in the forest, for the first time after her child vanished in these very woods four years ago.

movie_name: Long Arm of the Law: Part 3
synopsis: Michal Mak's second sequel to his brother's action classic finds an ex-soldier/escaped death row prisoner fleeing to Hong Kong and forced to work for a gang of criminals when they kidnap the woman he loves.
A journalist fallen out of favor begins seeing haunting visions of an old lady, who guides her towards a wicked conspiracy, conceived by evil itself.

A tabloid reporter and her new photographer, who've recently started working for the mayor of New York City, stumble upon evidence of conspiracy and political corruption that may involve their beloved mayor.

movie_name: Cool Cat Stops a School Shooting: A School Safety Film
synopsis: Cool Cat is in class when an active shooter attacks his school, and Cool Cat shows children different techniques and safety tips on what to do to stay safe, and then Cool Cat comes face-to-face with the shooter - But what happens then.

Bill and Jo Harding, advanced storm chasers on the brink of divorce, must join together to create an advanced weather alert system by putting themselves in the cross-hairs of extremely violent tornadoes.

During WW2, American volunteer pilots are stationed in China where, as part of the Flying Tigers unit, they dog-fight against Japanese warplanes.
An army private and his new bride are trying to honeymoon on an island occupied by the military and a murderer.
Jeet, a young man, falls in love with Paali, a vivacious woman and resorts to stalking in a desperate attempt to woo her.

WANTED BY THE LAW WANTED BY HIS ENEMY WANTED BY HIS FRIENDS AND WANTED BY HIS FEAR.

A feared don must woo a woman from a cultured family and marry her within a short period of time, in order to escape from his grandfather's insistent ghost. How will he convince a suitable woman to marry him, despite his criminal record?

synopsis: A self-anointed 'renegade' male flight attendant must save the day when the airline he works for tries to eliminate flight attendants as a cost-cutting measure.

An elderly African-American couple participate in an experimental rejuvenation procedure and unexpectedly find themselves faced with severely disfigured but intellectually superior clones of themselves.
The epic tale of the mighty hero who saved the multi-verse - and the three friends who tagged along
A maniac tries to kill off a group of teenagers on an encounter session in the desert.
Exploitation anthology from the twisted minds of established and up and coming directors from across the globe.
Animated film based on the classic holiday song.
World famous pop group the Spice Girls zip around London in their luxurious double decker tour bus having various adventures and performing for their fans.
Retired agent Matt Helm is re-activated in order to stop an evil organization from exploding an atom bomb over the USA and starting WWIII.
Henry (James Lydon) gets into another jam when he becomes the editor of the Centerville Hish School newspaper. The Fire Chief suspects him when he covers fires.

Contemporary Moscow. After a car accident, champion athlete Sergey Borozdin suddenly has a psychic ability to see past events. When he becomes a suspect in a series of murders, he is forced to use this ability to find the real killer.
Two professors team up to locate a lost treasure and embark on an adventure that takes them from a Tibetan ice cave to Dubai, and to a mountain temple in India.
A lonely art expert working for a mysterious and reclusive heiress finds not only her art worth examining.

movie_name: War for the Planet of the Apes

Three stories of horror and mystery. Evil Deeds 2, tells the story of writer James Mallony, taking a walk through the park and meeting a beautiful film student who turns out to be more that she appears to be.
The story of friendship and occasional misadventures of two Soviet scholars, Vitya and Kostya.

movie_name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Grudge of Edinburgh
synopsis: When sinister forces threaten the peace of Britannia, a young prince embarks on a perilous journey to save his loved ones and discover his true powers.

A tyrant from the future creates evil android doubles of Bill and Ted and sends them back to eliminate the originals.
In the near future, a ship of space explorers crash land on an unknown planet. They're soon met with some of their worst fears as they discover the planet is inhabited by monstrous dinosaurs.
An innocent female clown must summon the courage to conquer hell in order to save herself and her beloved man.
The last days in the life of legendary Hollywood actor Errol Flynn.
The storytelling chest is stolen by the Jackals and the city is in turmoil. Few kids join each other to help find the missing chest and save the situation.
Four outlaws and a female bounty hunter follow a path of violence and murder along the Texas/Mexico border, only to discover overlapping pasts
A man tied up in a dangerous crime organization, is forced on the run for the border when he makes a crucial mistake and is left with no other way out.
I princess who is skilled in martial arts dismisses her four potential suitors and journey's to find a man worthy of her hand in marriage.

movie_name: A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur's Court
synopsis: A singing mechanic from 1912 finds himself in Arthurian Britain.
Five friends go camping on the rugged coast of Vancouver Island, Canada. Things start to go seriously wrong while partying with two Australian surfers.
The girlfriend of a couple vacationing in Baja is kidnapped by a drug dealer who demands that her boyfriend smuggle back cocaine into the US or she will be killed.

Two unwitting ex-high school sweethearts who, while stranded at a random hotel bar during a snowstorm, discover their first love memories may be more than that after revisiting their past and present lives.

Pragya Paromita, fondly called Mitin, is appointed by a Parsi couple to investigate their eight-year-old son's kidnapping. Mitin has done economics from Presidency and balances her detective and homemaker lives equally well.

A runaway criminal breaks into an eerie chateau, taking its two frightened chambermaids hostage. As night falls, a group of mysterious aristocratic women arrive and the criminal begins to realize the women are hiding a sinister secret.

The life of a suburban American family is scarred after a nuclear attack.

In 1961, Kempton Bunton, a 60 year old taxi driver, steals Goya's portrait of the Duke of Wellington from the National Gallery in London.
A mother searches for her daughter who was kidnapped on a cross-country road trip.
A Plea to halt Political interference in Indian Sports

In the most anticipated interview of the year, sisters Adelaide, Carolina and Julia Paixão come together with their mother Anita - to recount the events that led to one of the most controversial crimes ever committed in Portugal.
A London teen discovers the world of rock music when he visits his cousin in California.
During the Florida land boom, The Marx Brothers run a hotel, auction off some land, thwart a jewel robbery, and generally act like themselves.
Full movie based on TV-series "My Wife's Girlfriends"
An unreal man in a surreal world follows his programming to help others as he looks for the only real thing he knows...Home.
A comet bearing a deadly Pokemon creature crash-lands onto Earth, terrorising a nearby high-tech city, where Ash, Pikachu and friends are currently visiting...
A visitor to Argentina is involved in a car accident, and he takes the opportunity to murder a woman traveling with him; looking into the crime is a female doctor who has suspicions about the death.
While in pursuit of a dangerous crime boss, a detective unwittingly shoots his own brother, who has fallen into a life of crime.

movie_name: Genghis Khan: To the Ends of the Earth and Sea
synopsis: Epic sweep and intimate details flow together to paint the story of Temujin, the man who became Genghis Khan.
In a futuristic world where women run the show, a shy plastics' designer buys a female robot, so he gains confidence and becomes a lady's man, but he falls for plastic woman.

movie_name: Franklin and the Turtle Lake Treasure
synopsis: When his Granny comes down with a mysterious ailment, Franklin and his friends must search for the treasure of Turtle Lake. This is said to be a talisman that can cure the illness.
While on the Trans-Siberian Express, an anthropologist and his rival must contain the threat posed by the former's cargo: a prehistoric ape which is the host for a parasitic life-form.
In Venezuela during the 1950s, a vacationing Texas oilman is asked to help extinguish an oil derrick fire and he succumbs to the charms of a visiting New York novelist.
A hero single-handedly sets himself against Martians trying to assume control of Earth.

Re-edited version of a Japanese TV serial combined with a direct-to-video anime, released in the U.S. as a feature.
As a young hero goes to battle with flying dinosaurs, he also must face his own internal monsters.

A Boston based rock band is given the break of their lives after their lead singer meets a mysterious young woman.
Three bachelors find themselves forced to take care of a baby left by one of the guys' girlfriends.
An assassin begins to psychologically crack as he develops a conscience, even as his clients continue to demand his skills.
Baby, it's cold outside. So come inside where it's full of hallucinatory time-travelling Gold Rush cannibals instead.
Things take a turn for the worse for a small factory owner and his wife when a group of militants decide to hide at their home.
A mobility-challenged boy who befriends a stray dog in an African township aspires to become a ping-pong champion, despite sabotage attempts by his nemesis and her miniature killer dog.
The career of Revolutionary War naval hero from his youth in Scotland through his service to Catherine the Great of Russia.

A young married physician discovers a mermaid, and gives into her request to be taken to see London. Comedy and romantic entanglements ensue soon after.

movie_name: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
synopsis: As Harry, Ron and Hermione race against time and evil to destroy the Horcruxes, they uncover the existence of the three most powerful objects in the wizarding world: the Deathly Hallows.
A teenage boy discovers the perpetrators of several brutal kidnappings in his home town.
A young couple in need of a break, venture off into a vastly remote area, and discover strange noises originating from deep within the woods.
There are 666 portals that connect this world to the other side. These are concealed from all human beings. Somewhere in Japan exists the 444th portal.... The forest of resurrection.
Seven teenagers are stalked by a murderous clown while refurbishing an old opera house.
Three towns. Three Stories. All true.

movie_name: The Mysterious Death of Lord Harrington
synopsis: Eight people on an island estate for the will reading of Lord Harrington, who was killed by a mysterious wolf like creature. Must band together in order to survive until morning.
High school peers Yuu and Haru travel between the real world and a parallel fantasy universe to help their friend Kotona, whose life is in danger.
Since Subhadra's father left them, her mother has faced snide remarks from the society. All she wants for her daughter is to live a scrupulous life. However, Subhadra falls in love with Raja.
A fun trip turns upside down when 3 guys and 3 girls enjoying themselves in the countryside become the perfect prey to a prison escapee who's out for blood.
Changsu happens to get a special perfume. The perfume has a special thing that appeals to women. Ara is also attracted to the perfume and meets Changsu
A wax museum owner uses his horror exhibits to unleash evil on the world.

A village has to be destroyed for coal mining. Henning, a 15 years old boy, who wants to visit his grandfather one more time, realizes that nothing will be the way it used to be.

movie_name: Jelger de Goochelaar en de Poppenheks
synopsis: After moving to his new home, Jelger finds an old painting of a witch. That night, she escapes from the painting and tries to overpower Belderplons by turning all of it's citizens into dolls.

Evildoers have taken over the town of Learsi, until a justice-seeker named Buddy Colt comes riding into town, and recruits a team of desperadoes known as the "Judges" to help him gain retribution for the annihilation of his brother.

movie_name: Detective Conan: The Time Bombed Skyscraper
synopsis: The detective genius Conan must solve a series of bombings or his true love will die!
The story of a town bully with a nickname of Nuri the Flea.

Rafael Infante (Chayanne) comes to Houston from Cuba to work at John Burnett's (Kris Kristofferson's) dance studio. He meets Ruby Sinclair (Vanessa Williams), a cute dance instructor there. Chemistry? Will John know he's Rafael's dad?
A radio host is victimized by the cannibal family as a former Texas Marshall hunts them.
An 8-year old boy invents a hand-held computer which can control any electronic device, and uses it to affect the entire town where he lives.
Fresh out of rehab, a young woman moves back in with her parents and sister, and soon becomes involved in a mystery that has left people in her town paralyzed.
A British colonial policeman in Africa, circa 1900, pursues a band of escaped killers across territory so wild, it lies just "one step to hell."

Duas almas passam o tempo buscando um destino, várias vidas, vários tempos e uma só história... Mesmo com muitas perdas e vidas, o amor verdadeiro se mantém forte, do passado ao presente, agora é para sempre!
Ratan, a son of a poor mother falls in love with a rich daughter Rupa.
A young lawyer is involved with a ghostly woman in his new house, where the builder and his fiancée died shortly after it was built.
A man finds his wife brutally murdered. He has no alibi so is instructed by his lawyer to go into hiding in an abandoned hotel. Strange occurrences start happening immediately.

Two ex-lovers are at odds with one another during a weekend lake house party. As a killer in the woods picks off their friends one by one, they must decide whether to rekindle their flame or lose each other forever.
After losing his niece in an assassination attempt, Aiden Pierce, a street-smart-hacker, uses his phone to take over a new operating system in Chicago to hunt the criminals that killed his niece.
On becoming a trustee of a family will Connor Murray engages in incredible story of power, romance,revenge and international finance spanning three centuries.
In this animated musical, a girl builds a rocket ship and blasts off, hoping to meet a mythical moon goddess.

To equip the American zoos with as many animals as possible, a cruel trio of big-game hunters team up with an unexpected ally, threatening the African fauna. Will Tarzan allow the fiendish huntress to pillage the jungle?
Henry Spencer tries to survive his industrial environment, his angry girlfriend, and the unbearable screams of his newly born mutant child.
A cat-and-mouse game engages between a blind woman and a serial killer when the former becomes the witness of a kidnap performed by the latter.

movie_name: The Girl of the Golden West
synopsis: A bandit disguises himself as an officer in an attempt to woo a saloon singer.
As Kano and the Black Dragon wreak havoc around the globe, a young warrior named Kenshi will have to rise above his own limitations and take on the looming threat of Outworld.
A possessed Ninja doll teams up with a teenage boy to avenge the murder of a poor child factory worker.
The Prince, Forestman and Peasant travel back in time, with the Spanish Goddess helping them to destroy the Pisscutter and remove Yonder Scotsman from power once and for all.
Professional hit-man Robert Rath wants to fulfill a few more contracts before retiring but unscrupulous ambitious newcomer hit-man Miguel Bain keeps killing Rath's targets.
In an era where aliens have invaded and conquered feudal Tokyo, a young samurai seeks work as he can.
During the 1853 Yellow Fever epidemic in New Orleans, people are being killed by a cunning assassin who literally frightens his victims to death.
A cowboy sets out to help a pretty young girl who's about to lose her ranch.
A loving young creative couple, Max and Anna, experience inexplicable difficulties which tears their relationship apart.
Beautiful in the sky but deadly on earth. In a small nowhere town where nothing happens a meteor crashes and causes havoc in this small town.

An adventurous tale set in a fantasy land with enchanting characters inspired by the folklore of Tilism e Hosh Ruba, "The Chronicles of Umro Ayyar" is an animated movie presented by Ingenuity Productions set to release in 2023.

For 100 years, stories have been told about a cult near Hackett Ranch where people have been kidnapped and never found. The owners of the ranch say they know nothing about it. Guess where this year's rodeo is?
Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, who resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head.

Hero Wah goes to study under Master Pride. When he returns to his parents, he learns that they have been murdered by a band of evil Westerners. After impregnating his wife Jade, he ventures to New York in search of his parents' killers.
A SWAT team transporting a vicious crime syndicate boss must fight their way out of a county detention center during a catastrophic alien invasion.

Kidnapped into Empyrean, Rachel is brainwashed into becoming an orphan where kids take an exam that dictates their future. Meanwhile, her husband Levi is set on a journey to rescue her when her destiny is to become God of Empyrean.
An influencer couple traveling the world on their yacht encounter an ancient evil presence on their journey that is hell bent on destroying them.

When their foster mother dies, unrelated foster brothers Mark (17yrs), and Tristan (11yrs) go on the run to escape the system. But to keep their secret safe they must put their trust in a gruff retired Army Colonel seeking redemption.
A controversial Vampire Guardian Angel(TM) with a taste for blood who finds his victims through their prayers of despair and suicidal thoughts.

movie_name: Darby O'Gill and the Little People

The lives of various Generation X-ers are linked by the murder of a young woman.

Believing to be able to communicate with his deceased father, a young boy develops psychic powers where he uses them to try to stop supernatural forces threatening his family and friends, especially a possessed ventriloquist dummy.
A modern-day version of the Greek mythological tale of the Gorgon.
A group of friends for meeting, a secret for disclosing, a nightmare for starting.

11-year-old Momo moves with her mother to a small island town after her father dies. When she arrives, she encounters three goblins that others cannot see who try to help her to cope with the loss of her father and the changes in her life.

A society with a pill that does away the need to sleep and an artificial sun, there is no end to morning daylight, living and work. The younger generation of the society consider rebelling to reclaim their dreams.
A man is killed in combat to awaken in another war, then killed again jumping through time as he looks to stop the cycle of death and rebirth.
Suspended from the Italian police force, Marco Borelli travels to South Africa to find out the truth about his father's death.
A group of Los Angeles cops decide to take off some of the pressures of their jobs by engaging in various forms of after hours debauchery.

You have magic powers - you don't know where they came from - you don't know how to control them - and you don't know what's going to happen next. It's the year 473 A.D. You're 12 years old, and your name is Merlin.
A man who has a talking mule gets a job on a newspaper, and both get mixed up in a murder trial.
A little girl who is tortured by her parents follow the footstep of a serilal killer to run away from her reality.
A species is harassed by an unconditional path. Something is about to change.

England's first undercover agent for Her Majesty's Secret Service fights to save Queen Elizabeth from one of history's greatest super-villain.

Two former friends, both disgraced struggle veterans who fought against Apartheid in South Africa, are now on opposite ends of a thrilling chase across the township, after their star-crossed children are involved in a deadly dilemma.
Two young kids end up spending Christmas eve alone and they mistake two burglars for Santa

movie_name: Pure Bloodlines: Blood's Thicker Than Water

Comes the sequel 'Bloods Thicker Than Water' hot from winning a media award at the 'London Hall of Fame'. Twin brothers Eric and Alec continue the hunt against head vampire Mr Visconti and his supernatural assassins.

movie_name: Once Upon a Time in New York City
synopsis: A gritty gangster thriller about the New York Underworld.

A deceased older couple switch places with a young living couple in order to save their small town cemetery from being developed by a greedy businessman.
A new take on the classic Robin Hood tale.
With the support of his family, Daniel takes on the responsibility of trying to teach Mekhi himself and help him overcome his challenges so that he can return to school.
The crew of a West of Ireland trawler, marooned at sea, struggle for their lives against a growing parasite in their water supply.

movie_name: Nobody Sleeps in the Woods Tonight 2
synopsis: When something horrible happens to the only survivor of a bloody massacre, an insecure rookie cop must overcome his fears to stop further carnage.

The 3rd Super Giant film, in which he saves Earth from the threat of the reptile-like Kapia Aliens. (Part 1 of 2)
Three vignettes about couples trying to get together and the problems that continue to keep them apart.
Eluding "Night-of-the-Living-Dead"-type zombies: on a New Jersey beach; in a hospital; at a cook-out; in a bar...
Two street musicians befriend a dog whose owner is searching for his long-lost daughter: a good-hearted young lady who is also the street musicians' neighbor.
As the daring thief Arsène Lupin (Romain Duris) ransacks the homes of wealthy Parisians, the Police, with a secret weapon in their arsenal, attempt to ferret him out.

After a Super Adaptoid breaks into the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier, it fakes its destruction. S.H.I.E.L.D and the superheroes enlist recruits to help determine what was stolen before Hydra and AIM can team up to take over the world.

movie_name: Keet & Koen en de speurtocht naar Bassie & Adriaan

January 1991. Six people are dead. Murdered. One thing in common-they are members of one of the most corrupt, powerful and toxic families in the country. A simple open and shut case? Anything but.
A dormant volcano deep with the Turkish forest holds within it a deadly secret. Perfectly preserved, a nest of pterodactyl eggs are ready to hatch...

Bound by a shared destiny, a teen bursting with scientific curiosity and a former boy-genius inventor embark on a mission to unearth the secrets of a place somewhere in time and space that exists in their collective memory.
A customs officer who can smell fear develops an unusual attraction to a strange traveler while aiding a police investigation which will call into question her entire existence.
Los Angeles police officer Brian O'Conner must decide where his loyalty really lies when he becomes enamored with the street racing world he has been sent undercover to destroy.
A greedy businessman-turned-renegade foments an Indian uprising against the coming telegraph to perpetuate his economic stranglehold on the territory.
The Pittsburgh Pirates' brash and abusive manager receives the help of an angel to win games and become a better person in the process.

6 teenagers head to an isolated house for a small getaway, only to later find out that there is a spiritual vampire that is taking over as one of the group members that will eventually kill off the group one by one.
Horror Anthology produced by filmmakers from around the world, which explores the subject of Demons, with inspiration from Ancient Mythology, Religion and the Cosmological Horror of H. P. Lovecraft.
A factory worker falls in love unknowingly with his boss's daughter. However, on their first date, he vows never to marry a rich girl.
Ignoring the eerie warning of a troubled mother suspected of child endangerment, a social worker and her own small kids are soon drawn into a frightening supernatural realm.
A man is thrust back in time, where he is expected to compete in a Medieval gladiatorial event.
Three small farm kids are lost for eight days in 1864 in Victoria.
A love triangle of obsession, played out in our world of constant communication.
A maverick American cop and his Chinese counterpart join forces to bring a drug dealer and his hired thugs to justice.
A story of a guy and a puppet trying to find their place in the world.
Sune and Sophie's families decide to celebrate the Midsummer holiday together. But the day before departure, Sophie breaks up with Sune. Sune attempts to win Sophie back by doing something romantic.

movie_name: Jelger de Goochelaar en de Vliegende Toverring
synopsis: Jelger is a magician who lives in the fictional village of Belderplons. When he finds a flying ring that warns him for upcoming danger, an evil wizard sets course for the village to recover his possession.
In this adaptation of Mark Twain's timeless classic, Thomasina Sawyer and Huck Finn must decide what to do after witnessing the pinning of a murder on an innocent man.
Three years after the failure of the last BR program, a second act is forged and a class of students are sent to an island with one objective: kill international terrorist Shuya Nanahara.
Forty eight hours in an area around a Parisian canal where a former Tango champion meets a killer.
A man and his second wife are haunted by the ghost of his first wife.
A gang of small town high school rejects stumble on and ancient formula for voodoo dolls and decide to try it for some well-deserved revenge against their tormentors.
An ambitious Siddhu and an aspiring writer Kadambari fall in love with each other as their bond gets tested by jealousy and greed.
A band of misfits go on an adventurous journey to bring back the cure for their dying world.
Detective Michael Shayne and his girlfriend Joanne are on their way to be married when a scream from a nearby hotel room draws his attention to a pair of theatrical murders.
A high school social outcast is taken under the wing of a mysterious mentor, only to be groomed as the hive's next queen.
Serum obtained from a brain after a mass murder transforms the good Dr. Jekyll of London into the evil Mr. Blood.
A private detective finds himself with a perfect new secretary. But after a notorious gossip columnist turns up murdered, she may prove too good to be true.

A poor farmer fight against a rich landlord and the corrupt administrates for a small piece of land. Ends with a painful decision to save his farms for his family.

A modern day American family struggles with the slow decay of their home life as a result of emotional abuse and unaddressed mental illness.
Featuring a young Noah Centineo, this family adventure film follows a group of curious kids from Camp Loggerhead as they embark on an adventure to solve the mystery of the missing sea turtle eggs.

A writer eloping with his mistress by train has second thoughts, pulls the emergency brake, bails out and witnesses the train's collision with another train, events eventually leading to murder and a police manhunt.
After being hypnotized by his sister-in-law, a man begins seeing haunting visions of a girl's ghost and a mystery begins to unfold around him.

Two Pittsburg nickel and dime junk pickers Tommy and Johnny Spazzino get sucked into the mob life when their mobbed-up dad gets whacked and their uncle forces them to step up to the plate to do the wrong thing for the right reason.
A small-time reporter tries to convince the police she saw a murder in the apartment across from hers.

Four friends, Jaga, Ganesh, Ajay and Vishwas are motoring to a cricket game. An accident leads them to divert on a side road, where they encounter a criminal gang that has kidnapped a young girl and shot a policeman in front of them.

When Michelle Weston's husband is killed in his small plane, strange things start to occur in their once happy Victorian home. Soon the police investigate his death as a homicide with Michelle as their prime suspect.

A song-filled new Air Bud 'Pup Star' movie that introduces four new pups to the family, who stow away on Santa's sleigh and find themselves trapped at the North Pole, trying to save the world's Christmas spirit.
Four teenagers who do not have a relationship with their parents arrive to rest in the camp.
Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's action-adventure classic, four plane crash survivors encounter danger in a world that time forgot.
A Crime Branch Special Officer Investigates the Serial disappearance of high profile individuals in a state capital.

Hugo, Stan and Bérénice grew up together then grew apart. Now, 15 years later, they meet again in the mountain village of their childhood to bury Hugo's brother. The reunion will mark the beginning of an adventure and a new life.
The life of Rayenari, a Tarahumara native in northern Mexico, will suddenly change with the visit of a strange poet called Antonin Artaud.

The film is a sequel to evergreen Mammooty's gangster film Samrajyam that came out in 1990. The film plots the eventful life of Jordan who is forced to take charge of his father's empire after 23 years.

In an attempt to reconnect with her estranged sister, Megan invites her along on a camping trip to a park they frequented as children. The trip turns deadly when a Creature emerges from the depths of Sherwood Lake.

A reporter witnesses a brutal murder and becomes entangled in a mystery involving a pair of Siamese twins who were separated at birth, one of them forced to live under the eye of a watchful, controlling psychiatrist.
In a world where the past does not exist in a city that oppresses its subject who completely block out the past...the only hope is to unleash the ancient book.
After a college student disappears, the authorities discover her case involves a sinister motive.

A blind detective is determined to deliver justice to the man who shot him. His failed assassin, who has broken out of jail, is equally determined to finish the job. A gritty and clever thriller based on the novel by Peter Goldsworthy.
Detective tries to figure out who killed a man who predicted his own death.
Out-of-luck youth gets a lift from a girl shoplifter whose car he had planned to steal. They become involved in crime and romance together.
The madam of a brothel agrees to let the police setup surveillance in her business to catch a criminal, in exchange for immunity.
A thief pockets a mobile phone without realizing that something sinister has made the device its home.

Aspiring college cheerleader Cassie Stratford consumes an experimental drug that grants her beauty and enough athletic ability to make the cheer squad. It has an unforeseen side effect - she starts to grow and grow and grow.
A twisted violent gang drama set in Los Angeles.
A young man will go to any extent for the girl he loves. He is asked to stay in a haunted house to demystify strange events.

synopsis: Join Mariposa & her new friend, Princess Catania, in this magical adventure to save the fairy land of Shimmervale. Together, the girls learn that with great friends, the sky is the limit!
