A forger is forced to work for a Nazi spy ring. His conscience gets the better of him, though, and he secretly conspires with the FBI to turn over the gang.
Determined to prove herself, a police officer must go undercover at a seedy lounge to catch a serial killer.
Twelve-year-old Mindy Ho inexpertly tries Taoist magic to fix her single mother's financial situation and seemingly hopeless romantic prospects.
A Group Of Teenagers Are Followed By A Human Hybrid That Can Almost Perfectly Copy The Appearance Of Anyone.
Two friends find their roommate dead on the morning of their moving day, throwing them into a race against time as they try to avoid cops, neighbors and an increasingly paranoid drug dealer.
A Manhattan doctor embarks on a bizarre, night-long odyssey after his wife's admission of unfulfilled longing.
They lost everything... but they will fight to the end.
A terrible pirate terrorizes the Antilles plundering ships, slaughtering their crews and selling women as slaves. One of the women asks Sansone for help.
Nandini's father agrees to her marriage with Ishwar. When an astrologer predicts that Ishwar is going to kill someone in 45 days, her father postpones the marriage.

A billionaire and his team with a private space exploration program, returns to Earth with an abducted extraterrestrial from a newly discovered alien planet, with hidden secrets of his own from this world.
The story of Togo, the sled dog who led the 1925 serum run despite being considered too small and weak to lead such an intense race.
An alcoholic blues player tries to sell his soul for talent in New Orleans, with disastrous results.
A man's wife was abducted by aliens ten years ago during a car accident which left him paralyzed from the waist down. Given up on life, he has become consumed with only one mission: finding his wife.
A family that hails from a village is struck by an unfortunate incident and gets into conflicts they never expected.
A love triangle turns deadly when a savvy hustler finds herself at a crossroads between a drug-dealing boyfriend and a better life.

movie_name: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
synopsis: Four best girlfriends hatch a plan to stay connected with one another as their lives start off in different directions: they pass around a pair of secondhand jeans that fits each of their bodies perfectly.
A team of paranormal investigators document the haunted Harland Manor, only to find themselves hunted by the ghosts that still dwell there.
Vijayalakshmi struggles to lead a normal life after the sudden death of her husband. However, meeting Preman, an auto rickshaw driver changes her life for the better.
For his birthday, Emperor Louis offers a reward to the tailor who designs the finest outfit for him to wear for his upcoming celebration.
A man's search for a stolen artifact leads him to the haunted town filled with Voodoo gangsters, masked adventurers, Depression-era private eyes and violent chiaroscuro women.
A young couple on the run takes the owner of a posh villa hostage after being surrounded by police, only to find that their ace in the hole is a dangerous serial killer.

movie_name: Fate/stay night [Heaven's Feel] III. spring song
synopsis: The final chapter in the Heaven's Feel trilogy. Angra Mainyu has successfully possessed his vessel Sakura Matou. It's up to Rin, Shirou, and Rider to cleanse the grail or it will be the end of the world and magecraft as we all know it.
Driven by personal tragedy and fitted with a wire, DS Alex Miller quickly develops an affinity with her new partner Douglas, a deeply corrupt officer and the man Miller has been recruited to stop.
A millionaire offers $10,000 to five people who agree to be locked in a large, spooky, rented house overnight with him and his wife.

Katherine Munroe and her guardian Anzu battle a continuous onslaught from The Corrupted while rumors stir of an ancient threat resurrected- a creature most foul who will stop at nothing to envelop the world in darkness.
At the turn of the century (1900) a young merchant is abducted by a group of brigands who are sheltered in a remote mountainous area of Greece aiming to extract ransom from his wealthy family.
A unusual comedy exploring the adversity of finding true love, 'Bridges Over Montreal' reveals five memorable first-dates, taking place on bridges in the romantic city of Montreal (in Canada).

An adventurous story about the famous alchemist Wilhelm Storitz. He dislikes the idea of the marriage of Marc and the local beauty Mira and so he uses his ability of being invisible to stand in the way of their wedding.
The revelry of an upscale Halloween party is shattered by gunshots as two armed robbers attempt to fleece the well-to-do patrons of their money and jewels.
A young knight intent on joining King Richard's crusaders pledges to lead a group of orphans to safety and to protect them from a notorious slaver.
A strangled prostitute is found outside the city of Mar del Plata. A detective, a journalist and a clairvoyant collaborate in a complex investigation that trigger other crimes.

After the evil Internet meme Momo causes her son to commit suicide, a vengeful mother goes onto the dark web to track his killers - but as she delves into the shadows she discovers that it's a journey that will ultimately corrupt her too.

A misfit high school senior meets some street people claiming to be the Greek Gods. They promise to help him find his first love - launching him on an adventure to discover who he really is, who he really wants, and how to get it all.
A man is cursed by seeing everything in slow motion.

Wang Xiao Gua works all day but still doesn't have a car or even a house. In the afterlife after his death, he was arranged to become a contestant for the variety show Hell Bank Presents " Running Ghost".

A young man must cope with involuntary telepathy, a potion-induced transformation, teleporting agents and a clone reincarnation, all while dodging an evil corporation that wants to harvest his brain for knowledge.
An otherworldly journey through a Europe in decline - a collection of darkly humorous, fantasy tales about ill-fated characters and doomed fortune.
Scar has escaped. John and Anthony must find Megan before its Too Late.
When an android replica of a boy is rejected by his aggrieved creator, he goes off to find his own identity in an adventure that would make him the greatest hero of his time.
After an apparent ship malfunction, two stranded astronauts revive their onboard computer, discovering her newfound ability to experience human emotions.
Two best friends are having a troubled friendship, and it all changes when a zombie apocalypse rises, and they stick together and have fun during the apocalypse.

Willie the woodworm and his family arrive on Noah's Ark by chance. When the flood hits, the Ark starts to leak and everyone put the blame on innocent Willie. He discovers that stowaway termites are behind the leaks and must stop them.
A young couple on a romantic weekend in the Australian bush are terrorised by a psychopathic family.
Famed artist RekRap releases a scavenger hunt app, which rewards the winner with his latest piece of artwork.
Astro City tracks superheroes Samaritan, Winged Victory, the Hanged Man and Jack-in-the-Box and their interactions with the people of the eponymous city.

After a rich young girl learns about a demon and it's terrible curse brought by her family for generations, she decides to go to her paternal village with her lover, and his friend, to find out the truth.
A luthier struggles to regain affection from a lost love and follows in the cursed footsteps of his competitor to do so.
A victim of a brutal attack finds a unique and beautiful therapeutic outlet to help him through his recovery process.
One of maverick director Ishii's best pictures.
A pensive man visits an empty house. A neighbor tells him the house is haunted but he ignores it. Park Jinseong's second feature that takes place in Jeju Island gazes into the pain of life.

The inhabitants of Blood River live by the mercy of Miss Isabella and her daughter, as long as they're loyal. But strangers to the town receive no such grace. When the rain of blood begins, the reign of blood will end.

Hoping his son will attend his alma mater, Judge Hardy agrees to let Andy look for work in New York for the summer before committing to start college. In the big city, Andy is confronted with the harsh realities of life and love.

After accidentally catching a gruesome murder on video, a photographer and a young hustler navigate the night streets of Los Angeles in pursuit of a serial killer who preys on the homeless-and who may not even be human.
After serving a year in prison for his activities as the leader of a street gang, Mu-gi begins an investigation into his brother's murder.
A very handsome man finds the love of his life, but he suffers an accident and needs to have his face rebuilt by surgery after it is severely disfigured.
The love affairs of four schoolkids: a romantic, a pragmatist, an airhead and a lothario.
The challenges of Uriel Goldstein a Jewish man in the Nazi Germany and a mexican artist Luciano in Berlin waging a symbolic battle between ideologies of our time.
After a tragic accident, a man conjures up a towering, vengeful demon called Pumpkinhead to destroy a group of unsuspecting teenagers.
After an Interpol operation in Italy, Michael attends a company dinner party when suddenly, the 50 guests are held hostage by 15-20 armed men for $150,000,000 there.
After Vivien discovers a cryptic message in her boyfriend's apartment, she decides to hire a detective. But before she can proceed, she first needs to change her identity.
A murdered body is discovered at a Gaming App launch party, guests grow suspicious of each other as they become players of the deadly game.

Two brothers fall on bad times due to lacking money, which means they only have a couple days to get the money together, in order to save their home. All while unaware that they are being chased by the bailiff Birger.
The misfits who work at a 24-hour copy center in Austin have their lives disrupted with a new hire - just as the owner blows into town with bad news: he is selling out to corporate America.

Preston Tylk is an ordinary guy living in Seattle. When he discovers that his wife, Emily, whom he adores, is having an affair, he is devastated. Storming out of the house, he returns later only to find her brutally murdered.
In this classic adaptation of Emile Zola's novel, a tortured train engineer falls in love with a troubled married woman who has helped her husband commit a murder.

Dobrinya Nikitich goes on a quest to save the royal niece and finds out whether his old friend Zmey Gorinich is loyal to him. During the adventures, he is accompanied by the royal messenger who's in love with the royal niece.
Marika Vargosh is a girl with a dark past and a difficult present. An orphan with no education, she is forced to work in a brothel in order to have enough to live on.
A psychopathic Japanese executive accidentally triggers a journalist's 'dark side'. They begin to connect over the Internet and make a complicated bond.
A diverse group of people go to what they presume is an uninhabited island to end their lives.
In the last days before Armaggeddon, three men must make one eternal choice: receive the mark of the devil or stand for Christ. This movie will make you think about your own life choices.

Rose nicknames a support group, run by new therapist Stephen, The Chocolate Club as everyone has issues that make them reach for something to sweet to soothe them. Faith, hope, love and friendship are explored on their journey.

Having endured his legendary twelve labors, Hercules, the Greek demigod, has his life as a sword-for-hire tested when the King of Thrace and his daughter seek his aid in defeating a tyrannical warlord.
Eight Israeli soldiers are sent on a mission to take control of an enemy missile base, but face a deadly counterattack.
"What Shadows Told Me", a Performance Documentary - Inspired by Marc Levy's "Le Voleur D'Ombres" [The Shadow Thief] , Created for and during Tainan Arts Festival, Tainan, Taiwan 2014.

Plop lives in the Melkherberg in the forest where everybody sits together to drink some milk and have cookies. Plop, Klus, Lui, Kwebbel, Smul en Sam love to dance and party. Together they encounter a lot of adventures.
A newspaper publisher and his Korean servant fight crime as vigilantes who pose as a notorious masked gangster and his aide.
After discovering the gates to hell are hidden within a neighbor's house, a boy, his dog and a demon friend try to outwit the home's owner. Based on the book by John Connolly.
Actual footage of Penitentes - a sect of Catholic religious fanatics who engage in self-flagellation - is combined with new footage about a murder.
A music-hall performer and her boyfriend find themselves caught up in the machinations of a trio of not particularly bright crooks.
A teenage time traveler falls in love with a girl from another era and the two must find a way to live together in the same time.

Wilbur the pig is scared of the end of the season, because he knows that come that time, he will end up on the dinner table. He hatches a plan with Charlotte, a spider that lives in his pen, to ensure that this will never happen.
A young Shaolin follower reunites with his discouraged brothers to form a soccer team using their martial art skills to their advantage.
Avery Paul, a disgraced boxer and ex-convict, is hired to abduct a runaway from a notorious drug house and return her safely to her family. But nothing goes as planned and nothing is what it seems.

If you can imagine Lethal Weapon with Mel Gibson and Danny Glover as younger, hotter ex-boyfriends, you'll have the basis for 'Hot Guys With Guns,' a modern take on the old-fashioned detective story. It's Chinatown meets Boystown.
A hotel business owner (Aadi Sai Kumar) is blackmailed by his partner (Jayaprakash Reddy) to repay his debt in order to save lives of hotel customers.
The greatest unlikely hero story never told. Henry Knox, a man who dared to achieve the impossible, and the Europeans who fought beside him to win America.
A young couple with a newborn baby don't realize that the nanny they hired is a magical nymph who sacrifices infants to an evil tree.

After a brief argument, a husband accidentally hits his wife leading to her death. Things goes murkier when a tough cop is suspecting him for the murder and the latter tries his best to evade the law.

movie_name: Spy Kids 4: All the Time in the World
synopsis: A retired spy is called back into action, and to bond with her new step-children, she invites them along for the adventure to stop the evil Timekeeper from taking over the world.
Psychotronic fantasy actioner featuring Superman, Tarzan and Ringo the Kid.
A district attorney rises to political success and the governorship but loses his sense of morality once he starts associating with the shadowy and perhaps diabolical Nick Beal.
While cleaning a new client's home, Christina and Brad discover something very suspicious.
All Might and Deku accept an invitation to visit I Island where they battle against a villain who takes the island hostage.
Professional assassin Serious Rogers seeks redemption by protecting a nanny and she'll kill anyone who gets in her way.
Policeman of the City of Perfection (where officially 'no one ever dies') becomes obsessed with a woman who manipulates him into killing a girl called Alice.

3 stories, 3 countries. Tibet, Mongolia, Siberia. Nomad children fill a hostile world with their wishes and their dreams. At major cross-roads in their lives, they are confronted by love, danger and death.
The unique view on the well-known story of Christ's death and resurrection, which we see with the eyes of brigand Barabbas who got away from death on the cross.
Prabhu an average suburban man for whom his family is everything. His life is turned upside down when his daughter Satya is possessed by the ghost of a little boy.
Eggs of the small but voracious alien creatures called Crites are left behind on earth and, after hatching, set their appetites on the small farm town of Grover's Bend.
A straight-laced Spanish man falls in love with a young foreigner.
Within the city limits of Devilin lies a home the towns folk call "Hell House". A house that was once the home of a family accused of mass murder. A family known as the Reapers.

movie_name: The Mystery of the Yellow Room
synopsis: Following the attempted murder of Mathilde, daughter of renowned Professor Stangerson, Joseph Rouletabille, a young reporter, accompanied by photographer Sainclair, visits the Château du Glandier to try and shed some light on the mystery.
Martin and Tania face their last battle.
A love triangle, involving the unhappily-married wife, her playwright husband and a guest who becomes her lover.
Based on the non-fictional novel "Dadagiri Dinagalu", an affluent youth is dragged into the 1980s Bangalore underworld to save his love from his conspiring father.
A young girl is targetted for murder by greedy relatives, but protected by a second-tier Hindu God!

The Mafia Ain't Dead is the dangerously enticing story about a washed-up boxer with a passion for the history of the Mafioso, who convinces his friends to successfully start their own mafia...Allegedly.
A veteran lineman takes an awe-struck young farmer under his wing, but problems arise when he introduces him to his occasional girlfriend, a pretty nurse.
A naive young American playboy in Hong Kong finds himself caught up in the middle of an international crime.

Sarah and Josh are married suburbanites. After a car accident, Sarah suffers blackouts. As her life spirals she hides a camera in her home and unlocks a horrific secret with far-reaching consequences.

As the sun is dying out, people all around the world build giant planet thrusters to move Earth out of its orbit and sail Earth to a new star system. Yet the 2500-year journey comes with unexpected dangers, and in order to save humanity, a group of young people in this age of a wandering Earth fight hard for the survival of humankind.

Fu Sheng plays the son of a man who is destined to die at the hands of a swordsman carrying a sword with a teardrop design forged into its blade. He believes that if he carries the sword then his father won't die.
A gangster in Harlem must rescue his ex-wife, who has been kidnapped by the Mafia.
A group of concert goers travel to the Coachella Music festival to have a weekend of fun. They weren't expecting a weekend of death and mayhem.
An Interpol agent suffers from a genetic mutation that transforms him into a dead ringer for the drug lord he's trying to capture.
Zoey and Frankie travel to New York to find a better life, but along the way they run into the psychopathic Bill Badd, who has just been released from prison and has all the locals in fear.
It is about a teenager from a Dalit (Oppressed caste) family, who lives at the village fringe, and falls in love with an upper caste girl.
A mad scientist turns himself into a half-man, half-bird monster to avenge the death of his ancestor.
Jaumet is about lo live his most unforgettable adventure. Traveling by car, he arrives in a village whose inhabitants are quite outlandishly, as if they were plunged in a rare carnival behavior.
As an antibiotic-resistant pandemic devastates the planet, the only safe place is in the air.
Two passionate twenty-somethings in an on-again / off-again relationship decide to road trip home together for the holidays.
Earthquakes in central Korea turn out to be the work of Yongary, a prehistoric gasoline-eating reptile that soon goes on a rampage through Seoul.
In a near future, a writer and a millionaire entrepreneur become unlikely friends when he hires the writer to put his childhood into prose, all in the hopes of finding his long lost love.

A pregnant daughter of the Annunaki Council refuses to ascend when her husband fails the Program and is ordered to return to the Garden called Earth. The fallout leaves them both running for their lives.
Phoenix Luk gets framed by the beautiful Mandy for the robbery of the emperor's treasure.
An ex Thai boxer, Nick, loses his job as bouncer, when he beats up a man forcing himself on Nomi, a trans woman singer. She hires him as bodyguard. He returns to the gym.
Abandoned by the love of his life, Santiago will get help from the people who loves him, even from an imaginary monster of his childhood.
A gang of opium smugglers, disguised as Taoist Priests transporting hopping corpses, are hired to transport a real dead body to it's final resting place.

Hannah is an ordinary girl with an ordinary life. But one day she meets the love of her life. But she finds out there are other people out there that like him too. Will she manage to get him? Or will she fail?
A retired U.S. Army Colonel living in England stumbles upon a spy ring when he shoots buckshot at a poacher during a hunt.
Love is forever. Especially in Paris.
A musician searches for the Master Flautist, a supernatural creature who is planning to blow up the world.
Set amongst the totally awesome 80's, this creature feature tells the morbid tale of a bachelor party gone to hell when an ancient curse is accidentally unleashed from the depths of Carpenter Lake.
Two loose-cannon narcotics cops investigate the flow of Ecstasy into Florida from a Cuban drug cartel.

movie_name: La véritable histoire du Chat Botté
synopsis: An adaptation of Charles Perrault's famous Puss'n Boots, "The True Story of Puss'n Boots" is a story for young and old for the first time on cinema screens.

Six months after the rage virus was inflicted on the population of Great Britain, the US Army helps to secure a small area of London for the survivors to repopulate and start again. But not everything goes according to plan.

Sex drugs and the outdoors. Turning 30 does Kit become a responsible women or keep following her hedonistic lifestyle thats leading to debt and destitution, as the party goes on forever. What does it take takes to grow up at 30?
An enormous spaceship hovers over Earth-this is a stadium, which hosts sports events that resemble soccer but at mind-boggling speeds. The name of the game is cosmoball.
When the Japanese Defense Minister is kidnapped on US soil, the FBI must race against the clock to save him and unravel an explosive international conspiracy.
A tough ex-marine joins a smuggler shipping arms to Chinese bandits. When his old outfit takes on the outlaws,he has a change of heart.
Alice, a psychological thriller poses battles between psychiatry and psychology, elements of roller derby and the iconic spirit of Halloween in a town called Bethlehem.

A troubled young woman, haunted by her mother's ghost, is suddenly confronted by paranormal events which are wreaking havoc on her small college town. She struggles to understand the meaning of these supernatural events...
It is about a woman with memory loss faced with the challenge of survival on a mysterious island.
A young girl travels west to live with her uncle during the California Gold Rush only to find that he has been killed by Indians and his identity assumed by an outlaw.
Finally the earth is ruled by the Kingdom of the Father in heaven.
In a major murder case, jurors are threatened and attacked. One of them disappears, and the detective Joe Keats looking for the guilty.
A provocative drama about a young woman who experiences the most significant change in her life.

A man in London tries to help a counter-espionage agent, but when the agent is killed and the man stands accused, he must go on the run to save himself and stop a spy ring that is trying to steal top-secret information.
A group of criminals commit several simultaneous robberies in different casinos.
The hunt for the empire's gold continues.

In November 1984, the Soviet Union's best submarine captain violates orders and heads for the U.S. in a new undetectable sub. The American CIA and military must quickly determine: Is he trying to defect or to start a war?

Six complete strangers are forced to band together and flee the city when a zombie outbreak occurs. But after making camp in the middle of the wilderness, the group realise it's each other they should fear.

Hinsa par Vijay is a film that depicts a journalist finding out that the holy book Gita is being misinterpreted by criminals supporting their acts of revenge as Dharm Yudh. And how a Brahmakumari Didi busts their myths and transforms them.
A Danish count invites his showgirl girlfriend to meet his family at their estate in the countryside. Her platonic friend, who at times looks after her baby, ends up employed as butler there.
An investigative reporter following an espionage story goes to London and gets involved with murder, scam artists and rock concerts.
In New York City, a young counterfeiter is introduced to the world of underground street fighting by a seasoned scam artist, who becomes his manager on the bare-knuckling brawling circuit.
Golgo 13 is assigned to murder a man named Boss Goa.
Two righteous heroes must team up to take on the murderous thieves who stole the famous Jade Monk statuette.
A TV production crew becomes the target of a deranged serial killer while making a mystery investigation documentary in their home town.
A group of degenerate serial date rapists have the tables turned on them when a masked killer begins to hunt them down one by one, and killing them in the most painful, degrading way possible.
A mutated rat has been let loose in a city.
A young man is forced onto a life-long journey through the land of Ihatov, ending with his work as a geologist at a volcano.
The crew of an Air Force bomber arrives in Pearl Harbor in the aftermath of the Japanese attack on December 7, 1941, and is sent on to Manila to help with the defense of the Philippines.
A beautiful partnership with picture perfect chemistry turned vicious rivalry.
The final sixty-seven days of Van Gogh's life are examined.
A surfer working in a home for the mentally impaired takes 2 patients on a day trip to the beach that has horrific results.
Set in a futuristic London, a band of thieves looks to restore hope to the city's impoverished population.
Episodic look at the life of a minister and his family as they move from one parish to another.
Follows a family who escapes to a small island running from a mysterious phenomenon that led to mass chaos, but their troubles are only beginning.

Gina is the dedicated nurse of Paul Dupré, a wealthy industrialist who has been treated for heart problems. Dupré dies brutally during an injection made by Gina, and immediately his wife Catherine accuses Gina.
Following hired assassin Floyd Lawton also known as Deadshot.
Two strangers meet in a park bench.they talk silly things then share personal things to each other soon it become cat and mouse game

After bringing a fossilized egg back to life with the Time Cloth, Nobita finds himself the owner of a baby dinosaur. Everything is fine until it grows up. Nobita and friends use Doraemon's time machine to return it back to its own time.

movie_name: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
synopsis: The Fantastic Four learn that they aren't the only super-powered beings in the universe when they square off against the powerful Silver Surfer and the planet-eating Galactus.

The Intellectual is a guy who has fun reading, thinking, and painting and tries to make grading papers entertaining even though it is a bit of a dull job. He is restless due to these great hobbies and dumb chores.

When a pill that gives its users unpredictable superpowers for five minutes hits the streets of New Orleans, a teenage dealer and a local cop must team with an ex-soldier to take down the group responsible for its creation.

When a teenager moves to a new town in the USA, a secret reveals. He starts a quest to find out about this dark secret that was many years hidden in the house he moved in, as his family starts acting strangely.
A proposal. A dinner. A stranger.
The story of Sidi, who lives in a run down neighborhood in the Malaysian city of Johor Bahru near the prospering Singapore, is told through seemingly ordinary moments in his life.
A documentary filmmaker explores seemingly unrelated paranormal incidents connected by the legend of an ancient demon called the "kagutaba."
Some places should never have been found.

Kat Abernathy must live up to her family name by attending law school and working for her family practice, until she is challenged to create a second identity for herself in order to pursue, defend and protect her passion as a painter.
Parents' sorrow after the murder of their artist son.
The fantastic adventures of little redheaded Dot in the Australian bush.
On December 31st, the Earth will be destroyed. Everything you know will become nothing. Maybe it already has.
Follows two police officers at a small wireless police station on the hilltop as they work to resolve the mystery about a woman's body parts that have been scattered all over Elaveezhapoonchira.
In future Japan, a dangerous pollen falls upon Tokyo, endangering its populace. Two people volunteer to become tests subject for a drug that could possibly provide a cure.
A crime repeats its pattern after 25 years .Is it the same killer or a new psycho on the streets?

Andrea arrives in Cuba to find out the truth about the death of his brother, the victim of a mysterious plane crash. He will face an unknown reality, and above all he will have to deal with the beautiful Alma, his brothers widow.
Five college students try to go camping at RokSaw trails as a last memory before they go their separate ways in life, but a cult group known as "The Lamb" shows up, and starts slaughtering everyone.
Two neighboring Indian kingdoms are ruled by cousins - King Ranjit and King Sohat. Unbeknownst to Ranjit, Sohat is plotting to seize control of his kingdom.
The world learns that an earth-shattering meteorite will arrive in 72 hours.
Keep Calm...and Stay Alive.
A mysterious woman appears before social media CEO Brad and tempts him into signing a privacy-violating contract before the end of the day.
A small town widow (Camille Keaton) faces a grisly confrontation with her would-be extortionists.
A story for two urban guys, who enter the mythical world of samodivas, on a quest to save the Earth.

A giant egg is unearthed at a construction site and soon opened, releasing the terrible Ivan Ooze, who wreaks vengeance on Zordon for imprisoning him millennia ago. With Zordon dying and their powers lost, the Rangers head to a distant planet to find the mystic warrior Dulcea.

movie_name: Mobile Suit Gundam Thunderbolt: December Sky
synopsis: Follows the decisive battles in Thunderbolt sector around the debris of Side 4 during the One Year War, between Earth Federation's prototype Full Armor Gundam and Zeon's prototype Psycho Zaku.

A talking dog befriends a boy after being rescued from dog smugglers. Later the dog gets jealous seeing his friend with a girl and her dog, and due to the dog's recklessness the dog smugglers succeeded in taking him away.
Sidelined at a very young age due to stammering, the eldest of identical triplets develops hatred for his younger brothers and creates havoc in their lives as they all reunite as adults.

movie_name: Thunderbolt Fantasy: The Sword of Life and Death
synopsis: This separates seasons one and two of Thunderbolt Fantasy. This adventure fills in backstory and provides a kind of a recap for season one.
A small time thug collecting debts for the local triad is torn between his criminal aspirations and his devotion to family.

movie_name: Ships That Pass in the Night
synopsis: In Switzerland an architect and a suffragist schoolteacher fall in love at a TB sanatorium.
Love connections are crossed in this convoluted tale of three young orphans and the affairs of their hearts.
When Alison takes a job at a new vintage clothing store in town, she soon realizes that there's something strange about the store manager and that the clothing displays are more than meets the eye.
In the year 2039, 5 astronauts are stranded on the new international space station after a meteor blast has possibly wiped out all life on Earth.
Edwin is a cop who goes undercover at an art gallery owned by a girl named Kenny, who's suspected of having some connection to a series of murders.
After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.
A biographer of a renowned crime writer finds real darkness behind the fiction.

Janet Gaynor plays a rebellious princess who must try to marry the man she loves, instead of the stuffy old prince her parents want her to marry. But will this ordinary man love her back once he finds out she's a princess?
A psychiatrist goes to an animal hospital to debark his dog, but encounters an evil mime that preys on the animal abusers who try to hurt their pets.

The San Bernardino National Forest becomes a war zone when two veterans seek revenge for the slaying of their fellow troop-mates. They brought this battle on themselves but the hunted are now the hunters.

When mysterious teen Decebal strikes up a friendship with elderly, hospital caretaker Milos, it soon becomes apparent he is no ordinary young man and that they share a deadly secret connecting them to a string of local bloody murders.
A woman is possessed by the Angel Of Death and marries a rich business man in order to acquire his soul.
Slip confronts a monopolizing taxicab company whose criminal tactics aim to drive its rivals out of business.
An overprotective brother, who wants to keep his five sisters safe from the cruel world, faces antagonism from them after they turn against him.
A wife learns her husband has another wife but stays with him for her children's sake.
Legendary luchador, Mil Mascaras, faces unbelievable horrors when the vengeful head of an Aztec chief is resurrected on a college campus.
A Science Fiction Thriller about a mysterious jewel that appears in our dimension, its dangerous power leaves the fate of the world in the hands of a few teenagers.
A man who had a heart attack and a woman waiting in line for a heart transplant; were taken to the hospital on the same day.
When Ivan meets his new friends in another place called Belogorie, his quest on the new country begins with sparkling immortals effect within love in the pass from his childhood up on his time .
A crooked sheriff in a small Southern town frames an ex-convict in a drug bust and takes his girlfriend.
A 1997 fantasy film based on Steve Szilagyi's 1992 novel, Photographing Fairie.

Lucius, a Roman architect, is transported through time to modern-day Japan, where he learns about Japanese bathhouses and uses this to his gain back home.
Bank robbers spark a shootout with a heavily-armed police force during a notoriously deadly heist in 1980.
A woman looks to a cop for help against her abusive husband, who constantly rapes, beats, and belittles her and her son, but the husband catches wind of the cop's plan.

Vincent and Agathe live together since many years. They're not married. Vincent had to move to Nice because of some professional projects. Agathe keeps living in Paris. Now Agathe discovers she's pregnant. Must they marry?
You Can Stay Here explores the dark secrets of a haunted school, where the creative and paranormal activities can't peacefully so-exist.

A secret apparatus that controls bombs by remote control is stolen from a laboratory. A federal agent is assigned to recover it, and his investigation leads him to a creepy mansion that is honeycombed with secret passage ways.
A group of outlaws come together to resist an oppressive government.
A movie sound mixer working on a low budget film is unappreciated by almost everyone. As he starts to lose his grasp on reality and his life spirals downwards, he finally snaps and takes revenge.

The Japanese government suppresses the horrifying news of Godzilla's resurrection as political tensions increase between the United States and Soviet Union, both of whom are willing to bomb Japan to stop the monster.
An undocumented immigrant, deported from the only home he's ever known, risks everything to make it back over the border.

A young heiress leads a life of excess and wants to marry a man her rich father despises. When her father suspiciously dies, and someone tries to kill her, she surrounds herself with her cousins, friends and lovers, all possible suspects.

A speeding ambulance abducts three beautiful young women to a sinister medical center where someone is making a killing selling healthy human organs on the black market. The title stands for Body Organ Replacement Network.
A college boy is framed for for drug dealing by a political leader and a corrupt cop.This incident uproots his normal,simple life and he starts walking on the path that he is accused of.
After the Earth is ravaged by an evil virus, we rely on the one creature that was a myth our entire lives to save us.

movie_name: The X Files: I Want to Believe
synopsis: Mulder and Scully are called back to duty by the FBI when a former priest claims to be receiving psychic visions pertaining to a kidnapped agent.
"Ahmed" decide to marry his university's friend "ahra" and be honest with his parents in his desire to marry, but his father refuses because he was still a student.
Within a time span of five days, a wealthy but dysfunctional family implodes through its four members' narcissism, mental instability and traumatic past, destroying their personal and social lives.
In the fourth installment of the 'Leyenda' saga, Leo San Juan and his gang will take on the Chupacabras.
A mother and daughter fight a minister for possession of their new home.
A scientist creates a beautiful "perfect woman", but since she is artificial, she seems soul-less and with no sense of morality, she brings ruin to all around her.
In the old city of Vienna, a young rebellious girl discovers, that she is part of a new species named: Cell reader. Knowing that she is half human half Cell reader, she is forced to choose a side.
An upstanding businessman is forced to seek revenge when an associate of his is murdered.

Medieval Vampire Horror on a Planet Ruled over by the Vampire King worlds oldest and most cruel vampire, his chained female servants terrorize as Soelene the outcast finds mortal love taking care of her sick human Mother.
Pipa begins her career as a police detective alongside her mentor, the controversial detective Francisco Juánez. Together they must solve the violent murder of a 19-year-old girl.
Europe after the outbreak of the Black Death - an ascetic Monk falls in love with the Devil.
An irresponsible guy locks horns with one of his relatives in a election.

A Dutch teenager is unaware of who or where he is. Police chase him. He gets a notebook describing himself as a student who helped a cute girl hack, got caught, and was punished with special training camp. What happened to him then?
A mob boss (James cell) finds out his wife gets killed, seeks revenge but things take a dangerous turn.
After a successful heist, Porter is left for dead. Once he recovers, he seeks vengeance and wants his share of the money.

movie_name: Department Q: The Keeper of Lost Causes
synopsis: Police inspector Carl Mørck is put in charge of a department of cold cases, joined only by his assistant Assad. They dig into a case about a missing woman.
In the aftermath of a war fought by magnetic weapons which caused massive earthquakes, a young and spunky boy named Conan gets involved in a grand adventure. A condensed version of the TV series.
Two thieves take control of an ancient weapon designed to defend the canal city of Altomare.
Hideyuki Mitamura, a student at a private school near Osaka, is kidnapped on his way home from school.
An unhinged, deceptively mild-mannered bank robber escapes prison, seeking revenge on the cop who accidentally killed his wife during a gun battle.
A married couple is dealing with a marriage crisis and therefore seeks the help of a couples therapist.

Set in a fantasy-medieval context, Mystikal shows the adventure of Eldyn, an apprentice magician rather clumsy and innocent, in which he gets involved in troubles due of a "small" error. He must repair the damage done, with the help of Fira.

movie_name: The Manchu Eagle Murder Caper Mystery
synopsis: A chicken hatchery owner (and novice private eye) tries to solve the arrow murder of local milkman, philanderer and animal fetishist.
When an island populated by happy, flightless birds is visited by mysterious green piggies, it's up to three unlikely outcasts - Red, Chuck and Bomb - to figure out what the pigs are up to.
10 short films by 10 different directors. 10 different kinds of adrenaline.
Mankind is dying. Only one man can do anything about it, Space Captain Harlock, but the Gaia Coalition will stop at nothing to end him.

A loner struggles with childhood tragedy. Seeking refuge, he immerses himself in martial art films. A life changing moment releases unknown abilities, taking him closer to solving the mystery of his past. But the truth will come at a cost
Story of anxious Peter (12) and his sister Verity (9), taken underground by a garrison of armoured pangolin.
An exploration of what happens on the infamous Devil's Night, which is the night before Halloween.
In the early 1960's, a group of people responsible for the construction of the Brasilia-Fortaleza road is abandoned in the middle of the jungle by the Brazilian government, after the military coup.
A young woman struggling with grief in a disjointed family, meets a boy that turns her life into the fairy-tale she always wished it to be.
The sensual side of Cirque du Soleil, presents a seductive, temptation-filled dimension of reality where jests and taboos titillate curiosity, blending burlesque and cabaret styles.
Victor Fortunetti is the lead player in a white slavery ring. Business is doing well until Asian mobsters muscle in on his turf. Then he becomes a crazed psychotic bent on revenge.
A Parisian tailor finds himself posing as a baron in order to collect a sizeable bill from an aristocrat, only to fall in love with an aloof young princess.
The story about a Bedouin boy, who became a Prince of Arabia.
Romance and comedy collide as a competitive family embarks upon an engaging holiday challenge adventure of a lifetime. Inspired by actual events.
Toby is a teenager who doesn't care much about school. In fact, he has his eyes on the title of a prestigious dog-sleigh race. He will have to undergo extensive training in order to win it.
An extraordinary musician. Blind from birth with no hope of ever seeing the world.
An unconventional love. A horrifying crime unfolds. Mind-blowing revenge-sex or serene forgiveness? Find out the hard way.
Byeong-gu believes that the world is on the verge of an alien invasion, and sets out to save the world.

Two friends try to re-unite by going on a road-trip to the forests and mountains. Their attempt to reconcile does not go easy due to the secrets they hold, and a shocking revelation ends their journey.
While working on a cold case, a sheriff discovers a cult in a small sleepy town.
Tom Sawyer and his pal Huckleberry Finn have great adventures on the Mississippi River, pretending to be pirates, attending their own funeral and witnessing a murder.
In a highly regimented boarding school, a pair of students discover that things are not as they seem.

On a stormy Saturday afternoon, six students from Crestview Academy begin to meet horrible fates as they serve out their detentions. Is a fellow student to blame, or perhaps Crestview's alleged ghosts are behind the terrible acts?
A man discovers a video reciting an ancient myth his mother read to him just before she disappeared. As it turns out the young woman who posted that video has gone missing as well.
The plot is undisclosed at this time.
In 1970, drug-fueled Los Angeles private investigator Larry "Doc" Sportello investigates the disappearance of a former girlfriend.
Two lovers on the lam battle rogue FBI agents, the mafia and mysterious creatures in 1940's Las Vegas.
A man takes an opportunity for revenge when he's asked to join a series of heists in the same territory as the men that betrayed and murdered his father years ago..
Lakshmi marries Ajay against the wishes of his parents. When Ajay and his family accuse Lakshmi of having an affair, Sivanna, her brother, decides to step in.

movie_name: The Amazing Metamorphosis of Juan Perez
synopsis: Juan Pérez is an average chilean that one day becomes in hero that ends in the worst way ever.
When a futuristic narcotic threatens to destroy his community, a Martian real estate agent goes to war with the corrupt business oligarch peddling this toxic drug on Mars.
A young prodigy's science experiment goes horribly wrong when he accidentally brings it to life.
Tom Sawyer and Huckleberry Finn investigate a suspicious graveyard murder and more in this musical version of Mark Twain's novel.
When a friend from his yakuza past gets released from prison, a loan shark and his former-male-host sidekick help the ex-con get back on his feet.

An independent 12 year old girl named Three is home alone late one night when her house is invaded by several masked intruders. While trying to escape from them she learns of a far more dangerous threat waiting outside.

Nine high school friends have a five-year reunion camping in a forest. They all have secrets. An unknown person straps a time bomb to each of them. Killing another gives one their time. Last one lives.
A mad scientist, plots to conquer the world by using a serum that can turn ordinary animals into giants.

In the last days of WWII, Germany, desperate for any last grasp to defeat the allied powers, formed together the German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, for one last mission, to attack the United States Homeland.
A paranormal adventure story told through still image photography and audio.
A swashbuckling adventure which takes place in the mid-1800's on the South Pacific islands where bloody raids and battles were once the rule of the day.
Feature adaptation of William Shakespeare's play 'The Tempest'.
After the death of his wealthy uncle, and with his inheritance at stake, Heir Pennington becomes involved in a balloon race.
While preparing for a camping trip, Fred Flintstone is enlisted by the Bedrock Secret Service to capture a criminal mastermind after a spy who looks like him is injured on the job.
An origin story of the mythical wizard from his boyhood in Wales through his training as a young man and ultimate role as defender of the natural world and mentor to King Arthur.
Satya, a college student, is smitten with Jyothi. But he is unable to express his romantic feelings for her. He gets into depression and when his friends learn about this, they plan a reunion.
Animated version of the classic story of a young farmgirl who is transported to the magic land of Oz.

Fabiola, a 40 years old woman, travels to a little island to visit her mother. Her intuition tells her that nothing is like it seems and the secrets could be linked to an accident that, many years ago, changed her life

Tarzan secretly arrives in Blue Valley, the land of the magical fountain of youth, to find the intrepid aviatrix who can save an innocent man. But, is she the same person she used to be? Can Tarzan protect the vale's ultimate mystery?
These sweet young fellas have now turned into young men, yet there is still danger lurking for them from their past - AND in their future. Time travel has consequences.
Dead Sunrise is about a group of friends that find a research lab in the woods only to unleash little flesh eating children onto the world.
Four friends studying in an engineering college unintentionally end up becoming a part of caste politics led by corrupt politicians.

A patient escapes from a lunatic asylum and runs into a woman being chased by an apparently indestructible maniacal cackling goon who works for a mysterious mobster. He decides to help her, but nothing is what it seems. Not even the past.
The death of a girl in the construction of a hospital will trigger a desperate search to communicate with the afterlife by a journalist.

A mentally-challenged guy was put into trial after allegedly raping his teacher. And as Amanda, Julian, and Ronald try to mount a convincing defense, they discover soon that they're all connected in more ways than just the case.
Strange happenings occur on a WW II submarine.
Unemployed cowhand Jim Garry is hired by his dishonest friend Tate Riling as muscle in a dispute between homesteaders and cattleman John Lufton.
12 year old Xiao Dou becomes close to his step-grandfather.

movie_name: Kamen Rider Build: Be the One
synopsis: After Japanese Civil War, the newly appointed governors of each region: Seito, Hokuto, and Touto now support each other in their mission to reunify Japan, however they are secretly members of Evolto's home clan known as the Blood Tribe.
Parents' sorrow after the murder of their artist son.
Peggy Sue faints at a high school reunion. When she wakes up, she finds herself in her own past, just before she finished school.

A young couple, physiologist Agla and filmmaker Gunnar wake up at a glacier camp to find the camp mysteriously abandoned and their co-workers gone. When searching for the lost team they realize they're up against an unknown deadly force.
When a classical dancer's suspecting wife sets an investigator behind him, a series of violent events are triggered, revealing his real identity and connection to a darker world.

movie_name: A Close Call for Boston Blackie
synopsis: Sleuth Blackie is framed for murder but manages to catch the culprit.

movie_name: Arthur Prescott and the Evil Alien
synopsis: Arthur, a trust fund baby with a trust fund family, develops amnesia when he's hit in the head by a stray golf ball. Through a series of hilarious mishaps, he's taken hostage by an alien named Lola, who is planning to destroy the universe.

Marie lives with her son,Guillaume ,a deficient teenager,according to psychologists .The boy ,expelled from high school,cannot find a steady job.Marie's relationship with her son has reached a dead end .
When a high school student starts dating a rebellious boy from a different school, she quickly finds herself in the crosshairs of someone trying to break them up - or hide a dangerous secret.
A transgender teenage girl on summer vacation in Los Angeles fights to survive after she falls in with four queer feminist vampires, who try to rid the city's streets of predatory men.
A salaryman and yakuza are each sent by their bosses to a remote Chinese village but discover more than they expected.
Arsène Lupin decides to run a detective agency in addition to being a gentleman thief. As a detective he happens to cooperate with police in order to unveil the criminal activities of a villain.
An animated adventure of the classic Pink Panther character.
The spirit of a recently deceased man hunts down nine people who attended his wake in the Philippines, but ignored some important superstitions.
The lives of a few gangsters in Kanyakumari.
A recently released felon seeks revenge against those who framed him and put him in jail.

A traveler is confronted by spirits in an abandoned shrine; a story of honor and firefighting in ancient Japan; a white bear defends the royal family from a monstrous red demon; ragtag soldiers battle a robotic force in futuristic Japan.

Ambitious but diminutive motorcycle cop John Wintergreen patrols the Arizona highways, yearning for promotion to the homicide division. Thanks to his revelation that a supposed suicide is actually a murder, his wish is granted.
A shy woman, endowed with the speed, reflexes, and senses of a cat, walks a thin line between criminal and hero, even as a detective doggedly pursues her, fascinated by both of her personas.

A gritty tale about two odious drug dealers, Sal and Mitch, on a mission to find their stolen cocaine. Follow them on their pursuit, as they leave behind a disturbing path of Chaos, Death and Destruction.
A workaholic architect is summoned to an island to help plan and build a very safe community but soon has second thoughts about the project.
James Bond investigates the mid-air theft of a space shuttle, and discovers a plot to commit global genocide.

Three friends must discover what's behind the killings of local children, the victims drew the same picture before they died. They uncover the evil spirit of a circus clown and must send it back to hell before more children are murdered.
When a nurse is found murdered, the doctor she worked for is accused of the crime. A reporter, who's attracted to the doctor's daughter, sets out to prove his innocence.

Teen tech whiz Danny must pull off an old-school ATM scam to buy his freedom from a crime boss, but when the proceeds go missing, he's the prime suspect. Tied up in a warehouse for interrogation, he'll need real-world ingenuity to escape.
A maid helps her employers climb the social ladder and has a secretive interest in one particular socialite.
An elderly baker must smuggle a giant loaf of bread filled with drugs in order to save the life of his estranged son.

movie_name: Gaia, Envoy to the Council of the Fourth Dimension
synopsis: A time-traveling guardian must save Earth

In the year 1999, A scientist who has the ability to see the future builds a time machine to pull his son from the year 2021 back in time to give him the mission to eradicate the serial project that will destroy the world in the future.
Humans in a fascist, militaristic future wage war with giant alien bugs.
After running away from his home, Kumar falls in with a gang and slowly rises through the ranks of the criminal underworld.
Determined teen Din is longing to reconnect with his childhood best friend when he meets a wish-granting dragon who shows him the magic of possibilities.
Four guys on a stag weekend in London, what could possibly go wrong.

movie_name: Little Grey Fergie Saves the Farm
synopsis: The little farm is in danger of being overrun by a motorway plan, but Little Grey Fergie and Gustav gets an idea to make the soil more fertile.

All the governments that have ruled the nation made laws that denied the indigenous people their way of life and their land often, protecting crony capitalist interests. The film revisits an episode of dissent in the 90s which brought up this question amongst us. A history forgotten!
1930's: Adam and Leroy tries to rob a cafe, but finds out that two girls are already trying to do the same. Instead of arguing with them they join them in a robbery-spree.
A young lawyer takes extreme measures as he vies for a promotion, while his fiancée's life begins to unravel after she meets someone new.
Based on the book, "Kidnapped by the Cartel" by Karen D. Scioscia - about the dangers that lurk in the drug underworlds in Mexico.
A Bombay cop tries to track down a serial killer who snipes at random victims.
Secrets may break us. Love makes us whole.
When a girl goes missing, a woman with a mysterious past tracks down the people responsible.
A masseur navigates a virtual limbo where he doesn't know what is real, what is a dream or what is fantasy.
The new owner of a sinister house gets involved with reanimated corpses and demons searching for an ancient Aztec skull with magic powers.

Nyatollah is a rich stingy guy who loves money. One day when he goes to the court to do a job for a friend he is thrown from the roof. This is the beginning of his acquaintance with Djin and the beginning of his adventure.
An adoption search triggers an espionage nightmare, forcing a former spy out of hiding to save the son he and his wife were forced to abandon years ago when his top-secret mission turned deadly.
When all else fails, how far would you go to succeed?
During an AI invasion that banished all living beings - one man, two women and a baby were forgotten.
A wannabe professional thief, his gay best friend, a sexy hostage, some thugs and a mystery package everyone wants.
Set in future, the protagonist is triggered by her rebellious love interest.
A bored young student falls for the young secretary of his rich friend's father. She senses some good in him and tries to make him discard his aimless lifestyle.
A guilt-ridden father must capture a brutal killer to prove the innocence of a convicted murderer - the last man alive who can lead him to his kidnapped son.
A depressed psychiatrist wakes up as a patient in the asylum where she worked, with no memory of why she is there or what she has done.
On Christmas Eve, Mauro, a reporter, has 24 hours to find a headine.
Alvaro and his friends try to scam a Dominican crime lord in order to pay off a debt to a Russian mobster.
Numerous plot lines intersect in this comedic romp about a female Victoria-carriage driver who disguises herself as a boy, and the hunt for the stash of diamonds hidden in her Victoria.

Marianne is a successful journalist in a big newspaper. When her father takes ill, and asks her back home to find a box in the attic containing papers he wants her to burn before reading. But she reads, and then tries to solve the mystery.
A mute woman finds herself at the center of a series of murders in the mountains of Spain, which police suspect are being committed by a drug-addled Satanist.
A young girl finds herself possessed by the spirit of a mischievous demon.

The Bumstead family dog, Daisy, becomes a top dog-model, and receives so much acclaim that she comes to the attention of a gangster's girl friend, who persuades the gang to kidnap Daisy for ransom. Blondie and Dagwood go to Daisy's rescue.
It's time to gather the Apostles to come up with a master plan and retire from public life as the Messiah by robbing the bank of Sepphoris.
John is kicked out from home by his girlfriend and moves in with his friend Max. After many entanglements Max's girlfriend Eva begins to favor John over Max.
A film producer challenges a group of bloggers to come up with a script for a potboiler. Will the bloggers win the challenge?

A wild stallion is captured by humans and slowly loses the will to resist training, yet, throughout his struggles for freedom, the stallion refuses to let go of the hope of one day returning home to his herd.

A royal descendant of an ancient winged tribe embarks on a quest to find magical pearls. When they fall into the hands of a human, he joins a team of unlikely heroes in a race against time to prevent the destruction of his people.
A security expert is sent to a remote scientific camp to investigate strange things that are happening.
An aspiring writer must find a way to kick-start his writing career at a writing festival. But a mind-bending pathogen that has infected most of the attendees gets in the way.
En route to Normandy, an American and a British officer reminisce in flashback about their romances with the same woman.
An orphaned brontosaurus teams up with other young dinosaurs in order to reunite with their families in a valley.
On the run from authorities, a sleazy courier poses as a Scout leader on a camping trip. But he has no idea what he's in for when he must actually take charge of a group of kids.
PABLO SAMO, WHOSE TRUE-TO-LIFE STORY IS THE SUBJECT OF THIS FILM, WAS A BARANGAY CAPTAIN AND A DREADED VIGILANTE FROM CAVITE.

A sadistic and brutal killer who distorts the scriptures to suit his own self serving madness teams up with a run-away drifter who bows to his every command, both for love and for fear of her own life.
Four Engineering students take it as their duty to fight against injustice in their own peculiar way believing that they have to react to any social prejudices that they come across.

Tightly-wound Ellie flies to Australia and enlists the help of an Aboriginal Tour Guide and a YouTube-famous Uber driver to find her husband and his eclectic family, and find her true self along the way, all before Christmas.
Flying monsters that young Masha has seen in visions suddenly attack her and a group of young magicians. A stranger saves her at the last minute.
Takes place on the world of Indian mythology.

A delirious roman porno re-imagining of Seijun Suzuki's 'Branded to Kill'. Directed by Atsushi Yamatoya and scripted by Yôzô Tanaka, both 'Branded to Kill's' screenwriters and Suzuki's regular collaborators.

movie_name: Murderous Leader to Human Rights Activist: A Leap of Faith
synopsis: When Tony Blair made his conversion from Protestant to Catholic one had to wonder, was he seeking greater redemption for the war on Iraq?
Drug dealer Zong Yanfeng wants revenge on the police officer who killed his sister.
Donnie Darko's little sister Samantha and her best friend Corey are on a cross-country road trip, but soon find themselves entangled in a dangerous glitch in the time-space continuum.

movie_name: Fat Guy with a Shotgun: Hillbilly Prophecy
synopsis: When the apocalypse begins, all that can stop Hell on Earth is a Fat Guy with a Shotgun
A story of a woman who fights against the ruthless world of man's society, to protect her only son.

Two modern day Nostradamus Descendants sent on a divine mission to prevent World War III caused by two rival NWO secret societies, use supernatural mental powers and alien help to save earth in a pivotal battle of good and evil.
A squad of American soldiers hunt down a suspected spy that escaped an internment camp during WWII.
A girl develops a bond with a flying bed before discovering that it might have murdered her brother.
Aliens kidnap two children and take them to another planet for the purpose of getting knowledge from their brains, but Gamera follows and tries to rescue them.
Iemon Tamiya is an impoverished master-less samurai who craves a better life, which he cannot have because of his marriage to Oiwa, who is completely devoted to her husband.

After being bullied, Debbie Lavani relocates to a new school only to find her past has come to haunt her. New friends Phil, Veronica and Adele show Debbie that what we learn from the past makes us stronger in the present.

A group of wayward astronauts returning from a long mission to Ganymede crash land on a planet very much like earth. The problem is that the mysterious inhabitants are murderous lunatics out to kill every one of them... or so it seems.
Aurora is a feature film based on the true of story of Dr. Lynne Fenton, the psychiatrist who treated the Aurora theater shooter.

Colton's friend Lucas recruits him to transport a top-secret package from California to New Mexico. Unaware of the package contents, he is ambushed by foreign agents and a news media crew trying to expose military secrets.
In Istanbul, retired CIA operative Bryan Mills and his wife are taken hostage by the father of a kidnapper Mills killed while rescuing his daughter.
A jockey transforms an injured colt into a champion Thoroughbred after saving it from the glue factory.
The story of a brother and sister who, overcoming the difficulties of growing up, are trying to prevent their parents from divorce.

An episode film initiated by Erik Borge, the fresh director of Norwegian Film, giving fresh film makers a chance of being seen by a big audience. Anja Breien, Egil Kolstø and Espen Thorstensons got the chance with very diverse films.
In 1862, the British commission inventor Fergusson to claim uncharted land in West Africa for Britain by flying his giant hot air balloon there.

Idol-loving Kazuya is obsessed with digital idol Akane, who appears in the smartphone-based cute girl training game 'Idol Plus'. One day, her classmate Kyoko asks her for advice. Kyoko wants to delete Idol Plus.
A 12-year-old girl paralyzed in a Little League collision rediscovers her passion for life as a child-prodigy baseball broadcaster, inspiring her depressed father to exorcise his own demons.
Remake of the 1943 movie based on Eric Knight's book "Lassie Come Home".
Carson is an American contraband runner approached by Tracy, a French woman who wants him to help rescue her brother from Albania where he is being held as a political prisoner.
When Rex, a Broken Hill cab driver, is told he doesn't have long to live, he sets out on an epic journey to Darwin in a bid to die on his own terms.
A New York newspaperman tracks clues to his missing sister in a small unfriendly hillbilly town.

Nadeem looses his legs in accident and now his brother Naeem looks after all his business. While away from home, Naeem gets news of Nadeem getting married, and to his shock, he sees his bride as Zeenat who was his love interest.
After a wealthy dowager who has made a substantial donation to her alma mater suddenly disappears, Nancy Drew sets out to solve the mystery.

A wealthy couple, Imre and Justine, are visiting the deep forests of Romania and find themselves at the mercy of Waldemar Daninsky, THE WEREWOLF. Waldemar and Justine must travel to London to seek the help from of Dr. Jekyll's grandson.

movie_name: World Order: Three Days and Three Nights
synopsis: When loner Veto meets a young journalist it changes his life forever as he is drawn into a conspiracy which is going on for centuries. He only survives due to the support of like-minded individuals.
A mysterious trucker is running down motorists on the highway.
Hilarity ensues when a handsome businessman goes undercover in New York City as a "Homeless Billionaire."

The son of an island chieftain, young Kehane defiantly opposes the efforts by crooked pearl hunter Bucko Larson to invade his domain. Larson and his minions hope to dissuade our hero by introducing him to seductive Ruby.
Ace Ventura, Pet Detective, returns from a spiritual quest to investigate the disappearance of a rare white bat, the sacred animal of a tribe in Africa.
Inspired by the life of a fearless young officer who made history by becoming the first Indian female Air Force officer to fly in a combat zone during the 1999 Kargil War
Two G-Men, returning from hell, must perform good deeds to save themselves from a doomed fate.
In 1950s California, the police tries to infiltrate and neutralize a shoplifting crime ring operating in major department stores.

A desperate doctor locks down South Union Cardiac Hospital to keep the greatest discovery in human history to himself, while a young intern races to save a dying young dancer, his ex-girlfriend, and his best friend, and stop his mentor.
Prithvi seeks revenge on Gyanendra Singh and the British. He sends his son Veer to Britain to study their plans. Veer kills Gyanendra's son but ends up falling in love with his daughter.

Two young sisters try to unearth the mystery of their mother's disappearance, journeying to an isolated mountain town where ghosts whisper into the ears of their living loved ones, luring them to a cold death in the town's lake.
A detective in search of a missing college student is lured by a madman into the lair of the fabled Chupacabras monster and he and several locals must face off against the legendary monster.
A compilation of five thought-provoking, thrilling short films from the mind of Hawkeye.
Somporn, a newly retire government officer and Ton an 11-year-old boy. Ton has to move to a new school. That is how Somporn and Ton meet and share their loneliness during summer.

In Buenos Aires, a man who has decreed that his daughters must marry in order of age allows an American dancer to perform at his club under the condition that he play suitor to his second-oldest daughter.
A policewoman, whose childhood friend disappeared in Patagonia years ago, starts a new search to find answers and soon finds her own life in danger.
A super-powered construction worker falls in with a group of criminals in order to raise the funds to help his ill mother.
Criminals and a beautiful but cunning hitchhiker battle a supernatural force known as the Reaper.

When a group of religious zealots destroy everything that he loves and leaves him for dead; A man embarks on a journey of revenge that will take him through all the post-apocalyptic dangers that is WASTELAND.
A darkly animated punk girl bedevils the brutalist world of a new breed of loveless immortal men.
With only a few months to live, a desperate man kidnaps a successful advertising director and makes one demand: Create an online campaign to pay for treatment - or share his fate.
An evil duke kidnaps the good king and tries to make the virtuous queen his bride and the peasants take arms.
Two siblings try to bring a dolphin separated from his family back home.
A tabloid journalist doesn't believe a word he writes, until he gets sent to investigate cattle mutilations in a West Texas.
When a ruthless group of human traffickers invade a nearby town and kidnap a teenage girl, a former military mother must find her before she disappears for good.
A jobless married man falls for a multinational company's offer to provide his family a life of luxury for the rest of their lives in exchange for body organs
