synopsis: As the truth behind the girls' contracts with Kyubey is revealed, Madoka has to make the ultimate decision to either see those she love the most die before her eyes or to sacrifice her life as a normal girl and help out her friends in need.
One child left alone to face the dangerous world of her own imagination.
A woman hires P.I. Lloyd Meadows to investigate her husband, a respectable social worker. What seemed to be a simple case of adultery turns into an ugly mess fast.
A teenage girl and her dog are stranded in the desert. With the help of a young illegal immigrant on the run, they try to make it out alive together.

In the future, laws skyrocket. Without room, the government deports convicts into the ocean. Armed only with makeshift bikinis and weapons, some surviving immigrants struggle to keep oxygen deprived cannibals out of a cavern dubbed Babylon.

After their caravan is attacked and their respective families butchered by Arab marauders, teenagers David and Sarah flee across the desert. But the desert is filled with danger from the elements, animals and the appetite of the Jackal.
A gang get suspicious of each other over a money dealing and a lady and her lover comes in between.
A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend, where his simmering uneasiness about their reception of him eventually reaches a boiling point.

A professional contract killer, haunted by visions of his violent past, spirals out of control. His work compromised as he reaches breaking point, he is forced to defend his family from his ruthless employers.
A washed up basketball player juggles a pregnant girlfriend and mounting personal problems while trying to make a big drug score in the shadow of the Rodney King riots.
On a remote holiday park in Cornwall, a young woman is drawn into a mysterious obsession when she suspects her boyfriend has cheated on her.
Two long lost brothers and one hacker take on the CIA and the Mob. Dodging multiple hit squads, they try to stay one step ahead of the army of agents and Wise Guys gunning to get them whacked.
Horror movie, psychic drama or just boring. A visual room for your own thoughts.
A tough-on-crime street cop must protect the only surviving witness to a strange murderous cult with far-reaching plans.
In this martial arts action-drama, a swordsman named Toh Hong travels home after a long battle to discover his wife and children have been brutally murdered.
A creeping fungus starts killing off astronauts on a trip back from the moon.
A group of seven strangers try to survive and escape from isolated Los Angeles that has been infected by a strange, human changing virus.
Elfette has to save the day when Santa Claus is kidnapped by the mafia, who try to take over Christmas.
In this sequel to`End Of Days`, Jericho Cane returns to Earth as a death-dealing arch-angel, sent from Heaven to wipe out evil.
After being insulted by a rich businessman named Rosario, pandit Jai Kishen teaches him a lesson by getting his daughter married to Raju - a Coolie posing as a millionaire.

In World War II, American pilots bring fighter planes to Soviet flyers who carry them into combat. A transfer station on the air route from Kamchatka to Siberia: the adventures and misadventures of all who pass through.
A dark, modern fairy tale about a troubled teenage girl who goes on a perilous quest for a fallen angel to save her mother from terminal cancer.
KHOLA HAWA is a love story between a middle-aged divorcée Aditi and a young boy Sayan, who is a daily soap script writer.
The pilots of a Royal Air Force squadron in World War I face not only physical but mental dangers in their struggle to survive while fighting the enemy.
Plot kept under wraps.

Dustin and Gary are forced to navigate their way through a modern myth when Dustin is bitten by a radioactive chihuahua. Once a curse takes hold of Dustin, he and Gary are forced to run for their lives from the monster slayer, Van Helsing.

Cyborg 009 and his team are re-united to fight the latest menace from the Black Ghost. Before they can tackle their foe the team must overcome an army of monsters sent to stop them, including giant jellyfish, and treacherous cyborgs.
A lord returns to his manor with his new wife, to hear rumors that he had already secretly returned and had committed several murders. Has he lost his mind, or is something dark afoot?

movie_name: Captain Video: Master of the Stratosphere
synopsis: Space hero Captain Video battles the evil Vultura on the planet Atoma.
A human child raised by wolves must face off against a menacing tiger named Shere Khan, as well as his own origins.

After a convoy of American soldiers disappears, a special ops team is deployed to rescue them. They soon encounter an army of gigantic scorpions, spiders and snakes that have come to Earth from another dimension.

movie_name: Sbatti il mostro in prima pagina
synopsis: A populist right-wing tabloid newspaper tries to derail the official police investigation of a brutal murder of a young girl in order to help the fascist and right-wing candidates it supports in the upcoming elections.
The devious brain behind a heist draws a top police detective, on the eve of his retirement, into an elaborate plot of robbery and revenge.
A look at the violent consequences faced by a middle-class family, as seen by three different points of view.
Two kids secretly take in stray dogs at a vacant hotel.
A mother gives her 13-year-old son a toy doll for his birthday, unaware of its more sinister nature.
After her job and relationship implode on the same day, Sofia starts from scratch and meets a dashing Spanish chef who might be her missing ingredient.
A young musician travels to London in pursuit of his dreams, but winds up the sole witness to a bizarre murder.
A married couple who both work as assassins-for-hire find out that they've been secretly commissioned to kill each other.

The true family of Frank Di Angelo is from underworld. His gang is made up a rough group of headstrong men. Mistakes, debts and treasons have unavoidably brought them face to face with Andrei Milhov, member of the Russian Mafia.
Hollywood in the 1940s. A tyrannical producer, a paranoid director, a starlet engaged twenty-four times, an actor who refuses to age - all against a backdrop of a series of murders.

movie_name: The Last of the Manson Girls
synopsis: Counterculture journalist Paul Krassner embarks on an LSD tinged investigation of the last of Manson's disciples: Brenda McCann, Sandra Good, and Lynette 'Squeaky' Fromme in order to find out if the Manson Murders were a CIA conspiracy.
After an argument with a colleague, Dr Nadra finds a man's corpse when she gets back home. She is soon suspected of murder.
A bookie (Cesar Romero) takes over a bankrupt art gallery and falls in love with a beautiful blonde (Carole Landis)
The pure, selfless, and strong bond between Shambu and his sister-in-law Shanti is misunderstood by their family and the society, leading them to face many trials that threaten to split the family.
FILMED with the exotic splendour of Mohammendan pageantry, FILMED with the fire of a great romance, FILMED with suspense that soars to breathless heights.
After the creation of the new world, a young, charming, rebellious, immortal being creates war in the most holy place in the history of the universe and is cast away from it and into the new world.
Lille, France. The affairs between a young couple living a tense period of their relationship, and a long term friend of theirs who cannot decide which one she likes the most.
A weak personality father trying to prove to his son that he's courageous, so he decided to join a TV Show about courage, and he faced a lot of crisis in a comic way.
A fighter avenges his slain father and recovers stolen gold.
1945. After releasing two armored boxes in the bay of Istanbul, a plane crashes into a mountain. The pilot survives but goes crazy and is admitted to an asylum. Twenty years later a man disappears.
A retired mobster goes on a revenge spree after being left for dead with 22 bullets in his body by his former childhood friend.
The monstrous offspring of a violent crime grows up in seclusion on a remote island, where a boat-full of hapless teens have shipwrecked, unaware of what's lurking in the woods.
Brad Angel, a man for hire, finds a woman on an island who claims she's being held prisoner.

The genius hacker Hex runs the "white hacker" club Better World. As he discovers the hackers that ruined his father's company he need all the help he can get from his club members in order to take them down.
Harry Price investigates the ghosts of Borley Rectory during his stay there.
Spark, a teenage monkey and his friends, Chunk and Vix, are on a mission to regain Planet Bana, a kingdom overtaken by the evil overlord Zhong.
While flying mail across the Andean mountains, Henri Guillaumet's plane has to crash-land, he must trek back to civilizatin on foot.
A behavioral experiment treating humans like animals goes awry when a university student manipulates the research with deadly results.
Italian erotic thriller in which a cheating husband wants to have his hotelier wife murdered so that he can be with his mistress.
After finding an old storage locker filled with his family's history, James Erikson begins a journey to discover the truth behind a mysterious piece of land in the small town of Solitude.
A group of hustlers encounter "The Dean" and pull off a successful sting that results in their pursuit by a vengeful gangster.
Haunted by a malevolent spirit since childhood, a desperate mother allows herself to become possessed in order to save the life of her terminally ill daughter.
A prisoner is brought to psychiatric detention space station orbiting a prison planet. He was exposed to aliens and gained healing power. A new doctor wants to experiment on the 7 prisoners/patients.

movie_name: Captain Sabertooth and the Treasure of Lama Rama
synopsis: The orphan boy Pinky follows the Captain on an exciting and dangerous journey across the big oceans to the kingdom of Lama Rama, hunting for a treasure and the answer to who is Pinky's father.
Two enemies become unlikely allies in an Arizona prison.

In your darkest hour you pleaded to God to save you and He would not answer - But what would you do if someone else did? Would the cost of your soul be worth saving your life or the lives of the people you loved?
A troubled deprogrammer isolates himself with a young cult member to "break" her, but he soon learns her cult's nightmarish beliefs are real - and he's their next target.
A local 8-year-old boy goes missing in Woodridge, Australia.

The self proclaimed 'king of sabres', and 'king of spears', decide to settle whose weapon is better by each taking a student and training them in the use of their favorite weapon, and whoever students' comes out on top is the winner.
In the 1970s, a group of 10 students struggles with poverty and develop hopes for the future in Gantong Village on the farming and tin mining island of Belitung off the east coast of Sumatra.

Based on the 1970 animated film, follows a family of Parisian felines who must team up with a smooth-talking tomcat to try to make it back home after their owner's jealous butler kidnaps them and leaves them in the country.
A young silver dragon teams up with a mountain spirit and an orphaned boy on a journey through the Himalayas in search for the Rim of Heaven.

An entitled young professional suffers from regret after losing his fiance in a tragic accident, but one day is awakened by her ghost who coaches him into living in the moment and not taking life for granted.

After his older brother is arrested, 16-year-old Deyjan is forced to relocate to a small town in New Jersey. As he tries to adjust to his new life, he discovers that his perfect new town hides a very bloody secret.
Mowgli, missing the jungle and his old friends, runs away from the man village unaware of the danger he's in by going back to the wild.
Inspired by the urban legend, 13 Bumps, a clairvoyant must solve a series of gruesome family murders before becoming a target herself.
Street kids get sent to the country, where they get mixed up in murder and a haunted house.
An aging film star retreats to the Scottish countryside with her nurse to recover from surgery. While there, mysterious forces of revenge emerge from the land where witches were burned.
An adaptation of Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale "The Snow Queen".
Two disquieted junior baseball players seek revenge on the local yakuza for attacking their coach.

After witnessing the alien abduction of her mother as a child, Aurora joins the UFO cult "The Cosmic Dawn". Now moved on from the cult, Aurora is forced to confront her past and pursue the ultimate truth about The Cosmic Dawn.
Set in the near future, family bonds are tested as each character is thoughtfully woven into a masterful tapestry of hope.
A modest super-express delivery courier gets entangled in a spiral of adventure and romance in Shanghaï
Once again the legendary tomb explorer Hu Bayi is on a dangerous mission as he seeks out the Tomb of Emperor Xian, located on an island of monstrous creatures in this mystical action-adventure.
An OFW working as a bioforensic trauma cleaner is haunted by a series of unfortunate events after she finds the diary of Mrs. Winters, who died of suicide.
A burgomeister and family man is haunted by a crime he committed 15 years before: robbing a wealthy Jewish Polish seed merchant to pay off his mortgage debt.

Elektra the warrior survives a near-death experience, becomes an assassin-for-hire, and tries to protect her two latest targets, a single father and his young daughter, from a group of supernatural assassins.

When the network of satellites designed to control the global climate starts to attack Earth, it's a race against the clock for its creator to uncover the real threat before a worldwide Geostorm wipes out everything and everyone.

Martin Blank is a professional assassin. He is sent on a mission to a small Detroit suburb, Grosse Pointe, and, by coincidence, his ten-year high school reunion party is taking place there at the same time.
Prequel to Henry James' "The Turn of the Screw", focusing on groundskeeper Peter Quint's slow corruption of the virtuous governess Miss Jessel and the children she looks after.

Balakrishnan, a teacher, falls in love with his colleague, Nirmala, and accompanies her in a visit to her native place to express his feelings. However, they face unexpected events during the journey.
In this haunting drama, a night of reckless drinking compels a car mechanic to forcibly detox his best friend -- whatever the cost.
A tomboyish juvenile delinquent, Paschal Draney, is sent to live in a foster home run by a well-known horse breeder where he befriends a Thoroughbred seemingly crippled by a congenital eye defect.
The world learns that an earth-shattering meteorite will arrive in 72 hours.
A group of teenagers discover a portal to the past. When one of them changes history, the effects start to snowball with tragic consequences.

When a local cop and an overzealous social-worker follow clues on missing persons cases around town, stomach-turning discoveries are unearthed on a pig farm, where the town butcher has been slaughtering more than livestock.

The story revolves around a woman named Anna Brookes who works with the military to hunt and take down Supernatural beings that were left behind after a world changing event scarred half of Lion City.
A grumpy publisher receives a parcel containing a hand that may or may not be fake. A woman is following him. Someone from his past? Reality and fantasy begin to intermingle.
A mysterious mastermind - Daredevil and his team forms a plan and commits bank heist to find the corporate looted people's money.
A hero goes on a quest to get a magic sword, the only one that can defeat "Bas-Celik", the tyrant who enslaved his village.

A sadistic prison warden takes out her sexual frustration on her women inmates. While a caring physician tries to improve the jail's brutal atmosphere, a pair of rebellious inmates take matters into their own hands.
Asko Mertanen is a waiter who is very interested in shooting. He gets fed up how the things are run in Finland, so he thinks that the best way to change them is to shoot the Finnish president.

A group of holidaymakers have booked themselves a dream trip with the Wild West White Water River Boat Company. Their journey will take them along the great Colorado so they can experience first hand the beauty of the Grand Canyon.
After he dies in a car accident, a man receives three more days on Earth to find his soul mate.

movie_name: Terrifying Girls' High School: Lynch Law Classroom
synopsis: Three new students at a super strict girls' school face off against the oppressive administration, a corrupt politician and a sadistic student discipline brigade.
A killer begins to stalk the actors of a low budget horror film, killing them off one by one.

MEDUSA DELUXE is a murder mystery set in a competitive hairdressing competition. Extravagance and excess collide, as the death of one of their own sows seeds of division in a community whose passion for hair verges on obsession.
When a notorious criminal is forced to return to London, it gives a detective one last chance to take down the man he's always been after.
A group of friends is torn apart when they become part of two human hunter's sick game. The men give them ten minutes to hide, and then the real hunt begins.

A fifteen year old kid is sent to a juvenile detention center after admitting to sexually abusing a girl. The therapeutic intervention with the youngster and his family surfaces the secrets and distortions that nourish them all.
Alicia has started getting these very noisy, and disturbing phone calls. The question is, are they real, or is it all in her head?

A cold hearted American hit man goes to Europe for 'one last score'. His encounter with a beautiful young woman casts self doubt on his lifeblood, and influences him to resist carrying out the contract

Dorothy Kilgallen's mysterious death prompts Special Investigator Gary Revel to sense something is amiss. Word from the top tells him to back off. That's not his style, and threats make him more interested.
A helicopter crashes in the desert, and the crew winds up in the underground city of Atlantis and get mixed up in a slave revolt.
Five girl friends received a Friend Request from a dead girl, whom ever accepted is found murdered.

Twenty-five years into the future, a respected government official turned undercover freedom fighter works to dismantle a global bio-security state through his access to an elite class who have reformed the biology of humanity.
The plot is unknown at this moment.

What happened to the women at 10 Rillington Place? The story of British serial killer John Christie, who committed most or all of his crimes in the titular terraced house, and the miscarriage of justice involving Timothy Evans.
In December of 1937 two young girls aged 9 and 4, May and August, lived blissfully with their parents in Nanjing. Unfortunately, the outbreak of the war totally changed their lives.
It's a quiet little town where nothing happens - until the day the bank is hit for half a million dollars by a thief wearing a clowns mask.
A surreal science fiction noir involving a man trapped in a future where seemingly everyone is a government spy and all-night noodle stands are outlawed.
A mother and daughter must confront a terrifying monster when they break down on a deserted road.

A girl works at a 5-star hotel by the beach. But the hotel has one strange rule: Never open room number 308 under any circumstance. Based on the legend, the spirit of the Queen of the South Sea supposedly lives in room 308 in that hotel.
John Deakin is being transported, as a prisoner, on a train with supplies and medicine to Fort Humboldt, Nevada.
Traded and sold like currency, the outcast people known as "Hues", are hunted down after turning color in a black and white world.

Simon Kress, a wealthy playboy on the planet Baldur, loves to collect dangerous, exotic animals. When most of his pets die after being left alone during a long business trip, he ventures into the city to find replacements.
A group of friends stranded near a desolate cornfield find shelter in an old farmhouse, though they soon discover the dwelling is the center of a supernatural ritual.
Seven uniquely connected people awaken in an unusual room and endure hellish creatures in this surrealistic nightmare.

A disturbed, war scarred crime reporter turns to illegal means in an attempt to generate news stories. Angry by his boss for a lack of stories, Lewis Bevan takes matters into his own hands to revive his flagging career.
Griff, office worker by day, superhero by night, has his world turned upside down when he meets Melody, a beautiful young scientist who shares his passion for the impossible.
A lonely housewife begins falling in love with her sister's fiancé.
Byomkesh Bakshi is a Bengali detective who is called on for a spine-chilling case with his assistant/friend Ajit.
A couple agree to have their deceased son cloned, under the supervision of an enigmatic doctor, but bizarre things start to happen several years after his rebirth.
A sleazy gangster has a gang of young girls commit robberies and prostitution for him by getting them hooked on drugs.
Arthurian legend meets Egyptian mythology with all the color and passion of the rainbow flag.
After years of hiding from a cruel, suspicious society on the land, mermaid Dyesebel returns and falls in love with a man named Fredo--and becomes the target of Fredo's jealous ex-girlfriend.
When a solar eclipse sends a colossal blast of super chilled air towards the earth, it then sets off a catastrophic chain of events that threatens to engulf the world in ice and begin a new Ice Age.

Two stories separated by 1400 years. After losing his mother in the midst of a war-torn country, an Iraqi child, learns the importance and power of patience by discovering the historical story of Lady Fatima and her suffering.
An earthquake has hit the city and a family must seek refuge before its too late.

movie_name: Don't Be Afraid of the Dark
synopsis: A young girl sent to live with her father and his new girlfriend believes that she has released creatures from a sealed ash pit in the basement of her new home.

A young woman struggles to move on with her life after the death of her husband, an acclaimed folk singer, when a brash New York writer forces her to confront her loss and the ambiguous circumstances of his death.
A young teenage girl is hired by a strange couple to watch their baby for the night. What the babysitter doesn't know is how strange the couple is, and exactly what kind of baby she is watching over.
A ruthless Viking seeks vengeance against his old enemy by kidnapping his daughters, but the plan is hindered by an unknown macabre presence from the legends.
Five years after the events of the first film, a summer camp next to the infamous Camp Crystal Lake is preparing to open, but the legend of Jason is weighing heavy on the proceedings.
A former Norwegian soldier loses his family in a terrifying home invasion. With the help from a group of NATO-commandos they hunt the villains through old war tunnels in the North of Norway.
A city councillor hijacks a documentary team and takes them on a wild and dangerous ride into his ruthless world of corruption.
A small-time hoodlum is divided between his conscience and loyalty to his boss when his cousin is murdered.
A depressed serial dater suspects his new girlfriend may be a contract killer and struggles to free her from a life of crime.

'Clew' is the story of Jack Hadrian, a painter living in the mid-twenty-first century who contracts for the purchase of a Muse, a genetically engineered bioform designed to be his perfect mate, after his fiancée disappears mysteriously.

An offbeat comedy about an estranged father who returns to his hometown after an absence of ten years in order to reconnect with his daughter and ex-wife but unwittingly finds himself responsible for almost destroying all their lives.
A crooked lawyer trying to cheat a young girl out of her inheritance tries to convince a sea captain to help him.
The film revolves around a theatre group where the entire group members gets devastated by a series of murders.
An accidental cross-time radio link connects father and son across 30 years. The son tries to save his father's life, but then must fix the consequences.

After an artist is threatened by the yakuza into creating valuable but highly illegal pornography, the law aims to execute him. Zatoichi, having been honor bound to protect the man and his family, must now run against the law.
The winning team of "Lust Stories" reunites to tell some spine-chilling tales. "Ghost Stories" is a 2020 Indian anthology horror film consisting of four short film segments.
A star player is kidnapped by the opposition. However, they are foiled by his girl-friend, just in time for him to get to the match and score the winning goal.
A small-time con artist and a Hawaiian real estate developer's mischevious, enterprising mistress team up for a potential $200,000 score.
A cat and two young girls during the end of the world. Who will survive? Who will die?
Alice wakes up in the Raccoon City hospital after the area has been overrun by zombies, and must now make it out of the city before a nuclear bomb is dropped.
A detective tries to unravel the strange circumstances surrounding the death of a young actress.
Max and his embarrassing mom go on a summer vacation at a folk high school in Jutland. Meanwhile, Max is also looking for a summer job in a bank.
Two stories of complicated long-distance relationships between people from different countries.
Historically ingenious bank heist leaves everyone wondering who's responsible.
A rogue Police Detective in search of his parents' killer is murdered and then reborn as the ultimate killer.

A feared don must woo a woman from a cultured family and marry her within a short period of time, in order to escape from his grandfather's insistent ghost. How will he convince a suitable woman to marry him, despite his criminal record?

movie_name: Joel D. Wynkoop's the Craiglon Incident
synopsis: Aliens invade the Earth and it is up Dawes, Parsons and Emile to save it.

Young woman discovers a videotape of an old kids' show that used to scare her as a child. After watching the tape again, she starts to relive her old trauma and losing her sense of reality in nightmarish way.
Nathan is an agoraphobic, living alone and keeping to himself. Until he meets his neighbour Izzy and something awakens, Something that is pure evil.

movie_name: Return to Return to Nuke 'Em High Aka Vol. 2
synopsis: Following the events of the previous film, a lesbian couple are determined to eliminate the most corrupt, evil forces of Tromaville and the world.
A young student is kidnapped by a group of masked criminals. Trapped in a remote farm where she is then mercilessly beaten and molested.
Red, a young Pokémon trainer, is out to become a Pokemon Master in the Kanto region.

movie_name: Sky Captain and the World of Tomorrow
synopsis: After New York City receives a series of attacks from giant flying robots, a reporter teams up with a pilot in search of their origin, as well as the reason for the disappearances of famous scientists around the world.
In the near future, humanity launches a desperate bid to colonize a new world. When they arrive things do not go as planned.
Gautham, a man with special needs, comes to Pondicherry. Hema, a carefree woman, befriends him and with the help of her father, who is a psychologist, unravels his horrific past life.
Four weeks after a mysterious, incurable virus spreads throughout the UK, a handful of survivors try to find sanctuary.
The story continues with Wuba after he parts way with his human parents Tian and Lan for his own journey. Peace has not been restored in the monster world after the death of the evil monster king.

A retiring patriarch disputes with a large construction firm over the fertile land his farm is placed on. At the same time the passing of his wife brings home a son from an extra-marital affair, upsetting the family balance further.

Ten-year old Sakura Avalon, Cardcaptor of the elusive, magical Clow Cards, unexpectedly wins a trip to Hong Kong where strange dreams lead her to an imprisoned sorceress with close connections to the creator of the cards.

1935. Trevor and Dante are in Capri where they both fall for a local beauty. Back in London the remains of a female body are found in a canal, and both are suspects in what increasingly appears to be a murder.
What seemed like a breezy idea for an engineer to net him millions of dollars, leaves him on the run for his life and piecing together why he's being chased.

movie_name: Girl Slaves of Morgana Le Fay
synopsis: Two French girls get lost in the woods and accidentally enter the realm of sorceress Morgana Le Fay - who gives them the choice of either staying young forever as her lovers, or rot in a dungeon for eternity.
A GOOD SAMARITAN TAKES THE LAW INTO HIS HAND TO CORRECT THE WRONGDOINGS IN HIS TOWN.
Larry Talbot returns to his father's castle in Wales and meets a beautiful woman. One fateful night, Talbot escorts her to a local carnival where they meet a mysterious gypsy fortune teller.
A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic ability.
An imprisoned drug kingpin offers a huge cash reward to anyone that can break him out of police custody, and only the L.A.P.D.'s Special Weapons and Tactics team can prevent it.

Charles Arthur Floyd finds work on an oil rig after serving time for armed robbery; but when he becomes involved with a married woman, her husband swears revenge. Floyd's boss doesn't know that his new employee was a jailbird.

movie_name: The Final Exit of the Disciples of Ascensia
synopsis: The film depicts the beginning and end of UFO cult and the lives of the people around it.

Cliff Ballenger, the wild-animal trainer for the circus had no fear of "Satan," the fiercest man-eating tiger in captivity, but the creature hated its master and longed to tear the big man to pieces with its rendering claws and fangs.
When a motley group of college freshmen choose bizarre Tyler Rooney as the new target for their juvenile pranks, Tyler calls upon hoodoo-cursed Mister White to exact a violent and bloody revenge.
A remake of the classic film 'Nosferatu'.

The father turns on as a light bulb, the older daughter has super-strength, the younger daughter is capable to be invisible, the grandmother floats and the son is super-intelligent. Definitely this family is from another world.
A recently discharged mentally challenged male becomes sexually obsessed with a married woman.
A psychiatrist and a nun must save a grieving mother before the parasitic demon they encountered nearly forty years ago returns and consumes her soul.
A story of child bravery in a post-apocalyptic world. A viral incident has wiped out more than half of the population, leaving only child survivors to fend for themselves.
Maxwell Smart, a highly intellectual but bumbling spy working for the CONTROL agency, is tasked with preventing a terrorist attack from rival spy agency KAOS.
In colonial Nigeria, an English documentary photographer in search of a story falls in love with an accused witch living under subhuman conditions.
A group of young veterans looking for work form an international cargo delivery business.

When an innocent man aspiring to be a musician is framed for committing a murder, he decides to form a music band with his co-prisoners for a competition, but his real intention seems to be different.

Story of Mami Jarum who is a snobbish person and thinks that her family is perfect and should be an example to other people. She also has the habit of looking for other people's mistakes and spreading the news.
On regaining his vision after a cornea transplant, a nine-year-old boy embarks on a journey to explore India along with his father.

John Sawyer, once an eminent barrister, has slid into a life of cynicism and drunkenness since his wife left him. When his daughter's boyfriend is accused of murder, Sawyer decides to try to pull himself together and defend him in court.

movie_name: Brief Story from the Green Planet
synopsis: Tania learns that her grandmother spent the last years of her life in the loving company of an alien. Together with two friends, the Trans woman travels through rural Argentina to bring the creature back to its place of origin.
A woman becomes involved in National Security for the benefit of her daughter.

When a group of college students accidentally venture onto a private property during pledge week, they encounter a backwoods family keen on doing whatever they have to do to keep their secrets safe from outsiders.
The Joker five-star system is under Emperor Amaterasu. Mecha pilot Ladios must save his co-pilot, Fatima-class female android Lachesis, from one of many warlords, who oppose Amaterasu.
Desperate and confused, Alicia will do the impossible to keep her son from prison after he's convicted of trying to murder his ex-wife.
A treasure hunting team travels to a small town in deep south Louisiana to look for the fabled treasure chest. The treasure is somewhere in a sunken riverboat casino at the bottom of Bayou Teche.

A teen's ability to surreally speak with cars sparks a revolution that could save his community. However, he soon finds himself in a fight for survival when his invention inadvertently accelerates the underlying problems.
Two explorers discover a secret that will change our view of the universe and mankind's destiny.
Two wealthy Ivy League athletes become the suspects of a major investigation after the disappearance of one of their fraternity pledges leads deputies to an underground fighting ring.

Dr. Bill Matthews is struck by lighting. While recovering at the hospital where he works, he begins an intimate relationship with Dr. Craig Murphy, who invites Bill to join a strange group of lightning survivors.
The wife of a diplomat in Geneva pretends to be a maid in order to continue her flirting with a handsome young courier.
A son must make a journey to Thailand to save his father after his dad is framed for a killing.
In Baghdad a girl escapes from a robber sheikh and thwarts a plot to rob a merchant.
A high school senior, Cooper Jackson, goes through his day to plan the biggest party of the year while his mother is away on a trip.
When an alien spacecraft of enormous power is spotted approaching Earth, Admiral James T. Kirk resumes command of the overhauled USS Enterprise in order to intercept it.
The story of the relationship between two young artists, a photographer and a writer, but above all the story of personal freedom through the filter of the imagination.
A young king and queen have everything they can ask for, except love for each other. In this story no one is who they appear to be, for the eyes are a force of deception for so many.

synopsis: High school student Asuna struggles to survive with a young swordsman after its revealed that she is trapped inside the game of Sword Art Online, where if your HP drops to zero, your brain will be destroyed in real life.
The people of Wakanda fight to protect their home from intervening world powers as they mourn the death of King T'Challa.
A trucker (Lamas) has to come home to help fight mobsters after his brother who embezzled $5,000,000 from them.
The sleazy and dangerous adventures of a gorgeous female private detective.
Sagina a factory laborer,an aggressive, honest and lovable character who was the first to fight against the tyranny of the British bosses in the Tea gardens of North-Eastern India.

Strange incidents occur in the heart of shonajhuri forest in rural bengal (the backdrop for both stories) which develops an ominous character of its own that allures and finally engulfs our protagonists.
A stray dog, found in the alleys in New Delhi, is brought to Sweden.

Seung-hie's father doesn't care that his pro-Japanese activities are making life harder for his countrymen living under occupation. His daughter, however, feels differently and devotes herself to the liberation movement

An Indian government official tries to remain loyal to his job and the state when his career is threatened by a criminal cartel who plan on ruining him as well as his son whom deals with the hoodlums in his own way of justice.
When an open-minded Jewish waiter and his son become victims of the Holocaust, he uses a perfect mixture of will, humor, and imagination to protect his son from the dangers around their camp.

A man repeats the same day running from the Yakuza. A woman encounters her violent mirror image. A woman and her laser gun fight a shadow demon. And a man is cursed to become a werewolf pining for a prostitute.
A detective assigned to protect a pop singer gets romantically involved with her twin sister after the singer is murdered.
A werewolf samurai walks the countryside, finding himself in the middle of a village of monsters who feed on human flesh.
Freckles (Johnny Downs) comes home from college...and the sheriff accuses him of murder, gangsters put him on the spot, and his girl friend, Jane (Gale Storm), falls in love with a confidence man.
Two Chinese men go to Copenhagen. While one of them philanders around with various Danish and Asian women, the other falls in love with his Chinese tour guide.

A videographer buys some cheap cameras from a car boot sale but gets more than what he bargained for when the cameras contain footage of a documentary about a local urban legend that quickly turns sinister.
A wife bears witness to her husband's descent into possession after buying an acoustic guitar from a N'awlins pawn shop.

A teenage girl, who accidentally releases an ancient and mischievous spirit on Halloween which causes decorations to come alive and wreak havoc, must team up with the last person she'd want to in order to save their town - her father!
A look at the lives of Carlo, Giulia, and their friends some 10 years after the events of L'Ultimo bacio.
A family of gunrunners launch a full scale war against those they believe to be responsible for the death of one of their own.
A lawyer pleads for the life of his mother who is accused of killing the man blackmailing her husband.
We thought we cured the virus.....we were wrong....a stronger, more intelligent zombie was born...
An easygoing gambler played by Atsumi (later to gain fame as Tora-san) gets caught in the crossfire of two gangs' warfare.

Willie the woodworm and his family arrive on Noah's Ark by chance. When the flood hits, the Ark starts to leak and everyone put the blame on innocent Willie. He discovers that stowaway termites are behind the leaks and must stop them.
Captain Drummond becomes a prisoner when he intents to protect a beautiful heiress of an espionage organization.
Two extraterrestrial women are sent on a mission by the regent of Venus to search for a male of another planet.
A spoof on The Hangover (2009), The Hunger Games (2012) and other movies, TV series etc. 4 men, with hangovers after a bachelor party, find themselves in a future, dystopian, kill or be killed game.

movie_name: Kenji Miyazawa's Night on the Galactic Railroad
synopsis: Two kittens go on a metaphysical journey on a magical railroad train.
Two guys by the name of Silas and Jamal decided to one day smoke something magical, which eventually helps them to ace their college entrance exam.
15 years after the original events, Doll Restoration artist Stephanie is followed by Charlie Crandall to her new home in Southern California for a final game of cat and mouse.
In 1988, Earth makes the first contact with an alien civilization. In 1991, these aliens, known as Newcomers, slowly begin to be integrated into human society after three years of quarantine.
A gangster hires an ex-football player to find his girlfriend. When he finds her, they fall in love, and the twists start to appear.
In a world on the verge of destruction, the only thing that will stand against a horde of vampires is a girl - or two.

movie_name: Tales of Terror: Make a Raid! East Japan Edition
synopsis: A spin-off project from the popular Kaidan Shin Mimibukuro (2003) series. Finally a documentary about visiting haunted places has arrived. In this east Japan version, various famous haunted places in east Japan are hit.
A pair of brothers work as adoption agents in a world where America has become infertile and children are a valuable commodity.
A man commits manslaughter and runs away to join a special guerilla unit in order to avoid being captured by the police
Misunderstandings arise between two brothers because of their different ideologies. So their sons turns out to be enemies. They need to overcome all the misunderstandings to get united again.

movie_name: The Magic Kids: Three Unlikely Heroes
synopsis: Vlad has just moved and joined one of the most famous magical schools in the world, where he meets fairies, witches, trolls and dwarfs. Him and his father are the first vampires in town, but he soon meets other special kids.
A stranded group of humans must survive the frontiers of space and each other as they confront an intangible enemy.'
Two cabdrivers accidentally get caught up in gang and criminal activity.
Based on the true story of drugs, satanism, and murder in the upper class town of Northport, Long Island in 1984.
An evil queen steals control of a kingdom and an exiled princess enlists the help of seven resourceful rebels to win back her birthright.

movie_name: Sexy Killer: You'll Die for Her
synopsis: A femme fatale fashionista at a trendy design school embarks on a brutal and bloody killing spree, while gleefully evading the hapless cops assigned to the murder cases.

movie_name: The Rifleman of the Voroshilov Regiment
synopsis: Veteran of World War II takes revenge on three scums who raped his naive granddaughter.
After his wife's publicized suicide, a Southern Baptist pastor and his teen daughter flee to an isolated farm where evil forces drive him to madness and violence.
The plot is unknown at this time.
For one female entity time stands still, while for another time travels back and forth between the plains of the supernatural and the earthly horrors of exploitation and murder.
Two clumsy mobsters on a mission in Paris.
Santos, a failed comic book artist, lives in a parallel universe where he's a superhero who has to save the world.
An indie rock band hits the road and unknowingly encounter a serial killing psychopath.
Plot kept under wraps. Described as a martial arts/Kung Fu film.
The story of The Super Mario Bros. on their journey through the Mushroom Kingdom

movie_name: Keeplock Aka Screams in the Night
synopsis: Pete Frangello is past 30 and on parole, trying to walk a straight line - but crooked officials want him to turn informant, and a onetime sweetheart has leapt back into his life with a sexy vengeance. Is vengeance what she has in mind?
Samuel Curtis, an interplanetary trader, sets forth through a rustic and remote solar system, unaware that his old friend Professor Hess is trying to kill him.

19-year-old Brooklyn boy Mike tries to balance a scholarship to NYU and his sophisticated Italian neighborhood roots, as well as an eager-to-marry girlfriend, a proud father and a less lawful transport job. After Tim McLoughlin's novel.

Lord Plaag from outer space has awoken from his slumber in a town near London, England called Hertford. Nigel is a comic salesman who must save his girlfriend from Lord Plaag's evil clutches (not the car variety).
12 strangers are held against their will as each of them must go along with the rules if they are to get the cure for a killer virus which infects them all.
Ten people who agree to take the same lucrative "job" find themselves locked in an underground complex and forced to play a murder game for seven days.

A down-and-out metalhead resurrects his dead bandmates in order to win back his ex-girlfriend and secure a record contract, but to defeat an army of the undead, he must learn to stop living in the past.
Two kids must overcome adversity and trouble at home and in school, without parents supervision they get in so many troubles, E.T. meets Goonies.
A young girl discovers a secret that will transform her life forever.
A CIA Operative is sent to Boston to assassinate a young woman.
Depressed in life, three youngsters decide to commit suicide and go to a beach house to do it, not realizing that the place is haunted by a ghost.
Magic abounds: Hunter and Jesamine unleash havoc on a towns bully with the help of a sorcerer's diary, and a mischievous monkey apprentice Fred.
Amar, Meet and Prem go into a small town where they encounter a 'femme fatale' in the form of Ragini. Ragini is everything they had dreamed of, but she slowly turns into their worst nightmare!
A romantic anniversary dinner takes a twist in time when 30 years of bewilderment inexplicably pass in the blink of an eye.
An anthology of four short horror stories revolving around a mysterious antique shop owner and his antique pieces, each of which hides a deadly secret.
An international school in Kobe, Japan is catapulted into the future after a time-slip occurs.

A Peace Corps volunteer, bubbling o'er with idealism, learns to his delight that he has been assigned to a remote, backward Colombian village. When he arrives, he is confused by the cynical attitude of his predecessor (In HD).
Three apparent murders and a pair of imposters disrupt the lives of an engaged couple.
A man crime driving past is in his future to redeem his place back in to the world.
With the help of his recent recruit, a gang leader takes on an established crime lord in a battle for control over Vancouver's arms and drug trade.
A gambler tries to help track down the men who hanged a rancher when he tried to thwart their cattle rustling operations by selling his ranch.
An ex-con is murdered in Yellowstone National Park while a bank robber's son is searching for the loot his father hid there 20 years before.
An American agent is killed in Bangkok while investigating suspicious virus outbreaks in south east Asia. Agent OSS 117 is sent to Thailand to unravel the mysteries behind the man called Dr. Sinn.
During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches, and spirits, and where humans are changed into beasts.

A young Christian girl named Isabella goes on a spiritual journey, pushing through life's trials and tribulations. She try's to discover who she is and sets out to forgive those in her life who caused her trauma.. starting with her father.
A woman who is about to die calls the town's priest and hands him a scapulary, saying that she knows of its great powers. Anybody who does not believe in them will end up dead.
When three runaways shack up in an abandoned general store, a supernatural correspondence connects them to many lives that were all touched by the owner of the store years before they were born.

'Solitary' is a contained sci-fi film about a man who wakes up inside a room to discover he's a prisoner sent into space to form Earth's first colony, and worse - his cell mate Alana is hell bent on destroying everything.

A full length animated feature film telling the classic story by William Shakespeare in 3D. This project also includes new musical score and songs as well as a companion read along guide for younger children.
A skilled flyer but very rebellious young seagull is kicked out of his clan. However, instead of being sad or lonely, he decides to enjoy and explore his newfound freedom.
A married, middle-age writer falls in love with a teen boy.
A priest and a police officer are trying to solve a set of mysterious suicides. As their investigation closes in, they discover another crime with even farther-reaching consequences.
When Ben returns a diary he found on a bus to its rightful owner, he is drawn into her psychologically dangerous world.

Catherine is left unmarried and pregnant when her mobster sweetheart is killed in this gangster comedy. With the help of another unmarried mother-to-be, Catherine goes looking for the stash of cash buried by her lover before his death.

A drug dealer starts trafficking girls to pull his gang out of debt. When a British black-ops mom comes after her daughter, all hell breaks loose. Can she save her daughter before she's smuggled into Mexico?

After losing his wife in a theater shooting, Hopper ends up living on the streets of Denver, where he meets a grifter named Ella. Together they fight a corrupt policeman and Hopper's resurfacing demons, as his wife's killer goes to trial.
A mother concerned about her young son's disturbing behavior thinks something supernatural may be affecting him.

Television lose viewers, making YouTube begin to be seen more, generating a war between internet and television figures for trying to get a briefcase with vital information about YouTube.
A boy obsessed with space travel tries to save his dying father with the help of friends and an eccentric NASA engineer.
After a man falls from his balcony, a police investigation focuses on the man's son and daughter-in-law.

Pre-Code early-talkie film version of Philip Barry's Broadway hit chronicles the first five years of marriage between James and Mary Hutton, during which the two paramours they deserted wait patiently--and manipulatively--in the wings.
An embattled android embarks on a quest for reproduction.
An invasion of alien bubbles causes wacky behavior, while government agents tries to find the perpetrator and save the planet from bubble trouble.

movie_name: Dark Story of a Japanese Rapist
synopsis: Study about a young disturbed man, who rapes and kills women and collects their bodies in a cave. A work based on the case of Yoshio Kodaira, a serial rape murder case shortly after the war.
Three teens realize their science project is the key to finding their missing parents, in another world.

Two cops are on the trail of gang that are planning a jewel robbery. Inspector Chow lives at home with his mother, while Inspector Pang has gambling problems that the gang exploits. Soon, innocent victims will pay with their lives.
The story of a town bully with a nickname of Nuri the Flea.
Sulwe has the darkest skin in her family and in her school. She wishes for her skin to be lighter, but through a supernatural experience, she comes to love her dark skin color.
Matías is a Russian-language translator. Rody, an Interpol agent who requires his services to clarify a case. A series of unforeseen events envelop them in a desperate run to protect their lives.
An Asian cop returns to Chicago to revenge his brother's death, only to come up against a psycho threesome on a killing spree.
Renos, a lonely professional waiter, sees his well-organized life routine changing after an unexpected series of events.
A killer terrorizes the small German town of Hainsburg. The police moves in to investigate the crimes and finds a suspect among a small group of teenagers.

One righteous and innocent man who studied law get angered by injustice and find the concealed truth of major company which runs illegal prostitution business and that company's connection with corrupt public prosecution power.
An American woman goes to Hawaii to search for her husband, MIA since the war, but he's a fugitive from the law and involved in a private feud against his former crime syndicate partners.
Running for Student Council President will impress the popular girl, until she decides she wants to be president, too.

In Victorian England, two grave robbers supply a wealthy doctor with bodies to research anatomy on, but greed causes them to look for a more simple way to get the job done. Based on the horrifying Burke and Hare case.
A coming of age story of young people's relationship - about love, break-up and growing up.
It follows the story of Jane Pineda, a washed-up actress and former child star whose career hits rock bottom while she trying to escape a big scandal.
Little Flying Dragon finds himself responsible for protecting a small child named Golden Boy, who reluctantly plays an important role in the ongoing battle between good and evil forces.
Gamblers who "took" an out-of-town sucker in a crooked poker game feel shadowy vengeance closing in on them.

Alejandro is a young writer going through "writer's block". His girlfriend helps him find a steady income writing children's stories, but news of a serial killer haunts him, he decides to write for a crime novel, taking him into deep.
Feature film based on the popular video game, Halo.
A singer on a gambling ship is married to a wealthy playboy. When he is found murdered, all evidence points to her as the culprit, and she is put on trial for the crime.

The Jeweller sells wedding rings to a young couple and teaches them some precious truths about the meaning of love and marriage. He also helps another couple fight for their troubled marriage, rebuilding their relationship.
A road trip to North-East India becomes a journey of discovery.

After the success of the first Brazilian space mission, a scientist intends to accomplish an even more audacious feat. His goal is to launch into space the Nationalist rocket II, this time taking two humans to the moon.
A séance proves a ghost compelled a spiritualist to kill his rich father.
A young boy befriends a stranded alien and together they must save Earth from an impending doom.
A fraternity's house burns down forcing them to buy an old mansion with a gruesome past. Their first night might be their last after a series of prank calls escalate.
A prince cursed to spend his days as a hideous monster sets out to regain his humanity by earning a young woman's love.
A guy who moves back to Portland, Oregon becomes involved in the mystery of his ex-girlfriend's disappearance.
Centers on Dracula/Vlad Tepes origins and a new take on his eternal love with Mina.
Venugopal is an honest politician who wants to curb the illegal activities of the mafia dons. However, things take a turn when he gets shot and is replaced by his lookalike as the home minister.
A young girl struggles to win the science fair amidst an absentee mother and a fungal monstrosity of a foster mother.
You can fix violins. You can't fix people.
Amid famine, a woman accused of witchcraft helps a shipwreck but falls for one of the survivors.

Fakharani and Kamal want to marry their sweethearts Faten and Feryal, but their firefighter chief father refuses because of the family's military history. So both guys enroll in the police academy to win his approval.
A talking-animal film about the unconditional love and benefits rescue animals give their owners.

In Africa, 2 expat "brothers" are usually at each other's throats but now have a common enemy. Ormond's men are shooting or catching much of the wildlife for export as well as forcing the locals off their land. Lots of fun fights follow.

A boy kills a man and accuses his twin brother of the murder, and the innocent brother ends up institutionalized, while his psychotic twin goes free. 10 years later, the innocent twin escapes, which triggers his brother into killing again.
A cunning French legal adviser teams up with an unemployed German girl and her sister to commit murders in Marseille.
An artist fails a test and is required to direct traffic in New York City's Holland Tunnel. He winds up falling in love with a beautiful woman, after he takes a trip to the moon on a Lunar Cruiser.
A young couple's romantic weekend away at a remote cottage turns into a harrowing fight for their lives when they are terrorized by an unhinged, homicidal sibling.
A US secret agent is sent to Berlin to pretend to be a spy for the USSR.
Lured by gold, two greedy peasants unknowingly escort a princess and her general across enemy lines.

Sarah, Jasmine, and Lydia always help each other if one is hit by the problem. At one point, Lydia complained to Jasmine and Sarah that she was expecting. The child was the result of his relationship with Christian, Lydia's ex- lover.
Based on the true story of two scuba divers accidentally stranded in shark infested waters after their tour boat has left.

Believing to be able to communicate with his deceased father, a young boy develops psychic powers where he uses them to try to stop supernatural forces threatening his family and friends, especially a possessed ventriloquist dummy.
After her uncle's death, a 14-year-old girl must speak on his behalf against a proposed pipeline that would bring oil tanker traffic to the waters around her hometown in British Columbia.
A brother and a sister live on the borderline between awareness of their actions and total unconsciousness, until they commit a sin from which there is no return.

movie_name: Banshee Blacktop, an Irish Ghost Story
synopsis: A drifter is picked up by police in connection with the disappearance of a young couple on a remote, windswept island months before. But the drifter turns the table on their investigation and relates a tale of madness and the supernatural.
The Maltese Murder Mystery tells the compelling story of human frailties and the lengths to which people will go both to conceal and, perhaps even more harmful, to hide from the truth.
Based on actual events, a group of college students are terrorized by a mysterious entity after moving into an historic house off campus.
King Henry II tests the loyalty and honor of his son Richard sending him to a hellish prison. In prison Richard must fight against adversaries representing the virtues of a knight.

Jorge is eleven years old his mother hopes for a pension that never comes to pay off debts with Mr. Matías, who threatens her with jail if she doesn't get paid soon. Jorge tries to assassinate him to free his mother from such a fate.
A woman, along with her lover, plans to con a rich man by marrying him, earning his trust, and then running away with all his money. Everything goes as planned until she falls in love with him.
With its loud acting style, exuberant sets and stunning shots in pastel colours, this Thai cult film is as much a parody as an homage to the Western and the romantic tearjerker.
North Korea sends a group of secret agents to kidnap Dr Jeong, a scientist, but South Korean agents get wind of the plot ant take steps to thwart it.

AGNI, a doctor and native Balinese prepares her wedding reception with her fiance, NICO. A beheading case is linked to a supernatural disturbance has befallen the troubled couple. A tale of love, jealousy and a mythical Bali Legend.
A man who killed the son of the owner of the land they worked on for hanging on his wife, bury him in the barn. From this moment on, a spiritually tense process begins for the man and his wife.
When a teenager is shot at the beach, a journalist from The Miami Journal is sent to cover the story. He's called by the murderer and told there'll be four more.
A reunion between 4 friends quickly goes awry when they find themselves face to face with Erzulie the swamp mermaid goddess.

Katya and her fiancé Andrey- successful young banker, fly to Malta on holiday. At the diving center they accidentally meet Max - professional diver, secretly engaged in black archaeology and, concurrently,is Katya's ex boyfriend.

Following twelve years in a mental hospital, former child detective Billy Argo is plagued by mysterious clues that call back to an unsolved case from his childhood -- the disappearance of his younger sister.
While serenading a wedding that quickly implodes, o nomadic musician falls for the bride, who runs afoul of her family. Now he has to save her life.

Kaala Mandir is a story of an innocent girl who forced to work in the in the sex trade and when she runs away she is raped by her madams goons. A tantrik finds her body and infuses life into her body with his magic powers.

A horror film with surreal language and social criticism on child abuse in Brazil.
With the help of a magic ticket, a young movie fan is transported into the fictional world of his favorite action movie character.

Death, who takes the form of a young man killed in an accident, asks a media mogul to act as his guide to teach him about life on Earth and, in the process, he falls in love with the mogul's daughter.

When Aryong, the daughter of a triad boss from Hong Kong is accused of killing the boss of a competing triad, she is goes into hiding in Korea. Upon arriving, she is guided by a nimble but loyal Gi-chul and his motley crew, who are assigned to protect her until her return.
Teenage vigilantes kill a drug pusher only to have him return as a zombie.
An adventure story centered on the search for a mystical artifact lost in the heart of Africa.
A respected doctor must race against time to find a cure for a lethal virus, unleashed by a paramilitary militia leader.
A married polish doctor has a lover who disappears at the Battle of the Dardanelles in 1915.

synopsis: When Ryotaro and Momotaros are injured in a fight with an Imagin, Kotaro, Kamen Rider New Den-O, and his Imagin partner Teddy return to help solve the case of a stolen ticket and the mystery of a young woman's doppelganger.
A young Native warrior seeks revenge on the cowboys who killed his buffalo herd.
Two look-a-likes, a mental asylum inmate and a rich businessman, land at places meant for each other.

The noble Liu family are separated when bandits besiege their city, and some treasure goes missing. Many years later, a group of youngsters are tasked with finding the treasure and a Liu family heir. A swordsman gets caught up in the tale.
A story about several people who share the same yard within their block, and a piece of blue sky above 'em.
Two cops, a rookie and a grizzled vet, pursue an accomplished bank robber.
An evil yet adorable Gingerbread man comes to life with the soul of a convicted killer - this real life cookie monster wreaks havoc on the girl who sent the killer to the electric chair.
A woman who learns she is a descendant from a line of powerful witches.
A magician helps outwit a Chinaman's gang.
The screwball cops of Special Vehicles Section 2 Division 2 must investigate and stop a spree of rampaging construction robots.

"Veer-Zaara" is a saga of love, separation, courage, and sacrifice. A love story that is an inspiration and will remain a legend forever.
A recovering drug addict and a synth-gen created soldier struggle to find their place in the world, and how to deal with visions of an apocalypse.

A spark of childhood inspiration causes an autistic man to embark on a quest to collect delicate items. Little does he know that his quest of building a delicate item would unlock the answers to his life and change everything.
A strange black entity from another world bonds with Peter Parker and causes inner turmoil as he contends with new villains, temptations, and revenge.
A pilot battles to save his family and the planet after an experiment for unlimited energy goes wrong.
A small town is entranced by the arrival of a gorgeous family, blinded by the real purpose for their arrival which will only lead to a gory end.
A older man and a young girl assassin duo go on the run.

movie_name: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
synopsis: Two Jedi escape a hostile blockade to find allies and come across a young boy who may bring balance to the Force, but the long dormant Sith resurface to claim their original glory.
Pate has a hard time learning math so he decides to be a rock star, thinking he won't need to study anymore.
A bank teller develops an elaborate game plan to lift money from the vault where she works.

A group of wayward teens are sent to a detention camp in rural North Carolina, where they discover a horrific past among the grounds and its keeper.

A 12-year-old Kansas orphan turns to the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman for help during a difficult time. Things have not gone well in Oz since the Wizard left, the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman must travel to Kansas to find Dorothy

He lingers there, long after he has already departed.
What would you do if the only way to find your freedom would be to deceive everybody, including your own family?
After killing the family of his ruthless enemy, ZENITH, Earth's greatest defender, quits and vanishes.
Iranian Star Wars knockoff about the adventures of two boys in outer space.

A bankrupt contractor tries to steel his ward's rough diamonds, as does her 'dead' brother.
An evil mastermind, known as La mano negra, attempts to steal a formula that creates synthetic drugs but a masked avenger known as La sombra will do anything to stop him.
Sunny Goldilocks the daughter of the infamous Goldee Goldilocks, the villain who made her way off the backs of the innocent people of the Fairytale Kingdom.

Don't try to save yourself!
