In a highly secured prison, 10 prisoners are found dead mysteriously. Erol and Selin are tasked with investigating the murders. The cause of death is the same for all: heart attack. But the truth is utterly different from that.
After a small earthquake in a tiny, quiet town, local citizens start to exhibit bizarre, violent and self-destructive behaviour.

Using Genesis Chapter III of the Old Testament, Chapter III portrays the fall of Eden, through post-modern and surreal elements commenting on man's intrinsically selfish nature and the modern media's commidification of human relationships.

After his wife's death, a baseball star races to uncover a priceless treasure that comes with a secret, and solve a 2,000 year-old mystery dating back to the very first Christmas, the truth about the Star of Bethlehem.

Forced to travel with her boyfriend, Laine begins to experience premonitions associated with the urban myth of The Creeper. She believes that something supernatural has been summoned - and that she is at the center of it all.
A young girl struggles to get back home when she starts inexplicably waking up as a different person everyday.
In 1930s New York City, The Shadow (Alec Baldwin) battles his nemesis, Shiwan Khan (John Lone), who is building an atomic bomb.
A young programmer whose job is to watch over the reality-warping Cube defies orders to rescue an innocent mother trapped in one of its rooms.
An order of Druids train their children to battle an evil Warlock determined to unleash Satan upon the world by bringing a collection of five mystic rune stones together.

Maurice Legrand, a meek cashier married to a nagging wife, has a secret passion: he's a Sunday painter. He falls in love with Lulu, a young woman dominated by Dédé, the pimp who she works for. Dédé pushes Lulu into a relationship with him.
Itzhak Rabin's murder ended all efforts of peace, and with him the whole left wing of Israel died. The movie shows the last of his days as prime minister, and what led to his murder.

Solomon returns home to bury his favorite nephew, who's traffic accident spawns a mystery that no one on either side of the law wants them to solve, pitting Solomon and his legendary crew against the LAPD and the Mob.
The adventures of teenager Max McGrath and his alien companion, Steel, who must harness and combine their tremendous new powers to evolve into the turbo-charged superhero Max Steel.
After the apocalypse, all water is radioactive and deadly to drink. In this dystopian world, Gylian goes to extreme lengths to make sure her daughter gets the medication she needs to survive.
A young gymnast, who tries desperately to please her demanding mother, discovers a strange egg. She hides it and keeps it warm, but when it hatches, what emerges shocks them all.

A struggling theater director uses an old porno theater to rehearse. As one strange occurrence follows the next, it becomes clear that the hall is haunted by a dancer who died in a mysterious theater fire years ago.
The story follows Aidie, a fighter inside and out, as she searches for her son while in the grip of the Church.
When Robert Langdon wakes up in an Italian hospital with amnesia, he teams up with Dr. Sienna Brooks and they race across Europe together against the clock to foil a deadly global plot.

Love Liv or Die is an action-filled, psychological thriller that will leave you on the edge of your seat. Liv is searching for the one thing that she is denied repeatedly. Love. She will do anything to get it, even if you must die.

After a painful encounter with some bullies next to an ant colony, Ant-Drew will never have to fear again, as an improbable, yet miraculous symbiosis begins. Now, he is unstoppable, and he thirsts for revenge. Is this a dream come true?
Somebody with very little Christmas spirit is killing anyone in a Santa suit one London holiday season, and Scotland Yard has to stop him before he makes his exploits an annual tradition.
Three friends reconnect in a secluded mountain town after a long quarantine. While out for a hike, the trio stumble upon something dark and terrible in the deep woods.
Mizuhara did his time in jail for Boss Komori. Now that he is out, the old gang wants to say welcome back with a bullet.
Young Ichabod Crane learns the backstory of the Legendary Headless Horseman before coming face to face with him.
Two criminals organize an ingenious blow to a Genoese bank, subtracting 4 billion lire. The police immediately suspect Francesco Vitale, the lawyer's code name, an elegant and intelligent thief.

movie_name: As Novas Aventuras da Turma da Mônica
synopsis: They are a total of 8 stories lived with the Monica group, which vary in a short time - only 2 or 8 minutes, and are stories that this time rely on the presence of elephant Jotalhão.

A young man hiking deep in the woods finds a female corpse manipulated in a bizarre manner. Shocked by the discovery, the man realizes that he is not alone on the scene. The murderer starts hunting him in order to protect his identity.
A group of young drug dealers commit crimes in a sleazy strip club.
Two boys traveling across the US hoping to start a new life find more then they can handle or even understand when they run into themselves.

A man and his daughter are attacked in the woods by what they believe is a Bigfoot-type creature. However, they soon begin to suspect that they may have stumbled onto a nest of aliens in a hidden spacecraft.

Alone with her thoughts of the Throne and how the Empire has changed over the years, Milcentia knew that the war had just begun. She had to now live up to her name, The Relentless One, as she mercilessly Defended the Throne.
Everybody falls in love. But to fall in love you have to fail in love. So that you can probably and hopefully live that unique love that everybody dreams of.
A group of friendly mental patients find out that their old nurse is being kidnapped. After being reunited they start a rescue party but wreak some havoc along the way to find her.
A group of wannabe ghost hunters set out to shoot a pilot, faking everything, and get more than they bargain for.
While on their journey finding a way home, a group must survive against the advances of an unknown enemy from the darkness.
A young boy and his imaginary friend go on the run after coming into accidental possession of a ruthless drug dealer's stash.

Young-mi makes a wager with her friend, Myeong-hie, that she can seduce the latter's father. Myeong-hie, believing that her father would always remain faithful to her mother, agrees to the wager with disasterous results.

Doctor Palmer, wrongly accused of the murder of a British officer, is a prisoner of the Maharajah of Hasnabad. Doctor Palmer and Gopal, his devoted assistant, escape with the complicity of Amrita, in love with Palmer
A goofy student is taught a lost martial art style by five ghosts.

A small boy abandoned in the jungle and raised by a benevolent group of apes slowly begins to realize that he isn't quite like the rest of his primate family in this touching meditation on the bond shared between man and beast.
A nerdy teenager listens to his darkest thoughts in order to fit in.

Kiz Babasi tells the story of what the taxi driver Adil did in order not to marry his daughter to a man whom he considers dangerous. When it comes to Adil, who is known as the "kiz babasi", what they do about it knows no bounds.
A peaceful New England town hides secrets and scandals.
In his dreams little Tomas escapes from his every day live to experience a lot of thrilling and exciting adventures.

Following the release of a killer that once made small-town Murdock famous, tensions surge as new unsolved murders begin to pile up. Linked to the victims, two spiteful teenage girls decide to pursue justice in their own sadistic way.

Inspired by true events from the 1970s, the story revolves around a young detective who becomes the head of a police unit focused on catching a rampant serial killer of women, nicknamed 'The Silesian Vampire'.
An entire nation's destiny lies in the hands of one man.
A wealthy young girl in Las Vegas getting a divorce from her banker husband becomes involved with a lady gangster and the G-Man that is after the gangster lady and her gang.
Cowboy Jones sets off on a journey to capture his arch nemesis, Bullet-Tooth

This is a unique story about the exact moment of death, at the same time, a thriller about a man trying to save a woman from human traffickers and at the same time it is a story about the Islamic history of humanity.
When two teenage boys play a pirated video game, they become recruited to the service of the lord of war, the father of all conflict and war since the beginning of the earth.
Salih is a night watchman in a town cemetery. He shows up at the guard's shack every afternoon and returns in the morning before sunrise.
JUNE is a 9-year-old orphan girl who shares her body with an ancient supernatural being whose mission is to destroy mankind to allow nature to prevail on earth.
Gagamboy (Spiderboy) is -you guessed it- Spiderman parody. both the main villain and Spiderboy gain their powers by eating radioactive bugs.
A forgotten European Song Contest singer, fading away in a pâté factory, falls in love with a young aspiring boxer. Together they decide to attempt her comeback.

Young Altar's family is massacred by the 'master of fire'. Before loosing his life his father manages to safe him. Altar grows up in captivity nevertheless and is forced to fight for money. But now that he's grown up, he lusts for revenge.

When a home invasion turns into a bloody shoot-out, a pair of ragtag fugitives take refuge in the house of a single mother as they wait on their fiery (and very pregnant) getaway driver to hatch an escape plan in time for a major payday.

The Dead bring their unfinished business of lust and revenge to the door of a romance writer and her new handyman. Veronica arrives naked. Coby has blood on him. Then the Others come. It''ll be a night they won't forget... If they survive.
A woman escapes from police custody in an attempt to prove her innocence and find her husband's real killer.
A courageous boy battles a gang of bumbling thieves to rescue a dog carrying a fortune in stolen diamonds.
A masked man's search for his missing student and the struggles he faces dealing with his horrific past.
A 100% Australian Suspense Thriller filmed in Western Australia. Using the state of the art Red Dragon camera.
A suspense horror film set in a small coastal town where, after a series of gory murders commited by mobs of townspeople against visiting tourists, the corpses begin to come back to life.
A police officer in the future uncovers the deadly secret behind a society that worships youth.
Biagio Bianchetti has an enemy since school, Ottone di Valerio, a classic "son of dad". Otto has always been better than him, he has covered him with failures and made him ridiculous in everything.
A former SAS and MI-5 Operative is called upon by an Old Military friend to investigate the suspicious suicide of his Daughter.
When an assassin is diagnosed with terminal cancer, she decides to carry out one final killing, assisted by her lover and stepson, Mikey.
In this landmark collaboration between activist and actress Ruby Dee and director Jules Dassin, Black revolutionaries are betrayed by one of their own. Based on the 1935 classic "The Informer."
After their world is destroyed, and their princess has been kidnapped, Mario and Luigi hunt down an evil wizard hellbent to destroy the Mushroom Kingdom.
A pair of novice kidnappers accidentally abduct the wrong girl, and find their lives are in danger when they discover their victim's boyfriend is a vicious serial killer.

In the 70s, Hong Kong enacted a policy that granted each male heir of New Territories villagers the privilege to build a house without paying any dues. Since then, those grants have become a commodity that village leaders can profit from.
A classic western - except, in this region of the world all the positions of power are held by women and all the prostitutes and laborers are men.
When a man comes home one night after being dead for 2 weeks, he must research the science behind why he's alive while dealing with the impact on his loved ones.
Brian Hawke of the Royal Navy versus the pirates of Madagascar.
Two people live in different times. Seo-Yeon lives in the present and Young-Sook lives in the past. One phone call connects the two, and their lives are changed irrevocably.
A young girl finds out some disturbing supernatural truths about her father, who has been a suspect to multiple murder cases.

When the protection of preserved land is lifted against all warnings to enable commercial use, men start to turn up dead. A torn family must join forces, before the past and the mystical creatures responsible can be put to rest.
A vigilante serial killer is stalking, killing and burying those he has judged guilty and anyone in this corrupt beach town could be next.
Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.
An orphan named Oliver Twist meets a pickpocket on the streets of London. From there, he joins a household of boys who are trained to steal for their master.
In a neon city plagued by crime, a revenge-crazed girl seeks vengeance for the cult murder of her father.
A boxer saves a girl from a noble kidnapper.
A futuristic version of the novel The Count of Monte Cristo.

The Village Hidden in the Leaves is home to the stealthiest ninja in the land. But twelve years earlier, a fearsome Nine-tailed Fox terrorized the Village before it was subdued and its spirit sealed with in the body of baby boy-Naruto.
A man trapped in an automated prison must outsmart a computer in order to escape.
A cheeky fairy named Violetta gets lost into the human world. To go back to the fairy world, She meets and teams up with a 12-year-old girl named Maxie and discovers her true destiny.
After being the only survivor of an airplane crash, a young girl is convinced everyone dead during the incident is still alive and will fight to prove this feeling.
When his new neighbour turns out to be the wizard Merlin, young Ben Clark is enlisted in an ancient battle to save the world.
Four kids on their annual summer camp holiday suspect the park's mascot has been murdered so they set out to investigate who killed Nelson Nutmeg?
A young teenage girl is hired by a strange couple to watch their baby for the night. What the babysitter doesn't know is how strange the couple is, and exactly what kind of baby she is watching over.
Shadows of a tortured past will weave their destiny / A film that looks at the aftermath of bullying.

The Street Angels are always at work. Raphael, a street Angel, arrives to collect his next assignment, only to be given a message that he can take a holiday for the first time in eons...if he can catch the train on time..
Ex-con turned "scrapper" Jake leads a quiet life caring for his family until he is pursued by violent Punjabi and Mexican criminals following a botched robbery.

movie_name: In the Light of the Night
synopsis: A troubled carpenter takes a job restoring an old water mill in the woods, but it hides secrets that will resonate with her mysterious past
Frank lands himself in trouble when he becomes involved in organ trafficking with a group of gangsters and tries to help out his Russian girlfriend's father who is diagnosed with a kidney disease.
A single mom decides to follow her dreams when she meets a charming country music singer who becomes her inspiration, and more.

A Production Company rents a Manor as their new office. It's an uneasy place with ancient gravestones at the yard and a scarface keeper. They prepare for celebration at their new place. However, some evil forces are in preparation aswell.
A team of armed services veterans jump back into action to save one of their own who was captured.

In order to defeat the Dark Legion, an anxious squire follows a weary wizard through mystical ruins and struggles to adhere the lessons of manhood while nearing Excalibur. Based on the King Arthur legends.
A fight between good and evil in a deceptive world.
A superstitious mother is convinced that her daughter's new boyfriend is the reincarnation of a man who tried to kill her 30 years ago.
Schizo the Clown is jovial one minute, angry the next. Either way he's a deadly mass murderer using clown tricks to kill his victims. But whatever you do, don't call him "Clowny".

The story of CJ, a teenager in search of his brother's killer. As he gets closer to the truth he finds that everyone involved is not as innocent as they seem - and he's forced to consider if "apathy" is the only way to survive.

Beach-stand operator Sam Barlow's life was meant to be sunny, simple and predictable and it might have been only he delivers a letter to his mate Jack Fields. This easy errand leads Jack to his death and Sam in search of the truth.
When a park ranger tells two bear cubs about Christmas and Santa Claus, they want to skip hibernation to celebrate, but their mother doesn't believe in Saint Nick and wants them to sleep.
A film with idiotic prince and Rita Mitsouko who records a new album.
A hip hop dance film featuring Filipino world class dance champions and inspired by the music of Francis Magalona.
Kenan is a brainless detective, he is sent to solve a complicated murder case.
Greg Heffley is an ambitious kid with an active imagination and big plans to be rich and famous. The problem is that he has to survive middle school first.
A gay disabled teenage boy changes into the body of a beautiful woman, so that he can be loved.
In the International Modeling World...there's a thin line between comedy and reality.
When a gentlewoman is found dead with her throat torn out, the villagers blame a supernatural monster. But Sherlock Holmes, who gets drawn into the case from nearby Quebec, suspects a human murderer.
When Ramu becomes a cop and is posted in an area ruled by a gangster, he has to undergo nightmarish trials and tribulations in order to serve justice.
A conspiracy nut discovers a startling truth while casually trawling the internet for time travel urban legends.
An American fashion photographer and his entourage start behaving in a completely different way than usual when they visit an island paradise, where they experience passion and ancient rituals.
Nicholas, an aspiring video game developer, decides to share the progress of his first project, but all quickly takes a turn when the creation begins taking on a mind of its own.
Policeman Galo's mission is to catch a heavy syndicate but because of his mission, his family may be affected. Can he solve everything without harming anyone?
Gangsters try to locate a car that includes a special chip.
Three friends stumble upon the horrific origins of a mysterious figure they discover is the root cause of the evil behind unspeakable acts.
A troubled evangelical minister agrees to let his last exorcism be filmed by a documentary crew.

movie_name: Kamen Rider Den-O & Kiva: Climax Deka
synopsis: Ryoutaro and the DenLiner gang have set up a detective agency called the DenLiner Police who seek to catch the Imagin that stole a spare Den-O pass from Owner and find the Imagin who has built a crime syndicate with human criminals.
A human child raised by wolves must face off against a menacing tiger named Shere Khan, as well as his own origins.

The story of the disappearance of Francis, a beautiful young bank teller missing since her car was found submerged in a river in 1974. She has become the subject of myth and legend, and the town and townspeople have never been the same.

Eve Black finds a job as a dancer in a shady night club to find out more about the mysterious death of her sister, who danced there before she died. The club is using girls for a strange drug experiment, so she asks a cop for help.

movie_name: Nove Crônicas para um Coração aos Berros
synopsis: In a mosaic of human relationships and day-to-day situations, men and women of different ages feel a pressing need to reinvent themselves. As they cross each other's paths, they all are at a turning point in their lives.
The story of the Women's Auxiliary Ferrying Squadron, a unit of female pilots during WW II who flew bombers from the factories to their final destinations.

Prabhakaran, a sincere police officer, is assigned to find Veerabhadran, a sandalwood smuggler around Tamilnadu-Karnataka border. On his mission he unfolds the mystery of Veerabhadran and finds the true culprits behind his actions.
A Mexican parrot named Cuco sets off on an adventure to defend his family.

John Logan leaves his parents and sweetheart in bucolic Happy Valley to make his fortune in the city. Those he left behind become miserable and beleaguered in his absence, but after several years he returns, a wealthy man.
A man who specialises in debunking paranormal occurrences checks into the fabled room 1408 in the Dolphin Hotel. Soon after settling in, he confronts genuine terror.
A girl becomes envious of her friend's stable family life and her resentment against her own heartless father grows
A family of sadistic butchers has dug into the back country and, from the deep freeze of winter to the dog days of summer, anyone who crosses their path is dead meat.
After his teenage daughter goes missing, a desperate father tries to find clues on her laptop.
Police detectives investigate the apparent serial killing of several children, after finding severed hands.

Cole, a former marine has a murky vocation - in the depths of the ocean he retrieves smuggled contraband in service of a debt and a past not of his making. A fated discovery leads to Helen, and he seems to come alive again until her own past resurfaces in a dark and violent way.
Biopic about the great college football coach Paul "Bear" Bryant of the University of Alabama.
A jilted fan soon finds himself pulled into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse after he accepts the opportunity to spy on his favorite actress via his laptop.

One day, Dual and Dorothy discover a new virus attacking a girl. They save the girl and wait for her to awaken, and when she does, she calls herself "Remo" and has only one thing to say: "I have to return to the flower garden..."
Captain Chadwell, Lieutenant Junger and Sergeant Smith are sent by Washington to help their colleagues of Fort Apache to recover stolen arms. A bounty hunter accompanies them.
Two young men find their inherited rivalry exacerbated by a woman with whom they form a love triangle.
The sixth voyage of Sinbad the Sailor.
Abandoning the yoga business she shares with her twin sister, Celeste sets out to forge her own identity, but her plans are derailed when her desperate twin stops at nothing to bring her home.
Life changes for a thirtysomething career woman when a coin she threw in a magic fountain as a girl finally reaches the bottom.

The most sought after woman in Hollywood inconveniently falls in love at the pinnacle of her career. She attempts to live a double life between her new lover and her famous colleagues. Love or career?
The Lone Wolf tracks down Nazi spies in London during the German bombing.
When two people head down a river to retrieve their boss' hydrochloric acid barrel, they run into too many obstacles to return with it and have to face the consequences.
During a stormy night in the past century, the one named "the witch" is about to give birth. Mrs. Gelinas and Toussaint Brodeur are assisting her in the process.
The Eternal Warrior has protected the Earth for more than 10,000 years from The Immortal Enemy - a monstrous, civilization killer.

The zombified leaders of the free world rise from the dead to hunt down a group of ill-fated teens and give them a lethal lesson in American history. Their only hope for survival is to summon the demonic spirit of John Wilkes Booth.
A demon raised from infancy after being conjured by and rescued from the Nazis, grows up to become a defender against the forces of darkness.
Three intergalactic beauties beam down off the California coast and have close encounters with three local beach boys.
An orphan who lives with his two cruel aunts befriends anthropomorphic bugs who live inside a giant peach, and they embark on a journey to New York City.
A Spanish politician whose high-class lifestyle is based on nefarious and illegal business threatens to break his entire party after a newspaper expose him to the public eye.
After consuming liquor, four friends decide to do something interesting and visit a haunted bungalow. However, they do not realize that they have returned home with an evil spirit.
Kuttan Pillai lives with his wife in a rural village and has an obsession with the jack fruit tree in his yard. During the Shivaratri festival, something strange happens that forms the main story.
A Secret Service agent protecting a Presidential nominee from a stalker uncovers a dark truth that could tear the country apart.
Remake of the 1956 film noir film "Beyond a Reasonable Doubt" in which a writer's plan to expose a corrupt district attorney takes an unexpected turn.
Explores the tangled relationship between a troubled private investigator and the missing woman he's hired to help find.
The story of a warrior living in the Ottoman period.
Rudra, a small-time burglar gets into a palace full of ghosts. Along with the ghost, she finds out the mystery about the owner of the palace- Annabelle Sethupathi.

Andrei, a detective and the world's most horrible father, brings together a terrible group of people in his apartment: his resentful actress daughter, an angry thug, and a cheated cop. Each one of them has a reason to want revenge..

Lupinrangers are abducted by someone from a parallel universe. The Patrangers arrested Lucky who just arrived at the scene of the investigation. Lucky then tried to explain that he's a member of the Kyuranger and the Earth is in danger.
A swashbuckling Irishman opposes French agents during the Napoleonic wars.

At an international school in Jakarta, a philosophy teacher challenges his class of twenty graduating seniors to choose which ten of them would take shelter underground and reboot the human race in the event of a nuclear apocalypse.

Guy Miller is on parolee and trying to rehabilitate his life, but circumstances bring him back to the dangerous Atlanta. And he must live up to his reputation as one of the slickest street operators in a deadly race against the clock.
In order to pass as human and blend in with society, a ghost couple need to drink virgin blood every full moon.
An MP's disowned son weds a factory girl and saves her from her stepfather's dope den.

A group of people find themselves trapped in a creepy mansion, complete with secret passageways, a mad doctor and a murderous gorilla.

In Los Angeles, a fallen soldier who has joined the ranks of the living dead reunites with his best friend in order to deal with the city's drug dealers and killers - a perfect way to collect the blood that one of them so desperately needs.
A reboot of Kamen Rider (1971) to celebrate its 50th anniversary.
Unable to satisfy his sexual desires with his wife, Biu regularly visits prostitutes, ties up and tortures them in various ways before killing them.
Action Adventure - based on a true story. Freediver Danai Varveri's epic struggle to become champion of the world.
Death has many faces. The newest entry into the Faces of the Dead anthology series is ready to reveal all of them. From the brilliant, twisted mind of Director/Writer Kyle Rappaport.
A director falls into insanity because of the films he is making, and we follow his attempt at making his last film, an anthology of surreal films.
A mother stops at nothing to recover her kidnapped son.
An ex-mercenary is forced out of isolation when three mysterious men kidnap and brainwash the city's children afflicted with the Geostigma disease.
An alien trying to escape from NASA is befriended by a wheelchair-bound boy.

A young man's desperate attempt to win over a girl's affections, results in him requiring the help of a mysterious woman, who has a strange connection to a magician, who can travel between parallel universes.
A couple who participated in a potent medical experiment gain telepathic ability and then have a child who is pyrokinetic.

movie_name: Sint & Diego en de Magische Bron van Myra
synopsis: A group of elite helpers begin an adventure in search of a magical source to prevent the Book of Sinterklaas losing it's power.

The domination of social media which paves the way for opportunities for everyone to express their thoughts and opinions freely not only provided vast benefit to the audience but it also created waves of disaster in the society.
A SWAT team transporting a vicious crime syndicate boss must fight their way out of a county detention center during a catastrophic alien invasion.

Precocious 12 year-old Stanley lives in a small town and yearns for more excitement in his life. He's a budding magician, and by an act of fate, acquires the "magical" Cape of the Great Houdin, and some dark forces will kill to get it.
Adam is stuck. Anxious. Alone. Trapped in a nine to five. Lost without purpose, he meets Eva. As she enters Adam's life, something changes, and a new reality awakens him.
In a parallel universe two great Argentinian icons, Carlos Gardel & Diego Maradona have the chance of a million to meet face to face.
Elias ran away from his village at the age of 13. Time has passed and he is now a doctor with a wife and son, who is also now 13.Miracles do not exist. The day that souls are reunited has come.
An encounter specialist loses his wife because of terrorists. Later, he is sent on a mission to catch hold of a big terrorist.
Injured and lost in the deep woods, a father and his estranged son face-off against the elements and each other's belief system in their desperate struggle to survive in the wild.
A college professor and game theorist becomes involved in a large-scale global incident.
A retired thief swears revenge on the lunatic who murdered his brother and partner, while going on the run with the loot they stole.

A man is brutally injured in a car accident that leaves him unable to walk while his wife is pregnant. He then tries to find out if the accident was intentional, leaving him and his wife endanger from a possible threat from his past.
Plot under wraps.
Exotic vehicle for the singer-dancer-model-actress Dalida, winner of the Miss Egypt beauty contest of 1954, who the French painter-director Gastyne discovered.
A student must face off against bullies and overcome hurdles, both academic and romantic, to win his college's coveted Student of the Year trophy.
A private detective tries to find a missing girl, who disappeared during a mysterious scientific research.

An ancient legend sends a group of people on an adventurous trip into the jungle where they are threatened by a powerful secretly operating organization. They all search for the same mysterious object - but with very different goals.
An elliptical tale of three couples who are magnetically drawn together. Love becomes electric as they struggle to connect, disconnect, or reconnect with their partner.
NON ROWDY, the movie chronicles the journey of the young boy who is trying to find a balance between the harsh society and yet want to achieve his dreams

movie_name: Alone: The Only Thing to Fear Is Yourself
synopsis: A man loses his house, his job, his woman and his mind. In the course of 24-hours, he will only win one back!
A radio station in the Deep South becomes the focal point of a right-wing conspiracy.
Feature film based on the children's book about a crocodile that lives in New York City.
After inadvertently destroying the orb that keeps his friend Pixy young, a boy must travel through a magical realm to save the elf's life.
Get caught up in the tale of a new stock broker who dreams of becoming rich. Those dreams make him susceptible to a stock market scam that threatens to get him in trouble.

A tormented detective tracks a religious serial killer, who's recreating the experiments of an insane 18th century scientist, trying to prove the existence of an afterlife - and his final target is the detective's wife.
An ambitious insurance saleswoman is stalked by by the strange and supernatural after meeting a mysterious man named Mitsuru.

A stood-up bride uses her lawyer as a stand-in groom for her absent and unreliable fiancé, hoping to get a quick divorce after the media interest dies down. In time, she realizes she may have wed the right man, but it might be too late.

In 1971 rural Kentucky, uptight schoolboy Christopher Robin discovers the joys of childhood in the orbit of a curious girl named Winnie Saunders, her menagerie of peculiar friends, and the unique manner in which they see their world.
An idealistic doctor must make some hard choices between his dedication to the profession and his personal life.
Three friends host a house party only to capture a bizarre event on camera that leads them too an abandoned house occupied by a demonic entity will they escape .
Follows a naive merman prince, who juggles life between the ocean, the only home he's ever known, and his new life on land in Tampa, Florida.
A mysterious deadly vapor suffocates a small American coal town. Based on actual events.

Anthology movie about three owners of a yellow Rolls-Royce. A British diplomat buys the car for his French wife. A mobster's girlfriend has an affair in Italy. An American woman drives a Yugoslavian partisan
A celebratory cliff jump turns to a nightmare injury which turns to a fight for survival on a remote island with no way up or out.
Jack Santos is a retired detective who is out to punish the men responsible for the murder of his mother, wife, and daughter.
An elderly man is murdered in his lavish Italian castle. When his friends and family arrive there for the reading of his will, the murderer has plans to continue his gory killing spree.
A beautiful female psychiatrist is brutally raped by someone disguised in a strange and exotic fashion - and left for dead at the foot of a precipice. Will someone find her and save her life?

A troubled girl, sentenced to community service on a ranch, bonds with a horse there. Her folks suggest that she enters the championship, but both she and the horse get seriously injured in a car accident.
A family living in a futuristic alternate universe tries to take down an evil dictator.
After Suzanne's wealthy fiance takes back his ring and makes it clear he used her, she's determined to use men in a similar way.

A first time PI follows his partners files on a serial killer that hides his murders as accidents; all the while trying to balance his work and personal life from colliding as an old friend reenters his life.
